WITH sales_agg AS (
  SELECT
    c_bill.c_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
    ca_bill.ca_state AS billing_state,
    w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
    tcs.t_hour AS hour_of_day,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) + SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS num_catalog_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS num_store_tickets
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN time_dim tcs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = tcs.t_time_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN customer c_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer c_ship ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = tcs.t_time_sk
  JOIN customer c_ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca_ss ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ss ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
  WHERE
    c_bill.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1990
    AND ca_bill.ca_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY')
    AND ca_ship.ca_location_type = 'single family'
    AND hd_bill.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
    AND ib.ib_upper_bound > 50000
    AND tcs.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
    AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
    AND c_ship.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    AND c_ss.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
  GROUP BY
    ROLLUP (c_bill.c_customer_sk, ca_bill.ca_state, w.w_warehouse_name, tcs.t_hour)
),
state_hour_agg AS (
  SELECT
    billing_state,
    hour_of_day,
    SUM(total_sales) AS sum_sales,
    AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales,
    COUNT(*) AS grp_cnt
  FROM sales_agg
  WHERE billing_state IS NOT NULL AND hour_of_day IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY billing_state, hour_of_day
)
SELECT
  sha.billing_state,
  sha.hour_of_day,
  sha.sum_sales,
  sha.avg_sales,
  t.metric_value,
  CASE t.metric_index
    WHEN 1 THEN 'sum_sales'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'avg_sales'
  END AS metric_type,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM state_hour_agg sha2
    WHERE sha2.billing_state = sha.billing_state
      AND sha2.sum_sales > sha.sum_sales
  ) AS higher_sum_groups
FROM state_hour_agg sha
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[sha.sum_sales, sha.avg_sales]) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(metric_value, metric_index)
WHERE sha.sum_sales > (
  SELECT AVG(sha3.sum_sales)
  FROM state_hour_agg sha3
  WHERE sha3.billing_state = sha.billing_state
)
ORDER BY sha.sum_sales DESC, sha.billing_state
LIMIT 100
queries.goal: Aggregate catalog and store sales per customer, state, warehouse and hour, then roll‑up to state‑hour totals, compute sum and average metrics, filter with a correlated subquery, expand metrics via UNNEST, and return the top 100 rows.

queries.sql:
WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        S.s_store_id,
        S.s_state,
        S.s_number_employees,
        P.p_promo_id,
        P.p_discount_active,
        CC.cc_country,
        W.w_state,
        I.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        SS.ss_net_profit,
        CS.cs_net_profit,
        WS.ws_net_profit,
        SR.sr_net_loss,
        CR.cr_net_loss,
        SS.ss_quantity,
        CS.cs_quantity,
        WS.ws_quantity
    FROM customer_demographics CD
    JOIN store_sales SS ON SS.ss_cdemo_sk = CD.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store S ON SS.ss_store_sk = S.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion P ON SS.ss_promo_sk = P.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_address CA ON SS.ss_addr_sk = CA.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store_returns SR ON SR.sr_ticket_number = SS.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN reason R ON SR.sr_reason_sk = R.r_reason_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales CS ON CS.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = CD.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN call_center CC ON CS.cs_call_center_sk = CC.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode SM ON CS.cs_ship_mode_sk = SM.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse W ON CS.cs_warehouse_sk = W.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns CR ON CR.cr_order_number = CS.cs_order_number
    JOIN inventory I ON I.inv_warehouse_sk = W.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales WS ON WS.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = CD.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page WP ON WS.ws_web_page_sk = WP.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site WEB ON WS.ws_web_site_sk = WEB.web_site_sk
    WHERE
        S.s_state = 'CA'
        AND P.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND CC.cc_country = 'United States'
        AND W.w_state = 'CA'
        AND I.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        AND SS.ss_quantity > 0
        AND WS.ws_quantity > 0
),
agg_by_store_promo AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        p_promo_id,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_net_profit,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_net_profit,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_sales_net_profit,
        SUM(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_net_loss,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS catalog_returns_net_loss,
        SUM(ss_quantity) AS store_quantity,
        SUM(cs_quantity) AS catalog_quantity,
        SUM(ws_quantity) AS web_quantity
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY s_store_id, p_promo_id
),
store_summary AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        SUM(store_sales_net_profit + catalog_sales_net_profit + web_sales_net_profit
            - store_returns_net_loss - catalog_returns_net_loss) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(store_quantity + catalog_quantity + web_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM agg_by_store_promo
    GROUP BY s_store_id
    HAVING SUM(store_sales_net_profit + catalog_sales_net_profit + web_sales_net_profit
            - store_returns_net_loss - catalog_returns_net_loss) > 10000
),
high_profit_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_id FROM store_summary WHERE total_net_profit > 50000
),
low_profit_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_id FROM store_summary WHERE total_net_profit < 20000
)
SELECT
    ss.s_store_id,
    ss.total_net_profit,
    ss.total_quantity
FROM store_summary ss
WHERE ss.s_store_id IN (
    SELECT s_store_id FROM high_profit_stores
    EXCEPT
    SELECT s_store_id FROM low_profit_stores
)
ORDER BY ss.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100
queries.goal: Analyze profit performance across stores and promotions, combining sales and return data from all TPC‑DS sources, then isolate high‑profit stores while excluding low‑profit ones.

WITH promo_returns_breakfast AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name AS i_product_name,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS distinct_promos
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
      AND t.t_meal_time = 'breakfast'
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name
    HAVING SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 10
),
promo_returns_dinner AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name AS i_product_name,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS distinct_promos
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p

    WHERE p.p_channel_email = 'Y'

    HAVING SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 10

    distinct_promos
FROM (
    SELECT i_item_id AS item_id,
           i_product_name AS product_name,
           total_net_loss,
           distinct_promos

WITH agg_returns AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_manufact,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_amt_inc_tax,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        (SELECT AVG(wr2.wr_net_loss)
         FROM web_returns wr2
         WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_net_loss_item
    FROM web_returns wr
    RIGHT JOIN item i
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c
        ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE i.i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Music', 'Children')
      AND i.i_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND (wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax > 500 OR wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax IS NULL)
      AND (wr.wr_fee BETWEEN 30 AND 80 OR wr.wr_fee IS NULL)
      AND (c.c_birth_month = 5 OR c.c_birth_month IS NULL)
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_manufact,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag
)
SELECT
    ar.i_item_id,
    ar.i_product_name,
    ar.i_category,
    ar.i_manufact,
    ar.c_customer_id,
    ar.c_first_name,
    ar.c_last_name,
    CASE
        WHEN ar.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 'Preferred'
        WHEN ar.c_preferred_cust_flag IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Regular'
    END AS customer_segment,
    ar.total_net_loss,
    ar.total_return_qty,
    ar.avg_return_amt_inc_tax,
    ar.avg_net_loss_item,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.i_category ORDER BY ar.total_net_loss DESC) AS category_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN ar.total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'HighLoss'
        WHEN ar.total_net_loss > 500 THEN 'MediumLoss'
        ELSE 'LowLoss'
    END AS net_loss_category
FROM agg_returns ar
ORDER BY ar.i_category, category_rank

/*
  Goal: Identify product IDs that appear in both catalog returns (for a selected set of brands and the DEPARTMENT catalog page) and store returns with a high net loss (> $100). This highlights items that generate returns across channels. Results are ordered by product ID and paginated to the first 10 rows.
*/
WITH catalog_returns_items AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_department
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department
        FROM catalog_page cp
        WHERE cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cr.cr_catalog_page_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) cp
    WHERE i.i_brand_id IN (1002001, 2004002, 6016006)
      AND cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_department
),
store_returns_items AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        i.i_formulation
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_net_loss > 100
      AND i.i_formulation LIKE 'thistle%'
    GROUP BY
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_formulation
)
SELECT i_item_id
FROM catalog_returns_items
INTERSECT
SELECT i_item_id
FROM store_returns_items
ORDER BY i_item_id
LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0

SELECT
    s.s_store_name AS store_name,
    p.p_promo_name AS promotion_name,
    d_sales.d_year AS sales_year,
    cd.cd_gender AS gender,
    hd.hd_buy_potential AS buy_potential,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS unique_customers,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt), 0) AS total_returns,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount
FROM
    store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
JOIN
    date_dim d_sales
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN
    customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN
    customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN
    customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN
    household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN
    promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN
    date_dim d_promo
        ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo.d_date_sk
JOIN
    store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN
    store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
       AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN
    web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN
    web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
WHERE
    NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND sr2.sr_return_quantity > 0
    )
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    d_sales.d_year,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_buy_potential
HAVING
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 100000
ORDER BY
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_returns AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        wp.wp_type,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_tax,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        CASE
            WHEN wr.wr_return_amt >= 1000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN wr.wr_return_amt >= 500 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS amt_category,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY wr.wr_return_amt DESC) AS rn_state
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_r
        ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_r.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM household_demographics hd_f
        WHERE hd_f.hd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk
          AND hd_f.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
          AND hd_f.hd_buy_potential = '501-1000'
    )
      AND wr.wr_return_amt > 500
      AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        wp_type,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(wr_return_amt) > 5000 THEN 'HighTotal'
            ELSE 'LowTotal'
        END AS total_category
    FROM base_returns
    GROUP BY ca_state, wp_type
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
),
top_returns AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        wp_type,
        wr_return_amt AS total_return_amt,
        1 AS return_cnt,
        amt_category AS total_category
    FROM base_returns
    WHERE rn_state <= 3
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    wp_type,
    total_return_amt,
    return_cnt,
    total_category
FROM aggregated
UNION ALL
SELECT
    ca_state,
    wp_type,
    total_return_amt,
    return_cnt,
    total_category
FROM top_returns
ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

WITH
  store_agg AS (
    SELECT
      d.d_date AS sale_date,
      hd.hd_buy_potential,
      SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
      SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_transactions,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
      END AS profit_category,
      (
        SELECT AVG(sr2.sr_return_quantity)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
      ) AS metric_value
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
      ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE d.d_current_month = 'Y'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
    GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, hd.hd_buy_potential
  ),
  web_agg AS (
    SELECT
      d_sold.d_date AS sale_date,
      hd.hd_buy_potential,
      SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
      SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_transactions,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 20000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) BETWEEN 0 AND 20000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
      END AS profit_category,
      (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wp2.wp_url)
        FROM web_page wp2
        WHERE wp2.wp_creation_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
      ) AS metric_value
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
      ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
      ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_current_month = 'Y'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
    GROUP BY d_sold.d_date_sk, d_sold.d_date, hd.hd_buy_potential
  )
SELECT
  sale_date,
  hd_buy_potential,
  total_sales,
  total_profit,
  distinct_transactions,
  profit_category,
  metric_value,
  channel
FROM (
  SELECT
    sale_date,
    hd_buy_potential,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    distinct_transactions,
    profit_category,
    metric_value,
    'Store' AS channel
  FROM store_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sale_date,
    hd_buy_potential,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    distinct_transactions,
    profit_category,
    metric_value,
    'Web' AS channel
  FROM web_agg
) combined
ORDER BY sale_date DESC, channel
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE lvl_seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM lvl_seq WHERE lvl < 5
), agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sum_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 1
      AND cs.cs_ext_tax > 10
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost >= 20
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 100
    GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
             cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
             cs.cs_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    ca.ca_state,
    sm.sm_type,
    p.p_promo_name,
    agg.sum_sales,
    agg.sum_profit,
    agg.cnt,
    lvl_seq.lvl,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY agg.sum_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(agg.sum_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY agg.sum_profit DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sales
FROM agg_sales agg
CROSS JOIN lvl_seq
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON agg.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sm.sm_ship_mode_sk, sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier
    FROM ship_mode sm
    WHERE sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = agg.cs_ship_mode_sk
) AS sm
JOIN promotion p
  ON agg.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'NY', 'FL')
  AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
  AND sm.sm_type = 'EXPRESS'
  AND ca.ca_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5 AND 1
  AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
  AND agg.cs_bill_addr_sk NOT IN (
      SELECT ca2.ca_address_sk
      FROM customer_address ca2
      WHERE ca2.ca_state = 'TX'
  )
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (ca.ca_state, sm.sm_type, p.p_promo_name, agg.sum_sales, agg.sum_profit, agg.cnt, lvl_seq.lvl),
    (ca.ca_state, sm.sm_type, agg.sum_sales, agg.sum_profit, agg.cnt, lvl_seq.lvl),
    (sm.sm_type, agg.sum_sales, agg.sum_profit, agg.cnt, lvl_seq.lvl),
    (agg.sum_sales, agg.sum_profit, agg.cnt, lvl_seq.lvl)
)
ORDER BY profit_rank, ca.ca_state
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE warehouse_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT inv.inv_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
           1 AS level
    FROM inventory inv
    GROUP BY inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wh.warehouse_sk,
           wh.level + 1
    FROM warehouse_hierarchy wh
    WHERE wh.level < 3
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           i.i_brand AS brand,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_count,
           'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse_hierarchy wh ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = wh.warehouse_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND ca.ca_state = 'TX'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 300
      AND cc.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
      AND cc.cc_tax_percentage < 5.00
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_site ws
          WHERE ws.web_state = 'CA'
            AND ws.web_tax_percentage < 4.50
      )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_brand
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           i.i_brand AS brand,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_count,
           'web' AS source
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse_hierarchy wh ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = wh.warehouse_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_type = 'Content'
      AND wsite.web_country = 'United States'
      AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 300
      AND wsite.web_tax_percentage < 5.00
      AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_brand
)
SELECT *
FROM catalog_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM web_agg
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        d.d_day_name,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '2023-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        nd.d_date_sk,
        nd.d_date,
        nd.d_year,
        nd.d_month_seq,
        nd.d_day_name,
        dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim nd ON nd.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dh.d_date)
    WHERE nd.d_date <= DATE '2023-01-31'
),

sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > 0
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr
          WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
            AND sr.sr_return_amt > 100
      )
),

pages_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_description,
        cp.cp_type,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id
    FROM catalog_page cp
    WHERE regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)discount')
      AND cp.cp_type LIKE 'S%'
)
SELECT
    d.d_year,
    d.d_month_seq,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    p.cp_department,
    SUM(s.cs_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(s.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
    AVG(s.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
    MAX(CONCAT(w.w_warehouse_name, ' - ', p.cp_department)) AS warehouse_dept,
    MIN(SUBSTRING(p.cp_description FROM 1 FOR 30)) AS short_descr,
    MIN(CAST(regexp_extract(p.cp_catalog_page_id, '(\\d+)$', 1) AS INTEGER)) AS catalog_page_num
FROM sales_filtered s
JOIN date_hierarchy d ON s.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN pages_filtered p ON s.cs_catalog_page_sk = p.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON s.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, w.w_warehouse_name, p.cp_department),
    (d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, w.w_warehouse_name),
    (d.d_year, d.d_month_seq),
    (d.d_year),
    ()
)
ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, d.d_month_seq, w.w_warehouse_name, p.cp_department
LIMIT 100

-- Goal: calculate total sales, total returns and profit per store and item category, flag high‑profit stores, using deep joins across all TPC‑DS tables, with a CASE expression, a RIGHT OUTER JOIN, a correlated EXISTS filter, and an ordered result limited to 100 rows.
WITH
  sales AS (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
      ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      ss.ss_customer_sk,
      ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
      ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
      ss.ss_addr_sk,
      ss.ss_store_sk,
      ss.ss_promo_sk,
      ss.ss_ticket_number,
      ss.ss_quantity,
      ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
      ss.ss_net_profit,
      ss.ss_net_paid,
      ss.ss_ext_discount_amt
    FROM store_sales ss
  ),
  returns AS (
    SELECT
      sr.sr_return_date_sk,
      sr.sr_return_time_sk,
      sr.sr_item_sk,
      sr.sr_customer_sk,
      sr.sr_cdemo_sk,
      sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
      sr.sr_addr_sk,
      sr.sr_store_sk,
      sr.sr_reason_sk,
      sr.sr_ticket_number,
      sr.sr_return_quantity,
      sr.sr_return_amt,
      sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
  )
SELECT
  s.s_store_name,
  i.i_category,
  SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
  SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)    AS total_return_amount,
  SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)    AS total_profit,
  CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_flag
FROM sales ss
RIGHT JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_sales ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_sales.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_sales ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_sales.ca_address_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sales ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk
JOIN returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
-- Re‑use the item dimension under a different alias for the store‑return side
JOIN item i2 ON sr.sr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim t_return ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_return ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_return.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_return ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
-- Re‑use the store dimension under a different alias for the return side
JOIN store s_ret ON sr.sr_store_sk = s_ret.s_store_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim t_catalog ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_catalog.t_time_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM store_returns sr2
  WHERE sr2.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    AND sr2.sr_return_quantity > 0
)
GROUP BY
  s.s_store_name,
  i.i_category
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        d.d_date,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_brand,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_qty,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = 'High'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 500
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM promotion p2
          WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND p2.p_cost > 1000
      )
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_id,
        d.d_date,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_brand
),

ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        d_date,
        i_item_id,
        i_brand,
        total_sales,
        total_qty,
        total_profit,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
        (
            SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_ext_sales_price)
            FROM store_sales ss2
            WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
        ) AS max_item_price
    FROM base_sales
),

aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        d_date,
        i_item_id,
        i_brand,
        SUM(total_sales) AS sum_sales,
        SUM(total_qty) AS sum_qty,
        SUM(total_profit) AS sum_profit,
        MAX(sales_rank) AS max_rank,
        CASE WHEN SUM(total_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
        MAX(max_item_price) AS max_item_price
    FROM ranked_sales
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (s_store_id, d_date, i_item_id, i_brand)
)

SELECT
    s_store_id,
    d_date,
    i_item_id,
    i_brand,
    sum_sales,
    sum_qty,
    sum_profit,
    max_rank,
    profit_flag,
    max_item_price
FROM aggregated
EXCEPT
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    d_date,
    i_item_id,
    i_brand,
    sum_sales,
    sum_qty,
    sum_profit,
    max_rank,
    profit_flag,
    max_item_price
FROM aggregated
WHERE sum_sales <= 5000
ORDER BY s_store_id, d_date, i_item_id
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT DATE '2022-01-01' AS dt
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dt + INTERVAL '1' DAY FROM date_seq WHERE dt + INTERVAL '1' DAY <= DATE '2022-01-31'
),
agg_store_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_item_sk,
        ss_store_sk,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
        MAX(ss_sold_date_sk) AS latest_sold_date_sk
    FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk
)
SELECT
    d.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    st.s_store_name,
    agg.store_net_paid,
    agg.store_net_profit,
    ws.ws_net_paid,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    wr.wr_return_amt,
    CASE 
        WHEN i.i_current_price > (
            SELECT AVG(i2.i_current_price)
            FROM item i2
            WHERE i2.i_category = i.i_category
        ) THEN 'Above Avg Price'
        ELSE 'Below Avg Price'
    END AS price_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY agg.store_net_profit DESC) AS category_store_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ws.ws_net_paid DESC) AS overall_sales_rn
FROM agg_store_sales agg
JOIN item i ON agg.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store st ON agg.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON agg.latest_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim td_ws_sold ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td_ws_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wr_return ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr_return.d_date_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
WHERE 
    d.d_year = 2022
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('UT', 'KS', 'TN')
    AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM date_seq ds WHERE ds.dt = d.d_date)
ORDER BY agg.store_net_profit DESC, ws.ws_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  d_sold.d_year AS sales_year,
  ws_site.web_class,
  cc.cc_name,
  SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
  SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_store_return_net_loss,
  SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_catalog_return_net_loss,
  SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_web_return_net_loss,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_returns cr2 WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number) AS catalog_return_cnt_per_order
FROM web_sales ws
-- Date dimensions for sold and shipped dates
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
-- Time dimension for sold time
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sold ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
-- Customer and related dimensions
LEFT JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
-- Web site and its date dimensions
LEFT JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_web_open ON ws_site.web_open_date_sk = d_web_open.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_web_close ON ws_site.web_close_date_sk = d_web_close.d_date_sk
-- Warehouse for the sale
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
-- Store returns (joined via customer)
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sr_returned ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr_returned.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sr_returned ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr_returned.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
-- Web returns (joined via item and order)
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wr_returned ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr_returned.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr_returned ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr_returned.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr.ca_address_sk
-- Catalog returns (joined via refunded customer)
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cr_returned ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr_returned.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cr_returned ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr_returned.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse w_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_cr_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_cr_refunded.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_cr_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_refunded.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (d_sold.d_year, ws_site.web_class, cc.cc_name)
ORDER BY d_sold.d_year, ws_site.web_class, cc.cc_name
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        d_sales.d_year AS d_year,
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        s.s_state AS store_state,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS ws_net_paid,
        sr.sr_return_amt AS sr_return_amt,
        ws.ws_order_number AS ws_order_number,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_quantity_on_hand,
        i.i_current_price AS i_current_price,
        (
            SELECT wp_inner.wp_type
            FROM web_page wp_inner
            WHERE wp_inner.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS page_type
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_sales
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_store_closed
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_store_closed.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d_sales.d_year = 1998
        AND i.i_current_price > 100
        AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < 850
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND s.s_state = 'TX'
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND c.c_birth_country = 'United States'
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 0
        AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_page wp2
            WHERE wp2.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
              AND wp2.wp_type = 'Home'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_returns sr2
            WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND sr2.sr_return_amt > 1000
        )
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_web_sales DESC) AS rn,
    d_year,
    i_category,
    store_state,
    total_web_sales,
    total_store_return_amt,
    num_orders,
    avg_inventory,
    high_price_sales,
    any_page_type
FROM (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_category,
        store_state,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS num_orders,
        AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory,
        SUM(CASE WHEN i_current_price > 200 THEN ws_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS high_price_sales,
        MAX(page_type) AS any_page_type
    FROM sales_data
    GROUP BY d_year, i_category, store_state
) agg
ORDER BY total_web_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH intersect_warehouses AS (
    SELECT w_warehouse_sk FROM (
        SELECT w_warehouse_sk FROM warehouse WHERE w_state = 'CA'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT w_warehouse_sk FROM warehouse WHERE w_state = 'TX'
    ) AS s1
    INTERSECT
    SELECT w_warehouse_sk FROM (
        SELECT w_warehouse_sk FROM warehouse WHERE w_gmt_offset BETWEEN -8 AND -5
        UNION ALL
        SELECT w_warehouse_sk FROM warehouse WHERE w_country = 'USA'
    ) AS s2
),
agg_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        w.w_state,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_count,
        AVG(cd.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate
    FROM
        web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                               AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
                               AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                               AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_current_month = 'Y'
        AND d.d_dom = 15
        AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 4000
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 200
        AND w.w_warehouse_sk IN (SELECT w_warehouse_sk FROM intersect_warehouses)
    GROUP BY
        d.d_year,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        w.w_state
)
SELECT
    ad.d_year,
    ad.w_warehouse_id,
    ad.w_state,
    ad.total_net_profit,
    ad.total_sales,
    ad.total_catalog_return_amount,
    ad.total_web_return_amount,
    ad.order_count,
    ad.avg_purchase_estimate,
    CASE
        WHEN ad.total_net_profit > 1000000 THEN 'HIGH'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS profit_category,
    (
        SELECT SUM(inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand)
        FROM inventory inv2
        WHERE inv2.inv_warehouse_sk = ad.w_warehouse_sk
          AND inv2.inv_date_sk = (
                SELECT d2.d_date_sk
                FROM date_dim d2
                WHERE d2.d_year = ad.d_year
                ORDER BY d2.d_date_sk
                LIMIT 1
          )
    ) AS year_inventory_qty
FROM agg_data ad
ORDER BY ad.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE level_seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM level_seq WHERE lvl < 5
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_color,
        i.i_size,
        i.i_current_price,
        cp.cp_department,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        ca_bill.ca_state,
        cd_bill.cd_marital_status
    FROM item i
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND i.i_color = 'Red'
      AND i.i_size = 'M'
      AND cd_bill.cd_marital_status = 'M'
      AND ca_bill.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_current_price > (SELECT MAX(i_current_price) FROM item WHERE i_brand = 'Brand#2')
      AND ss.ss_quantity > (SELECT AVG(ss_quantity) FROM store_sales)
)
SELECT
    i_brand,
    cp_department,
    lvl,
    SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ss_quantity) AS avg_store_quantity,
    SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
    SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
    MIN(i_current_price) AS min_price,
    MAX(i_current_price) AS max_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i_item_sk) AS distinct_item_count,
    MAX(i_color) AS max_color,
    MAX(i_size) AS max_size
FROM joined_data
CROSS JOIN level_seq
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (i_brand, cp_department, lvl),
    (i_brand, lvl),
    (cp_department, lvl),
    (lvl)
)
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk,
           d.d_date,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM tpcds.date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk,
           d2.d_date,
           dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date = dh.d_date + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    WHERE dh.lvl < 10
),
promo_agg AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           p.p_promo_name,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS promo_sales
    FROM tpcds.web_sales ws
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk,
             p.p_promo_name
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    i.i_item_id,
    d_sold.d_year,
    dh.lvl AS week_level,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
    MAX(COALESCE(promo_agg.promo_sales, 0)) AS max_promo_sales
FROM tpcds.web_sales ws
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_sold ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer c_ship ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_ship ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_ship ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
JOIN tpcds.web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN tpcds.warehouse wh ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN tpcds.promotion promo ON ws.ws_promo_sk = promo.p_promo_sk
JOIN tpcds.income_band ib_bill ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib_bill.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN tpcds.income_band ib_ship ON hd_ship.hd_income_band_sk = ib_ship.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN promo_agg ON ws.ws_promo_sk = promo_agg.p_promo_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 1999
GROUP BY ROLLUP (c.c_customer_id, i.i_item_id, d_sold.d_year, dh.lvl)
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk,
           d.d_date,
           1 AS level
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_fy_year = 1911
    ORDER BY d.d_date_sk
    LIMIT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk,
           d_next.d_date,
           dh.level + 1
    FROM date_dim d_next
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON d_next.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE dh.level < 5
),
raw_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        cp.cp_department,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        p.p_promo_name,
        ca.ca_state,
        t_sold.t_meal_time,
        map(
            array['sales','catalog_return','store_return','web_return'],
            array[cs.cs_ext_sales_price, cr.cr_return_amount, sr.sr_return_amt, wr.wr_return_amt]
        ) AS metric_map
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON d.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON (cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        OR sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        OR wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk)
    WHERE
        d.d_fy_year = 1911
        AND cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
        AND t_sold.t_meal_time = 'breakfast'
),
exploded AS (
    SELECT
        rd.d_year,
        rd.cp_department,
        rd.r_reason_desc,
        rd.cs_order_number,
        rd.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        m.metric_name,
        m.metric_value
    FROM raw_data rd
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(rd.metric_map) AS m(metric_name, metric_value)
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        cp_department,
        r_reason_desc,
        SUM(metric_value) AS total_metric,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p_promo_name) AS promo_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ca_state) AS state_cnt
    FROM exploded
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(d_year, cp_department, r_reason_desc)
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    cp_department,
    r_reason_desc,
    total_metric,
    order_cnt,
    avg_discount,
    promo_cnt,
    state_cnt,
    SUM(total_metric) OVER (
        PARTITION BY d_year
        ORDER BY cp_department NULLS LAST
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_total_metric
FROM agg
ORDER BY d_year, cp_department, r_reason_desc
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE hour_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(t_hour) AS hour
    FROM time_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT hour + 1
    FROM hour_range
    WHERE hour + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(t_hour) FROM time_dim)
)
SELECT
    hr.hour AS hour_of_day,
    i.i_brand,
    cc.cc_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS orders_cnt,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(cs.cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_net_paid,
    MIN(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS min_sold_date_sk,
    MAX(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS max_sold_date_sk,
    (SELECT MAX(cs3.cs_net_paid) FROM catalog_sales cs3) AS global_max_net_paid
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN hour_range hr ON hr.hour = td.t_hour
INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND ca.ca_state = 'TX'
  AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
  AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
  AND cs.cs_order_number NOT IN (
        SELECT cr2.cr_order_number
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_return_amount > 1000
    )
GROUP BY hr.hour, i.i_brand, cc.cc_state
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        d_date.d_year,
        d_date.d_month_seq,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        p.p_promo_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid + cs.cs_net_paid + ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity + cs.cs_quantity + ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit + cs.cs_net_profit + ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
        AND ss.ss_sold_time_sk = cs.cs_sold_time_sk
        AND ss.ss_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
        AND ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        AND ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND ss.ss_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_date ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_date.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_time ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_time.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ss.ss_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_date.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_time.t_time_sk
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_date.d_date_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_time.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
    WHERE
        d_date.d_year = 1998
        AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
        AND p.p_purpose = 'Unknown'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND t_time.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2 WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (
        s.s_store_id,
        d_date.d_year,
        d_date.d_month_seq,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        p.p_promo_name
    )
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    i_category,
    i_brand,
    p_promo_name,
    total_net_paid,
    total_quantity,
    total_net_profit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS rn_store_profit,
    CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Non-Positive' END AS profit_indicator,
    (
        SELECT AVG(inner_cs.cs_net_profit)
        FROM catalog_sales inner_cs
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON inner_cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE d2.d_year = sales_agg.d_year
    ) AS avg_yearly_profit
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

    ),
    catalog_returns_agg AS (

    ),
    joined_agg AS (
        SELECT d.d_year,

               SUM(ssa.store_net_profit)      AS total_store_profit,
               SUM(wsa.web_net_profit)        AS total_web_profit,

               SUM(inv.total_on_hand)         AS total_inventory_on_hand,
               (SUM(ssa.store_net_profit) + SUM(wsa.web_net_profit) - SUM(sra.total_net_loss) - SUM(cra.catalog_net_loss)) AS net_total_profit,
               CASE WHEN EXISTS (

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT
    sub.i_manufact,
    sub.i_category,
    sub.total_sales,
    sub.total_quantity,
    sub.group_label
FROM (
    SELECT i.i_manufact,
           i.i_category,
           s.total_sales,
           s.total_quantity,
           CAST('callyeingeing' AS varchar) AS group_label
    FROM sales_agg s
    JOIN item i ON s.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_manufact = 'callyeingeing'
      AND i.i_rec_end_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND s.total_sales > 5000
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i.i_manufact,
           i.i_category,
           s.total_sales,
           s.total_quantity,
           CAST('esecallypri' AS varchar) AS group_label
    FROM sales_agg s
    JOIN item i ON s.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_manufact = 'esecallypri'
      AND i.i_rec_end_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND s.total_sales BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000
) AS sub
ORDER BY sub.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH base_data AS (

        s.s_store_id,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_color,
        split(i.i_color, ',') AS color_array,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_year,
        ca.ca_zip,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        wp.wp_autogen_flag,
        wp.wp_type,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_paid
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND ca.ca_zip = '12477'
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1970
)
SELECT
    bd.s_state,
    bd.i_category,
    col.color,
    SUM(bd.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales_amount,
    SUM(bd.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales_amount,
    SUM(bd.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(bd.ss_net_profit) + SUM(bd.ws_net_profit) - SUM(bd.wr_net_loss) AS net_profit_across_channels,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_paid)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        JOIN store s2 ON ss2.ss_store_sk = s2.s_store_sk
        WHERE s2.s_state = bd.s_state
    ) AS avg_store_net_paid_for_state,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_item_sk = bd.i_item_sk
          AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_active_promo
FROM base_data bd
CROSS JOIN UNNEST (bd.color_array) AS t (color)
GROUP BY ROLLUP (bd.s_state, bd.i_category, color)
HAVING SUM(bd.ss_ext_sales_price) > 10000
ORDER BY net_profit_across_channels DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department AS cp_department,
        i.i_brand AS i_brand,
        cs.cs_net_paid AS cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_quantity AS cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_order_number AS cs_order_number,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS ss_net_paid,
        sr.sr_return_amt AS sr_return_amt,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_sr
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td_sr.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd3
        ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd3.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number BETWEEN 10 AND 20
        AND i.i_formulation LIKE '85seashell%'
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND td_cs.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 16
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
        AND cs.cs_net_paid > 100
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 50 AND 200
        AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F'
)
SELECT
    cp_department,
    i_brand,
    SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_net_paid,
    SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid,
    SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty
FROM base
GROUP BY ROLLUP (cp_department, i_brand)
ORDER BY cp_department, i_brand
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_keys AS (
    SELECT 2450085 AS ws_sold_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_sold_date_sk + 1
    FROM date_keys
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk < 2450095
),
high_cost AS (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS total_high_cost,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt_high
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_ship_cost > 500
      AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT ws_sold_date_sk FROM date_keys)
    GROUP BY sm.sm_ship_mode_sk, sm.sm_carrier
),
low_cost AS (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS total_low_cost,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt_low
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_ship_cost <= 500
      AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT ws_sold_date_sk FROM date_keys)
    GROUP BY sm.sm_ship_mode_sk, sm.sm_carrier
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        hc.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        hc.sm_carrier,
        hc.total_high_cost,
        hc.cnt_high
    FROM high_cost hc
    EXCEPT
    SELECT
        lc.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        lc.sm_carrier,
        lc.total_low_cost,
        lc.cnt_low
    FROM low_cost lc
)
SELECT
    c.sm_ship_mode_sk,
    c.sm_carrier,
    c.total_high_cost,
    c.cnt_high,
    (SELECT SUM(ws2.ws_ext_ship_cost)
     FROM web_sales ws2
     WHERE ws2.ws_ship_mode_sk = c.sm_ship_mode_sk) AS total_ship_cost_all,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM web_sales ws3
     WHERE ws3.ws_ship_mode_sk = c.sm_ship_mode_sk
       AND ws3.ws_ext_ship_cost > 500) AS high_cost_txns
FROM combined c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM low_cost lc
    WHERE lc.sm_ship_mode_sk = c.sm_ship_mode_sk
)
ORDER BY c.total_high_cost DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  p.p_promo_name,
  d.d_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS num_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS num_customers,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
  AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_email_address LIKE '%@gmail.com' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gmail_customer_count,
  (SELECT SUM(cr.cr_return_amount)
   FROM catalog_returns cr
   JOIN date_dim dr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
   WHERE cr.cr_order_number IN (
         SELECT cs2.cs_order_number
         FROM catalog_sales cs2
         WHERE cs2.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
           AND cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       )
   ) AS total_return_amount,
  regexp_extract(cp.cp_catalog_page_id, '^([A-Z]+)', 1) AS page_id_prefix
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
WHERE
  cs.cs_sold_date_sk <= (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2005)
  AND regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '(?i)discount|clearance')
  AND regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)sale')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_returns cr_exists
    WHERE cr_exists.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
      AND cr_exists.cr_return_amount > 0
  )
GROUP BY
  p.p_promo_name,
  d.d_year,
  cp.cp_catalog_page_id
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH distinct_promos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_start_date_sk
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_start_date_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    d.d_year,
    dp.p_promo_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cc_name) AS distinct_call_centers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.r_reason_desc) AS distinct_catalog_reasons,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r2.r_reason_desc) AS distinct_store_reasons,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r3.r_reason_desc) AS distinct_web_reasons,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss + COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_net_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity + COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_quantity
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN date_dim d
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_returning
    ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r2
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_sr
    ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r3
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r3.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr_refunded
    ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr_refunded.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr_returning
    ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_wr_returning.ca_address_sk
JOIN distinct_promos dp
    ON dp.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site ws
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year >= 2000
GROUP BY d.d_year, dp.p_promo_name
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_current_price,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_response_target,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        s.s_state,
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        sm.sm_code,
        sm.sm_type,
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_state,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_type,
        td.t_hour,
        td.t_sub_shift,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
                        AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
                        AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                        AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                        AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
                        AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
                        AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                        AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                        AND cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
                        AND cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
                        AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
                        AND cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
                        AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
                        AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                        AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                        AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND p.p_response_target >= 5
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
      AND cc.cc_state = 'TX'
      AND cp.cp_type = 'A'
),
expanded AS (
    SELECT
        b.*, 
        attr AS ship_mode_attribute
    FROM base b
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[b.sm_carrier, b.sm_code]) AS t(attr)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_store_name,
        s_city,
        s_state,
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        p_promo_name,
        ship_mode_attribute,
        SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_return_loss,
        SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_web_return_loss,
        SUM(sr_net_loss + cr_net_loss + wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        AVG(ss_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        CASE WHEN s_state = 'CA' THEN 'West' ELSE 'Other' END AS region_flag
    FROM expanded
    GROUP BY
        s_store_id,
        s_store_name,
        s_city,
        s_state,
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,

WITH RECURSIVE returns_union AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
           cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amount
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000

    UNION

    SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
           cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amount
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
),
aggregated_returns AS (
    SELECT cust_sk,
           SUM(return_amount) AS total_return_amount
    FROM returns_union
    GROUP BY cust_sk
),
promotion_date_ranges AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           sd.d_date_sk AS start_date_sk,
           ed.d_date_sk AS end_date_sk
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN date_dim sd ON p.p_start_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim ed ON p.p_end_date_sk = ed.d_date_sk
),
promo_custs AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion_date_ranges pdr ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN pdr.start_date_sk AND pdr.end_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000

    UNION

    SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion_date_ranges pdr ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN pdr.start_date_sk AND pdr.end_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
),
filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT cust_sk
    FROM aggregated_returns
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cust_sk FROM promo_custs
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       ar.total_return_amount
FROM filtered_customers fc
JOIN aggregated_returns ar ON fc.cust_sk = ar.cust_sk
JOIN customer c ON fc.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
ORDER BY ar.total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE base_sales (ca_state, i_category, sum_net_profit, sales_count, lvl) AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS sum_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_count,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN promotion p_ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_ss.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    -- Catalog sales joins
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_cs ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_cs.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN promotion p_cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cs.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c_cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_cs.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_cs ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_cs.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_cs ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_cs.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_cs.ca_address_sk
    -- Web sales joins
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN promotion p_ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c_ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_ws.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ws ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ws.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ws ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_ws.ca_address_sk
    WHERE
        d_ss.d_year = 2002
        AND i.i_brand = 'BrandA'
        AND p_ss.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
        AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM promotion p_sub
            WHERE p_sub.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
              AND p_sub.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        )
    GROUP BY CUBE(ca.ca_state, i.i_category)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        i_category,
        sum_net_profit,
        sales_count,
        lvl + 1
    FROM base_sales
    WHERE lvl < 1
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        i_category,
        sum_net_profit,
        sales_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY sum_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        AVG(sum_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS avg_state_profit
    FROM base_sales
    WHERE lvl = 1
      AND sum_net_profit IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    i_category,
    sum_net_profit,
    sales_count,
    profit_rank,
    avg_state_profit
FROM ranked_sales
ORDER BY ca_state, profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH
   catalog_base AS (
        SELECT
            cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
            cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
            d.d_date,
            d.d_year,
            t.t_hour AS hour,
            c.c_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
            c.c_first_name AS first_name,
            c.c_last_name AS last_name,
            ca.ca_city AS city,
            ca.ca_state AS state,
            cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax AS sales_amount,
            'Catalog' AS sales_channel,
            CASE WHEN cc.cc_gmt_offset > 0 THEN 'East' ELSE 'West' END AS region_flag,
            cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
            cp.cp_department AS catalog_department,
            CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS web_url,
            i.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inventory_qty
        FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
        JOIN tpcds.date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN tpcds.time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        JOIN tpcds.customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        LEFT JOIN tpcds.inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2001
          AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
          AND ca.ca_city IN ('San Jose', 'Los Angeles')
          AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
          AND cs.cs_quantity > 2
          AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > 0
   ),
   web_base AS (
        SELECT
            ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
            ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
            d.d_date,
            d.d_year,
            t.t_hour AS hour,
            c.c_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
            c.c_first_name AS first_name,
            c.c_last_name AS last_name,
            ca.ca_city AS city,
            ca.ca_state AS state,
            ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax AS sales_amount,
            'Web' AS sales_channel,
            CASE WHEN ws.ws_web_site_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 'Online' ELSE 'Offline' END AS region_flag,
            CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS call_center_name,
            CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS catalog_department,
            wp.wp_url AS web_url,
            i.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inventory_qty
        FROM tpcds.web_sales ws
        JOIN tpcds.date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN tpcds.time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        JOIN tpcds.customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN tpcds.web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        LEFT JOIN tpcds.inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2001
          AND wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
          AND ca.ca_state = 'WA'
          AND ws.ws_quantity > 1
          AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 0
   ),
   union_sales AS (
        SELECT * FROM catalog_base
        UNION ALL
        SELECT * FROM web_base
   ),
   enriched_sales AS (
        SELECT
            us.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sold_date_sk, sales_channel ORDER BY sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank,
            SUM(sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY sales_channel) AS total_sales_per_channel
        FROM union_sales us
   ),
   final_join AS (
        SELECT
            es.*,
            ss.ss_quantity AS store_quantity,
            ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax AS store_sales_amount,
            wr.wr_return_quantity,
            wr.wr_return_amt,
            r.r_reason_desc,
            wsi.web_name AS web_site_name
        FROM enriched_sales es
        LEFT JOIN tpcds.store_sales ss
            ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = es.sold_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
