            ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = es.sold_date_sk

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_name,
        sm_sales.sm_type,
        ca_ss.ca_city,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        ss.ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ss ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_sales ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_sales.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs2 ON cr.cr_order_number = cs2.cs_order_number
    JOIN ship_mode sm_return ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_return.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk
)
SELECT
    b.s_store_name,
    b.sm_type,
    b.ca_city,
    SUM(b.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales_paid,
    SUM(b.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales_paid,
    SUM(b.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_net_loss,
    SUM(b.ss_net_profit) - SUM(b.cr_net_loss) AS net_profit_adjusted,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM catalog_returns cr_sub
        JOIN customer_address ca_sub ON cr_sub.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_sub.ca_address_sk
        WHERE ca_sub.ca_city = b.ca_city
    ) AS returns_in_city
FROM base b
GROUP BY b.s_store_name, b.sm_type, b.ca_city
ORDER BY total_store_sales_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH promo_info AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name,
        regexp_extract(p.p_promo_name, '([0-9]{4})', 1) AS promo_year_extracted,
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '.*Discount.*') THEN 'Discount'
            WHEN regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '.*Clearance.*') THEN 'Clearance'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS promo_category,
        p.p_start_date_sk,
        p.p_end_date_sk
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '^Promo-')
      AND p.p_promo_name LIKE '%2021%'
),

returns_info AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        CASE
            WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity > 20 THEN 'HighQty'
            WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity >= 10 THEN 'MidQty'
            ELSE 'LowQty'
        END AS qty_bucket
    FROM store_returns sr
    WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL
),

demo_info AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count
    FROM household_demographics hd
),

page_info AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_type,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_creation_date_sk,
        regexp_extract(wp.wp_url, '(https?://[^/]+)', 1) AS url_domain,
        CASE
            WHEN wp.wp_url LIKE '%/sale%' THEN 'SalePage'
            WHEN wp.wp_url LIKE '%/new%' THEN 'NewArrivals'
            ELSE 'OtherPage'
        END AS page_category
    FROM web_page wp
    WHERE wp.wp_url IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    pi.promo_category,
    di.hd_buy_potential,
    pg.page_category,
    ri.qty_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
    SUM(ri.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    AVG(ri.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(ri.sr_return_amt) > overall.avg_return_amt THEN 'AboveAvg'
        ELSE 'BelowOrEqualAvg'
    END AS avg_vs_overall,
    MAX(CONCAT(pi.promo_category, '_', pg.page_category)) AS promo_page_combo,
    MAX(SUBSTRING(pg.wp_url, 1, 15)) AS url_prefix_sample
FROM
    returns_info ri
    JOIN date_dim d_ret ON ri.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN demo_info di ON ri.sr_hdemo_sk = di.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN promo_info pi ON d_ret.d_date_sk = pi.p_start_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN page_info pg ON d_ret.d_date_sk = pg.wp_creation_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM store_returns) overall
WHERE
    pi.promo_category IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    ROLLUP (pi.promo_category, di.hd_buy_potential, pg.page_category, ri.qty_bucket)
ORDER BY
    pi.promo_category ASC,
    di.hd_buy_potential ASC,
    pg.page_category ASC,
    ri.qty_bucket ASC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    S.s_store_id,
    S.s_store_name,
    S.s_state,
    CP.cp_catalog_page_number,
    SM.sm_type,
    WP.wp_type,
    SUM(SS.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(CS.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(SR.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_store_returns,
    SUM(COALESCE(CR.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_catalog_returns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SS.ss_ticket_number) AS store_sales_txns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CS.cs_order_number) AS catalog_sales_txns,
    AVG(SS.ss_quantity) AS avg_store_quantity,
    AVG(CS.cs_quantity) AS avg_catalog_quantity,
    (SELECT AVG(cs_net_profit) FROM catalog_sales) AS avg_catalog_profit,
    SUM(SS.ss_net_profit) + SUM(CS.cs_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(SR.sr_net_loss, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(CR.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS net_profit
FROM
    store_sales SS
    INNER JOIN store S
        ON SS.ss_store_sk = S.s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN customer C
        ON SS.ss_customer_sk = C.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics CD
        ON SS.ss_cdemo_sk = CD.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics HD
        ON SS.ss_hdemo_sk = HD.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address CA
        ON SS.ss_addr_sk = CA.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns SR
        ON SR.sr_item_sk = SS.ss_item_sk
       AND SR.sr_ticket_number = SS.ss_ticket_number
       AND SR.sr_store_sk = S.s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_sales CS
        ON CS.cs_bill_customer_sk = C.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page CP
        ON CS.cs_catalog_page_sk = CP.cp_catalog_page_sk
    INNER JOIN ship_mode SM
        ON CS.cs_ship_mode_sk = SM.sm_ship_mode_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse W
        ON CS.cs_warehouse_sk = W.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns CR
        ON CR.cr_item_sk = CS.cs_item_sk
       AND CR.cr_order_number = CS.cs_order_number
       AND CR.cr_catalog_page_sk = CP.cp_catalog_page_sk
       AND CR.cr_ship_mode_sk = SM.sm_ship_mode_sk
       AND CR.cr_warehouse_sk = W.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page WP
        ON WP.wp_customer_sk = C.c_customer_sk
WHERE
    S.s_state = 'CA'
    AND CP.cp_catalog_page_number IN (1, 5, 19)
    AND CA.ca_city = 'Pine Oak'
    AND WP.wp_type = 'article'
    AND SM.sm_type = 'AIR'
    AND S.s_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
GROUP BY
    S.s_store_id,
    S.s_store_name,
    S.s_state,
    CP.cp_catalog_page_number,
    SM.sm_type,
    WP.wp_type
ORDER BY
    total_store_sales DESC,
    S.s_store_id ASC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        d_ss.d_year,
        i.i_brand,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_profit,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit_discount_active,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE d_ss.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND s.s_state = 'TX'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound > 50000
      AND s.s_gmt_offset >= -6
    GROUP BY
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        d_ss.d_year,
        i.i_brand
),

catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_cs.d_year,
        i.i_brand,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE d_cs.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY
        d_cs.d_year,
        i.i_brand
),

web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_ws.d_year,
        i.i_brand,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS web_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_site we
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
    WHERE d_ws.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND we.web_gmt_offset >= -6
    GROUP BY
        d_ws.d_year,
        i.i_brand
)

SELECT
    ssag.ss_store_sk,
    ssag.d_year,
    ssag.i_brand,
    ssag.total_store_sales,
    ssag.total_store_profit,
    ssag.profit_discount_active,
    ssag.total_return_quantity,
    ca.total_catalog_sales,
    ca.total_catalog_profit,
    wa.total_web_sales,
    wa.total_web_profit,
    (ssag.total_store_profit / NULLIF(ssag.sales_cnt, 0)) AS avg_store_profit_per_sale,
    CASE WHEN ssag.profit_discount_active > 0 THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'Full Price' END AS profit_type
FROM store_sales_agg ssag
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales_agg ca
    ON ssag.d_year = ca.d_year
    AND ssag.i_brand = ca.i_brand
LEFT JOIN web_sales_agg wa
    ON ssag.d_year = wa.d_year
    AND ssag.i_brand = wa.i_brand
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_returns sr2
    WHERE sr2.sr_store_sk = ssag.ss_store_sk
      AND sr2.sr_net_loss > 500
)
HAVING ssag.total_store_profit > (
    SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_profit)
    FROM store_sales ss2
)
ORDER BY ssag.total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE order_numbers AS (
    SELECT 1 AS order_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT order_num + 1
    FROM order_numbers
    WHERE order_num < 1000
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category,
        cd.cd_gender,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ship_mode_sk IN (1, 6, 7)
      AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 1000
      AND i.i_manufact_id = 212
      AND cd.cd_dep_employed_count >= 2
      AND ws.ws_order_number IN (SELECT order_num FROM order_numbers)
      AND i.i_category IN (
          SELECT i2.i_category
          FROM item i2
          WHERE i2.i_wholesale_cost < 5
      )
    GROUP BY ws.ws_order_number, i.i_item_id, i.i_category, cd.cd_gender
)
SELECT
    agg.ws_order_number,
    agg.i_item_id,
    agg.i_category,
    agg.cd_gender,
    agg.total_sales,
    agg.avg_discount,
    agg.order_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.cd_gender ORDER BY agg.total_sales DESC) AS gender_sales_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_ext_sales_price) FROM web_sales ws2) AS overall_avg_sales_price
FROM agg
ORDER BY agg.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sampled_sales AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    d.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 500 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.word) AS distinct_product_name_words,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_web_pages,
    (SELECT SUM(ss2.ss_net_profit) FROM store_sales ss2) AS overall_net_profit,
    (SELECT AVG(ss3.ss_net_profit) FROM store_sales ss3 WHERE ss3.ss_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk) AS avg_store_net_profit,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_returns sr2 WHERE sr2.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk) AS returns_on_day
FROM sampled_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN customer c
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
-- Lateral join to split product name into words (array expansion)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT split(i.i_product_name, ' ') AS words
) AS t
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.words) AS u(word)
-- Lateral join to bring web_page rows for the customer (correlated join)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT * FROM web_page WHERE wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
) AS wp
WHERE
    regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '.*[0-9]{2,}.*')
    AND i.i_color LIKE '%Red%'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM store_returns sr_ex
        WHERE sr_ex.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
          AND sr_ex.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    )
GROUP BY ROLLUP (s.s_store_id, d.d_year, i.i_category, CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 500 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END)
ORDER BY s.s_store_id, d.d_year, i.i_category
LIMIT 100

WITH all_facts AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS profit,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk AS catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS web_site_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS reason_sk,
        'catalog' AS src
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_ext_list_price > 2000
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_promo_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer),
        CAST(NULL AS integer),
        ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer),
        'web'
    FROM tpcds.web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_list_price > 2000
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        -sr.sr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        CAST(NULL AS integer),
        CAST(NULL AS integer),
        CAST(NULL AS integer),
        sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer),
        sr.sr_reason_sk,
        'store_return'
    FROM tpcds.store_returns sr
    WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
),
joined_facts AS (
    SELECT
        af.item_sk,
        af.profit,
        af.quantity,
        af.promo_sk,
        af.call_center_sk,
        af.catalog_page_sk,
        af.hd_demo_sk,
        af.web_site_sk,
        af.reason_sk,
        af.src,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_class,
        i.i_manufact,
        i.i_current_price,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        p.p_discount_active,
        p.p_cost AS promo_cost,
        c.cc_state,
        cp.cp_type,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        wsd.web_state
    FROM all_facts af
    JOIN tpcds.item i
        ON af.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.promotion p
        ON af.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.call_center c
        ON af.call_center_sk = c.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp
        ON af.catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
        ON af.hd_demo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r
        ON af.reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_site wsd
        ON af.web_site_sk = wsd.web_site_sk
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        i_item_sk,
        i_item_desc,
        i_category,
        SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt,
        MAX(promo_cost) AS max_promo_cost
    FROM joined_facts
    WHERE i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND hd_income_band_sk IN (5, 7, 11)
      AND (p_discount_active = 'Y' OR p_discount_active IS NULL)
    GROUP BY i_item_sk, i_item_desc, i_category
    HAVING SUM(profit) > 2000
),
excluded_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sr.sr_item_sk
    FROM tpcds.store_returns sr
    WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity > 10
),
final_items AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM agg
    EXCEPT
    SELECT a.*
    FROM agg a
    JOIN excluded_items e ON a.i_item_sk = e.sr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    fi.i_item_sk,
    fi.i_item_desc,
    fi.i_category,
    fi.total_profit,
    fi.total_quantity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fi.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(p2.p_cost)
     FROM tpcds.promotion p2
     WHERE p2.p_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk) AS avg_promo_cost_for_item
FROM final_items fi
ORDER BY fi.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE year_range AS (
    SELECT 1998 AS yr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT yr + 1 FROM year_range WHERE yr < 1999
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT s.s_store_id AS store_id,
           s.s_store_name AS store_name,
           'profit' AS metric_type,
           COALESCE(SUM(ss.ss_net_profit), 0) AS amount
    FROM store_sales ss
    RIGHT OUTER JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE (d.d_year IS NULL OR d.d_year IN (SELECT yr FROM year_range))
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT s.s_store_id AS store_id,
           s.s_store_name AS store_name,
           'loss' AS metric_type,
           COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS amount
    FROM store_returns sr
    RIGHT OUTER JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE (d.d_year IS NULL OR d.d_year IN (SELECT yr FROM year_range))
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
)
SELECT store_id,
       store_name,
       metric_type,
       amount
FROM (
    SELECT store_id, store_name, metric_type, amount FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT store_id, store_name, metric_type, amount FROM returns_agg
) AS combined
ORDER BY store_id, metric_type
LIMIT 100

WITH joined AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        t.t_hour,
        i.inv_item_sk,
        i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_type,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS cat_net_loss,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        cust.c_customer_id,
        cust.c_first_name,
        cust.c_last_name,
        ca.ca_city,
        cd.cd_gender,
        st.s_store_id,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS store_net_loss,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        wp.wp_url,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_net_loss AS web_net_loss
    FROM tpcds.date_dim d
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.inventory TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) i
        ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp
        ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.time_dim t
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer cust
        ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca
        ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.store st
        ON st.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
       AND sr.sr_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
       AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
       AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
       AND sr.sr_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
       AND sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_site ws_site
        ON ws_site.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       AND wp.wp_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
       AND ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
       AND ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
       AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
       AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
       AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
       AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
       AND wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
       AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
       AND wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
       AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
       AND wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1999
      AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        cp_type,
        SUM(cat_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        SUM(store_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
        SUM(web_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        SUM(cat_net_loss) + SUM(store_net_loss) + SUM(web_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (c_customer_id, cp_type)
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    cp_type,
    catalog_net_loss,
    store_net_loss,
    web_net_loss,
    total_net_loss,
    total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank
FROM aggregated
WHERE total_net_loss IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_seq AS (
    SELECT t_time_sk, t_time, t_hour, t_minute, t_second, t_shift, t_sub_shift
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_time = (SELECT min(t_time) FROM time_dim)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT td.t_time_sk, td.t_time, td.t_hour, td.t_minute, td.t_second, td.t_shift, td.t_sub_shift
    FROM time_seq ts
    JOIN time_dim td ON td.t_time = ts.t_time + 1
    WHERE ts.t_time < (SELECT max(t_time) FROM time_dim)
),
agg_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        ts.t_time_sk,
        ts.t_shift,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amt,
        AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS store_return_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS web_return_cnt,
        (SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number), 0)) AS total_net_paid_per_order
    FROM time_seq ts
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_ship ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON hd_ship.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_return ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_return.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_return ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_return ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_return.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_return ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_return.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_wr_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_wr_refund.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr_refund.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_refund.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_refund.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_wr_returning ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c_wr_returning.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr_returning ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_wr_returning.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_returning ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_returning.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_returning ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_returning.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship > 5000
        AND cs.cs_quantity >= 2
        AND s.s_rec_start_date >= DATE '1997-01-01'
        AND cd_ship.cd_gender = 'M'
        AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
        AND ts.t_shift = 'evening'
    GROUP BY ts.t_time_sk, ts.t_shift
)
SELECT
    sub.t_shift,
    AVG(sub.total_net_paid) AS avg_total_net_paid,
    SUM(sub.total_return_amt) AS sum_total_return_amt,
    AVG(sub.total_net_paid_per_order) AS avg_net_paid_per_order
FROM agg_metrics sub
GROUP BY sub.t_shift
ORDER BY avg_total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT sr_store_sk,
       sr_return_date_sk,
       SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
FROM tpcds.store_returns
WHERE sr_hdemo_sk = 5962
  AND sr_reversed_charge > 50.0
GROUP BY sr_store_sk, sr_return_date_sk
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    -- Anchor: start from a specific date
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2023-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step: walk backward one day at a time
    SELECT dd.d_date_sk, dd.d_date
    FROM date_dim dd
    JOIN date_range dr ON dd.d_date = DATE_ADD('day', -1, dr.d_date)
    WHERE dd.d_date >= DATE '2022-12-01'
),
filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_salutation, c_last_review_date, c_birth_year
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_salutation = 'Mrs.'
      AND c_last_review_date = 2452292
      AND c_birth_year = 1975
),
avg_return_amt AS (
    SELECT AVG(wr_return_amt) AS overall_avg_return_amt
    FROM web_returns
)
SELECT
    dr.d_date,
    fc.c_salutation,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
    MIN(wr.wr_return_amt) AS min_return_amt,
    MAX(wr.wr_return_amt) AS max_return_amt,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > (SELECT overall_avg_return_amt FROM avg_return_amt) THEN 'Above Avg'
        ELSE 'Below Avg'
    END AS return_amount_category
FROM web_returns wr
JOIN date_range dr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_customers fc ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE r.r_reason_desc = 'Did not like the warranty'
GROUP BY dr.d_date, fc.c_salutation, r.r_reason_desc
HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 500
ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH high_priced_sales AS (
   SELECT
      cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
      cp.cp_department,
      SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
      COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
      AVG(cs.cs_list_price) AS avg_list_price
   FROM
      catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cs
      JOIN catalog_page AS cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
      JOIN household_demographics AS hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
   WHERE
      cs.cs_list_price > 100
      AND hd.hd_dep_count <= 2
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND cp.cp_start_date_sk BETWEEN 2450905 AND 2451085
   GROUP BY
      cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
      cp.cp_department
),
low_priced_sales AS (
   SELECT
      cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
      cp.cp_department,
      SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
      COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
      AVG(cs.cs_list_price) AS avg_list_price
   FROM
      catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cs
      JOIN catalog_page AS cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
      JOIN household_demographics AS hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
   WHERE
      cs.cs_list_price < 90
      AND hd.hd_dep_count <= 2
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND cp.cp_start_date_sk BETWEEN 2450905 AND 2451085
   GROUP BY
      cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
      cp.cp_department
)
SELECT
   hp.cp_catalog_page_id,
   hp.cp_department,
   hp.total_net_profit,
   hp.sales_cnt,
   hp.avg_list_price
FROM high_priced_sales hp
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1
   FROM low_priced_sales lp
   WHERE lp.cp_catalog_page_id = hp.cp_catalog_page_id
     AND lp.cp_department = hp.cp_department
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
   lp.cp_catalog_page_id,
   lp.cp_department,
   lp.total_net_profit,
   lp.sales_cnt,
   lp.avg_list_price
FROM low_priced_sales lp
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1
   FROM high_priced_sales hp
   WHERE hp.cp_catalog_page_id = lp.cp_catalog_page_id
     AND hp.cp_department = lp.cp_department
)
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE promo_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           p.p_item_sk,
           p.p_cost,
           1 AS level
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_cost > 1000
      AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           p.p_item_sk,
           p.p_cost,
           ph.level + 1
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN promo_hierarchy ph ON p.p_item_sk = ph.p_item_sk + 1
    WHERE ph.level < 5
)
SELECT ws.ws_order_number,
       ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
       ws.ws_quantity,
       ws.ws_net_paid,
       ws.ws_net_profit,
       p.p_promo_id,
       p.p_cost,
       p.p_promo_name,
       ws_site.web_name,
       ws_site.web_state,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ws_site.web_name ORDER BY ws.ws_net_paid DESC) AS sales_rank,
       CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV'
            WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email'
            ELSE 'Other'
       END AS primary_channel,
       ph.level AS promo_hierarchy_level
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN web_site ws_site
  ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
JOIN promotion p
  ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN promo_hierarchy ph
  ON p.p_promo_sk = ph.p_promo_sk
WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 2
  AND ws.ws_net_paid > 1000
  AND ws.ws_ext_tax < 200
  AND p.p_cost BETWEEN 500 AND 5000
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'N'
  AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
  AND ws_site.web_state = 'CA'
  AND ws_site.web_rec_start_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
          AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    )
ORDER BY ws.ws_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    store_agg AS (
        SELECT
            p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
            p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
            SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
            COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS num_customers,
            regexp_extract(c.c_email_address, '@(.*)$', 1) AS email_domain,
            CASE WHEN i.i_current_price > 100 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Cheap' END AS price_category,
            CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS full_name,
            substring(p.p_promo_id, 1, 3) AS promo_id_prefix
        FROM store_sales ss
        INNER JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        WHERE regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '.*[A-Z]{2,}.*')
          AND c.c_email_address LIKE '%@gmail.com'
        GROUP BY
            p.p_promo_id,
            p.p_promo_name,
            email_domain,
            price_category,
            full_name,
            promo_id_prefix
    ),
    web_agg AS (
        SELECT
            p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
            p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
            SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
            COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS num_customers,
            regexp_extract(c.c_email_address, '@(.*)$', 1) AS email_domain,
            CASE WHEN i.i_current_price > 100 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Cheap' END AS price_category,
            CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS full_name,
            substring(p.p_promo_id, 1, 3) AS promo_id_prefix
        FROM web_sales ws
        INNER JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        INNER JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        INNER JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        WHERE wp.wp_url LIKE 'http://www.example.com/%'
          AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '.*[0-9]{3}.*')
        GROUP BY
            p.p_promo_id,
            p.p_promo_name,
            email_domain,
            price_category,
            full_name,
            promo_id_prefix
    ),
    union_agg AS (
        SELECT promo_id, promo_name, total_sales, num_customers, email_domain, price_category, full_name, promo_id_prefix
        FROM store_agg
        UNION
        SELECT promo_id, promo_name, total_sales, num_customers, email_domain, price_category, full_name, promo_id_prefix
        FROM web_agg
    ),
    final_agg AS (
        SELECT
            promo_id,
            promo_name,
            SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales,
            SUM(num_customers) AS total_customers,
            MAX(email_domain) AS email_domain,
            MAX(price_category) AS price_category,
            MAX(full_name) AS full_name,
            MAX(promo_id_prefix) AS promo_id_prefix,
            CASE WHEN SUM(total_sales) > 10000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category
        FROM union_agg
        GROUP BY promo_id, promo_name
    ),
    ranked AS (
        SELECT
            promo_id,
            promo_name,
            total_sales,
            total_customers,
            email_domain,
            price_category,
            full_name,
            promo_id_prefix,
            sales_category,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS promo_rank
        FROM final_agg
    )
SELECT
    promo_id,
    promo_name,
    total_sales,
    total_customers,
    email_domain,
    price_category,
    full_name,
    promo_id_prefix,
    sales_category,
    promo_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY total_sales DESC, promo_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH returns_without_promo AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS i_item_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    EXCEPT
    SELECT p.p_item_sk
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN item i2 ON p.p_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
),
base_data AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_formulation,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_channel_email,
        p.p_channel_event,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        wp.wp_type
    FROM item i
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE i.i_brand_id IN (2004002, 1003001)
      AND i.i_formulation LIKE '%steel%'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= 5
      AND (p.p_channel_email = 'N' OR p.p_channel_email IS NULL)
      AND (p.p_channel_event = 'N' OR p.p_channel_event IS NULL)
      AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450850 AND 2451074
      AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
      AND i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM returns_without_promo)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        i_brand,
        i_category,
        CASE
            WHEN p_channel_email = 'N' AND p_channel_event = 'N' THEN 'No Email/Event'
            WHEN p_channel_email = 'Y' OR p_channel_event = 'Y' THEN 'Has Email/Event'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS promo_channel_type,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
        SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity_returned,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM base_data
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_brand, i_category, promo_channel_type)
)
SELECT
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    promo_channel_type,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_loss,
    total_quantity_sold,
    total_quantity_returned,
    transaction_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS brand_sales_rank
FROM aggregated
WHERE i_brand IS NOT NULL
  AND i_category IS NOT NULL
  AND promo_channel_type IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY i_brand, brand_sales_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        sum(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        count(*) AS txn_cnt,
        concat('Store_', cast(ss.ss_item_sk AS varchar)) AS source_label,
        regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)([A-Z]{3})', 1) AS extracted_code,
        substring(i.i_product_name, 1, 10) AS product_name_prefix
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_net_paid > 0
      AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)\\b[[:alpha:]]{5,}\\b')
      AND i.i_product_name LIKE '%Coffee%'
      AND i.i_item_sk IN (
          SELECT cs.cs_item_sk
          FROM catalog_sales cs
          JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
          WHERE p.p_promo_name LIKE '%Discount%'
      )
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, i.i_item_desc, i.i_product_name
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        sum(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        count(*) AS txn_cnt,
        concat('Web_', cast(ws.ws_item_sk AS varchar)) AS source_label,
        regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)([A-Z]{3})', 1) AS extracted_code,
        substring(i.i_product_name, 1, 10) AS product_name_prefix
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_net_paid > 0
      AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)\\b[[:alpha:]]{5,}\\b')
      AND i.i_product_name LIKE '%Coffee%'
      AND i.i_item_sk IN (
          SELECT cs.cs_item_sk
          FROM catalog_sales cs
          JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
          WHERE p.p_promo_name LIKE '%Discount%'
      )
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, i.i_item_desc, i.i_product_name
)
SELECT
    agg.item_sk,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    agg.total_net_paid,
    agg.txn_cnt,
    agg.source_label,
    agg.extracted_code,
    agg.product_name_prefix,
    (SELECT avg(cs.cs_net_paid) FROM catalog_sales cs) AS avg_catalog_net_paid
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_agg
) agg
JOIN item i ON agg.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE i.i_category = 'Sports'
ORDER BY agg.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 5
),
base AS (
    SELECT 
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        d_sold.d_year,
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        w.w_gmt_offset,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_channel_email,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        cp.cp_type,
        sm.sm_type,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
        CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_discount,
        ARRAY[CAST(ws.ws_quantity AS decimal(7,2)), ws.ws_ext_sales_price] AS metric_vals
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
                         AND cp.cp_end_date_sk   = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2002
      AND w.w_gmt_offset = -6.00
      AND p.p_channel_email = 'N'
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#45'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'Standard'
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND ws.ws_quantity > (
            SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_quantity)
            FROM web_sales ws2
      )
      AND ws.ws_item_sk IN (
            SELECT i2.i_item_sk
            FROM item i2
            WHERE i2.i_category = 'Sports'
      )
),
unnested AS (
    SELECT 
        b.*, 
        v.metric_val
    FROM base b
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(b.metric_vals) AS v(metric_val)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        s_state,
        s_store_id,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws_net_profit)      AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        MAX(has_discount) AS any_discount_flag
    FROM unnested
    GROUP BY s_state, s_store_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        s_state,
        s_store_id,
        total_sales,
        total_profit,
        distinct_orders,
        any_discount_flag,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
        SUM(total_profit) OVER (
            ORDER BY total_sales 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_profit
    FROM aggregated
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    r.s_state,
    r.s_store_id,
    r.total_sales,
    r.total_profit,
    r.distinct_orders,
    r.any_discount_flag,
    r.sales_rank,
    r.cumulative_profit,
    seq.n
FROM ranked r
JOIN seq ON seq.n = ((r.sales_rank - 1) % 5) + 1
ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_state,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS cs_net_profit,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        dd.d_date,
        dd.d_year,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_type,
        cp.cp_description,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_type AS wp_type,
        ws_site.web_name
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim dd
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON cs.cs_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws_site
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON dd.d_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 2001
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
      AND cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        cc_call_center_id,
        web_name,
        d_date,
        d_year,
        cp_type,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN cp_type = 'monthly' THEN (cs_net_profit + ws_net_profit) * 1.1
                ELSE cs_net_profit + ws_net_profit
            END
            - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)
        ) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price + ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY
        cc_call_center_id,
        web_name,
        d_date,
        d_year,
        cp_type
)
SELECT
    cc_call_center_id,
    web_name,
    d_date,
    total_net_profit,
    total_sales_amount,
    distinct_orders,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS yearly_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date) AS row_num_per_cc
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY yearly_rank, total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT MIN(ss_sold_date_sk) AS date_sk, 1 AS lvl
    FROM store_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dh.date_sk + 1, dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    WHERE dh.lvl < 5
)
SELECT
    store.s_store_id,
    store.s_store_name,
    store.s_market_manager,
    time_dim.t_shift,
    time_dim.t_sub_shift,
    customer_demographics.cd_gender,
    SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(store_sales.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    MIN(store_sales.ss_net_profit) AS min_profit,
    MAX(store_sales.ss_net_profit) AS max_profit,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ss_inner.ss_item_sk)
        FROM store_sales ss_inner
        WHERE ss_inner.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    ) AS distinct_items_sold
FROM store_sales
JOIN time_dim
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_demographics
    ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
JOIN store
    ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
JOIN date_hierarchy
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_hierarchy.date_sk
WHERE
    time_dim.t_shift = 'first'
    AND time_dim.t_sub_shift = 'morning'
    AND time_dim.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
    AND customer_demographics.cd_dep_count <= 2
    AND customer_demographics.cd_purchase_estimate >= 8000
    AND store.s_market_manager = 'David Smith'
    AND store.s_company_id = 1
    AND store_sales.ss_quantity > 1
    AND store_sales.ss_net_profit > 0
GROUP BY
    store.s_store_id,
    store.s_store_name,
    store.s_market_manager,
    time_dim.t_shift,
    time_dim.t_sub_shift,
    customer_demographics.cd_gender
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH item_month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM
        store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
    JOIN
        date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            i_item_sk,
            i_category_id,
            i_brand_id,
            i_manufact
        FROM item
        WHERE i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    ) AS i
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 1998
        AND d.d_current_month = 'Y'
        AND d.d_holiday = 'N'
        AND i.i_category_id IN (4, 6)
        AND i.i_brand_id = 2
        AND ss.ss_ext_discount_amt > 0
        AND ss.ss_quantity >= 1
        AND i.i_manufact LIKE '%anti%'
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    im.d_year,
    im.d_month_seq,
    AVG(im.total_sales) AS avg_monthly_sales,
    COUNT(*) AS num_items,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(im.total_profit) > 5000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN AVG(im.total_profit) > 0 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_tier,
    (SELECT MAX(total_sales) FROM item_month_sales) AS max_overall_sales
FROM
    item_month_sales im
WHERE
    im.total_sales > 1000
GROUP BY
    im.d_year,
    im.d_month_seq
HAVING
    AVG(im.total_sales) > (SELECT MAX(total_sales) FROM item_month_sales) * 0.1
ORDER BY
    avg_monthly_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    -- Pages that satisfy a set of business predicates
    filtered_pages AS (
        SELECT
            cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
            cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
            cp.cp_start_date_sk,
            cp.cp_department,
            cp.cp_catalog_number,
            cp.cp_type,
            d.d_date,
            d.d_year,
            d.d_holiday,
            d.d_current_quarter
        FROM catalog_page cp
        JOIN date_dim d ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE cp.cp_department IN ('Sports', 'Electronics')
          AND cp.cp_type = 'A'
          AND d.d_holiday = 'N'
          AND d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
    ),
    -- Pages that are of type 'A'
    pages_type_a AS (
        SELECT cp_catalog_page_id FROM catalog_page WHERE cp_type = 'A'
    ),
    -- Pages that belong to the 'Electronics' department
    pages_department_elec AS (
        SELECT cp_catalog_page_id FROM catalog_page WHERE cp_department = 'Electronics'
    ),
    -- Intersection of the two sets above (pages that are both type 'A' and in Electronics)
    pages_a_and_elec AS (
        SELECT cp_catalog_page_id FROM pages_type_a
        INTERSECT
        SELECT cp_catalog_page_id FROM pages_department_elec
    ),
    -- Main aggregation with window function and anti‑join
    final AS (
        SELECT
            cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
            cp.cp_department,
            cp.cp_catalog_number,
            cp.cp_start_date_sk,
            d.d_date,
            COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customer_cnt,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY cp.cp_department
                ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) DESC
            ) AS dept_customer_rank,
            CASE WHEN cp.cp_catalog_number > 10 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS catalog_size_category,
            (
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.c_customer_id)
                FROM customer c2
                WHERE c2.c_first_shipto_date_sk = cp.cp_start_date_sk
            ) AS total_customers_for_page
        FROM catalog_page cp
        JOIN date_dim d ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE cp.cp_catalog_page_id IN (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id FROM pages_a_and_elec)
          AND d.d_current_quarter = 'Y'
          AND d.d_fy_year = '2004'
          AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
          AND c.c_birth_year >= 1970
          AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM catalog_page cp2
                WHERE cp2.cp_department = cp.cp_department
                  AND cp2.cp_start_date_sk > cp.cp_start_date_sk
          )
        GROUP BY
            cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
            cp.cp_department,
            cp.cp_catalog_number,
            cp.cp_start_date_sk,
            d.d_date,
            d.d_current_quarter,
            d.d_fy_year
    )
SELECT DISTINCT
    f.cp_catalog_page_id,
    f.cp_department,
    f.cp_catalog_number,
    f.distinct_customer_cnt,
    f.dept_customer_rank,
    f.catalog_size_category,
    f.total_customers_for_page
FROM final f
ORDER BY f.dept_customer_rank ASC, f.cp_catalog_page_id

/*
  Goal: Analyze sales performance by item category, ship‑mode contract and customer state, 
  while incorporating store and web return information, highlighting high‑value items and orders.
*/
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
        ws.ws_wholesale_cost,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        sm.sm_contract,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_category_id,
        i.i_item_id,
        ca.ca_state,
        cd.cd_gender
    FROM tpcds.web_sales ws
    JOIN tpcds.item i               ON ws.ws_item_sk      = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm          ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN tpcds.warehouse w          ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca  ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
)
SELECT
    base.i_category,
    base.sm_contract,
    base.ca_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base.ws_order_number)                AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(base.ws_ext_sales_price)                         AS total_sales,
    AVG(base.ws_ext_discount_amt)                        AS avg_discount,
    MIN(base.ws_net_profit)                              AS min_profit,
    MAX(base.ws_net_profit)                              AS max_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)                                AS total_store_return,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT base.i_item_id)                   AS distinct_item_ids,
    (
        SELECT SUM(wr.wr_return_amt)
        FROM tpcds.web_returns wr
        WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = base.ws_item_sk
          AND wr.wr_order_number = base.ws_order_number
    )                                                    AS total_web_return_amt,
    CASE WHEN base.ws_ext_sales_price > (
            SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_ext_sales_price)
            FROM tpcds.web_sales ws2
            WHERE ws2.ws_ship_mode_sk = 13
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                     AS is_above_max_for_mode13
FROM base
-- bring in store_returns and its related dimensions (semi‑join via regular join)
JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr       ON sr.sr_item_sk = base.ws_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk   = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
-- bring in web_page (required table)
JOIN tpcds.web_page wp            ON base.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE
    base.sm_contract = 'Xjy3ZPuiDjzHlRx14Z3'  -- realistic contract value
    AND base.i_category_id = 9                 -- specific category
    AND base.ws_wholesale_cost > 5.00          -- filter on cost
    AND base.ca_state = 'CA'                   -- customers in California
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tpcds.web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = base.ws_item_sk
          AND wr2.wr_order_number = base.ws_order_number
          AND wr2.wr_return_amt > 100.00
    )
GROUP BY
    base.i_category,
    base.sm_contract,
    base.ca_state
ORDER BY
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_ret AS (
    SELECT
        'store' AS return_channel,
        t.t_shift AS shift,
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity,
        COALESCE(lsp.total_spent, 0) AS total_customer_spent
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_spent
        FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42) AS ss
        WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) AS lsp ON TRUE
    WHERE t.t_shift = 'Morning'
      AND c.c_birth_country = 'JAPAN'
    GROUP BY t.t_shift, c.c_birth_country
),
web_ret AS (
    SELECT
        'web' AS return_channel,
        t.t_shift AS shift,
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity,
        COALESCE(lws.total_spent, 0) AS total_customer_spent
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_spent
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) AS lws ON TRUE
    WHERE t.t_shift = 'Morning'
      AND c.c_birth_country = 'JAPAN'
    GROUP BY t.t_shift, c.c_birth_country
)
SELECT
    return_channel,
    shift,
    birth_country,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    return_cnt,
    avg_return_quantity,
    total_customer_spent
FROM store_ret
UNION ALL
SELECT
    return_channel,
    shift,
    birth_country,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    return_cnt,
    avg_return_quantity,
    total_customer_spent
FROM web_ret
ORDER BY return_channel, shift, birth_country
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date, lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy
    JOIN date_dim d_next
      ON d_next.d_date = date_hierarchy.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-10'
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        i.i_item_id,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity,
        MIN(sr.sr_return_amt) AS min_return_amount,
        MAX(sr.sr_return_amt) AS max_return_amount
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh
      ON d.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
      ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
      ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
      ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
      ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND i.i_current_price > 100.00
      AND c.c_current_cdemo_sk = 475745
      AND hd.hd_income_band_sk = 5
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound = 120000
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_page cp
          WHERE cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
      )
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, i.i_item_id
),
inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand,
        COUNT(*) AS inventory_record_count
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh
      ON d.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        r.c_customer_id AS entity_id,
        r.i_item_id AS item_id,
        r.total_return_amount,
        r.return_count,
        r.avg_return_quantity,
        r.min_return_amount,
        r.max_return_amount,
        NULL AS total_quantity_on_hand,
        NULL AS inventory_record_count
    FROM returns_agg r
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        NULL AS entity_id,
        i.item_id,
        NULL AS total_return_amount,
        NULL AS return_count,
        NULL AS avg_return_quantity,
        NULL AS min_return_amount,
        NULL AS max_return_amount,
        i.total_quantity_on_hand,
        i.inventory_record_count
    FROM inventory_agg i
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    entity_id,
    item_id,
    total_return_amount,
    return_count,
    avg_return_quantity,
    min_return_amount,
    max_return_amount,
    total_quantity_on_hand,
    inventory_record_count
FROM combined
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC NULLS LAST,
         total_quantity_on_hand DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT MIN(ss_sold_date_sk) AS date_sk,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM store_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1, lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy
    WHERE date_sk + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales)
      AND lvl < 10
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status AS marital_status,
        COALESCE(r.r_reason_desc, 'No Reason') AS reason_desc,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)) AS total_catalog_refund,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_refunded_cash, 0)) AS total_web_refund,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS num_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS num_catalog_returns,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS num_web_returns
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dh.date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2450900
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1970
        AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        r.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT
    gender,
    reason_desc,
    AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales,
    AVG(total_catalog_refund) AS avg_catalog_refund,
    AVG(total_web_refund) AS avg_web_refund,
    AVG(total_sales - (total_catalog_refund + total_web_refund)) AS avg_net_revenue,
    CASE WHEN AVG(total_sales - (total_catalog_refund + total_web_refund)) < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS revenue_status,
    COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM sales_agg
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_returns cr2
    JOIN reason r2 ON cr2.cr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    WHERE cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = (
        SELECT c2.c_customer_sk
        FROM customer c2
        WHERE c2.c_customer_id = sales_agg.c_customer_id
    )
      AND r2.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
)
GROUP BY
    gender,
    reason_desc
HAVING AVG(total_sales) > (
    SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_paid_inc_tax)
    FROM store_sales ss2
    WHERE ss2.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2450900
)
ORDER BY avg_net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH expensive_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_category
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price > (SELECT AVG(i_current_price) FROM item)
)
SELECT sales_channel,
       d_year,
       i_category,
       total_net_profit,
       total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT 'store' AS sales_channel,
           d.d_year,
           ei.i_category,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN expensive_items ei ON ss.ss_item_sk = ei.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2002
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store s
          WHERE s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
            AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      )
    GROUP BY CUBE ('store', d.d_year, ei.i_category)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'web' AS sales_channel,
           d.d_year,
           ei.i_category,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
           SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN expensive_items ei ON ws.ws_item_sk = ei.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2002
    GROUP BY CUBE ('web', d.d_year, ei.i_category)
) AS combined
ORDER BY sales_channel, d_year, i_category
LIMIT 100

WITH returns_warehouses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 20
),
inventory_warehouses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN warehouse w ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 500
),
eligible_warehouses AS (
    SELECT w_warehouse_id FROM returns_warehouses
    INTERSECT
    SELECT w_warehouse_id FROM inventory_warehouses
),
inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT inv_warehouse_sk, sum(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk
),
aggregated_returns AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        cp.cp_department,
        sum(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        count(*) AS return_count,
        iagg.total_inventory_on_hand
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory_agg iagg ON iagg.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 10
      AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Advanced Degree')
      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, r.r_reason_desc, cp.cp_department, iagg.total_inventory_on_hand
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(agg.w_warehouse_id, 'ALL') AS warehouse_id,
    COALESCE(agg.r_reason_desc, 'ALL') AS reason_desc,
    COALESCE(agg.cp_department, 'ALL') AS department,
    sum(agg.total_return_amount) AS sum_return_amount,
    avg(agg.return_count) AS avg_return_count,
    max(agg.total_inventory_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
    (
        SELECT sum(cr2.cr_return_quantity)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = (
            SELECT w2.w_warehouse_sk
            FROM warehouse w2
            WHERE w2.w_warehouse_id = agg.w_warehouse_id
        )
    ) AS warehouse_total_return_quantity
FROM aggregated_returns agg
WHERE agg.w_warehouse_id IN (SELECT w_warehouse_id FROM eligible_warehouses)
GROUP BY ROLLUP (agg.w_warehouse_id, agg.r_reason_desc, agg.cp_department)
ORDER BY warehouse_id, reason_desc, department

WITH ws_sample AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM web_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (12345)
    WHERE ws_sales_price > 200
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        d.d_month_seq AS month_seq,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        MIN(t.t_hour) AS min_hour,
        SUM(ws_sample.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ws_sample.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_on_hand,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center_name
    FROM ws_sample
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws_sample.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ws_sample.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws_sample.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws_sample.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws_sample.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws_sample.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws_sample.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws_sample.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse wh ON ws_sample.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                       AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                       AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                           AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND s.s_state = 'TX'
      AND i.i_color = 'Red'
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 40001
    GROUP BY
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        cc.cc_name
)
SELECT
    year,
    month_seq,
    s_store_id,
    s_state,
    i_item_id,
    i_product_name,
    min_hour,
    total_net_profit,
    total_quantity,
    avg_inventory_on_hand,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    call_center_name,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id, year, month_seq ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag
FROM agg
ORDER BY year, month_seq, profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE page_numbers AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_number AS page_num,
           cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    FROM catalog_page cp
    WHERE cp.cp_catalog_page_number = (SELECT MIN(cp2.cp_catalog_page_number) FROM catalog_page cp2)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.page_num + 1 AS page_num,
           cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    FROM page_numbers p
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_number = p.page_num + 1
    WHERE p.page_num < (SELECT MAX(cp3.cp_catalog_page_number) FROM catalog_page cp3)
)
SELECT
    agg.demographic_key,
    agg.cd_gender,
    agg.cd_marital_status,
    agg.total_amount,
    agg.source,
    latest.latest_store_sale_date
FROM (
    SELECT
        cd.cd_demo_sk AS demographic_key,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_amount,
        'return' AS source
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN page_numbers pn ON cp.cp_catalog_page_number = pn.page_num
    WHERE cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM warehouse w
          WHERE w.w_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk
            AND w.w_state = 'CA'
      )
    GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        cd.cd_demo_sk AS demographic_key,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_amount,
        'store' AS source
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_ext_sales_price > (
          SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
          FROM catalog_returns cr2
    )
    GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status
) AS agg
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT MAX(ss3.ss_sold_date_sk) AS latest_store_sale_date
    FROM store_sales ss3
    WHERE ss3.ss_cdemo_sk = agg.demographic_key
) AS latest
WHERE agg.total_amount > (
    SELECT AVG(cr3.cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns cr3
)
ORDER BY agg.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH distinct_returns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_current_price,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        wp.wp_url
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 500
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < 300
      AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 1000
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 20 AND 2000
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    i_product_name,
    r_reason_desc,
    cr_return_amount,
    cr_net_loss,
    CASE WHEN cr_return_amount > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_item_id ORDER BY cr_return_amount DESC) AS rn_return_rank
FROM distinct_returns
ORDER BY loss_category DESC, rn_return_rank
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sampled_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr_call_center_sk,
        SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS sum_return_amt_inc_tax,
        AVG(cr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        MIN(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS min_return_amt_inc_tax,
        MAX(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS max_return_amt_inc_tax
    FROM catalog_returns
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    WHERE cr_return_amt_inc_tax > 500
      AND cr_return_quantity > 0
      AND cr_refunded_cash > 0
    GROUP BY cr_call_center_sk
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_call_center_id,
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_state,
    sr.sum_return_amt_inc_tax,
    sr.avg_return_tax,
    sr.return_cnt,
    sr.min_return_amt_inc_tax,
    sr.max_return_amt_inc_tax,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
          AND cr2.cr_return_amt_inc_tax > 200
    ) AS total_return_cnt_all_time,
    (
        SELECT MAX(cr2.cr_refunded_cash)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    ) AS max_refunded_cash
FROM call_center cc
JOIN sampled_returns sr
    ON sr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
WHERE
    cc.cc_state = 'CA'
    AND cc.cc_employees > 100
    AND cc.cc_rec_end_date = DATE '2000-12-31'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr3
        WHERE cr3.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
          AND cr3.cr_return_amt_inc_tax > 1000
          AND cr3.cr_refunded_cash < 500
    )
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_call_center_id,
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_state,
    sr.sum_return_amt_inc_tax,
    sr.avg_return_tax,
    sr.return_cnt,
    sr.min_return_amt_inc_tax,
    sr.max_return_amt_inc_tax
HAVING
    sr.sum_return_amt_inc_tax > 5000
    AND sr.return_cnt >= 5
ORDER BY sr.sum_return_amt_inc_tax DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH union_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity AS quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid_inc_tax,
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
        ss.ss_addr_sk AS address_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk AS hdemo_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS ship_mode_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS catalog_page_sk,
        'store' AS sales_channel
    FROM store_sales ss

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid_inc_tax,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS store_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk AS address_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk AS hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk AS catalog_page_sk,
        'catalog' AS sales_channel
    FROM catalog_sales cs
),

store_ship_modes AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        sm_id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.s_store_sk,
            array_agg(DISTINCT sm.sm_ship_mode_id) AS ship_modes_arr
        FROM union_sales su
        LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON su.ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        LEFT JOIN store s ON su.store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        GROUP BY s.s_store_sk
    ) agg
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(agg.ship_modes_arr) AS t(sm_id)
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_name,
        i1.i_category,
        i2.i_brand,
        td_hour.t_hour,
        td_meal.t_meal_time,
        smm.sm_id AS ship_mode_id,
        SUM(su.quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(su.net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(i1.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price,
        (
            SELECT AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)
            FROM catalog_sales cs
            WHERE cs.cs_item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
        ) AS avg_catalog_discount
    FROM union_sales su
    JOIN item i1 ON su.item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
    JOIN item i2 ON su.item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_hour ON su.sold_time_sk = td_hour.t_time_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_meal ON su.sold_time_sk = td_meal.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON su.hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON su.address_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s ON su.store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON su.ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON su.catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_ship_modes smm ON s.s_store_sk = smm.s_store_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
          AND cs2.cs_ext_discount_amt > 0
    )
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_name,
        i1.i_category,
        i2.i_brand,
        td_hour.t_hour,
        td_meal.t_meal_time,
        smm.sm_id
)
SELECT
    s_store_name,
    i_category,
    i_brand,
    t_hour,
    t_meal_time,
    ship_mode_id,
    total_quantity,
    total_net_paid,
    avg_item_price,
    avg_catalog_discount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_name ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS store_rank
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
   SELECT
       s.s_store_sk,
       s.s_store_id,
       s.s_state,
       i.i_item_sk,
       i.i_category,
       t_sales.t_hour,
       SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid,
       SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_store_qty,
       COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_qty,
       SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_net_paid,
       SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_web_qty,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS total_web_orders
   FROM store_sales ss
   JOIN time_dim t_sales
       ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk
   JOIN item i
       ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   JOIN customer_address ca_sa
       ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_sa.ca_address_sk
   JOIN store s
       ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
       ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
          AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
   LEFT JOIN time_dim t_returns
       ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_returns.t_time_sk
   JOIN web_sales ws
       ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   JOIN time_dim t_ws
       ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
   JOIN web_page wp
       ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
   JOIN web_site wsit
       ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
   JOIN customer_address ca_bill
       ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
   JOIN customer_address ca_ship
       ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
   WHERE
       t_sales.t_hour > 12
       AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
       AND s.s_state = 'CA'
       AND ss.ss_coupon_amt > 500
       AND wsit.web_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5 AND 0
   GROUP BY
       s.s_store_sk,
       s.s_store_id,
       s.s_state,
       i.i_item_sk,
       i.i_category,
       t_sales.t_hour
),
stores_without_returns AS (
   SELECT ss.s_store_sk
   FROM store_sales ss
   EXCEPT
   SELECT sr.sr_store_sk
   FROM store_returns sr
),
final_agg AS (
   SELECT
       sa.s_store_sk,
       sa.s_store_id,
       sa.s_state,
