       sa.i_category,
       sa.t_hour,
       sa.total_store_net_paid,
       sa.total_store_qty,
       sa.total_web_net_paid,
       sa.total_web_qty,
       sa.total_return_qty,
       sa.total_web_orders,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.i_category ORDER BY sa.total_store_net_paid DESC) AS store_net_paid_rank,
       (
           SELECT AVG(sub.total_web_net_paid)
           FROM sales_agg sub
           WHERE sub.t_hour = sa.t_hour
       ) AS avg_web_net_paid_same_hour
   FROM sales_agg sa
   JOIN stores_without_returns swr
       ON sa.s_store_sk = swr.s_store_sk
   WHERE
       sa.total_store_net_paid > (
           SELECT AVG(sub2.total_store_net_paid)
           FROM sales_agg sub2
           WHERE sub2.t_hour = sa.t_hour
       )
)
SELECT *
FROM final_agg
ORDER BY total_store_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
  returns_orders AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_return_amount > 0
  ),
  sales_orders AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number AS order_number
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_net_paid > 0
  ),
  filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number FROM returns_orders
    EXCEPT
    SELECT order_number FROM sales_orders
  ),
  agg_data AS (
    SELECT
      cc.cc_name AS cc_name,
      w.w_warehouse_name AS w_warehouse_name,
      ib.ib_lower_bound AS ib_lower_bound,
      td.t_hour AS t_hour,
      SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
      SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
      COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS return_orders,
      AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
      (
        SELECT MAX(cr2.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
      ) AS max_return_amount_warehouse
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE
      td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 11
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND ca.ca_state = 'TX'
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
      AND cr.cr_order_number IN (SELECT cr_order_number FROM filtered_orders)
    GROUP BY
      cc.cc_name,
      w.w_warehouse_name,
      ib.ib_lower_bound,
      td.t_hour
    HAVING
      SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 5000
  )
SELECT
  cc_name,
  w_warehouse_name,
  ib_lower_bound,
  t_hour,
  total_return_amount,
  total_net_paid,
  return_orders,
  avg_sales_price,
  max_return_amount_warehouse,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_name ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS rn
FROM agg_data
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC, rn
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_date_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        c_bill.c_customer_id AS bill_customer_id,
        cd_bill.cd_gender AS bill_gender,
        c_ship.c_customer_id AS ship_customer_id,
        cd_ship.cd_gender AS ship_gender,
        wp.wp_type,
        url_part,
        d_sold.d_year AS sold_year,
        d_sold.d_month_seq AS sold_month_seq,
        d_ship.d_year AS ship_year,
        d_ship.d_month_seq AS ship_month_seq,
        d_return.d_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
        d_return.d_year AS return_year,
        cp_start.cp_department AS catalog_department,
        st.s_store_name,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c_bill
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer c_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation
        ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wp_access
        ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c_wp_customer
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c_wp_customer.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_wp_cdemo
        ON c_wp_customer.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_wp_cdemo.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_return
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp_start
        ON cp_start.cp_start_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp_end
        ON cp_end.cp_end_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store st
        ON st.s_closed_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc_open
        ON cc_open.cc_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc_close
        ON cc_close.cc_closed_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(wp.wp_url, '/')) AS t(url_part)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        jd.sold_year,
        jd.s_store_name,
        jd.bill_gender,
        jd.wp_type,
        jd.catalog_department,
        SUM(jd.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(jd.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COALESCE(SUM(jd.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(jd.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory,
        COUNT(DISTINCT jd.url_part) AS distinct_url_parts
    FROM joined_data jd
    GROUP BY
        jd.sold_year,
        jd.s_store_name,
        jd.bill_gender,
        jd.wp_type,
        jd.catalog_department
    HAVING
        SUM(jd.ws_net_profit) > 1000
        AND COALESCE(SUM(jd.wr_return_amt), 0) > 0
)
SELECT
    a.sold_year,
    a.s_store_name,
    a.bill_gender,
    a.wp_type,
    a.catalog_department,
    a.total_sales,
    a.total_profit,
    a.total_return_amt,
    (
        SELECT MAX(wr2.wr_return_amt)
        FROM web_returns wr2
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE d2.d_year = a.sold_year
    ) AS max_return_amt_for_year,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.s_store_name ORDER BY a.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    a.total_inventory,
    a.distinct_url_parts
FROM aggregated a
ORDER BY a.profit_rank, a.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        d.d_year AS year,
        d.d_month_seq AS month_seq,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS amount,
        'sales' AS txn_type
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN inventory i ON d.d_date_sk = i.inv_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
      AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, s.s_store_name, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, cd.cd_gender
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        d.d_year AS year,
        d.d_month_seq AS month_seq,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS amount,
        'return' AS txn_type
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
    GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, s.s_store_name, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, cd.cd_gender
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM sales_agg
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM returns_agg
)
SELECT
    c.store_sk,
    c.store_name,
    c.year,
    c.month_seq,
    c.gender,
    SUM(c.amount) AS total_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.txn_type) AS txn_type_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(c.amount) > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(c.amount) > 5000  THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS amount_category,
    (
        SELECT SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE sr.sr_store_sk = c.store_sk
          AND d2.d_year = c.year
    ) AS total_return_loss
FROM combined c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_page cp
    WHERE (
            cp.cp_start_date_sk = (
                SELECT d3.d_date_sk
                FROM date_dim d3
                WHERE d3.d_year = c.year
                  AND d3.d_month_seq = c.month_seq
                LIMIT 1
            )
            OR cp.cp_end_date_sk = (
                SELECT d3.d_date_sk
                FROM date_dim d3
                WHERE d3.d_year = c.year
                  AND d3.d_month_seq = c.month_seq
                LIMIT 1
            )
        )
      AND cp.cp_department = 'Sports'
)
GROUP BY c.store_sk, c.store_name, c.year, c.month_seq, c.gender
HAVING SUM(c.amount) > 1000
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        d_sold.d_year,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_return_quantity) AS distinct_return_qty_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cp_start
        ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_cp_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cp_end
        ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_cp_end.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (1, 2, 3)
      AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM inventory inv
          WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
            AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      )
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        d_sold.d_year,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand
)
SELECT
    sagg.c_customer_id,
    sagg.c_first_name,
    sagg.c_last_name,
    sagg.d_year,
    sagg.i_category,
    sagg.i_brand,
    sagg.total_sales,
    sagg.total_profit,
    CASE WHEN sagg.total_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status,
    sagg.total_quantity,
    sagg.distinct_return_qty_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sagg.c_customer_id ORDER BY sagg.total_sales DESC) AS rn_sales,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM store_returns sr_corr
     WHERE sr_corr.sr_customer_sk = sagg.c_customer_sk) AS total_returns_for_customer
FROM sales_agg sagg
HAVING sagg.total_sales > 10000
ORDER BY sagg.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE rec_dates AS (
    -- Build a date range for January 2001 using the date_dim table
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM rec_dates r
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date = r.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d.d_date <= DATE '2001-01-31'
),
sales_with_info AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_tax,
        s.s_state,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        -- Build an array of two numeric metrics for later UNNEST
        ARRAY[CAST(ss.ss_quantity AS DOUBLE), CAST(ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS DOUBLE)] AS metric_array
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN rec_dates rd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000
      AND ss.ss_quantity >= 1
      AND s.s_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY')
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound >= 5000
      AND rd.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-01-31'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential <> 'Unknown'
      AND ss.ss_ext_tax > 0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr_ex
          WHERE cr_ex.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
            AND cr_ex.cr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
            AND cr_ex.cr_return_amount > 500
      )
),
unnested_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        sw.s_state,
        sw.hd_income_band_sk,
        sw.ss_sold_date_sk,
        metric_val AS metric_value,
        sw.cr_return_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN sw.cr_return_amount IS NULL THEN 'NoReturn'
            WHEN sw.cr_return_amount > 0      THEN 'Return'
            ELSE 'Refund'
        END AS return_status
    FROM sales_with_info sw
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sw.metric_array) AS t(metric_val)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        s_state,
        hd_income_band_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt,
        SUM(metric_value) AS metric_sum,
        SUM(CASE WHEN return_status = 'Return' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returns_cnt,
        AVG(metric_value) AS metric_avg
    FROM unnested_metrics
    GROUP BY s_state, hd_income_band_sk
),
aggregated_alt AS (
    SELECT
        s_state,
        hd_income_band_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt,
        SUM(metric_value) * 1.1 AS metric_sum, -- adjusted to create a different set
        SUM(CASE WHEN return_status = 'Return' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returns_cnt,
        AVG(metric_value) AS metric_avg
    FROM unnested_metrics
    WHERE metric_value > 0
    GROUP BY s_state, hd_income_band_sk
),
unioned AS (
    SELECT * FROM aggregated
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM aggregated_alt
)
SELECT
    s_state,
    hd_income_band_sk,
    transaction_cnt,
    metric_sum,
    returns_cnt,
    metric_avg
FROM unioned
ORDER BY metric_sum DESC, s_state
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_branch AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category AS product_category,
        d_sale.d_year AS sales_year,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS store_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT cp.cp_type) AS distinct_page_types,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT url_part) AS url_path_segments
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sale
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sale.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sale
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sale.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_start
        ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_end
        ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_return
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_return
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sale.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sale.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN UNNEST(split(wp.wp_url, '/')) AS t(url_part) ON TRUE
    WHERE d_sale.d_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2000
    GROUP BY
        i.i_category,
        d_sale.d_year,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)
),
store_branch AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category AS product_category,
        d_sale.d_year AS sales_year,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR)) AS distinct_page_types,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT url_part) AS url_path_segments
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sale
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sale.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sale
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sale.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_return
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_return
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sale.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sale.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN UNNEST(split(wp.wp_url, '/')) AS t(url_part) ON TRUE
    WHERE d_sale.d_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2000
    GROUP BY
        i.i_category,
        d_sale.d_year,
        s.s_store_name
)
SELECT
    product_category,
    sales_year,
    store_name,
    SUM(total_net_paid) AS net_paid,
    SUM(total_return_amount) AS return_amount,
    SUM(distinct_customers) AS total_distinct_customers,
    array_distinct(flatten(array_agg(distinct_page_types))) AS all_page_types,
    array_distinct(flatten(array_agg(url_path_segments))) AS all_url_p

WITH store_data AS (
  SELECT
    d.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_category_id,
    p.p_promo_name,
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_customer_sk,
    ca.ca_state,
    ss.ss_ticket_number,
    ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
    ss.ss_net_profit,
    sr.sr_return_amt,
    sr.sr_store_credit,
    CASE WHEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_volume_category
  FROM
    store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
      ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
      AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_year = 2001
    AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
    AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 0
    AND sr.sr_store_credit > 500
),
web_data AS (
  SELECT
    d.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_category_id,
    p.p_promo_name,
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_customer_sk,
    ca.ca_state,
    ws.ws_order_number,
    ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_volume_category
  FROM
    web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_year = 2001
    AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
    AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 0
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(s.d_year, w.d_year) AS d_year,
  COALESCE(s.i_category, w.i_category) AS i_category,
  COALESCE(s.i_category_id, w.i_category_id) AS i_category_id,
  COALESCE(s.p_promo_name, w.p_promo_name) AS p_promo_name,
  COALESCE(s.c_customer_id, w.c_customer_id) AS c_customer_id,
  COALESCE(s.ca_state, w.ca_state) AS ca_state,
  (SUM(COALESCE(s.ss_ext_sales_price, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(w.ws_ext_sales_price, 0))) AS total_sales,
  (SUM(COALESCE(s.ss_net_profit, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(w.ws_net_profit, 0))) AS total_profit,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.sr_store_credit, 0)) AS total_store_credit,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(s.ss_ticket_number, w.ws_order_number)) AS distinct_transactions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sales_volume_category, w.sales_volume_category) = 'High' THEN COALESCE(s.ss_ticket_number, w.ws_order_number) END) AS high_volume_transactions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales ss2 WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = COALESCE(s.c_customer_sk, w.c_customer_sk) AND ss2.ss_ext_sales_price > 500) AS high_value_purchases_by_customer,
  CASE WHEN (SUM(COALESCE(s.ss_net_profit, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(w.ws_net_profit, 0))) > 0.2 * (SUM(COALESCE(s.ss_ext_sales_price, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(w.ws_ext_sales_price, 0))) THEN 'HighMargin' ELSE 'LowMargin' END AS profit_margin_category
FROM
  store_data s
  FULL OUTER JOIN web_data w
    ON s.d_year = w.d_year
    AND s.i_category_id = w.i_category_id
    AND s.p_promo_name = w.p_promo_name
    AND s.c_customer_id = w.c_customer_id
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(s.d_year, w.d_year),
  COALESCE(s.i_category, w.i_category),
  COALESCE(s.i_category_id, w.i_category_id),
  COALESCE(s.p_promo_name, w.p_promo_name),
  COALESCE(s.c_customer_id, w.c_customer_id),
  COALESCE(s.ca_state, w.ca_state)
ORDER BY
  total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        d.d_year,
        cc.cc_division_name,
        we.web_name,
        cp.cp_department,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_returns_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_returns_loss,
        AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_store_profit_per_tx,
        (
            SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_profit)
            FROM store_sales ss2
            WHERE ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        ) AS avg_store_profit_by_date
    FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN promotion p_ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_ss.p_promo_sk
        JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim dr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
        JOIN time_dim tr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = tr.t_time_sk
        JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
        JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        JOIN promotion p_cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cs.p_promo_sk
        JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN warehouse w_cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        JOIN promotion p_ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
        JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
        JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim drw ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = drw.d_date_sk
        JOIN time_dim trw ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = trw.t_time_sk
        JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
        AND t.t_hour = 15
        AND cc.cc_class = 'large'
        AND r_sr.r_reason_sk = 1
    GROUP BY d.d_year, cc.cc_division_name, we.web_name, cp.cp_department
)
SELECT 
    sa.d_year,
    sa.cc_division_name,
    sa.web_name,
    sa.cp_department,
    sa.distinct_customers,
    sa.total_store_profit,
    sa.total_web_profit,
    sa.total_catalog_sales,
    sa.total_store_returns_loss,
    sa.total_web_returns_loss,
    sa.avg_store_profit_per_tx,
    sa.avg_store_profit_by_date,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.d_year ORDER BY sa.total_store_profit DESC) AS store_profit_rank
FROM sales_agg sa
ORDER BY sa.total_store_profit DESC
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        d_sold.d_year AS year,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_cs_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_cs_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS cs_order_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk,
             cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
             cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
             d_sold.d_year
),
ws_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        d_ws_sold.d_year AS year,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_ws_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_ws_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS ws_order_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk,
             ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
             ws.ws_web_page_sk,
             d_ws_sold.d_year
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.year,
        cs.total_cs_sales,
        cs.total_cs_profit,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        ws.total_ws_sales,
        ws.total_ws_profit
    FROM cs_agg cs
    FULL OUTER JOIN ws_agg ws
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = ws.ws_ship_mode_sk
        AND cs.year = ws.year
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(cc.cc_name, 'No Call Center') AS call_center_name,
    COALESCE(ws_site.web_name, 'No Web Site') AS web_site_name,
    COALESCE(sm_cs.sm_type, sm_ws.sm_type, 'Unknown') AS ship_mode_type,
    combined.year,
    combined.total_cs_sales,
    combined.total_cs_profit,
    combined.total_ws_sales,
    combined.total_ws_profit,
    t_cs.t_meal_time AS cs_meal_time,
    wp.wp_url AS web_page_url,
    (
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0)
        FROM web_returns wr
        JOIN web_sales ws_sub
            ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws_sub.ws_item_sk
           AND wr.wr_order_number = ws_sub.ws_order_number
        JOIN date_dim d_sub
            ON ws_sub.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sub.d_date_sk
        WHERE ws_sub.ws_ship_mode_sk = combined.ws_ship_mode_sk
          AND d_sub.d_year = combined.year
    ) AS total_return_amount,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.r_reason_desc)
        FROM web_returns wr
        JOIN reason r
            ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        JOIN web_sales ws_sub
            ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws_sub.ws_item_sk
           AND wr.wr_order_number = ws_sub.ws_order_number
        JOIN date_dim d_sub
            ON ws_sub.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sub.d_date_sk
        WHERE ws_sub.ws_ship_mode_sk = combined.ws_ship_mode_sk
          AND d_sub.d_year = combined.year
    ) AS distinct_return_reasons,
    d_cc_open.d_year AS cc_open_year,
    d_cc_closed.d_year AS cc_closed_year,
    d_ws_open.d_year AS ws_open_year,
    d_ws_close.d_year AS ws_close_year
FROM combined
LEFT JOIN call_center cc
    ON combined.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_cs
    ON combined.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_cs.sm_ship_mode_sk
LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_ws
    ON combined.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site ws_site
    ON combined.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON combined.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_open
    ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_cc_open.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_closed
    ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_closed.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ws_open
    ON ws_site.web_open_date_sk = d_ws_open.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ws_close
    ON ws_site.web_close_date_sk = d_ws_close.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cs
    ON combined.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_sales cs_check
    JOIN call_center cc_check
        ON cs_check.cs_call_center_sk = cc_check.cc_call_center_sk
    WHERE cs_check.cs_call_ce

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year, d_month_seq, d_day_name, 1 AS level
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2021-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dd.d_date_sk, dd.d_date, dd.d_year, dd.d_month_seq, dd.d_day_name, dh.level + 1
    FROM date_dim dd
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON dd.d_date = dh.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE dd.d_date <= DATE '2021-01-31'
)
SELECT
    dh.d_date,
    s.s_store_name,
    c.c_customer_id,
    we.web_name,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
    (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)) AS total_net_profit,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dh.d_date ORDER BY (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)) DESC) AS store_daily_rank,
    (SELECT SUM(cr2.cr_net_loss) FROM catalog_returns cr2 WHERE cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk) AS total_return_loss,
    cd.max_item_discount,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.s_state IN ('CA','OR','WA') THEN 'West'
        WHEN s.s_state IN ('NY','NJ','CT') THEN 'East'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS region
FROM
    date_hierarchy dh
JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN (SELECT * FROM store TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)) s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    AND cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    AND cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN time_dim t_ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
JOIN web_site we
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory i
    ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    AND i.inv_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_open
    ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_cc_open.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_close
    ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_close.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ws_open
    ON we.web_open_date_sk = d_ws_open.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ws_close
    ON we.web_close_date_sk = d_ws_close.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT max(cs_sub.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS max_item_discount
    FROM catalog_sales cs_sub
    WHERE cs_sub.cs_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
      AND cs_sub.cs_sold_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
) cd
WHERE
    dh.d_year = 2021
    AND sm.sm_contract LIKE 'A%'
    AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 1000
    AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 500
    AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 2
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
          AND wr2.wr_net_loss > 0
    )
GROUP BY
    dh.d_date,
    s.s_store_name,
    c.c_customer_id,
    we.web_name,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    cd.max_item_discount,
    s.s_state
ORDER BY
    dh.d_date,
    store_daily_rank
LIMIT 100

/*
  Goal: Identify the top‑profit items (by net profit across catalog, store and web channels) for the Electronics category,
  sold in California call centers to high‑value households, with strong customer preference. The query joins all 13 selected
  TPC‑DS tables, applies multiple filters, uses TABLESAMPLE, EXCEPT, a semi‑join via EXISTS, DISTINCT, a HAVING clause,
  a CASE expression and ranks the results.
*/
WITH distinct_cc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc_call_center_sk,
        cc_state,
        cc_city,
        cc_country
    FROM call_center
    WHERE cc_state = 'CA'
),

catalog_sales_no_return AS (
    SELECT cs.*
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT cs_order_number
        FROM catalog_sales
        EXCEPT
        SELECT cr_order_number
        FROM catalog_returns
    ) eo
        ON cs.cs_order_number = eo.cs_order_number
),

inventory_sample AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM inventory
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
),

catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)                     AS sum_catalog_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number)         AS cnt_sales_orders,
        MAX(cs.cs_call_center_sk)                  AS any_call_center_sk,
        MAX(cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk)                   AS any_hdemo_sk,
        MAX(cs.cs_bill_customer_sk)                AS any_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales_no_return cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0
),

store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ss.*, t.t_hour
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
),

store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS sum_store_profit,
        COUNT(*)               AS cnt_store_transactions
    FROM store_sales_filtered ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
),

web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)    AS sum_web_profit,
        COUNT(*)                 AS cnt_web_transactions,
        MAX(ws.ws_quantity)      AS max_ws_quantity,
        MAX(ws.ws_web_page_sk)   AS any_web_page_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 5
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk
),

catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)      AS sum_catalog_return_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS cnt_catalog_return_orders,
        MAX(cr.cr_reason_sk)     AS any_catalog_reason_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
),

web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss)      AS sum_web_return_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS cnt_web_return_orders,
        MAX(wr.wr_reason_sk)     AS any_web_reason_sk,
        MAX(wr.wr_web_page_sk)   AS any_wr_web_page_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk
),

web_page_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_type,
        wp.wp_city
    FROM web_page wp
    WHERE wp.wp_type = 'product'
),

joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        ca.sum_catalog_profit,
        sa.sum_store_profit,
        wa.sum_web_profit,
        COALESCE(cra.sum_catalog_return_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wra.sum_web_return_loss, 0) AS sum_return_loss,
        ca.cnt_sales_orders,
        sa.cnt_store_transactions,
        wa.cnt_web_transactions,
        cra.cnt_catalog_return_orders,
        wra.cnt_web_return_orders,
        cc.cc_state,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        r_cat.r_reason_desc          AS catalog_return_reason,
        r_web.r_reason_desc          AS web_return_reason,
        wp_ws.wp_type                AS web_page_type,
        wp_wr.wp_city                AS web_return_page_city,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag
    FROM item i
    JOIN inventory_sample inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales_agg ca   ON i.i_item_sk = ca.cs_item_sk
    LEFT

SELECT
    d_date.d_year AS sales_year,
    s.s_store_name AS store_name,
    p_store.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_total,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS catalog_sales_total,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS web_sales_total,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_returns_loss
FROM
    store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) AS ss
JOIN date_dim d_date
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_date.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_time
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_time.t_time_sk
JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN promotion p_store
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_store.p_promo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
-- store returns
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
   AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d_return
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_return
    ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr
    ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
-- catalog sales
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_date.d_date_sk
   AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_time.t_time_sk
JOIN promotion p_cs
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cs.p_promo_sk
JOIN call_center cc_cs
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc_cs.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp_cs
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_cs.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_cs
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_cs.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_cs
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_cs_bill
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_cs_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_cs_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_cs_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cs_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_cs_ship.d_date_sk
-- catalog returns
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN date_dim d_cr_return
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr_return.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_cr_return
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr_return.t_time_sk
JOIN call_center cc_cr
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_cr.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp_cr
    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp_cr.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_cr
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_cr
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_cr_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_refunded.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_cr_returning
    ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_returning.cd_demo_sk
-- web sales
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_date.d_date_sk
   AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_time.t_time_sk
JOIN promotion p_ws
    ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_ws
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_ws
    ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_ship.cd_demo_sk
GROUP BY
    ROLLUP(d_date.d_year, s.s_store_name, p_store.p_promo_name)
ORDER BY
    store_sales_total DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  w.w_warehouse_id,
  w.w_warehouse_name,
  p.p_promo_name,
  td.t_sub_shift,
  td.t_meal_time,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
  AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon_amt,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
  MIN(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS min_discount_amt,
  MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS max_net_profit,
  (
    SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_discount_amt)
    FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  ) AS avg_discount_by_warehouse
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE td.t_time IN (14, 9)
  AND td.t_sub_shift = 'morning'
  AND td.t_meal_time = 'breakfast'
  AND cs.cs_coupon_amt > 0
  AND cs.cs_net_paid >= 1500
  AND p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
  AND p.p_channel_press = 'N'
  AND cs.cs_bill_addr_sk IN (4892495, 5111435)
  AND cs.cs_item_sk IN (
    SELECT p_sub.p_item_sk
    FROM promotion p_sub
    WHERE p_sub.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND p_sub.p_channel_email = 'Y'
  )
GROUP BY
  w.w_warehouse_id,
  w.w_warehouse_name,
  p.p_promo_name,
  td.t_sub_shift,
  td.t_meal_time
LIMIT 100

WITH returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_order_number,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_order_number
)
SELECT
    cd_bill.cd_gender,
    cd_bill.cd_education_status,
    t_sale.t_hour,
    wp_sale.wp_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS num_orders,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    COALESCE(ra.total_return_amt, 0) AS total_return_amount,
    COALESCE(ra.total_net_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN time_dim t_sale
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sale.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp_sale
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp_sale.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
   AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
JOIN time_dim t_return
    ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded
    ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning
    ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp_return
    ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp_return.wp_web_page_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra
    ON ws.ws_order_number = ra.wr_order_number
WHERE ws.ws_web_page_sk IN (
    SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk
    FROM web_page wp
    WHERE wp.wp_image_count > 4
)
GROUP BY cd_bill.cd_gender, cd_bill.cd_education_status, t_sale.t_hour, wp_sale.wp_type
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM catalog_returns
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) REPEATABLE (12345)
    WHERE cr_return_ship_cost > 50.00
      AND cr_return_quantity > 0
      AND cr_return_amount > 0.00
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        ws.web_state,
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        wp.wp_link_count
    FROM filtered_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON d.d_date_sk = wp.wp_creation_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws ON d.d_date_sk = ws.web_open_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_holiday = 'N'
      AND d.d_year = 2000
      AND i.i_current_price > 100.00
      AND wp.wp_link_count >= 10
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        jd.d_year,
        jd.i_brand,
        jd.i_category,
        jd.web_state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT jd.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        SUM(jd.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(jd.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
        MAX(jd.cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount,
        MIN(jd.cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount
    FROM joined_data jd
    GROUP BY jd.d_year, jd.i_brand, jd.i_category, jd.web_state
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    a.d_year,
    a.i_brand,
    a.i_category,
    a.web_state,
    a.distinct_orders,
    a.total_return_amount,
    a.avg_return_amount,
    a.max_return_amount,
    a.min_return_amount,
    (SELECT AVG(cr4.cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns cr4) AS overall_avg_return_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.i_brand ORDER BY a.total_return_amount DESC) AS brand_return_rank
FROM aggregated a
ORDER BY a.total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
  Goal: Identify the cities with the highest total net loss from store returns, separating morning (9‑12 am) and afternoon (1‑6 pm) periods, filtering by email domain patterns and suite‑number patterns, and showcasing string processing, lateral joins, sampling, subqueries, and UNION aggregation.
*/
WITH sampled_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_addr_sk,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_tax,
        sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
)
SELECT
    ra.ca_city AS city,
    CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS customer_name,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.c_email_address, '@(.+)$', 1) AS email_domain,
    cur_addr.cur_suite_number,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    (SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_net_loss)
     FROM store_returns sr2
     WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS customer_total_net_loss
FROM sampled_returns sr
JOIN customer c
  ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN time_dim td
  ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ra
  ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ra.ca_address_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ca.ca_suite_number AS cur_suite_number,
           ca.ca_location_type AS cur_location_type
    FROM customer_address ca
    WHERE ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
) AS cur_addr
WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 12
  AND REGEXP_LIKE(c.c_email_address, '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@example\\.com$')
GROUP BY
    ra.ca_city,
    CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name),
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.c_email_address, '@(.+)$', 1),
    cur_addr.cur_suite_number

UNION

SELECT
    ra.ca_city AS city,
    CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS customer_name,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.c_email_address, '@(.+)$', 1) AS email_domain,
    cur_addr.cur_suite_number,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    (SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_net_loss)
     FROM store_returns sr2
     WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS customer_total_net_loss
FROM sampled_returns sr
JOIN customer c
  ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN time_dim td
  ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ra
  ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ra.ca_address_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ca.ca_suite_number AS cur_suite_number,
           ca.ca_location_type AS cur_location_type
    FROM customer_address ca
    WHERE ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
) AS cur_addr
WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 13 AND 18
  AND ra.ca_suite_number LIKE 'Suite %'
GROUP BY
    ra.ca_city,
    CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name),
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.c_email_address, '@(.+)$', 1),
    cur_addr.cur_suite_number

ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH ss_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount
    FROM
        store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
        JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451462 AND 2451557
    GROUP BY
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category
),
cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount
    FROM
        catalog_sales cs
        JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451462 AND 2451557
    GROUP BY
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category
)
SELECT
    q.item_sk,
    q.i_item_id,
    q.i_category,
    q.sales_amount,
    q.source,
    (SELECT SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity)
     FROM catalog_returns cr
     WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = q.item_sk
       AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2451462 AND 2451557) AS total_return_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT item_sk, i_item_id, i_category, sales_amount, 'store' AS source
    FROM ss_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT item_sk, i_item_id, i_category, sales_amount, 'catalog' AS source
    FROM cs_agg
) q
ORDER BY q.sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT MIN(date_sk) AS date_sk FROM (
        SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk FROM catalog_sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws_sold_date_sk FROM web_sales
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1 FROM date_series
    WHERE date_sk < (
        SELECT MAX(date_sk) FROM (
            SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk FROM catalog_sales
            UNION ALL
            SELECT ws_sold_date_sk FROM web_sales
        )
    )
),
union_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sale_date_sk,
        td.t_hour AS hour,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_profit > 0
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM warehouse w
          WHERE w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
            AND w.w_state = 'OH'
      )
    GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk, td.t_hour
    UNION
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sale_date_sk,
        td.t_hour AS hour,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_net_profit > 0
      AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk IN (
          SELECT w_warehouse_sk FROM warehouse WHERE w_state = 'OH'
      )
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, td.t_hour
)
SELECT
    ds.date_sk AS sale_date_sk,
    us.hour,
    COALESCE(us.total_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit
FROM date_series ds
LEFT JOIN union_sales us ON ds.date_sk = us.sale_date_sk
ORDER BY ds.date_sk ASC, us.hour ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH overall_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(wr_return_tax) AS avg_tax
    FROM tpcds.web_returns
),
refunded_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'Refunded' AS demographic_role,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        overall_stats.avg_tax AS avg_tax,
        (SELECT AVG(wr2.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) FROM tpcds.web_returns wr2) AS avg_return_amt_all
    FROM tpcds.web_returns wr
    JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
        ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    CROSS JOIN overall_stats
    WHERE hd.hd_dep_count >= 5
      AND wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax > 500
    GROUP BY CUBE (hd.hd_buy_potential, ib.ib_lower_bound)
),
returning_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'Returning' AS demographic_role,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        overall_stats.avg_tax AS avg_tax,
        (SELECT AVG(wr2.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) FROM tpcds.web_returns wr2) AS avg_return_amt_all
    FROM tpcds.web_returns wr
    JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
        ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    CROSS JOIN overall_stats
    WHERE hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 0
      AND wr.wr_return_tax > 10
    GROUP BY CUBE (hd.hd_buy_potential, ib.ib_lower_bound)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM refunded_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM returning_agg
)
SELECT
    demographic_role,
    hd_buy_potential,
    ib_lower_bound,
    total_return_amt,
    total_return_tax,
    total_return_qty,
    avg_tax,
    avg_return_amt_all
FROM combined
ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sampled_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss_item_sk,
        ss_quantity,
        ss_net_paid,
        ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42)
),

store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,
        'store' AS source_type,
        SUBSTRING(i.i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 10) AS desc_snippet,
        CONCAT(i.i_product_name, '-', 'store') AS product_label
    FROM sampled_store_sales ss
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = (SELECT max(d_year) FROM date_dim)
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_item_desc, '^[A-Z][a-z]+')
      AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%a%'
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_item_desc
),

catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > (SELECT avg(cs2.cs_net_paid) FROM catalog_sales cs2) THEN 'AboveAvg' ELSE 'BelowAvg' END AS profit_category,
        'catalog' AS source_type,
        SUBSTRING(i.i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 10) AS desc_snippet,
        CONCAT(i.i_product_name, '-', 'catalog') AS product_label
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1210 AND 1212
      AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%e%'
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_item_desc
),

combined AS (
    SELECT
        i_item_sk,
        i_product_name,
        transaction_count,
        total_sales,
        profit_category,
        source_type,
        desc_snippet,
        product_label
    FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        i_item_sk,
        i_product_name,
        transaction_count,
        total_sales,
        profit_category,
        source_type,
        desc_snippet,
        product_label
    FROM catalog_agg
)

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM combined
    EXCEPT
    SELECT
        c.i_item_sk,
        c.i_product_name,
        c.transaction_count,
        c.total_sales,
        c.profit_category,
        c.source_type,
        c.desc_snippet,
        c.product_label
    FROM combined c
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON c.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
) AS final_result
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 5
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_state,
        cc.cc_mkt_id,
        cc.cc_rec_start_date,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_manufact,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca.ca_state AS ca_state,
        cd.cd_gender,
        sm.sm_type,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        ws.ws_quantity AS ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        wp.wp_type,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_paid > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS net_paid_category,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS rn
    FROM call_center cc
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    WHERE
        cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND cc.cc_mkt_id = 3
        AND cc.cc_rec_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
        AND i.i_manufact = 'barcallyese'
        AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
        AND cs.cs_quantity >= 2
        AND cs.cs_net_paid > 1000
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2 WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        )
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        cc_state,
        i_manufact,
        sm_type,
        net_paid_category,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_cs_net_paid,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_cr_net_loss,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_ws_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(*) AS total_rows
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (cc_state, i_manufact, sm_type, net_paid_category)
)
SELECT
    cc_state,
    i_manufact,
    sm_type,
    net_paid_category,
    total_cs_net_paid,
    total_cr_net_loss,
    total_ws_net_paid,
    distinct_customers,
    total_rows,
    (SELECT MAX(n) FROM seq) AS max_seq
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY cc_state NULLS LAST, i_manufact NULLS LAST, sm_type NULLS LAST, net_paid_category
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq (n) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 5
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        c.c_salutation,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_coupon_amt,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cs_sold_date_sk,
            cs_sold_time_sk,
            cs_ship_date_sk,
            cs_bill_customer_sk,
            cs_ship_customer_sk,
            cs_call_center_sk,
            cs_catalog_page_sk,
            cs_ship_mode_sk,
            cs_warehouse_sk,
            cs_item_sk,
            cs_promo_sk,
            cs_order_number,
            cs_quantity,
            cs_wholesale_cost,
            cs_list_price,
            cs_sales_price,
            cs_ext_discount_amt,
            cs_ext_sales_price,
            cs_ext_wholesale_cost,
            cs_ext_list_price,
            cs_ext_tax,
            cs_coupon_amt,
            cs_ext_ship_cost,
            cs_net_paid,
            cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
            cs_net_paid_inc_ship,
            cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
            cs_net_profit
        FROM catalog_sales
        TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    ) cs
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE
        cs.cs_coupon_amt > 500
        AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship > 4000
        AND c.c_salutation = 'Mrs.'
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        fs.customer_sk,
        fs.c_salutation,
        fs.cs_order_number,
        fs.cs_net_profit,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        s.n
    FROM filtered_sales fs
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = fs.customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_return_ship_cost < 1000
    JOIN seq s
        ON ((fs.cs_order_number % 5) + 1) = s.n
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_returning_customer_sk = fs.customer_sk
          AND wr2.wr_return_amt > 2000
    )
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        jd.customer_sk,
        jd.c_salutation,
        COUNT(DISTINCT jd.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(jd.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(jd.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
        SUM(jd.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jd.wr_return_quantity > 0 THEN jd.cs_order_number END) AS return_order_cnt
    FROM joined_data jd
    GROUP BY jd.customer_sk, jd.c_salutation
)
SELECT
    a.customer_sk,
    a.c_salutation,
    a.order_cnt,
    a.total_profit,
    a.avg_profit,
    a.total_net_loss,
    a.return_order_cnt,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(a.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY a.c_salutation ORDER BY a.total_profit ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit_by_salutation
FROM agg a
ORDER BY a.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2000-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT nd.d_date_sk, nd.d_date
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim nd ON nd.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE ds.d_date < DATE '2000-01-07'
),
promo_words AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name,
        split(p.p_promo_name, ' ') AS promo_word_array
    FROM promotion p
),
promo_words_unnested AS (
    SELECT
        pw.p_promo_sk,
        pw.p_promo_name,
        w.word AS promo_word
    FROM promo_words pw
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(pw.promo_word_array) AS t(word)
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date,
        pw.promo_word,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS profit_category,
        'store' AS source
    FROM (SELECT * FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5)) ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_series ds ON d.d_date = ds.d_date
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN promo_words_unnested pw ON p.p_promo_sk = pw.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY ds.d_date, pw.promo_word
),
catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date,
        pw.promo_word,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 15000 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS profit_category,
        'catalog' AS source
    FROM (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5)) cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_series ds ON d.d_date = ds.d_date
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN promo_words_unnested pw ON p.p_promo_sk = pw.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY ds.d_date, pw.promo_word
)
SELECT
    final.d_date,
    final.promo_word,
    final.total_profit,
    final.profit_category,
    final.source,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY final.source ORDER BY final.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM (
    SELECT d_date, promo_word, total_profit, profit_category, source
    FROM store_sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_date, promo_word, total_profit, profit_category, source
    FROM catalog_sales_agg
) AS final
ORDER BY final.source, final.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS amount,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS profit,
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        'sales' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 150000
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 18
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 0
),
returns_data AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        sr.sr_return_amt AS amount,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS profit,
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        'store_return' AS source
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound > 50000
      AND td.t_hour >= 12
      AND sr.sr_return_amt > 0
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM sales_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM returns_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        wr.wr_return_amt AS amount,
        wr.wr_fee AS profit,
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        'web_return' AS source
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN reason r2 ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_type = 'product'
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound < 100000
      AND td.t_hour >= 9
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        source,
        item_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers,
        AVG(CASE WHEN source = 'sales' THEN amount END) AS avg_sales_amount,
        MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'store_return' THEN profit END) AS max_store_return_loss,
        MIN(amount) AS min_amount,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY source) AS sum_amount_by_source,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(amount) > 10000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(amount) > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS amount_category
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY source, item_id
)
SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rn
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 5
),
non_returned_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_order_number
    FROM catalog_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT DISTINCT cr_order_number
    FROM catalog_returns
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    cp.cp_description AS catalog_page_desc,
    w.w_city AS warehouse_city,
    s.s_store_name AS store_name,
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_quantity,
    cs.cs_net_profit,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cr2.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    ) AS total_return_amount,
    promo.p_promo_id,
    promo.p_discount_active,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_name ORDER BY cs.cs_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    LAG(cs.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_name ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS prev_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_name ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit,
    seq.n AS seq_num
FROM call_center cc
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_discount_active
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
    LIMIT 1
) AS promo
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN store s
    ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN seq
    ON cs.cs_quantity > seq.n
WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND cp.cp_catalog_page_number BETWEEN 1 AND 18
  AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND w.w_country = 'USA'
  AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
  AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451114 AND 2451452
  AND cs.cs_order_number IN (SELECT order_number FROM non_returned_orders)
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
          AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    )
ORDER BY profit_rank, cs.cs_order_number
LIMIT 100

WITH
store_channel AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
        COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) AS store_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_orders
    FROM store_sales ss
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_returns sr
        ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk
),

catalog_channel AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS catalog_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS catalog_orders
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
),

web_channel AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS web_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site wsite
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_type = 'type'
      AND wsite.web_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY ws.ws_promo_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk
),

aggregated_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        p.p_promo_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(sc.store_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ccat.catalog_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(wc.web_net_paid, 0)) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(COALESCE(sc.store_orders, 0) + COALESCE(ccat.catalog_orders, 0) + COALESCE(wc.web_orders, 0)) AS total_orders,
        (SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_net_paid) FROM catalog_sales cs2 WHERE cs2.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk) AS max_catalog_net_paid,
        CASE WHEN MIN(p.p_discount_active) = 'Y' THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'Regular' END AS promo_type,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cc2.cc_call_center_id) FROM call_center cc2 WHERE cc2.cc_state = 'CA') AS num_call_centers_ca
    FROM promotion p
    LEFT JOIN store_channel sc
        ON sc.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_channel ccat
        ON ccat.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_channel wc
        ON wc.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c
        ON COALESCE(sc.ss_customer_sk, ccat.cust_sk, wc.cust_sk) = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON COALESCE(sc.ss_cdemo_sk, ccat.demo_sk, wc.demo_sk) = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_sales cs3 WHERE cs3.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND cs3.cs_quantity > 5)
      AND c.c_birth_year >= 1970
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr2
          JOIN reason r2 ON sr2.sr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
          WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            AND r2.r_reason_desc LIKE '%size%'
      )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (c.c_customer_id, p.p_promo_id)
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    p_promo_id,
    total_net_paid,
    total_orders,
    max_catalog_net_paid,
    promo_type,
    num_call_centers_ca,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS spend_rank
FROM aggregated_sales
WHERE total_net_paid > 0
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor: earliest time record
    SELECT
        t_time_sk,
        t_time,
        t_hour,
        t_minute,
        t_second,
        t_am_pm,
        t_shift,
        t_sub_shift,
        t_meal_time,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_time = (SELECT MIN(t_time) FROM time_dim)
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step: next second in the sequence (limit depth to avoid runaway)
    SELECT
        td.t_time_sk,
        td.t_time,
        td.t_hour,
        td.t_minute,
        td.t_second,
        td.t_am_pm,
        td.t_shift,
        td.t_sub_shift,
        td.t_meal_time,
        th.lvl + 1
    FROM time_hierarchy th
    JOIN time_dim td
      ON td.t_time = th.t_time + 1
    WHERE th.lvl < 10
)
SELECT
    sm.sm_type,
    sm.sm_code,
    wp.wp_type,
    wp.wp_link_count,
    th.t_shift,
    th.t_hour,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_count,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    MIN(wr.wr_fee) AS min_return_fee,
    MAX(wr.wr_return_tax) AS max_return_tax
FROM time_hierarchy th
JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = th.t_time_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
  ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = th.t_time_sk
  AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN web_page wp
  ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE
    sm.sm_type = 'EXPRESS'
    AND wp.wp_link_count > 5
    AND wp.wp_rec_start_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-09-01' AND DATE '2001-09-30'
    AND wr.wr_fee > 30
    AND th.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
GROUP BY CUBE (
    sm.sm_type,
    sm.sm_code,
    wp.wp_type,
    wp.wp_link_count,
    th.t_shift,
    th.t_hour
)
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE hours (hour) AS (
    SELECT MIN(t_hour) FROM time_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT hour + 1 FROM hours WHERE hour < (SELECT MAX(t_hour) FROM time_dim)
),
catalog_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i.i_formulation, '^\\d{3}')
),
web_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
),
catalog_only_items AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk FROM catalog_items
    EXCEPT
    SELECT ws_item_sk FROM web_items
),
base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_item_sk IN (SELECT cs_item_sk FROM catalog_only_items)
)
SELECT
    t.t_hour AS sale_hour,
    p.p_promo_name,
    concat(i.i_brand, ' - ', i.i_product_name) AS brand_product,
    substring(i.i_formulation, 1, 5) AS formulation_prefix,
    regexp_extract(i.i_formulation, '([0-9]+)', 1) AS formulation_number,
    sum(bs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    (SELECT sum(ws.ws_net_paid) FROM web_sales ws WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS total_web_net_paid,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound
FROM base_sales bs
JOIN time_dim t ON bs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN hours h ON t.t_hour = h.hour
JOIN item i ON bs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN promotion p ON bs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON bs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON bs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
WHERE p.p_promo_name LIKE '%Clearance%'
  AND i.i_category LIKE '%Electr%'
GROUP BY
    t.t_hour,
    p.p_promo_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_formulation,
    substring(i.i_formulation, 1, 5),
    regexp_extract(i.i_formulation, '([0-9]+)', 1),
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100
SELECT "Goal" AS goal, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS placeholder

WITH
store_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS website_name,
        p.p_promo_name AS promotion_name,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        CONCAT(CAST(ib.ib_lower_bound AS varchar), '-', CAST(ib.ib_upper_bound AS varchar)) AS income_band_range,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS sales_amount,
        CAST(0 AS bigint) AS inventory_qty,
        p.p_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS warehouse_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM promotion p_filt
        WHERE p_filt.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
          AND p_filt.p_channel_radio = 'N'
    )
),
web_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS store_name,
        ws_site.web_name AS website_name,
        p.p_promo_name AS promotion_name,
