        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        CONCAT(CAST(ib.ib_lower_bound AS varchar), '-', CAST(ib.ib_upper_bound AS varchar)) AS income_band_range,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS sales_amount,
        inv_lateral.wh_qty AS inventory_qty,
        p.p_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        wh.w_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse wh ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (

),
return_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS store_name,

        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS promo_sk,
        wh.w_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    INNER JOIN warehouse wh ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk

SELECT
    COALESCE(src.store_name, 'All Stores') AS store_name,

    src.promotion_name,
    ret.reason_desc,
    src.gender,
    src.income_band_range,
    SUM(src.sales_amount) AS total_sales_amount,

WITH RECURSIVE level_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM level_hierarchy WHERE lvl < 5
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_state,
        cc.cc_employees,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_type,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_list_price,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        sm.sm_type,
        td.t_hour,
        td.t_minute,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        ws.ws_quantity AS ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS ws_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        AND cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        cc.cc_state IN ('CA', 'TX')
        AND cc.cc_employees > 100
        AND cc.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
        AND cc.cc_rec_end_date <= DATE '2005-12-31'
        AND cs.cs_list_price > 100
        AND cs.cs_quantity >= 5
        AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
        AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2
            WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        )
)
SELECT
    h.lvl AS hierarchy_level,
    jd.cc_state,
    jd.sm_type,
    CASE WHEN jd.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable'
         WHEN jd.cs_net_profit < 0 THEN 'Loss'
         ELSE 'Break-even' END AS profit_category,
    SUM(jd.cs_net_paid) AS total_cs_net_paid,
    SUM(jd.ws_net_paid) AS total_ws_net_paid,
    MAX(l.avg_qty) AS avg_quantity_per_cc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.lvl ORDER BY SUM(jd.cs_net_paid) DESC) AS rn_within_level,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(jd.cs_net_paid) DESC) AS overall_rank
FROM joined_data jd
JOIN level_hierarchy h ON h.lvl = ((jd.cc_employees % 5) + 1)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_quantity) AS avg_qty
    FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_call_center_sk = jd.cc_call_center_sk
) l ON TRUE
GROUP BY ROLLUP(
    h.lvl,
    jd.cc_state,
    jd.sm_type,
    CASE WHEN jd.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable'
         WHEN jd.cs_net_profit < 0 THEN 'Loss'
         ELSE 'Break-even' END
)
ORDER BY total_cs_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        d.d_year,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND sr.sr_return_amt > 50
      AND r.r_reason_desc IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (d.d_year, r.r_reason_desc, sr.sr_customer_sk)
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        d.d_year,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer rc
        ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = rc.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer rt
        ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = rt.c_customer_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 100
      AND cp.cp_type IN ('ad', 'general')
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (d.d_year, r.r_reason_desc, cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(s.d_year, c.d_year) AS year,
    COALESCE(s.r_reason_desc, c.r_reason_desc) AS reason_desc,
    COALESCE(s.sr_customer_sk, c.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
    s.total_return_amt,
    c.total_return_amount,
    (
        SELECT MAX(p.p_cost)
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_start_date_sk = COALESCE(s.date_sk, c.date_sk)
    ) AS max_promo_cost,
    wp.wp_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.total_return_amt, 0) DESC) AS row_num
FROM store_agg s
FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_agg c
    ON s.date_sk = c.date_sk
   AND s.sr_customer_sk = c.customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = COALESCE(s.sr_customer_sk, c.customer_sk)
   AND wp.wp_creation_date_sk = COALESCE(s.date_sk, c.date_sk)
WHERE (wp.wp_type = 'ad' OR wp.wp_type = 'general')
  AND (COALESCE(s.total_return_amt, 0) > 200 OR COALESCE(c.total_return_amount, 0) > 200)
  AND COALESCE(s.r_reason_desc, c.r_reason_desc) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY row_num
LIMIT 100

WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_store_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
        AVG(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS avg_store_coupon
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 18
      AND ss.ss_quantity > 20
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 3000
      AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
),

catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_catalog_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
        AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_catalog_coupon,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 18
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 15
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
),

catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    INNER JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 18
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 0
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
),

web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_web_return_quantity,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    INNER JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 18
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
      AND wr.wr_return_amt > 0
      AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 4000
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk
),

item_details AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_current_price,
        i.i_color
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 500
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_current_price,
    COALESCE(ss.total_store_quantity, 0) AS store_quantity,
    COALESCE(ss.total_store_sales, 0) AS store_sales_amount,
    COALESCE(cs.total_catalog_quantity, 0) AS catalog_quantity,
    COALESCE(cs.total_catalog_sales, 0) AS catalog_sales_amount,
    COALESCE(cr.total_return_quantity, 0) AS catalog_return_qty,
    COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount, 0) AS catalog_return_amount,
    COALESCE(wr.total_web_return_quantity, 0) AS web_return_qty,
    COALESCE(wr.total_web_return_amount, 0) AS web_return_amount,
    COALESCE(ss.avg_store_coupon, 0) AS avg_store_coupon,
    COALESCE(cs.avg_catalog_coupon, 0) AS avg_catalog_coupon,
    cs.distinct_orders
FROM item_details i
LEFT JOI

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_month_seq = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d_next
      ON d_next.d_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d_next.d_year = 2001
),
base_data AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date AS d_date,
        i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name AS i_product_name,
        cd.cd_gender AS cd_gender,
        hd.hd_buy_potential AS hd_buy_potential,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
        ws.ws_sales_price
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t
      ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
      ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
      ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN promotion p
      ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
         AND p.p_start_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
      ON inv.inv_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
         AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
         AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
         AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
         AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
         AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
         AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
      ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
         AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
         AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
         AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
         AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        AND i.i_current_price > 20.00
        AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
        AND (p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y' OR p.p_channel_dmail IS NULL)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventory inv2
            WHERE inv2.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
              AND inv2.inv_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
              AND inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand = 0
        )
),
agg_data AS (
    SELECT
        d_date,
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        cd_gender,
        hd_buy_potential,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr_ticket_number) AS distinct_store_returns,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_sales_net_paid,
        AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount,
        MIN(ws_sales_price) AS min_sales_price,
        MAX(ws_sales_price) AS max_sales_price
    FROM base_data
    GROUP BY
        d_date,
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        cd_gender,
        hd_buy_potential
)
SELECT
    d_date,
    i_item_id,
    i_product_name,
    cd_gender,
    hd_buy_potential,
    distinct_store_returns,
    total_store_return_amount,
    total_sales_net_paid,
    avg_discount_amount,
    min_sales_price,
    max_sales_price,
    SUM(total_sales_net_paid) OVER (
        PARTITION BY i_item_id
        ORDER BY d_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_sales_net_paid
FROM agg_data
ORDER BY d_date DESC, total_sales_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_return_summary AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 10000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_reason_sk IN (
        SELECT r.r_reason_sk FROM reason r WHERE LOWER(r.r_reason_desc) LIKE '%gift%'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state
),
web_sales_summary AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_count,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 20000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ship_mode_sk IN (
        SELECT sm.sm_ship_mode_sk FROM ship_mode sm WHERE sm.sm_carrier IN ('Federal Express', 'UPS')
    )
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state
)
SELECT
    state,
    total_amount,
    total_category,
    source_type
FROM (
    SELECT
        state,
        total_return_amount AS total_amount,
        return_category AS total_category,
        'Store Return' AS source_type
    FROM store_return_summary
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        state,
        total_sales_amount AS total_amount,
        sales_category AS total_category,
        'Web Sale' AS source_type
    FROM web_sales_summary
) combined
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_division_name AS division_name,
        cp.cp_type AS page_type,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND cc.cc_rec_end_date   <= DATE '2001-12-31'
      AND cp.cp_type IN ('monthly', 'quarterly', 'bi-annual')
      AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > 500
      AND cs.cs_quantity >= 1
      AND cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost > 2000
    GROUP BY cc.cc_division_name, cp.cp_type
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        division_name,
        page_type,
        total_sales,
        total_profit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS rn
    FROM sales_agg
),
recursive_cum AS (
    -- Anchor: first ranked row
    SELECT
        division_name,
        page_type,
        total_sales,
        total_profit,
        rn,
        total_profit AS cum_profit,
        total_sales  AS cum_sales
    FROM ranked_sales
    WHERE rn = 1

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step: add the next rank
    SELECT
        rs.division_name,
        rs.page_type,
        rs.total_sales,
        rs.total_profit,
        rs.rn,
        rc.cum_profit + rs.total_profit AS cum_profit,
        rc.cum_sales  + rs.total_sales  AS cum_sales
    FROM ranked_sales rs
    JOIN recursive_cum rc
        ON rs.rn = rc.rn + 1
)
SELECT
    division_name,
    page_type,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    rn,
    cum_profit,
    cum_sales,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cum_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_sales
FROM recursive_cum
ORDER BY cum_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE url_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor: start from each web page URL that matches the shop pattern
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_url AS url,
        1 AS level
    FROM web_page wp
    WHERE wp.wp_url LIKE '%/shop/%'

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step: strip the last path segment to walk up the URL hierarchy
    SELECT
        uh.wp_web_page_sk,
        regexp_replace(uh.url, '/[^/]*$', '') AS url,
        uh.level + 1 AS level
    FROM url_hierarchy uh
    WHERE uh.url LIKE '%/%' AND uh.level < 5
),
intersected_orders AS (
    SELECT ws_order_number
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_quantity > 10
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws_order_number
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_ext_discount_amt > 0
)
SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    i.i_category,
    uh.level,
    d.domain,
    CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS customer_name,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS num_orders
FROM intersected_orders io
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_order_number = io.ws_order_number
JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN url_hierarchy uh ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = uh.wp_web_page_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT regexp_extract(wp.wp_url, '^https?://([^/]+)/', 1) AS domain
) d
WHERE
    REGEXP_LIKE(c.c_email_address, '.*@example\\.com$')
    AND wp.wp_url LIKE '%/shop/%'
    AND (cd.cd_marital_status = 'M' OR cd.cd_marital_status = 'S')
    AND t.t_meal_time = 'lunch'
GROUP BY CUBE (
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    i.i_category,
    uh.level,
    d.domain,
    CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name)
)
HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 10000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 100
),
promo_words AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           p.p_promo_name,
           t.token
    FROM promotion p
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(p.p_promo_name, ' ')) AS t(token)
    WHERE p.p_promo_sk IN (SELECT n FROM seq)
)
SELECT
    pw.p_promo_sk,
    pw.p_promo_name,
    pw.token,
    CAST('catalog' AS varchar) AS channel,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN promo_words pw ON cs.cs_promo_sk = pw.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
WHERE sm.sm_contract = 'Xjy3ZPuiDjzHlRx14Z3'
GROUP BY pw.p_promo_sk, pw.p_promo_name, pw.token
UNION ALL
SELECT
    pw.p_promo_sk,
    pw.p_promo_name,
    pw.token,
    CAST('web' AS varchar) AS channel,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN promo_words pw ON ws.ws_promo_sk = pw.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
WHERE sm.sm_contract = 'Xjy3ZPuiDjzHlRx14Z3'
GROUP BY pw.p_promo_sk, pw.p_promo_name, pw.token
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    d.d_year,
    ca_ret.ca_state,
    cd_ret.cd_gender,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    AVG(cr.cr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax,
    COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
    MAX(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS max_return_qty,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_returns wr_sub
        WHERE wr_sub.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    ) AS web_returns_on_date
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN date_dim d
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ret
    ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret
    ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  AND d.d_month_seq = 120
  AND t.t_meal_time = 'lunch'
  AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
  AND ca_ret.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND cr.cr_return_amount > 1000
GROUP BY ROLLUP (d.d_year, ca_ret.ca_state, cd_ret.cd_gender, p.p_channel_tv)
HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 5000
ORDER BY d.d_year ASC, total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH ws_detail AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 0
),
warehouse_sales AS (
    SELECT
        'warehouse' AS entity_type,
        w.w_warehouse_id AS entity_id,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS entity_name,
        SUM(d.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(d.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
            ELSE 'NonPositive'
        END AS profit_category,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.ws_order_number) AS order_count,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM web_sales ws2
            WHERE ws2.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
              AND ws2.ws_net_profit > (
                  SELECT SUM(ws3.ws_net_profit)
                  FROM web_sales ws3
                  WHERE ws3.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
              )
        ) AS higher_profit_cnt
    FROM ws_detail d
    JOIN warehouse w ON d.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_site s ON d.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk
    WHERE s.web_mkt_class LIKE '%services%'
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name
    HAVING SUM(d.ws_net_profit) > 5000
),
page_sales AS (
    SELECT
        'web_page' AS entity_type,
        wp.wp_web_page_id AS entity_id,
        wp.wp_url AS entity_name,
        SUM(d.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(d.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
            ELSE 'NonPositive'
        END AS profit_category,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.ws_order_number) AS order_count,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM web_sales ws2
            WHERE ws2.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
              AND ws2.ws_net_profit > (
                  SELECT SUM(ws3.ws_net_profit)
                  FROM web_sales ws3
                  WHERE ws3.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
              )
        ) AS higher_profit_cnt
    FROM ws_detail d
    JOIN web_page wp ON d.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_max_ad_count >= 2
      AND wp.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '1999-09-01'
    GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url
    HAVING SUM(d.ws_net_profit) > 2000
)
SELECT
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    entity_name,
    total_profit,
    profit_category,
    order_count,
    higher_profit_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS rn
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM warehouse_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM page_sales
) AS combined
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_birth_month,
        regexp_extract(c.c_email_address, '@([^.]*)\\.') AS email_domain,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag
    FROM tpcds.customer c
    WHERE c.c_email_address IS NOT NULL
        AND regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '@(example|test)\\.com$')
        AND c.c_login LIKE 'A%'
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
),
customer_returns AS (
    SELECT
        fc.c_customer_sk,
        fc.c_birth_month,
        fc.email_domain,
        fc.c_first_name,
        fc.c_last_name,
        fc.c_login,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        MIN(sr.sr_return_amt) AS min_return_amt,
        MAX(sr.sr_return_amt) AS max_return_amt
    FROM filtered_customers fc
    JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 0
    GROUP BY fc.c_customer_sk, fc.c_birth_month, fc.email_domain, fc.c_first_name, fc.c_last_name, fc.c_login
)
SELECT
    cr.c_birth_month,
    cr.email_domain,
    cr.c_first_name || ' ' || cr.c_last_name AS full_name,
    substring(cr.c_login, 1, 1) AS login_initial,
    cr.total_net_loss,
    cr.return_count,
    cr.min_return_amt,
    cr.max_return_amt
FROM customer_returns cr
WHERE cr.total_net_loss > 500

UNION ALL

SELECT
    cr.c_birth_month,
    cr.email_domain,
    cr.c_first_name || ' ' || cr.c_last_name AS full_name,
    substring(cr.c_login, 1, 1) AS login_initial,
    cr.total_net_loss,
    cr.return_count,
    cr.min_return_amt,
    cr.max_return_amt
FROM customer_returns cr
WHERE cr.return_count >= 5
ORDER BY c_birth_month DESC, email_domain ASC, total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand,
        cd.cd_gender,
        CASE
            WHEN sr.sr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss'
            ELSE 'Profit'
        END AS profit_status,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p2.p_promo_id)
            FROM promotion p2
            WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
              AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        ) AS active_promo_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 100
      AND ss.ss_list_price > 50
      AND sr.sr_reversed_charge > 50
      AND sr.sr_return_tax <= 5
      AND p.p_channel_email = 'N'
      AND p.p_response_target = 1
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY
        i.i_brand,
        cd.cd_gender,
        CASE
            WHEN sr.sr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss'
            ELSE 'Profit'
        END
),

gender_agg AS (
    SELECT
        gender,
        COUNT(DISTINCT brand) AS brand_count,
        SUM(net_contribution) AS sum_net_contribution,
        AVG(net_contribution) AS avg_net_contribution,
        MAX(net_contribution) AS max_net_contribution
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i_brand AS brand,
            cd_gender AS gender,
            (total_sales_profit - total_return_loss) AS net_contribution
        FROM base_agg
    ) AS b
    WHERE net_contribution > 1000
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT
    gender,
    brand_count,
    sum_net_contribution,
    avg_net_contribution,
    max_net_contribution,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_net_contribution DESC) AS gender_profit_rank,
    SUM(avg_net_contribution) OVER () AS total_avg_net_across_genders
FROM gender_agg
ORDER BY avg_net_contribution DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d_next
      ON d_next.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '2001-01-31'
),
filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        ca.ca_city,
        ca.ca_state,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        r.r_reason_desc
    FROM store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-01-31'
),
lateral_item_code AS (
    SELECT
        fr.*, 
        ic.item_numeric_code
    FROM filtered_returns fr
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(fr.i_item_id, '(\\d+)', 1) AS item_numeric_code
    ) ic
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date,
        li.item_numeric_code,
        CONCAT(li.ca_city, ', ', li.ca_state) AS location,
        li.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(li.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        AVG(li.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss
    FROM lateral_item_code li
    JOIN date_series ds ON li.sr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(li.i_item_desc, '.*[0-9]{3}.*')
      AND li.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%'
    GROUP BY ds.d_date,
             li.item_numeric_code,
             CONCAT(li.ca_city, ', ', li.ca_state),
             li.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    a.d_date,
    a.item_numeric_code,
    a.location,
    a.r_reason_desc,
    a.total_net_loss,
    a.return_cnt,
    a.avg_net_loss,
    (SELECT AVG(sr2.sr_net_loss)
     FROM store_returns sr2
     JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
     WHERE d2.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-01-31') AS overall_avg_net_loss
FROM aggregated a
ORDER BY a.total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH item_dim AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk,
           i_brand,
           i_category,
           i_manufact_id,
           i_size
    FROM item
    WHERE i_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
), base AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_ship_cost,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_tax,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        w.w_county,
        w.w_country,
        wp.wp_type,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_manufact_id
    FROM catalog_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cr
    JOIN item_dim i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE w.w_county IN ('Ziebach County', 'Bronx County')
      AND i.i_manufact_id IN (212, 220)
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 100
      AND (wr.wr_return_amt IS NULL OR wr.wr_return_amt > 50)
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > (SELECT avg(cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns)
), agg AS (
    SELECT
        w_county,
        i_brand,
        i_category,
        wp_type,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
        SUM(cr_return_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost,
        SUM(cr_net_loss + COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_net_loss
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CUBE (w_county, i_brand, i_category, wp_type)
    HAVING SUM(cr_return_amount) > 500
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(w_county, 'ALL') AS county,
    COALESCE(i_brand, 'ALL') AS brand,
    COALESCE(i_category, 'ALL') AS category,
    COALESCE(wp_type, 'ALL') AS page_type,
    total_catalog_return_amount,
    total_web_return_amount,
    total_ship_cost,
    total_net_loss,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_catalog_return_amount DESC) AS rn_desc_return_amount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(w_county, 'ALL') ORDER BY total_catalog_return_amount DESC) AS rank_by_county
FROM agg
ORDER BY total_catalog_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_channel_tv,
        p.p_response_target,
        cd_s.cd_credit_rating AS sales_credit_rating,
        cd_r.cd_credit_rating AS return_credit_rating,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_refunded_cash,
        sr.sr_fee
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_s
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_s.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN store_returns sr
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_r
        ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_r.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE p.p_response_target = 1
      AND cd_s.cd_credit_rating IN ('High Risk', 'Good')
      AND sr.sr_fee > 20
      AND ss.ss_net_profit > 0
      AND sr.sr_return_amt < 1000
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        p_promo_id,
        p_channel_tv,
        sales_credit_rating,
        return_credit_rating,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_sales_paid,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(sr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) - SUM(sr_refunded_cash) AS net_gain
    FROM base
    GROUP BY
        p_promo_id,
        p_channel_tv,
        sales_credit_rating,
        return_credit_rating
)
SELECT
    p_promo_id,
    p_channel_tv,
    sales_credit_rating,
    return_credit_rating,
    total_sales_paid,
    total_sales_profit,
    total_return_amount,
    total_refunded_cash,
    net_gain,
    CASE
        WHEN net_gain > 5000 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS net_gain_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_gain DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM agg
ORDER BY profit_rank ASC, p_promo_id
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE catalog_page_seq AS (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk,
           cp_catalog_page_number,
           cp_catalog_number,
           cp_start_date_sk
    FROM catalog_page
    WHERE cp_catalog_page_sk = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
           cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
           cp.cp_catalog_number,
           cp.cp_start_date_sk
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN catalog_page_seq c ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = c.cp_catalog_page_sk + 1
    WHERE c.cp_catalog_page_sk < 5
)
SELECT
    cp.cp_catalog_number,
    cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    s.s_state,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amt,
    AVG(sr.sr_reversed_charge) AS avg_reversed_charge,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS distinct_ticket_count,
    MIN(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS min_income_lower,
    MAX(ib.ib_upper_bound) AS max_income_upper
FROM catalog_page_seq cp
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
FULL OUTER JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
WHERE cp.cp_start_date_sk >= 2450900
  AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
  AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 200000
  AND s.s_number_employees > 200
  AND sr.sr_reversed_charge > 100.00
  AND cr.cr_return_amount > 50.00
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM ship_mode sm
        WHERE sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cr.cr_ship_mode_sk
          AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    )
GROUP BY
    cp.cp_catalog_number,
    cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    s.s_state
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode_id,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        MIN(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS min_sold_date_sk,
        MAX(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS max_sold_date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '.*[0-9]{3}.*')
      AND sm.sm_contract LIKE 'O9V6%'
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, i.i_product_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, cc.cc_name
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode_id,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS call_center_name,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        MIN(ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS min_sold_date_sk,
        MAX(ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS max_sold_date_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE i.i_category LIKE '%Electronics%'
      AND regexp_like(sm.sm_contract, '^.*$')
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, i.i_product_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id
    HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0
),
combined_sales AS (
    SELECT item_sk, product_name, ship_mode_id, call_center_name,
           net_profit, total_quantity, order_count, min_sold_date_sk, max_sold_date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT item_sk, product_name, ship_mode_id, call_center_name,
           net_profit, total_quantity, order_count, min_sold_date_sk, max_sold_date_sk
    FROM web_sales_agg
),
avg_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM combined_sales
)
SELECT
    cs.item_sk,
    cs.product_name,
    cs.ship_mode_id,
    cs.call_center_name,
    SUM(cs.net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.total_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS source_count,
    concat(cs.product_name, '_', cs.ship_mode_id) AS product_ship_key,
    regexp_extract(cs.product_name, '([A-Z0-9]+)', 1) AS extracted_code,
    (SELECT MAX(cs2.net_profit) FROM combined_sales cs2) AS max_net_profit_overall
FROM combined_sales cs
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM inventory inv
    WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = cs.item_sk
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
)
GROUP BY cs.item_sk, cs.product_name, cs.ship_mode_id, cs.call_center_name
HAVING SUM(cs.total_quantity) > (SELECT avg_quantity FROM avg_stats)
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sampled_store_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_addr_sk,
        sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
        d.d_year
    FROM (SELECT * FROM store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42)) sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE hd.hd_vehicle_count > 2
)
SELECT
    agg.return_year,
    agg.total_net_loss,
    agg.total_returns,
    agg.distinct_web_customers
FROM (
    SELECT
        return_year,
        SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk)
            FROM web_sales ws
            JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            WHERE d2.d_year = return_year
        ) AS distinct_web_customers
    FROM (
        SELECT
            d_year AS return_year,
            sr_net_loss AS net_loss,
            sr_return_quantity AS return_quantity
        FROM sampled_store_returns
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            d.d_year AS return_year,
            cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss,
            cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_quantity
        FROM (SELECT * FROM catalog_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (99)) cr
        JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        WHERE hd.hd_dep_count > 1
    ) AS combined
    GROUP BY return_year
) AS agg
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_sales ws2
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE d3.d_year = agg.return_year
      AND ws2.ws_net_profit > 0
)
ORDER BY agg.total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series(inv_date_sk) AS (
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(inv_date_sk) FROM inventory)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT inv_date_sk + 1
    FROM date_series
    WHERE inv_date_sk < (SELECT MAX(inv_date_sk) FROM inventory)
),
filtered_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.inv_date_sk,
           i.inv_item_sk,
           i.inv_warehouse_sk,
           i.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory i
    WHERE i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND i.inv_item_sk IN (101438, 101428, 101419, 101440, 101426)
      AND i.inv_warehouse_sk IN (7, 9, 16, 17, 18)
      AND i.inv_date_sk BETWEEN 2450836 AND 2451060
      AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand < 1000
      AND i.inv_date_sk <> 2450850
),
excluded_items AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk
    FROM filtered_inventory
    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand < 100
),
remaining_items AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk
    FROM filtered_inventory
    EXCEPT
    SELECT inv_item_sk
    FROM excluded_items
),
final_data AS (
    SELECT 
        i.inv_item_sk,
        i.inv_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_city,
        CASE 
            WHEN w.w_city = 'Pleasant Hill' THEN 'PH'
            WHEN w.w_city = 'Fairview' THEN 'FV'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS city_group,
        i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        lt.total_qty_by_item
    FROM filtered_inventory i
    JOIN date_series d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.inv_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(i2.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_by_item
        FROM inventory i2
        WHERE i2.inv_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk
    ) lt
    WHERE i.inv_item_sk IN (SELECT inv_item_sk FROM remaining_items)
)
SELECT
    city_group,
    w_city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inv_item_sk) AS distinct_item_count,
    SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity,
    AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_quantity,
    MIN(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS min_quantity,
    MAX(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_quantity,
    SUM(total_qty_by_item) AS total_quantity_all_warehouses
FROM final_data
GROUP BY city_group, w_city
HAVING SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) > 500
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id AS call_center_id,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        cp.cp_department AS department,
        'sales' AS record_type,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS amount,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS profit_or_loss
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
),
returns AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id AS call_center_id,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        cp.cp_department AS department,
        'returns' AS record_type,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS profit_or_loss
    FROM tpcds.catalog_returns cr
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_returning ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
)
SELECT
    call_center_id,
    ship_mode_type,
    department,
    SUM(CASE WHEN record_type = 'sales' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN record_type = 'sales' THEN profit_or_loss ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN record_type = 'returns' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN record_type = 'returns' THEN profit_or_loss ELSE 0 END) AS total_return_loss
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM returns
) combined
GROUP BY call_center_id, ship_mode_type, department
ORDER BY call_center_id, ship_mode_type, department
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH avg_profit AS (
    SELECT avg(ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit
    FROM web_sales
),
air_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d_sold.d_year AS sales_year,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_type,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        SUM(lc.price_component) AS total_price_component,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT price_component
        FROM UNNEST(ARRAY[ws.ws_wholesale_cost, ws.ws_list_price, ws.ws_sales_price]) AS t(price_component)
        WHERE price_component > 100
    ) lc
    WHERE ws.ws_net_profit > (SELECT avg_net_profit FROM avg_profit)
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND i.i_manufact_id = 995
      AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'High Risk'
    GROUP BY d_sold.d_year, sm.sm_type
),
ground_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d_sold.d_year AS sales_year,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_type,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        SUM(lc.price_component) AS total_price_component,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT price_component
        FROM UNNEST(ARRAY[ws.ws_wholesale_cost, ws.ws_list_price, ws.ws_sales_price]) AS t(price_component)
        WHERE price_component > 100
    ) lc
    WHERE ws.ws_net_profit > (SELECT avg_net_profit FROM avg_profit)
      AND sm.sm_type = 'GROUND'
      AND i.i_manufact_id = 220
      AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Low Risk'
    GROUP BY d_sold.d_year, sm.sm_type
),
combined AS (
    SELECT sales_year, ship_type, total_net_profit, order_count, total_price_component, distinct_orders
    FROM air_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sales_year, ship_type, total_net_profit, order_count, total_price_component, distinct_orders
    FROM ground_sales
)
SELECT
    sales_year,
    ship_type,
    total_net_profit,
    order_count,
    total_price_component,
    distinct_orders
FROM combined
ORDER BY sales_year DESC, ship_type
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        cp.cp_department,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'PROFITABLE' ELSE 'LOW_PROFIT' END AS profit_category,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
        FROM income_band ib
        WHERE ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) ib
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cp.cp_type = 'PROMO'
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, cp.cp_department, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
)

SELECT
    cm.d_year,
    cm.d_month_seq,
    cm.cp_department,
    'catalog' AS channel,
    cm.total_sales,
    cm.total_profit,
    cm.profit_category,
    cm.order_cnt,
    cm.ib_lower_bound,
    cm.ib_upper_bound
FROM catalog_monthly cm

UNION ALL

SELECT
    d.d_year,
    d.d_month_seq,
    NULL AS cp_department,
    'web' AS channel,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 60000 THEN 'PROFITABLE' ELSE 'LOW_PROFIT' END AS profit_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    NULL AS ib_lower_bound,
    NULL AS ib_upper_bound
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM web_returns wr
      WHERE wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
  )
GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq

ORDER BY total_sales DESC
OFFSET 10 LIMIT 100

WITH item_promo_ful AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_wholesale_cost,
        i.i_current_price,
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active
    FROM item i
    FULL OUTER JOIN promotion p
        ON i.i_item_sk = p.p_item_sk
)
SELECT
    uq.event_type,
    uq.item_id,
    uq.event_date,
    uq.total_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        'sale' AS event_type,
        ipf.i_item_id AS item_id,
        d.d_date AS event_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_amount
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item_promo_ful ipf
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = ipf.i_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_item_sk IN (
            SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_wholesale_cost > 5
        )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_returns sr
            WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
              AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
        )
    GROUP BY ipf.i_item_id, d.d_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'return' AS event_type,
        ipf.i_item_id AS item_id,
        d.d_date AS event_date,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_amount
    FROM store_returns sr
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item_promo_ful ipf
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = ipf.i_item_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk IN (
            SELECT c_customer_sk
            FROM customer
            WHERE c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        )
    GROUP BY ipf.i_item_id, d.d_date
) uq
ORDER BY uq.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 20

WITH RECURSIVE promo_levels AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           p.p_promo_id,
           1 AS level
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pl.p_promo_sk,
           pl.p_promo_id,
           pl.level + 1
    FROM promo_levels pl
    WHERE pl.level < 3
),
customer_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 5000
)
SELECT
    u.cust_id,
    u.metric_type,
    u.metric_val,
    CASE WHEN u.metric_val > 5000 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS spend_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_returning_customer_sk = u.cust_sk) AS total_return_events
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id      AS cust_id,
        'PromotedNetPaid'    AS metric_type,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)  AS metric_val,
        c.c_customer_sk      AS cust_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promo_levels pl ON cs.cs_promo_sk = pl.p_promo_sk
    WHERE pl.level = 1
      AND c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT cust_sk FROM customer_sales)
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 2000

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id       AS cust_id,
        'ReturnAmount'        AS metric_type,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS metric_val,
        c.c_customer_sk       AS cust_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%Damaged%'
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 500
) u
ORDER BY u.metric_val DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE dh.lvl < 7
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    w.w_city,
    sm.sm_type,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_count,
    AVG(rc.return_count) AS avg_returns_per_order,
    (SELECT MAX(p_cost) FROM promotion) AS overall_max_promo_cost
FROM
    web_sales ws
INNER JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim t_sold
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse w
    ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN promotion promo
    ON ws.ws_promo_sk = promo.p_promo_sk
INNER JOIN web_site ws_site
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
   AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
INNER JOIN reason r
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim t_return
    ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d_return
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
   AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN call_center cc
    ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM web_returns wr2
    WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
) rc
WHERE d_sold.d_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_hierarchy)
GROUP BY CUBE (d_sold.d_year, w.w_city, sm.sm_type)
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

Goal: Analyze net paid revenue by item category and store state for steel items sold through a specific warehouse and call‑center market class, using a recursive CTE to aggregate across two sales levels.

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_year,
           d_month_seq,
           d_current_month
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk,
           d_next.d_date,
           d_next.d_year,
           d_next.d_month_seq,
           d_next.d_current_month
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d_next ON d_next.d_date = date_add('day', 1, ds.d_date)
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-31'
),
base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date,
        ds.d_date_sk,
        cc.cc_division_name,
        cd.cd_gender,
        td.t_hour,
        inv.inv_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
        AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_web_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS num_tickets,
        MIN(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS min_ext_sales,
        MAX(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS max_ext_sales,
        CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'M' THEN 'Male' ELSE 'Female' END AS gender_label
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    WHERE ds.d_year = 1998
      AND ds.d_month_seq = 1
      AND ds.d_current_month = 'Y'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND cc.cc_division_name = 'able'
      AND cc.cc_hours LIKE '8AM-12AM%'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
      AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = 10
      AND ss.ss_quantity > 1
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 1
    GROUP BY
        ds.d_date,
        ds.d_date_sk,
        cc.cc_division_name,
        cd.cd_gender,
        td.t_hour,
        inv.inv_warehouse_sk,
        CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'M' THEN 'Male' ELSE 'Female' END
)
SELECT
    ba.d_date,
    ba.cc_division_name,
    ba.cd_gender,
    ba.t_hour,
    ba.inv_warehouse_sk,
    ba.total_store_sales,
    ba.avg_web_profit,
    ba.num_tickets,
    ba.min_ext_sales,
    ba.max_ext_sales,
    ba.gender_label,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM (
            SELECT ss2.ss_ticket_number
            FROM store_sales ss2
            WHERE ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = ba.d_date_sk
            EXCEPT
            SELECT ws2.ws_order_number
            FROM web_sales ws2
            WHERE ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = ba.d_date_sk
        ) AS diff
    ) AS tickets_not_in_web,
    LAG(ba.total_store_sales) OVER (ORDER BY ba.d_date) AS lag_total_store_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ba.d_date) AS row_num
FROM base_agg ba
ORDER BY ba.d_date, ba.total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM seq WHERE lvl < 5
),
city_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.web_site_sk,
        ws.web_city,
        ws.web_name,
        ws.web_open_date_sk,
        ws.web_close_date_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount
    FROM web_site ws
    JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(ws.web_city, '^G.*')
      AND ws.web_city LIKE '%wood%'
    GROUP BY ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_city, ws.web_name,
             ws.web_open_date_sk, ws.web_close_date_sk
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS rn,
    cs.web_city,
    cs.web_name,
    concat(cs.web_city, ' - ', cs.web_name) AS city_full,
    substring(cs.web_city FROM 1 FOR 3) AS city_prefix,
    CASE WHEN cs.total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Positive Profit' ELSE 'Negative Profit' END AS profit_category,
    cs.distinct_customers,
    cs.total_net_paid,
    cs.total_net_profit,
    cs.total_discount,
    (SELECT AVG(disc.cs_ext_discount_amt)
     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cs2.cs_ext_discount_amt
           FROM catalog_sales cs2
           WHERE cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = cs.web_open_date_sk) disc) AS avg_distinct_discount_on_open_date,
    regexp_extract(cs.web_name, '(\\w+)', 1) AS first_word_in_name
FROM city_sales cs
JOIN seq s ON s.lvl = (cs.web_site_sk % 5) + 1
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_manufact,
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sum_cat_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS sum_web_net_profit,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS sum_cat_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS sum_web_return_amount,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS sum_cat_quantity,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS sum_web_quantity
    FROM
        catalog_sales cs
        JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
                                     AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
        JOIN web_sales ws ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
        JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
                              AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    WHERE
        cs.cs_quantity > 10
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 5
        AND cs.cs_ext_tax > 10
        AND p.p_end_date_sk > 2450500
        AND i.i_wholesale_cost < 10
        AND p.p_channel_event = 'N'
        AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM web_page wp
            WHERE wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
              AND wp.wp_type = 'product'
        )
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_manufact,
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name
)
SELECT
    ba.i_item_sk,
    ba.i_item_desc,
    ba.i_manufact,
    ba.p_promo_name,
    ba.sum_cat_net_profit,
    ba.sum_web_net_profit,
    ba.sum_cat_return_amount,
    ba.sum_web_return_amount,
    (ba.sum_cat_net_profit + ba.sum_web_net_profit - ba.sum_cat_return_amount - ba.sum_web_return_amount) AS total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN (ba.sum_cat_net_profit + ba.sum_web_net_profit - ba.sum_cat_return_amount - ba.sum_web_return_amount) > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (ba.sum_cat_net_profit + ba.sum_web_net_profit - ba.sum_cat_return_amount - ba.sum_web_return_amount) > 0 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY ba.i_manufact
        ORDER BY (ba.sum_cat_net_profit + ba.sum_web_net_profit - ba.sum_cat_return_amount - ba.sum_web_return_amount) DESC
    ) AS rank_within_manufact,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_page wp2
        WHERE wp2.wp_web_page_sk = (
            SELECT ws3.ws_web_page_sk
            FROM web_sales ws3
            WHERE ws3.ws_item_sk = ba.i_item_sk
            LIMIT 1
        )
    ) AS web_page_count_for_item,
    (
        SELECT SUM(wr2.wr_return_amt)
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = ba.i_item_sk
    ) AS total_web_returns_for_item
FROM
    base_agg ba
WHERE
    (ba.sum_cat_net_profit + ba.sum_web_net_profit) > 5000
    AND (ba.sum_cat_return_amount + ba.sum_web_return_amount) < 2000
    AND ba.i_manufact IS NOT NULL
    AND ba.p_promo_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    total_net_profit DESC,
    profit_category,
    rank_within_manufact
LIMIT 100

WITH promo_channels AS (
    SELECT
        p_promo_sk,
        p_promo_name,
        p_discount_active,
        ARRAY[p_channel_dmail, p_channel_email, p_channel_catalog, p_channel_tv, p_channel_radio, p_channel_press, p_channel_event, p_channel_demo] AS channels
    FROM promotion
)
SELECT
    store.s_store_id,
    store.s_state,
    item.i_item_id,
    item.i_category,
    date_dim.d_year,
    promo_channels.p_promo_name,
    pc.channel,
    SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(store_returns.sr_return_amt) AS total_returns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT store_sales.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
    AVG(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon,
    MAX(inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_inventory,
    CASE WHEN store.s_state = 'CA' THEN 'West' ELSE 'Other' END AS region,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cs_ext_sales_price)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    ) AS avg_catalog_sales_price
FROM date_dim
JOIN store_sales
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN item
    ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
JOIN household_demographics
    ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address
    ON store_sales.ss_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
JOIN store
    ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
JOIN promo_channels
    ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promo_channels.p_promo_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(promo_channels.channels) AS pc (channel)
JOIN store_returns
    ON store_returns.sr_ticket_number = store_sales.ss_ticket_number
JOIN reason
    ON store_returns.sr_reason_sk = reason.r_reason_sk
JOIN catalog_sales
    ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    AND catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN ship_mode
    ON catalog_sales.cs_ship_mode_sk = ship_mode.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse
    ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN inventory
    ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    AND inventory.inv_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
    AND inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN income_band
    ON household_demographics.hd_income_band_sk = income_band.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN web_returns
    ON web_returns.wr_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    AND web_returns.wr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
WHERE
    date_dim.d_year = 2002
    AND item.i_category = 'Sports'
    AND store.s_state = 'CA'
    AND promo_channels.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 2
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM income_band ib
        WHERE ib.ib_upper_bound > 80000
          AND ib.ib_income_band_sk = income_band.ib_income_band_sk
    )
    AND store.s_store_id IN (
        SELECT s_store_id FROM store s1 WHERE s1.s_number_employees > 500
        INTERSECT
        SELECT s_store_id FROM store s2 WHERE s2.s_floor_space > 20000
    )
GROUP BY
    store.s_store_id,
    store.s_state,
    item.i_item_id,
    item.i_category,
    date_dim.d_year,
    promo_channels.p_promo_name,
    pc.channel
HAVING
    SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) > 10000
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT store_sales.ss_ticket_number) >= 10
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_product_name,
           i.i_brand,
           i.i_category,
           CONCAT(i.i_brand, ' ', i.i_product_name) AS full_product_label,
           SUBSTRING(i.i_product_name FROM 1 FOR 15) AS product_name_short
    FROM item i
    WHERE regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '(?i)bike|chair|table')
       OR i.i_product_name LIKE '%Bike%'
),

catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_product_name,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales,
           COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS catalog_orders,
           CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > 50000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS catalog_sales_category
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item_filtered i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name)
),

web_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_product_name,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_orders,
           CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 50000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS web_sales_category
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item_filtered i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name)
),

promo_stats AS (
    SELECT p.p_item_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS promo_count
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY p.p_item_sk
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(ca.i_item_sk, wa.i_item_sk) AS item_sk,
    COALESCE(ca.i_product_name, wa.i_product_name) AS product_name,
    COALESCE(ca.catalog_sales, 0) AS catalog_sales,
    COALESCE(wa.web_sales, 0) AS web_sales,
    COALESCE(ca.catalog_orders, 0) AS catalog_orders,
    COALESCE(wa.web_orders, 0) AS web_orders,
    ca.catalog_sales_category,
    wa.web_sales_category,
    ps.promo_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p WHERE p.p_item_sk = COALESCE(ca.i_item_sk, wa.i_item_sk) AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y') AS active_promotions,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(ca.i_product_name, wa.i_product_name), ' (', COALESCE(ps.promo_count, 0), ' promos)') AS product_label,
    i.full_product_label,
    i.product_name_short
FROM catalog_agg ca
FULL OUTER JOIN web_agg wa
    ON ca.i_item_sk = wa.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promo_stats ps
    ON ps.p_item_sk = COALESCE(ca.i_item_sk, wa.i_item_sk)
LEFT JOIN item_filtered i
    ON i.i_item_sk = COALESCE(ca.i_item_sk, wa.i_item_sk)
WHERE (COALESCE(ca.catalog_sales, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_sales, 0)) > 10000
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = COALESCE(ca.i_item_sk, wa.i_item_sk)
          AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      )
ORDER BY (COALESCE(ca.catalog_sales, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_sales, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH hd_income AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        CASE
            WHEN ib.ib_lower_bound >= 150000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN ib.ib_lower_bound >= 100000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS income_category
    FROM household_demographics hd
    JOIN income_band ib
      ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
)
SELECT
    td.t_meal_time,
    hdbill.income_category,
    sm.sm_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_count,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales,
    AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    MAX(hdship.hd_vehicle_count) AS max_vehicle_count,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    ) AS store_sales_cnt,
    CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 1000000 THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'Regular' END AS sales_tier
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN time_dim td
    ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN hd_income hdbill
    ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hdbill.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN hd_income hdship
    ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hdship.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
INNER JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        sm2.sm_ship_mode_id,
        w2.w_warehouse_name
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN ship_mode sm2
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w2
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
) ws_l
GROUP BY
    td.t_meal_time,
    hdbill.income_category,
    sm.sm_type
HAVING
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 500000
ORDER BY
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

/* Goal: Identify top-selling store sales transactions enriched with customer, item, promotion, warehouse and call‑center details, rank them within each state, and apply multiple business filters. */
WITH distinct_promos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.p_promo_id
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    ss.ss_ticket_number,
    ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
    td.t_shift,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_color,
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    ca.ca_state,
    ss.ss_quantity,
    ss.ss_net_paid,
    p.p_promo_name,
    inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    (
        SELECT cc.cc_name
        FROM call_center cc
        WHERE cc.cc_call_center_sk = (
            SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk
            FROM catalog_sales cs
            WHERE cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
              AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk = ss.ss_sold_time_sk
            LIMIT 1
        )
    ) AS call_center_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY ss.ss_net_paid DESC) AS rn_state_net_paid,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.ss_net_paid DESC) AS overall_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN ss.ss_net_paid > 1000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN ss.ss_net_paid BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS net_paid_bucket
FROM
    store_sales ss
JOIN time_dim td
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE
    td.t_shift = 'second'
    AND td.t_second < 10
    AND i.i_color = 'Red'
    AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
    AND p.p_promo_id IN (SELECT p_promo_id FROM distinct_promos)
    AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
    AND ss.ss_quantity > 2
ORDER BY
    ss.ss_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_join AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        cp.cp_type,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_item_sk,
        w.w_state,
        sm.sm_type,
        CASE WHEN (COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_bucket,
        (COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS total_net_paid,
        COALESCE(ss.ss_quantity, 0) AS store_quantity,
        COALESCE(cs.cs_quantity, 0) AS catalog_quantity,
        COALESCE(ws.ws_quantity, 0) AS web_quantity
    FROM
        catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        AND cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        AND cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t2 ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t2.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t3 ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t3.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 1900
        AND cp.cp_type = 'quarterly'
        AND i.i_manager_id = 13
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
),
agg_per_item_date AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        cp_type,
        i_category,
        profit_bucket,
        SUM(total_net_paid) AS sum_total_net_paid,
        SUM(store_quantity) AS sum_store_qty,
        SUM(catalog_quantity) AS sum_catalog_qty,
        SUM(web_quantity) AS sum_web_qty,
        COUNT(*) AS trans_cnt
    FROM base_join
    GROUP BY d_year, cp_type, i_category, profit_bucket
)
SELECT
    profit_bucket,
    SUM(trans_cnt) AS total_transactions,
    AVG(sum_total_net_paid) AS avg_total_net_paid,
    SUM(sum_store_qty) AS total_store_qty,
    SUM(sum_catalog_qty) AS total_catalog_qty,
    SUM(sum_web_qty) AS total_web_qty,
    CASE WHEN AVG(sum_total_net_paid) > 8000 THEN 'Top' ELSE 'Below' END AS performance_category
FROM agg_per_item_date
WHERE sum_total_net_paid > 5000
GROUP BY profit_bucket
ORDER BY avg_total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
Goal: Analyze total sales and returns by product category and warehouse, providing subtotals (ROLLUP), the average quantity sold per item, a running net profit, and correlated inventory information. The query joins all 14 selected TPC‑DS tables, re‑aliases customer_demographics twice for billing and shipping roles, uses a UNION ALL of three return sources, a scalar correlated subquery, an EXISTS filter, and a window function.
*/
WITH
sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_product_name,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        cp.cp_department,
        cd_bill.cd_gender      AS bill_gender,
        cd_ship.cd_gender      AS ship_gender,
        hd_bill.hd_vehicle_count AS bill_vehicle_count,
        hd_ship.hd_vehicle_count AS ship_vehicle_count,
