        ib_bill.ib_upper_bound AS bill_income_upper,
        ib_ship.ib_upper_bound AS ship_income_upper,
        td.t_hour              AS sold_hour,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib_bill ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib_bill.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib_ship ON hd_ship.hd_income_band_sk = ib_ship.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
),
returns_union AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_order_number      AS order_number,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk  AS return_date_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_time_sk  AS return_time_sk,
        cr.cr_item_sk           AS item_sk,
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk      AS warehouse_sk,
        cr.cr_call_center_sk    AS call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_reason_sk         AS reason_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity   AS return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount     AS return_amount,
        'catalog'               AS return_source
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        wr.wr_order_number,
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk,
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        wr.wr_reason_sk,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        'web'                AS return_source
    FROM web_returns wr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        NULL,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        sr.sr_reason_sk,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        'store'              AS return_source
    FROM store_returns sr
),
returns_detail AS (
    SELECT
        ru.order_number,
        ru.return_date_sk,
        ru.return_time_sk,
        ru.item_sk,
        ru.warehouse_sk,
        ru.call_center_sk,
        ru.reason_sk,
        ru.return_quantity,
        ru.return_amount,
        ru.return_source,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_product_name,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        r.r_reason_desc
    FROM returns_union ru
    JOIN item i ON ru.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON ru.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON ru.reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
)
SELECT
    sd.cs_s

WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_city,
        s.s_state,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_current_price,
        cc.cc_name,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        time_dim.t_hour,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        (coalesce(cs.cs_ext_sales_price, 0) + coalesce(ws.ws_ext_sales_price, 0) - coalesce(sr.sr_return_amt, 0) - coalesce(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS net_sales
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN time_dim ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    WHERE
        s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND i.i_current_price > 20
        AND time_dim.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 17
        AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
        AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 100000
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_sk,
        s_store_id,
        s_city,
        i_item_id,
        SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc_name) AS distinct_cc_cnt
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(s_store_sk, s_store_id, s_city, i_item_id)
)
SELECT
    s_store_id AS store_id,
    s_city AS city,
    i_item_id AS item_id,
    total_net_sales,
    distinct_cc_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY total_net_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr_sub
        WHERE sr_sub.sr_store_sk = agg.s_store_sk
          AND sr_sub.sr_returned_date_sk = (
              SELECT MAX(sr3.sr_returned_date_sk)
              FROM store_returns sr3
              WHERE sr3.sr_store_sk = agg.s_store_sk
          )
    ) AS recent_return_cnt
FROM agg
WHERE total_net_sales > (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_sales_price)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        JOIN item i2 ON cs2.cs_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
        WHERE i2.i_item_id = agg.i_item_id
    )
    AND s_store_id IS NOT NULL
    AND s_city <> ''
    AND total_net_sales IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY store_id, item_id
LIMIT 100

WITH union_orders AS (
    SELECT ws_order_number AS order_number
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sales_price > 500
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr_order_number AS order_number
    FROM web_returns
    WHERE wr_return_amt > 1000
),
high_price_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_current_price > 200
    UNION
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_wholesale_cost > 150
)
SELECT
    i.i_brand,
    sm.sm_type,
    d_sold.d_year,
    d_sold.d_month_seq,
    cc.cc_state,
    s.s_state,
    cd_bill.cd_gender,
    ws.ws_quantity,
    metric_val,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    MIN(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales,
    MAX(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN item i
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site we
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
   AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory inv
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
   AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
   AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN store s
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
  AND d_sold.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
  AND d_sold.d_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
  AND sm.sm_type = 'OVERNIGHT'
  AND i.i_current_price > 100
  AND ws.ws_order_number IN (SELECT order_number FROM union_orders)
  AND i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM high_price_items)
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
          AND wr2.wr_return_quantity > 0
    )
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[CAST(ws.ws_quantity AS double), CAST(ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS double)]) AS t(metric_val)
GROUP BY i.i_brand, sm.sm_type, d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_month_seq, cc.cc_state, s.s_state, cd_bill.cd_gender, ws.ws_quantity, metric_val
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the first day of 2001
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step: add one day at a time until the end of 2001
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_year
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2001-12-31'
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_year AS ds_year,
        i.i_category,
        w.w_state,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM date_series ds
    -- Fact: catalog sales (core sales data)
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    -- Optional dimensions for richer context
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
                                 AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
    -- Store‑sales side (adds another sales channel)
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i2 ON i2.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk    -- satisfies store_sales → item rule
    LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
    -- Call‑center (for operational context)
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    -- Inventory (stock levels at the warehouse/item/date)
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
                              AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                              AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    -- Web‑returns side (e‑commerce activity)
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
    WHERE ds.d_year = 2001
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 0
      AND cc.cc_company = 1
      AND i.i_brand = 'BrandA'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
),
agg_data AS (
    SELECT
        ds_year,
        i_category,
        w_state,
        SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS total_web_return_qty,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
        ARRAY[SUM(cs_quantity), SUM(cs_net_paid)] AS agg_metrics
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(i_category, w_state), ds_year
),
ranked_data AS (
    SELECT
        ds_year,
        i_category,
        w_state,
        total_quantity,
        total_net_paid,
        total_net_profit,
        total_return_qty,
        total_return_amount,
        total_web_return_qty,
        total_web_return_amount,
        total_inventory_on_hand,
        profit_flag,
        agg_metrics,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS category_rank
    FROM agg_data
)
SELECT
    rd.ds_year,
    rd.i_category,
    rd.w_state,
    rd.total_quantity,
    rd.total_net_paid,
    rd.total_net_profit,
    rd.total_return_qty,
    rd.total_return_amount,
    rd.total_web_return_qty,
    rd.total_web_return_amount,
    rd.total_inventory_on_hand,
    rd.prof

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        i.i_item_id,
        ss.ss_net_paid      AS store_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_paid      AS web_net_paid,
        cc.cc_name,
        ws_site.web_name,
        sm.sm_type,
        wh.w_warehouse_name,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ws_site.web_state,
        d_ss.d_year
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    -- Call center linked via the sale date (open date) and its closed date
    JOIN call_center cc ON d_ss.d_date_sk = cc.cc_open_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cc_close ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_close.d_date_sk
    -- Web sales for the same customer (billing side)
    JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i2 ON ws.ws_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws_site_open ON ws_site.web_open_date_sk = d_ws_site_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws_site_close ON ws_site.web_close_date_sk = d_ws_site_close.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse wh ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    -- Inventory for the same item and warehouse
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
    -- Additional demographic and address joins for the web side (different aliases)
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_ss.d_year = 2001
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND ws_site.web_state = 'OH'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_sales ws2
          WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            AND ws2.ws_net_paid > 500
      )
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    i_item_id,
    SUM(store_net_paid + web_net_paid) AS total_combined_net_paid,
    cc_name,
    web_name,
    sm_type,
    w_warehouse_name,
    (
        SELECT SUM(inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand)
        FROM inventory inv2
        WHERE inv2.inv_item_sk = base_sales.i_item_id
    ) AS total_inventory_quantity
FROM base_sales
GROUP BY c_customer_id, i_item_id, cc_name, web_name, sm_type, w_warehouse_name

EXCEPT

SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    i_item_id,
    SUM(store_net_paid + web_net_paid) AS total_combined_net_paid,
    cc_name,
    web_name,
    sm_type,
    w_warehouse_name,
    (
        SELECT SUM(inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand)
        FROM inventory inv2
        WHERE inv2.inv_item_sk = base_sales.i_item_id
    ) AS total_inventory_quantity
FROM base_sales
GROUP BY c_customer_id, i_item_id, cc_name, web_name, sm_type, w_warehouse_name
HAVING SUM(store_net_paid + web_net_paid) < 5000
ORDER BY total_combined_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH union_data AS (
  -- Sales branch: catalog sales with related dimensions
  SELECT
    'sale' AS event_type,
    cs.cs_order_number AS order_number,
    cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
    d_sales.d_year AS year,
    i1.i_category AS item_category,
    i1.i_item_id AS item_id,
    c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    ca1.ca_city AS customer_city,
    hd1.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
    ib1.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower,
    ib1.ib_upper_bound AS income_upper,
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    sm1.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
    p.p_channel_dmail AS promo_channel_dmail,
    cs.cs_net_paid AS net_amount,
    cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amount,
    NULL AS store_state,
    r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
    NULL AS return_quantity
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN date_dim d_sales ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i1 ON cs.cs_item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
  JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca1 ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca1.ca_address_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm1 ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm1.sm_ship_mode_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
  LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_promo_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_promo_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_cc_open.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_close ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_close.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM promotion p2
    WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
      AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND p2.p_start_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
  )
  UNION ALL
  -- Returns branch: store returns with related dimensions
  SELECT
    'return' AS event_type,
    NULL AS order_number,
    sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
    d_returned.d_year AS year,
    i2.i_category AS item_category,
    i2.i_item_id AS item_id,
    c2.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    ca2.ca_city AS customer_city,
    hd2.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
    ib2.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower,
    ib2.ib_upper_bound AS income_upper,
    cc2.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    NULL AS ship_mode_type,
    p2.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
    p2.p_channel_dmail AS promo_channel_dmail,
    sr.sr_return_amt AS net_amount,
    NULL AS discount_amount,
    s.s_state AS store_state,
    r2.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
    sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_quantity
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN date_dim d_returned ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_returned.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i2 ON sr.sr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
  JOIN customer c2 ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c2.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca2 ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca2.ca_address_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN reason r2 ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
  LEFT JOIN call_center cc2 ON cc2.cc_closed_date_sk = d_returned.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN promotion p2 ON p2.p_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_promo_start_ret ON p2.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start_ret.d_date_sk
)
SELECT
  ud.event_type,
  ud.item_category,
  ud.year,
  SUM(ud.net_amount) AS total_amount,
  AVG(ud.discount_amount) AS avg_discount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ud.customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM store_returns sr2
    WHERE sr2.sr_returned_date_sk IN (
      SELECT d2.d_date_sk
      FROM date_dim d2
      WHERE d2.d_year = ud.year
    )
      AND sr2.sr_item

WITH RECURSIVE profit_levels AS (
    SELECT 1 AS level
    UNION ALL
    SELECT level + 1 FROM profit_levels WHERE level < 5
),
store_data AS (
   SELECT
      ca_sales.ca_state AS state,
      ib.ib_income_band_sk AS income_band,
      i_store.i_item_id AS item_id,
      SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
      SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
      SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_returns_loss,
      SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_returns_loss,
      SUM(p.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS order_cnt
   FROM store_sales ss
   JOIN item i_store ON ss.ss_item_sk = i_store.i_item_sk
   JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
   JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   JOIN customer_address ca_sales ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_sales.ca_address_sk
   JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
   JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
   JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
   JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i_store.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   GROUP BY ROLLUP (ca_sales.ca_state, ib.ib_income_band_sk, i_store.i_item_id)
),
catalog_data AS (
   SELECT
      ca_bill.ca_state AS state,
      ib2.ib_income_band_sk AS income_band,
      i_catalog.i_item_id AS item_id,
      SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
      SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
      0 AS total_returns_loss,
      0 AS total_web_returns_loss,
      SUM(p2.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost,
      COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt
   FROM catalog_sales cs
   JOIN item i_catalog ON cs.cs_item_sk = i_catalog.i_item_sk
   JOIN promotion p2 ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
   JOIN customer c2 ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c2.c_customer_sk
   JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
   JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
   JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
   JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
   GROUP BY ROLLUP (ca_bill.ca_state, ib2.ib_income_band_sk, i_catalog.i_item_id)
),
combined_data AS (
   SELECT * FROM store_data
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM catalog_data
),
aggregated_combined AS (
   SELECT
      state,
      income_band,
      item_id,
      SUM(total_profit) AS total_profit,
      SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales,
      SUM(total_returns_loss) AS total_returns_loss,
      SUM(total_web_returns_loss) AS total_web_returns_loss,
      SUM(total_promo_cost) AS total_promo_cost,
      SUM(order_cnt) AS order_cnt
   FROM combined_data
   GROUP BY ROLLUP (state, income_band, item_id)
)
SELECT
   ac.state,
   ac.income_band,
   ac.item_id,
   ac.total_profit,
   ac.total_sales,
   ac.total_returns_loss,
   ac.total_web_returns_loss,
   ac.total_promo_cost,
   ac.order_cnt,
   pl.level,
   RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ac.state ORDER BY ac.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
   (SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM store_returns sr_sub
      WHERE sr_sub.sr_item_sk = (
         SELECT i_sub.i_item_sk
         FROM item i_sub
         WHERE i_sub.i_item_id = ac.item_id
      )
   ) AS total_store_returns_for_item
FROM aggregated_combined ac
CROSS JOIN profit_levels pl
WHERE ac.total_profit > (
   SELECT AVG(inner_ac.total_profit)
   FROM aggregated_combined inner_ac
   WHERE inner_ac.state = ac.state
)
GROUP BY ROLLUP (ac.state, ac.income_band, ac.item_id, pl.level)
HAVING SUM(ac.total_profit) > 0
ORDER BY ac.state, ac.income_band, ac.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE levels AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM levels WHERE lvl < 5
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department,
        t.t_hour,
        levels.lvl,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_item_sk
    FROM levels
    CROSS JOIN time_dim t
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c_cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_cs.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_cs ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_cs.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_cs.ca_address_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp2 ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp2.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_cr_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_cr_ref.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_cr_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_ref.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_cr_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_cr_ref.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_cr_ret ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c_cr_ret.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_cr_ret ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_ret.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_cr_ret ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_cr_ret.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c_ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ss ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN customer c_sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_sr.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    JOIN customer c_ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_ws.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ws ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_ws.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp2 ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp2.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_wr_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_wr_ref.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_ref.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr_ref.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_wr_ret ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c_wr_ret.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_ret ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_ret.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr_ret ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_wr_ret.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c_wp.c_customer_sk
    WHERE
        cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
        AND cd_cs.cd_marital_status = 'M'
        AND ca_cs.ca_state = 'CA'
        AND wp.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
        AND wsit.web_gmt_offset > 0
        AND cs.cs_quantity > (SELECT avg(t2.t_hour) FROM time_dim t2)
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        cp_department,
        t_hour,
        lvl,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_ext_sales
    FROM base
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (cp_department, t_hour, lvl)
)
SELECT
    cp_department,
    t_hour,
    lvl,

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d_sold.d_year AS sold_year,
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        ib.ib_upper_bound AS income_upper,
        w.w_warehouse_sq_ft AS warehouse_sq_ft,
        wp.wp_type AS page_type,
        ws.web_country AS web_country,
        COALESCE(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0) AS inventory_qty,
        COALESCE(ss.ss_quantity, 0) AS store_qty,
        COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0) AS return_qty
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = cs.cs_bill_addr_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
        AND ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_brand_id = 12
      AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound >= 50000
      AND w.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 500000
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        sold_year,
        category,
        SUM(sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(inventory_qty) AS total_inventory,
        SUM(store_qty) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(return_qty) AS total_returns
    FROM base
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (sold_year, category),
        (sold_year),
        (category),
        ()
    )
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        sold_year,
        category,
        total_sales,
        total_quantity,
        total_inventory,
        total_store_sales,
        total_returns,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sold_year ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS overall_row_num
    FROM agg
    WHERE total_sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    sold_year,
    category,
    total_sales,
    total_quantity,
    sales_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank <= 5
UNION
SELECT
    sold_year,
    NULL AS category,
    total_sales,
    total_quantity,
    NULL AS sales_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE category IS NULL AND total_sales > 10000
ORDER BY sold_year, total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        'sales' AS source,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_amount,
        (
            SELECT i2.i_current_price
            FROM item i2
            WHERE i2.i_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        ) AS current_price
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 0
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr
          WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND cr.cr_return_amount > 300
      )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_item_sk
),
returns AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        'returns' AS source,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_amount,
        (
            SELECT i2.i_current_price
            FROM item i2
            WHERE i2.i_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        ) AS current_price
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 200
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_item_sk
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    item_id,
    product_name,
    source,
    total_amount,
    current_price
FROM (
    SELECT item_id, product_name, source, total_amount, current_price FROM sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT item_id, product_name, source, total_amount, current_price FROM returns
) combined
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sales_combined AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        s.s_state AS store_state,
        wsite.web_state AS website_state,
        i.i_current_price,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS ss_discount,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS ws_discount,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS ss_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS ws_net_paid,
        CASE WHEN (ss.ss_ext_discount_amt + ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) > 500 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_level,
        split(i.i_item_desc, ' ') AS desc_words,
        i.i_item_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    WHERE c.c_first_sales_date_sk BETWEEN 2449000 AND 2452000
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1980
      AND s.s_tax_percentage > 0.05
      AND i.i_current_price > 30.00
      AND ss.ss_ext_discount_amt > 100.00
      AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 50.00
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM store_sales ss2
          WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND ss2.ss_coupon_amt > 3000.00
      )
),
unnested AS (
    SELECT
        sc.i_category,
        sc.store_state,
        sc.website_state,
        sc.discount_level,
        sc.ss_net_paid + sc.ws_net_paid AS total_net_paid,
        sc.ss_discount + sc.ws_discount AS total_discount,
        w.word
    FROM sales_combined sc
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sc.desc_words) AS t(word)
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    store_state,
    website_state,
    discount_level,
    SUM(total_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(total_discount) AS total_discount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT word) AS distinct_word_count
FROM unnested
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, store_state, website_state, discount_level)
HAVING SUM(total_net_paid) > 1000
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC

WITH RECURSIVE loss_levels AS (
    SELECT 1 AS loss_level
    UNION ALL
    SELECT loss_level + 1 FROM loss_levels WHERE loss_level < 5
),
return_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt,
        AVG(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_amt
    FROM store_returns sr
    GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    CONCAT(ca.ca_city, ', ', ca.ca_state) AS full_location,
    ca.ca_county,
    CASE
        WHEN sr.sr_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category,
    sr.sr_return_quantity,
    sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
    ra.total_return_amt,
    ra.return_cnt,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM store_returns sr2
     WHERE sr2.sr_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
       AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
       AND sr2.sr_ticket_number <> sr.sr_ticket_number) AS same_item_day_other_returns,
    SUBSTR(i.i_product_name, 1, 3) AS product_prefix,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(ca.ca_street_number, '(\\d+)') AS street_number_digits,
    CASE
        WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2 THEN 'Multiple Vehicles'
        ELSE 'One or None'
    END AS vehicle_category,
    cd.cd_gender,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(cd.cd_education_status, '^([^ ]+)') AS education_primary
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN time_dim td
    ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN item i
    ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN reason r
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN return_aggregates ra
    ON sr.sr_item_sk = ra.sr_item_sk
JOIN loss_levels ll
    ON FLOOR(sr.sr_net_loss / 1000) + 1 = ll.loss_level
WHERE
    ca.ca_county LIKE '%County'
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(ca.ca_city, '^[AEIOU].*')
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_product_name, '\\d')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM reason r2
        WHERE r2.r_reason_sk = sr.sr_reason_sk
          AND REGEXP_LIKE(r2.r_reason_desc, '(?i)damaged|defective')
    )
    AND (
        SELECT AVG(sr3.sr_return_amt_inc_tax)
        FROM store_returns sr3
        WHERE sr3.sr_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    ) > 50
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(cd.cd_education_status, 'College|University')
ORDER BY sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE cte_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_product_name,
           i.i_brand,
           i.i_item_desc,
           1 AS depth
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_product_name,
           i.i_brand,
           i.i_item_desc,
           ci.depth + 1
    FROM item i
    JOIN cte_items ci ON i.i_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk + 1
    WHERE ci.depth < 3
)
SELECT
    ci.i_brand,
    t.word AS word,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(cs.cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid)
     FROM catalog_sales cs2
     WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk) AS item_avg_net
FROM cte_items ci
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(ci.i_item_desc, ' ')) AS t(word)
WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk)
GROUP BY ci.i_brand, t.word

UNION ALL

SELECT
    ci.i_brand,
    t.word AS word,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(ws.ws_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid,
    (SELECT AVG(cs3.cs_net_paid)
     FROM catalog_sales cs3
     WHERE cs3.cs_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk) AS item_avg_net
FROM cte_items ci
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(ci.i_item_desc, ' ')) AS t(word)
WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk)
GROUP BY ci.i_brand, t.word

ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dd.d_date_sk, dd.d_date, dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_dim dd
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON dd.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE dd.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-31'
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    d_sold.d_month_seq,
    p.p_promo_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(inv_qty.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_count
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory inv
    WHERE inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
      AND inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    ORDER BY inv.inv_quantity_on_hand DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS inv_qty
JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON dh.d_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 1998
  AND cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
GROUP BY
    d_sold.d_year,
    d_sold.d_month_seq,
    p.p_promo_name,
    cp.cp_department
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE n_series AS (
    SELECT 1 AS level
    UNION ALL
    SELECT level + 1 FROM n_series WHERE level < 5
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        ws.ws_promo_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month = 5
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND i.i_wholesale_cost > 2.00
      AND p.p_channel_catalog = 'N'
      AND p.p_channel_radio = 'N'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND we.web_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk,
             ws.ws_item_sk,
             ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
             ws.ws_ship_customer_sk,
             ws.ws_web_page_sk,
             ws.ws_promo_sk
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    we.web_name,
    i.i_brand,
    p.p_promo_name,
    sa.total_sales,
    sa.avg_discount,
    sa.distinct_orders,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY we.web_name ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC) AS rn,
    (SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_ext_sales_price)
     FROM web_sales ws2
     WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = sa.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS max_customer_sale
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN web_site we ON sa.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
JOIN item i ON sa.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN promotion p ON sa.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN n_series ns ON ns.level = 1
ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_by_store_customer AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_suite_number,
        c.c_customer_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(ss.ss_ticket_number) AS order_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS distinct_sales_days
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE
        c.c_birth_month IN (4, 6, 9, 11, 12)
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND s.s_gmt_offset BETWEEN -8.00 AND -5.00
        AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 500
        AND ss.ss_quantity >= 2
        AND ss.ss_sales_price < 100
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_suite_number,
        c.c_customer_id
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_market_manager,
    SUM(sbsc.total_sales) AS store_total_sales,
    AVG(sbsc.total_profit) AS avg_customer_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sbsc.c_customer_id) AS num_customers,
    MAX(sbsc.total_profit) AS max_customer_profit,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
          AND ss2.ss_ext_sales_price > 10000
    ) AS high_value_txn_count,
    token
FROM sales_by_store_customer sbsc
JOIN store s ON sbsc.s_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(s.s_suite_number, '\\s+')) AS t(token)
WHERE token <> ''
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_market_manager,
    token
HAVING SUM(sbsc.total_sales) > 20000
ORDER BY store_total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE level_seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM level_seq WHERE lvl < 5
),
store_demo AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_discount_amt,
        cd.cd_demo_sk,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_education_status,
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
        cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
        cd.cd_dep_college_count
    FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 5000
      AND cd.cd_dep_employed_count = 0
      AND ss.ss_sales_price > 200
      AND ss.ss_ext_discount_amt < 50
),
web_demo_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cd.cd_demo_sk,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_education_status,
        cd.cd_dep_college_count,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_gmt_offset,
        w.w_city,
        w.w_state
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship > 2000
      AND ws.ws_ext_tax BETWEEN 10 AND 40
      AND cd.cd_dep_college_count >= 2
      AND w.w_city = 'Los Angeles'
)
SELECT
    l.lvl,
    sd.cd_gender,
    sd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.ss_ticket_number) AS store_transactions,
    SUM(sd.ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wd.ws_order_number) AS web_orders,
    SUM(wd.ws_net_paid) AS web_net_paid,
    AVG(wd.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_web_net_paid_inc_tax,
    MIN(wd.w_gmt_offset) AS min_warehouse_gmt_offset,
    (SELECT MAX(w2.w_warehouse_sq_ft) FROM warehouse w2 WHERE w2.w_state = 'CA') AS max_warehouse_sq_ft_ca
FROM level_seq l
JOIN store_demo sd
    ON (sd.ss_quantity % 5) + 1 = l.lvl
JOIN web_demo_warehouse wd
    ON (wd.ws_quantity % 5) + 1 = l.lvl
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM web_sales ws2
    WHERE ws2.ws_item_sk = wd.ws_item_sk
      AND ws2.ws_net_paid > 3000
)
GROUP BY
    l.lvl,
    sd.cd_gender,
    sd.cd_education_status,
    wd.w_gmt_offset
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY
    l.lvl,
    store_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT CAST(2449408 AS integer) AS d_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_date_sk + 1 FROM date_series WHERE d_date_sk < 2452300
),
distinct_promos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_cost,
        p.p_channel_event,
        p.p_discount_active,
        p.p_start_date_sk,
        p.p_end_date_sk
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_date_sk,
        ws.ws_promo_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        cust_bill.c_first_sales_date_sk AS bill_first_sales_date_sk,
        cust_ship.c_first_sales_date_sk AS ship_first_sales_date_sk,
        dp.p_promo_name,
        dp.p_cost,
        ds_sold.d_year AS sold_year,
        ds_ship.d_year AS ship_year,
        ds_ret.d_year AS return_year,
        ds_p_start.d_year AS promo_start_year,
        ds_p_end.d_year AS promo_end_year,
        ds_cust_bill_first_sales.d_year AS bill_first_sales_year
    FROM web_sales ws
    -- sales date
    JOIN date_dim ds_sold
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds_sold.d_date_sk
    -- shipping date
    JOIN date_dim ds_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = ds_ship.d_date_sk
    -- billing customer
    JOIN customer cust_bill
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = cust_bill.c_customer_sk
    -- shipping customer
    JOIN customer cust_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = cust_ship.c_customer_sk
    -- promotion (distinct set)
    JOIN distinct_promos dp
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = dp.p_promo_sk
    -- promotion start date
    JOIN date_dim ds_p_start
        ON dp.p_start_date_sk = ds_p_start.d_date_sk
    -- promotion end date
    JOIN date_dim ds_p_end
        ON dp.p_end_date_sk = ds_p_end.d_date_sk
    -- returns by order number
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    -- returns by item (second alias for web_returns)
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr2
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr2.wr_item_sk
    -- return date
    LEFT JOIN date_dim ds_ret
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ds_ret.d_date_sk
    -- refunded customer
    LEFT JOIN customer cust_refund
        ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = cust_refund.c_customer_sk
    -- returning customer
    LEFT JOIN customer cust_returning
        ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = cust_returning.c_customer_sk
    -- filter sold dates through the recursive series
    JOIN date_series ds_series
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds_series.d_date_sk
    -- billing customer's first sales date dimension
    JOIN date_dim ds_cust_bill_first_sales
        ON cust_bill.c_first_sales_date_sk = ds_cust_bill_first_sales.d_date_sk
    WHERE ds_sold.d_year = 2001
      AND dp.p_channel_event = 'N'
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        sold_year,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(p_promo_name, sold_year)
)
SELECT
    promo_name,
    sold_year,
    total_net_profit,
    total_return_amount,
    distinct_orders,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS rn_global
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY promo_name, sold_year DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH cs_base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    d_sold.d_month,
    cp.cp_department,
    sm.sm_type,
    p.p_promo_name,
    s.s_store_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    c_bill.c_customer_sk,
    SUM(cs_base.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(cs_base.cs_quantity) AS total_catalog_quantity,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS total_web_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs_base.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    (
        SELECT SUM(ws2.ws_net_paid)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
          AND ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    ) AS customer_daily_web_sales
FROM cs_base
JOIN date_dim d_sold
  ON cs_base.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship
  ON cs_base.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c_bill
  ON cs_base.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill
  ON cs_base.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ship
  ON cs_base.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON cs_base.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion p
  ON cs_base.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
  ON cs_base.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
  AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN store s
  ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r
  ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
  AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_returns sr2
    JOIN reason r2 ON sr2.sr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
      AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
      AND r2.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
)
GROUP BY
    d_sold.d_year,
    d_sold.d_month,
    cp.cp_department,
    sm.sm_type,
    p.p_promo_name,
    s.s_store_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    c_bill.c_customer_sk
ORDER BY total_catalog_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_year,
           1 AS level
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2002-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dd.d_date_sk,
           dd.d_date,
           dd.d_year,
           dh.level + 1
    FROM date_dim dd
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON dd.d_date = dh.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE dh.level < 30
),
agg_returns AS (
    SELECT cr_ship_mode_sk,
           cr_returned_date_sk,
           SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
           AVG(cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
           SUM(cr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit,
           COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_return_amount > 20
    GROUP BY cr_ship_mode_sk, cr_returned_date_sk
),
intersect_ship_modes AS (
    SELECT cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_return_quantity > 5
    INTERSECT
    SELECT sm_ship_mode_sk
    FROM ship_mode
    WHERE sm_code = 'AIR'
)
SELECT 
    d.d_date,
    d.d_year,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    sm.sm_code,
    ar.total_return_amount,
    ar.avg_return_amount,
    ar.return_cnt,
    ar.total_store_credit,
    wp.wp_url,
    wp_stats.max_char_cnt,
    dh.level AS date_hierarchy_level
FROM agg_returns ar
JOIN date_dim d ON ar.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON ar.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN intersect_ship_modes im ON im.ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT wp.wp_url,
           wp.wp_char_count,
           wp.wp_creation_date_sk
    FROM web_page wp
    WHERE wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
) AS wp
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT MAX(wp2.wp_char_count) AS max_char_cnt
    FROM web_page wp2
    WHERE wp2.wp_creation_date_sk = wp.wp_creation_date_sk
) AS wp_stats
JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON dh.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE sm.sm_code = 'AIR'
  AND d.d_year = 2002
  AND ar.total_store_credit > 10
ORDER BY ar.total_return_amount DESC, d.d_date ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_name, substring(p.p_promo_name FROM 1 FOR 10) AS promo_prefix, i.i_item_id AS i_item_id, i.i_product_name AS i_product_name, concat(i.i_product_name, ' - ', i.i_item_id) AS product_item_key, regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '^([^ ]+)', 1) AS first_word_desc, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' ELSE 'Other' END AS promo_channel_type, d.d_date_sk, cc.cc_name, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(COALESCE(r.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_returns, (SELECT MAX(inv_quantity_on_hand) FROM inventory WHERE inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS max_inventory_qty FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns r ON r.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND r.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cc.cc_name FROM call_center cc WHERE cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LIMIT 1 ) cc WHERE regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '[0-9]{2,}') AND p.p_promo_name LIKE '%discount%' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory inv JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND w.w_city LIKE 'San%' ) GROUP BY p.p_promo_name, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_item_desc, p.p_channel_tv, d.d_date_sk, cc.cc_name HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 1000 ) SELECT promo_prefix, i_item_id, i_product_name, product_item_key, first_word_desc, promo_channel_type, total_sales, total_profit, total_returns, CASE WHEN total_sales > 0 THEN (total_returns / total_sales) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS return_rate_pct, max_inventory_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, cc_name FROM sales_agg ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_vs_store_items AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS catalog_not_in_store_item_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT cs_item_sk FROM catalog_sales
        EXCEPT
        SELECT ss_item_sk FROM store_sales
    ) diff
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    td.t_hour,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_catalog_items,
    CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_category,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_sales_price)
     FROM catalog_sales cs2
     WHERE cs2.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS avg_catalog_sales_per_customer,
    (SELECT catalog_not_in_store_item_cnt FROM catalog_vs_store_items) AS catalog_not_in_store_item_cnt,
    MAX(wsit.web_company_name) AS web_company_name_max
FROM
    time_dim td
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT *
        FROM web_site wsit
        WHERE wsit.web_site_sk = ws.ws_web_site_sk
    ) wsit
WHERE
    ca.ca_state = 'CA'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost > 2000
    AND wsit.web_gmt_offset = -5.00
GROUP BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    td.t_hour,
    p.p_promo_name
ORDER BY
    total_catalog_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH intersect_orders AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_order_number AS order_number
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 5
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cr.cr_order_number AS order_number
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
),

sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_state                     AS w_state,
        cp.cp_department               AS cp_department,
        d_sold.d_year                  AS d_year,
        cs.cs_order_number             AS cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_profit               AS cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_quantity                 AS cs_quantity,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag       AS preferred_cust_flag,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number
    FROM intersect_orders io
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_order_number = io.order_number
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wp_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sr_return ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr_return.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cc_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_cc_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cc_closed ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_closed.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cp_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_cp_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cp_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_cp_end.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_ws_close.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        w.w_state = 'NY'
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND d_sold.d_year = 2000
        AND cp.cp_department = 'Books'
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
),

aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        w_state,
        cp_department,
        d_year,
        SUM(cs_net_profit)      AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(cs_quantity)        AS total_quantity
    FROM sales_data
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (w_state, cp_department, d_year),
        (w_state, cp_department),
        (w_state),
        ()
    )
)

SELECT
    w_state,
    cp_department,
    d_year,
    total_net_profit,
    order_cnt,
    total_quantity,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN total_net_profit > 50000  THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END                                 AS profit_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w_state ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS state_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit) FROM catalog_sales cs2)                AS avg_net_profit_overall
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH intersect_item_ids AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk FROM catalog_sales
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws_item_sk FROM web_sales
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_returns,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_returns,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns,
    COALESCE(SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand), 0) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cr2.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ) AS total_return_amount_for_item_across_all_stores
FROM store s
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd_sr.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
JOIN warehouse wh_cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = wh_cs.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p_cat ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cat.p_promo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_bill_cs ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill_cs.hd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ship_cs ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship_cs.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse wh_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = wh_cr.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_refund_cr ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refund_cr.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_return_cr ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_return_cr.hd_demo_sk
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim t_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
JOIN warehouse wh_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh_ws.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p_web ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_web.p_promo_sk
JOIN web_site webs ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = webs.web_site_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_bill_ws ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill_ws.hd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ship_ws ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship_ws.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_refund_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refund_wr.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_return_wr ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_return_wr.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse wh_inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = wh_inv.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE i.i_item_sk IN (
    SELECT cs_item_sk FROM catalog_sales
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws_item_sk FROM web_sales
)
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand
ORDER BY total_catalog_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH inv_w AS (
    SELECT
        inv.inv_date_sk,
        inv.inv_item_sk,
        inv.inv_warehouse_sk,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_warehouse_sq_ft,
        w.w_street_type,
        w.w_street_name,
        w.w_city,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_country,
        w.w_gmt_offset
    FROM inventory inv
    FULL OUTER JOIN warehouse w
        ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_warehouse_sq_ft,
        td.t_hour,
        hd_bill.hd_vehicle_count,
        inv_w.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_tax,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_tax,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN inv_w w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim td
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_refunded
        ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_refunded.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_returning
        ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_returning.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        w.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 500000
        AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
        AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        AND hd_bill.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
        AND inv_w.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        w_warehouse_name,
        cp_department,
        SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount,0) + COALESCE(cr_return_tax,0)) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt,0) + COALESCE(wr_return_tax,0)) AS total_web_return_amount,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customer_count,
        AVG(cs_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_sales_price) FROM catalog_sales cs2) AS overall_avg_sales_price
    FROM base
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (w_warehouse_name, cp_department),
        (w_warehouse_name),
        (cp_department),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    w_warehouse_name,
    cp_department,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    total_return_amount,
    total_web_return_amount,
    total_inventory_on_hand,
    distinct_customer_count,
    avg_sales_price,
    overall_avg_sales_price,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w_warehouse_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank_by_department
FROM agg
ORDER BY w_warehouse_name, cp_department
LIMIT 100

WITH ticket_intersect AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number AS ticket_number
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 10
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number AS ticket_number
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 10
)
SELECT
    d.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    cc.cc_state,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
    AVG(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash,
    MIN(cs.cs_net_profit) AS min_net_profit,
    (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_refunded_cash)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk) AS avg_refund_cash_item_year
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
   AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN reason r
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   AND cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   AND cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
   AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
   AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE
    d.d_year = 2001
    AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
    AND cc.cc_state = 'MI'
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND sr.sr_net_loss > 1000
    AND cr.cr_net_loss > 500
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ticket_intersect ti
        WHERE ti.ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    )
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (d.d_year, i.i_category, cc.cc_state),
    (d.d_year, i.i_category),
    (d.d_year),
    (i.i_category),
    (cc.cc_state),
    ()
)
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dr.d_date)
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2022-01-31'
),
store_fact AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        i.i_item_id,
        d.d_year,
        ss.ss_quantity               AS sold_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid               AS net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit             AS net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_quantity        AS return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt             AS return_amt,
        sr.sr_net_loss               AS return_net_loss,
        r.r_reason_desc              AS return_reason,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar)        AS ship_mode,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar)        AS web_page_url
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
                              AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#45'
      AND d.d_year = 2001
      AND sr.sr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL
      AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Customer Not Satisfied'
),
web_fact AS (
    SELECT
        CAST('WEB' AS varchar)        AS s_store_id,
        i.i_item_id,
        d.d_year,
        ws.ws_quantity               AS sold_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid               AS net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit             AS net_profit,
        wr.wr_return_quantity        AS return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt             AS return_amt,
        wr.wr_net_loss               AS return_net_loss,
        r.r_reason_desc              AS return_reason,
        sm.sm_code                   AS ship_mode,
        wp.wp_url                    AS web_page_url
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                              AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE sm.sm_code = 'AIR'
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#45'
      AND d.d_year = 2001
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL
      AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Customer Not Satisfied'
),
combined_fact AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_fact
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_fact
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        i_item_id,
        d_year,
        SUM(sold_quantity)               AS total_quantity,
        SUM(net_paid)                     AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(net_profit)                   AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_quantity,
        SUM(COALESCE(return_amt, 0))      AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(return_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_

WITH catalog_part AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        d.d_year AS year,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax > 0
),
store_part AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        d.d_year AS year,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid,
        ss.ss_customer_sk AS cust_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND ss.ss_net_paid > 0
),
combined_sales AS (
    SELECT promo_sk, promo_name, year, net_paid, cust_sk FROM catalog_part
    UNION ALL
    SELECT promo_sk, promo_name, year, net_paid, cust_sk FROM store_part
)
SELECT
    cs.promo_sk,
    cs.promo_name,
    cs.year,
    SUM(cs.net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cust_sk) AS distinct_customers,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_list_price)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_promo_sk = cs.promo_sk
    ) AS avg_catalog_list_price
FROM combined_sales cs
GROUP BY cs.promo_sk, cs.promo_name, cs.year
HAVING SUM(cs.net_paid) > 10000
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE year_seq AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_year) AS year_val FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year_val + 1 FROM year_seq WHERE year_val < (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim)
),

aggregated_returns AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        CAST(regexp_extract(wsite.web_suite_number, '\\d+') AS integer) AS suite_number,
        substr(wsite.web_mkt_class, 1, 5) AS mkt_class_prefix,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_sales wsales ON wr.wr_order_number = wsales.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = wsales.ws_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON wsales.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(r.r_reason_desc, '(?i)product|color')
      AND wsite.web_suite_number LIKE 'Suite %'
      AND CAST(regexp_extract(wsite.web_suite_number, '\\d+') AS integer) BETWEEN 100 AND 500
    GROUP BY d.d_year, suite_number, mkt_class_prefix
)

SELECT
    y.year_val,
    dim.suite_number,
    dim.mkt_class_prefix,
    COALESCE(ar.return_count, 0) AS return_count,
    COALESCE(ar.total_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
    COALESCE(ar.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount
FROM year_seq y
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT suite_number, mkt_class_prefix FROM aggregated_returns
) dim
LEFT JOIN aggregated_returns ar
    ON ar.year = y.year_val
    AND ar.suite_number = dim.suite_number
    AND ar.mkt_class_prefix = dim.mkt_class_prefix
ORDER BY y.year_val DESC, ar.total_net_loss DESC

WITH billing_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        p.p_promo_name,
        CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS promo_status,
        (SELECT avg(ws2.ws_net_paid_inc_ship)
         FROM web_sales ws2
         WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk) AS avg_net_paid_for_promo,
        'billing' AS sales_role,
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_demo = 'N'
      AND ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship >= 500
),
shipping_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        p.p_promo_name,
        CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS promo_status,
        (SELECT avg(ws2.ws_net_paid_inc_ship)
         FROM web_sales ws2
         WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk) AS avg_net_paid_for_promo,
        'shipping' AS sales_role,
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
