      AND ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship < 500
)
SELECT
    combined.ws_order_number,
    combined.ws_net_paid_inc_ship,
    combined.ws_quantity,
    combined.hd_buy_potential,
    combined.p_promo_name,
    combined.promo_status,
    combined.avg_net_paid_for_promo,
    combined.sales_role,
    combined.promo_sk
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM billing_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM shipping_sales
) AS combined
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM promotion p2
    WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = combined.promo_sk
      AND p2.p_end_date_sk > 2450000
)
ORDER BY combined.ws_net_paid_inc_ship DESC
LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 5
)
SELECT
    p.p_promo_name,
    sm.sm_carrier,
    substring(p.p_promo_name FROM 1 FOR 5) AS promo_prefix,
    regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '\\w+', 0) AS item_first_word,
    concat(p.p_promo_name, '_', sm.sm_carrier) AS promo_carrier_concat,
    s.n AS seq_bucket,
    sum(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    count(*) AS sales_count
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN seq s ON s.n = (p.p_promo_sk % 5) + 1
WHERE cs.cs_sold_time_sk IN (
    SELECT t_time_sk FROM time_dim WHERE t_meal_time LIKE 'd%'
)
  AND regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '(?i)discount')
  AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%metal%'
GROUP BY
    p.p_promo_name,
    sm.sm_carrier,
    substring(p.p_promo_name FROM 1 FOR 5),
    regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '\\w+', 0),
    concat(p.p_promo_name, '_', sm.sm_carrier),
    s.n
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dr.d_date)
    WHERE d.d_date < DATE '2022-01-31'
),
base_data AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        d_ret.d_year,
        cd_ref.cd_gender AS refunded_gender,
        cd_ret.cd_gender AS returning_gender,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active,
        ws.web_site_id,
        ws.web_street_name,
        wp.wp_url
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret
        ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_promo_end
        ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_access
        ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_access.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws_close
        ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_ws_close.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_ret.d_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
),
subq1 AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number
    FROM base_data
    WHERE refunded_gender = 'M' AND returning_gender = 'F'
),
subq2 AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number
    FROM base_data
    WHERE p_discount_active = 'Y' AND web_site_id IS NOT NULL
),
intersected_orders AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number FROM subq1
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cr_order_number FROM subq2
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    refunded_gender,
    returning_gender,
    p_promo_id,
    web_site_id,
    SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr_order_number) AS orders_cnt
FROM base_data
WHERE cr_order_number IN (SELECT cr_order_number FROM intersected_orders)
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (d_year, refunded_gender, returning_gender, p_promo_id, web_site_id),
    (d_year, refunded_gender, returning_gender, p_promo_id),
    (d_year, refunded_gender, returning_gender),
    (d_year, refunded_gender),
    (d_year),
    ()
)
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT MIN(t_time_sk) AS time_sk,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM time_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time_sk + 1,
           lvl + 1
    FROM time_hierarchy
    WHERE time_sk < (SELECT MAX(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim)
),

base_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_market_id,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        dcp.cp_department,
        wp.wp_max_ad_count,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit + ws.ws_net_profit) > 5000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit + ws.ws_net_profit) BETWEEN 0 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_tier
    FROM time_hierarchy th
    JOIN time_dim td ON td.t_time_sk = th.time_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page dcp ON dcp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cr.cr_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cr.cr_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    WHERE
        s.s_market_id IN (1,5,6)
        AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 5 AND 10
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND s.s_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
        AND hd.hd_dep_count > 2
        AND p.p_promo_name LIKE '%Summer%'
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_market_id,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        dcp.cp_department,
        wp.wp_max_ad_count,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id
),

grouped_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        s_store_id,
        s_market_id,
        p_promo_id,
        p_promo_name,
        hd_income_band_sk,
        hd_buy_potential,
        cp_department,
        wp_max_ad_count,
        sm_ship_mode_id,
        profit_tier,
        SUM(store_net_profit) AS sum_store_net_profit,
        SUM(web_net_profit) AS sum_web_net_profit,
        SUM(total_return_amount) AS sum_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt,
        GROUPING_ID(c_customer_id, s_store_id, p_promo_id) AS gid
    FROM base_sales_agg
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name,
         s_store_id, s_market_id,
         p_promo_id, p_promo_name,
         hd_income_band_sk, hd_buy_potential,
         cp_department, wp_max_ad_count, sm_ship_mode_id,
         profit_tier),
        (s_market_id, profit_tier),
        (profit_tier),
        ()
    )
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        gs.*,
        LAG(sum_store_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s_market_id ORDER BY sum_store_net_profit DESC) AS lag_store_profit,
        (SELECT AVG(sum_store_net_profit) FROM grouped_sales) AS overall_avg_store_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN sum_store_net_profit > (SELECT AVG(sum_store_net_profit) FROM grouped_sales) THEN 'Above Avg'
            ELSE 'Below Avg'
        END AS store_perf_category
    FROM grouped_sales gs
    WHERE sum_store_net_profit IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    s_store_id,
    s_market_id,
    p_promo_id,
    p_promo_name,
    profit_tier,
    sum_store_net_profit,
    sum_web_net_profit,
    sum_return_amount,

WITH RECURSIVE sales_rec AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        1 AS depth
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451910 AND 2451920
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        depth + 1
    FROM sales_rec s
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_order_number = s.cs_order_number
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = s.cs_item_sk
    WHERE s.depth < 2
)
SELECT
    sr.cs_sold_date_sk,
    p.p_promo_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sr.cs_sold_date_sk, p.p_promo_id) AS row_num,
    SUM(sr.cs_net_paid)               AS total_sales_net_paid,
    AVG(sr.cs_net_paid)               AS avg_sales_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)               AS total_catalog_return_loss,
    SUM(sr_ret.sr_net_loss)           AS total_store_return_loss,
    SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand)       AS total_inventory_qty,
    MAX(i.inv_quantity_on_hand)       AS max_inventory_qty,
    MIN(i.inv_quantity_on_hand)       AS min_inventory_qty
FROM sales_rec sr
JOIN call_center cc
    ON sr.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON sr.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON sr.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON sr.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON sr.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN inventory i
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk
JOIN store_returns sr_ret
    ON sr_ret.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
   AND sr_ret.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = sr.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = sr.cs_item_sk
   AND cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   AND cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
   AND cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND w.w_state = 'WA'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 500
  AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
  AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
          AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
          AND ws.ws_net_paid > 0
    )
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (sr.cs_sold_date_sk, p.p_promo_id),
    (sr.cs_sold_date_sk),
    (p.p_promo_id),
    ()
)
ORDER BY row_num
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           0 AS level
    FROM   date_dim
    WHERE  d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk,
           d_next.d_date,
           dr.level + 1
    FROM   date_dim d_next
    JOIN   date_range dr ON d_next.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE  dr.level < 30
),

sales_aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk                                 AS cust_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_gender,
        p.p_promo_id,
        CAST(NULL AS integer)                             AS warehouse_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar)                             AS warehouse_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)                               AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt)                       AS total_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number)               AS transaction_count
    FROM   store_sales ss
    JOIN   date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN   customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN   customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN   promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE  c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND  p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND  dr.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-01-31'
    GROUP BY
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_gender,
        p.p_promo_id
),

web_sales_aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk                            AS cust_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_gender,
        p.p_promo_id,
        w.w_warehouse_sk                                 AS warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name                               AS warehouse_name,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid)                              AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt)                      AS total_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number)               AS transaction_count
    FROM   web_sales ws
    JOIN   date_range dr ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN   customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN   customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN   promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN   warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN   web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE  c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND  p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND  w.w_state = 'NY'
      AND  wp.wp_image_count > 0
      AND  EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM   inventory i
            WHERE  i.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
               AND i.inv_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
               AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        )
    GROUP BY
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_gender,
        p.p_promo_id,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name
),

combined_sales AS (
    SELECT * FROM sales_aggregated
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_sales_aggregated
),

customers_with_returns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sr.sr_customer_sk AS cust_sk
    FROM   store_returns sr
    JOIN   date_range dr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk
    FROM   web_returns wr
    JOIN   date_range dr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
),

low_inventory_warehouses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.inv_warehouse_sk
    FROM   inventory i
    JOIN   date_range dr ON i.inv_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE  i.inv_quantity_on_hand < 5
),

warehouse_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.warehouse_sk,
        cs.warehouse_name,
        SUM(cs.total_net_paid)   AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.total_discount)   AS total_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cust_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM   combined_sales cs
    WHERE  cs.warehouse_sk

WITH sampled_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws_sold_time_sk,
        ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws_web_site_sk,
        ws_promo_sk,
        ws_net_paid,
        ws_net_profit,
        ws_ext_discount_amt
    FROM web_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        w.web_name AS site_name,
        regexp_extract(p.p_promo_name, '^([A-Za-z]+[0-9]+)', 1) AS promo_period,
        SUM(s.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(s.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        SUM(s.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_sales
    FROM sampled_sales s
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON s.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON s.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_site w
        ON s.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '.*_OFF$')
      AND t.t_meal_time LIKE '%lunch%'
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (w.web_name, regexp_extract(p.p_promo_name, '^([A-Za-z]+[0-9]+)', 1)),
        (w.web_name),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    site_name,
    promo_period,
    concat(site_name, ' - ', COALESCE(promo_period, 'ALL')) AS site_promo_label,
    total_net_profit,
    avg_discount,
    total_net_sales
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY site_name ASC, promo_period ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE base_sales_return AS (
    -- Base case: join returns and sales with initial filters
    SELECT
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_tax,
        cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost,
        1 AS level
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 20.00
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity >= 1
      AND cr.cr_return_tax < 5.00
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 100.00
      AND cs.cs_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk IN (6624, 848, 2093)
      AND cs.cs_ship_customer_sk <> 0
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step (single additional level to satisfy WITH RECURSIVE requirement)
    SELECT
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_tax,
        cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost,
        bsr.level + 1
    FROM base_sales_return bsr
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = bsr.cr_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = bsr.cr_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    WHERE bsr.level < 2
),
agg_by_demo AS (
    SELECT
        cr_returning_hdemo_sk,
        cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM base_sales_return
    GROUP BY cr_returning_hdemo_sk, cr_returning_cdemo_sk
    HAVING SUM(cr_return_amount) > 500.00
)
SELECT
    DISTINCT
    ag.cr_returning_hdemo_sk,
    ag.cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
    ag.total_return_amount,
    ag.total_sales_price,
    ag.distinct_orders,
    ag.total_sales_price / NULLIF(ag.total_return_amount, 0) AS sales_per_return,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ag.total_return_amount DESC) AS rn,
    AVG(ag.total_return_amount) OVER () AS avg_return_amount_all_groups
FROM agg_by_demo ag
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = ag.cr_returning_cdemo_sk
      AND cs2.cs_ext_wholesale_cost > 500.00
      AND cs2.cs_quantity > 1
)
ORDER BY ag.total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_total_discount,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS web_total_discount,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS combined_net_profit,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'High Profit'
            ELSE 'Low Profit'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1999
      AND d.d_week_seq BETWEEN 10 AND 30
      AND ws.ws_ext_tax > 100.00
      AND ss.ss_ext_discount_amt > 0
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, d.d_year
)
SELECT
    sa.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
    sa.d_year,
    sa.store_net_profit,
    sa.web_net_profit,
    sa.combined_net_profit,
    sa.profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.d_year ORDER BY sa.combined_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM sales_agg sa
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_sales ws2
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws2.ws_warehouse_sk = sa.w_warehouse_sk
      AND d2.d_year = sa.d_year
      AND ws2.ws_coupon_amt = 0
)
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_tax,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        d_sold.d_year AS sold_year
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND d_sold.d_date < DATE '2001-01-01'
)
,
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        d_sold.d_year AS sale_year,
        i_sales.i_product_name,
        i_sales.i_category,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
        cp.cp_department AS department,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        ws.web_name AS website_name,
        SUM(sb.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(sb.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(sb.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(sb.cr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_quantity
    FROM sales_base sb
    JOIN date_dim d_ship
        ON sb.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill
        ON sb.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship
        ON sb.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON sb.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON sb.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON sb.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN item i_sales
        ON sb.cs_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
    JOIN item i_inventory
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i_inventory.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON sb.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cc_open
        ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_cc_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cc_close
        ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_close.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr
        WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = sb.cs_item_sk
          AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = sb.cs_sold_date_sk
    )
    GROUP BY
        d_sold.d_year,
        i_sales.i_product_name,
        i_sales.i_category,
        cc.cc_name,
        cp.cp_department,
        sm.sm_type,
        ws.web_name
)
SELECT
    sale_year,
    i_product_name,
    i_category,
    call_center_name,
    department,
    ship_mode_type,
    website_name,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_profit,
    total_return_amount,
    total_return_quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS rn
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, ds.lvl + 1
    FROM date_dim d2
    JOIN date_seq ds
      ON d2.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE ds.lvl < 5
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS num_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk
),

returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS num_returns
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
      AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk
),

promo_list AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_promo_name) AS promo_names
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN promotion p
      ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d_sold.d_year,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ca.ca_city,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    sa.total_net_paid,
    sa.total_net_profit,
    COALESCE(ra.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_state ORDER BY sa.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_state,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_net_profit DESC) AS global_profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN sa.total_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN sa.total_net_profit > 50000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    t.promo_name,
    d_promo_start.d_date AS promo_start_date,
    d_promo_end.d_date AS promo_end_date
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sold
  ON d_sold.d_date_sk = sa.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN promotion p
  ON p.p_promo_sk = sa.ss_promo_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  AND cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = cs.cs_bill_addr_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra
  ON ra.store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk
  AND ra.sold_date_sk = sa.ss_sold_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_return
  ON d_return.d_date_sk = ra.returned_date_sk
JOIN promo_list pl
  ON pl.store_sk = s.s_store_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(pl.promo_names) AS t(promo_name)
JOIN date_dim d_promo_start
  ON d_promo_start.d_date_sk = p.p_start_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_promo_end
  ON d_promo_end.d_date_sk = p.p_end_date_sk
JOIN date_seq ds
  ON ds.d_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND ca.ca_county = 'Maricopa County'
  AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
ORDER BY sa.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        cp.cp_department,
        cd.cd_gender,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_item_sk,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        cs.cs_order_number
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r2 ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        cp_department,
        cd_gender,
        p_promo_name,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) + SUM(ws_net_paid) + SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS catalog_order_cnt
    FROM joined
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2000-12-31'
        AND p_item_sk IN (56527, 75314)
        AND cd_gender = 'M'
        AND ib_upper_bound <= 130000
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr_sub
            WHERE cr_sub.cr_order_number = joined.cs_order_number
                AND cr_sub.cr_return_quantity > 0
        )
    GROUP BY
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        cp_department,
        cd_gender,
        p_promo_name
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    i_product_name,
    cp_department,
    cd_gender,
    p_promo_name,
    total_catalog_sales,
    total_web_sales,
    total_store_sales,
    catalog_order_cnt,
    CASE WHEN total_sales > 10000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS dept_rank
FROM agg
HAVING total_catalog_sales > 0
ORDER BY total_catalog_sales DESC, dept_rank ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT DATE '2000-01-01' AS date_val
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_val + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM date_hierarchy
    WHERE date_val < DATE '2000-01-07'
),
orders_without_returns AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_order_number AS order_number
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cr.cr_order_number AS order_number
    FROM catalog_returns cr
),
catalog_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number AS order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk AS catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk AS address_sk,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inventory_on_hand
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
          AND inv.inv_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
        ORDER BY inv.inv_quantity_on_hand DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS inv
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 5
      AND d.d_year = 2001
      AND cc.cc_zip = '74593'
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND d.d_date IN (SELECT date_val FROM date_hierarchy)
),
store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_ticket_number AS order_number,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity AS quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid,
        CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS call_center_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS catalog_page_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS warehouse_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        ss.ss_addr_sk AS address_sk,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inventory_on_hand
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
          AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        ORDER BY inv.inv_quantity_on_hand DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS inv
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 5
      AND d.d_year = 2001
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND d.d_date IN (SELECT date_val FROM date_hierarchy)
),
returns_data AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_order_number AS order_number,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_time_sk AS time_sk,
        cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity AS quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amount,
        cr.cr_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_catalog_page_sk AS catalog_page_sk,
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk AS address_sk,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inventory_on_hand
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_d

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wsite.web_site_id,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        CASE
            WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000' THEN 'High'
            WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000' THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS buy_potential_category,
        cs.cd_gender,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_return_amt IS NOT NULL THEN wr.wr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_return_amt,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS avg_ext_sales_price
    FROM
        tpcds.web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
        JOIN tpcds.web_site wsite
            ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
        JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cs
            ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cs.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
            ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
            ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
            AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    WHERE
        wsite.web_country = 'United States'
        AND cs.cd_gender = 'M'
        AND hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (4, 7, 11)
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 2
        AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2451200
    GROUP BY
        wsite.web_site_id,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        CASE
            WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000' THEN 'High'
            WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000' THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END,
        cs.cd_gender
)
SELECT
    sa.web_site_id,
    sa.buy_potential_category,
    sa.cd_gender,
    sa.order_cnt,
    sa.total_profit,
    sa.total_quantity,
    sa.total_return_amt,
    sa.avg_ext_sales_price,
    (SELECT avg(ws2.ws_net_profit) FROM tpcds.web_sales ws2) AS overall_avg_profit
FROM
    sales_agg sa
WHERE
    sa.total_profit > 10000
    AND sa.total_return_amt < 2000
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tpcds.web_site w2
        WHERE w2.web_site_id = sa.web_site_id
          AND w2.web_state = 'CA'
    )
ORDER BY
    sa.total_profit DESC,
    sa.web_site_id
LIMIT 100

WITH unified_returns AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        i.i_category AS category,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_quantity AS quantity,
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND t.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND sr.sr_net_loss > 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory inv WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        i.i_category AS category,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_quantity AS quantity,
        c_ref.c_customer_id AS customer_id
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_ref.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND t.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cr.cr_net_loss > 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory inv WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        i.i_category AS category,
        wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        wr.wr_return_quantity AS quantity,
        c_ref.c_customer_id AS customer_id
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_ref.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND t.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND wr.wr_net_loss > 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory inv WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0)
), agg_by_group AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        category,
        SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers
    FROM unified_returns
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((year, category), (year), ())
), final_agg AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        category,
        total_net_loss,
        total_quantity,
        distinct_customers,
        CASE
            WHEN category IS NOT NULL THEN AVG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY year)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS avg_net_loss_per_year
    FROM agg_by_group
    WHERE total_net_loss IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(year, -1) AS year,

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs_item_sk,
        cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs_ship_addr_sk,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_cs_ext_sales_price,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_cs_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS cs_order_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cs_net_profit > 0 THEN cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS positive_profit_sales
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    WHERE cs_ext_sales_price > 1000
      AND cs_quantity > 1
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk, cs_ship_mode_sk, cs_warehouse_sk, cs_bill_addr_sk, cs_ship_addr_sk
),
ws_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws_item_sk,
        ws_order_number,
        ws_web_page_sk,
        ws_web_site_sk,
        ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws_net_profit
    FROM tpcds.web_sales
    WHERE ws_quantity > 5
      AND ws_ext_sales_price > 500
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    i.i_class,
    sm.sm_type,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
    ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
    wp.wp_url,
    ws.web_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_profit,
    SUM(ws_sales.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(ws_sales.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
    COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_return_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cs_agg.total_cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Positive Profit'
        WHEN SUM(cs_agg.total_cs_net_profit) < 0 THEN 'Negative Profit'
        ELSE 'Zero Profit'
    END AS profit_category,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_discount_amt)
     FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs2
     WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_catalog_discount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged' THEN wr.wr_order_number END) AS damaged_return_cnt
FROM cs_agg
JOIN tpcds.item i
    ON cs_agg.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm
    ON cs_agg.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN tpcds.warehouse w
    ON cs_agg.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_bill
    ON cs_agg.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_ship
    ON cs_agg.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
JOIN ws_sales
    ON i.i_item_sk = ws_sales.ws_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.web_page wp
    ON ws_sales.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN tpcds.web_site ws
    ON ws_sales.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_order_number = ws_sales.ws_order_number
LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE i.i_class = 'furniture'
  AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
  AND w.w_state = 'CA'
  AND ca_bill.ca_state = 'TX'
  AND wp.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-09-01'
  AND wp.wp_rec_start_date <= DATE '2000-12-31'
  AND (r.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged' OR r.r_reason_desc IS NULL)
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    i.i_class,
    sm.sm_type,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    ca_bill.ca_state,
    ca_ship.ca_state,
    wp.wp_url,
    ws.web_name
ORDER BY total_catalog_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_bill.ca_county AS bill_county,
        ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
        ca_ship.ca_county AS ship_county,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        hd_bill.hd_buy_potential AS bill_buy_potential,
        hd_ship.hd_buy_potential AS ship_buy_potential
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_net_profit IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    address_role,
    carrier,
    SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'Profitable'
        ELSE 'Less Profitable'
    END AS profit_flag
FROM (
    SELECT
        ws_order_number,
        'Bill' AS address_role,
        sm_carrier AS carrier,
        ws_quantity,
        ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
        bill_state AS state,
        bill_buy_potential AS buy_potential,
        CASE
            WHEN ws_net_profit > 1000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN ws_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM joined_sales
    WHERE bill_county = 'Washington County'
      AND sm_carrier = 'UPS'
      AND ws_quantity >= 2

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ws_order_number,
        'Ship' AS address_role,
        sm_carrier AS carrier,
        ws_quantity,
        ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
        ship_state AS state,
        ship_buy_potential AS buy_potential,
        CASE
            WHEN ws_net_profit > 1000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN ws_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM joined_sales
    WHERE ship_state = 'TX'
      AND sm_carrier = 'UPS'
      AND ws_quantity >= 2
) AS u
GROUP BY address_role, carrier
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_time_sk,
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk,
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk,
        cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_returning_addr_sk,
        cr.cr_call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_catalog_page_sk,
        cr.cr_ship_mode_sk,
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_tax,
        cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        cr.cr_fee,
        cr.cr_return_ship_cost,
        cr.cr_refunded_cash,
        cr.cr_reversed_charge,
        cr.cr_store_credit,
        cr.cr_net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42)
    WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk IN (797995, 174162, 189998)
      AND cr.cr_store_credit > 50
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 10
      AND cr.cr_return_amount >= 100
      AND cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk NOT IN (1338591, 1264671, 1162881)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        cp.cp_type,
        SUM(fr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(fr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        MIN(fr.cr_return_quantity) AS min_return_qty,
        MAX(fr.cr_return_quantity) AS max_return_qty,
        (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns cr2) AS overall_avg_return_amount
    FROM filtered_returns fr
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON fr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
      AND cp.cp_catalog_number IN (1, 13, 8)
      AND cp.cp_description IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_number, cp.cp_type),
        (cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_number),
        (cp.cp_department),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    a.cp_department,
    a.cp_catalog_number,
    a.cp_type,
    a.total_return_amount,
    a.avg_return_amount,
    a.return_count,
    a.min_return_qty,
    a.max_return_qty,
    a.overall_avg_return_amount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.cp_department ORDER BY a.total_return_amount DESC) AS dept_return_rank
FROM aggregated a
ORDER BY a.total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS period_key,
        'catalog' AS channel,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS net_paid,
        (SELECT AVG(p.p_cost) FROM promotion p WHERE p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_promo_cost
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr
          WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM promotion p
          WHERE p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND p.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
      )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS period_key,
        'web' AS channel,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS net_paid,
        (SELECT AVG(p.p_cost) FROM promotion p WHERE p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_promo_cost
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    WHERE wsit.web_country = 'United States'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr
          WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM promotion p
          WHERE p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND p.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
      )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    u.item_id,
    u.period_key,
    u.channel,
    u.net_paid,
    u.avg_promo_cost,
    SUM(u.net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY u.item_id) AS total_net_for_item,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.item_id ORDER BY u.net_paid DESC) AS rn
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM catalog_agg
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM web_agg
) u
ORDER BY total_net_for_item DESC, rn
LIMIT 100

WITH sampled_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs_ship_date_sk,
        cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs_quantity,
        cs_sales_price,
        cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs_net_profit,
        cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs_order_number
    FROM catalog_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42)
    WHERE cs_sales_price > 50
      AND cs_quantity > 1
      AND cs_ship_date_sk BETWEEN 2450850 AND 2450910
)
SELECT
    cp.cp_department,
    CASE
        WHEN cs.cs_sales_price >= 150 THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN cs.cs_sales_price >= 100 THEN 'Mid'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS price_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    MIN(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales,
    MAX(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit) FROM catalog_sales cs2) AS overall_avg_profit
FROM catalog_page cp
JOIN sampled_sales cs
    ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
WHERE cp.cp_catalog_page_number IN (5, 15, 8)
  AND cp.cp_catalog_number = 14
  AND cp.cp_type = 'A'
  AND cs.cs_sales_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
  AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_sales cs_ex
        WHERE cs_ex.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
          AND cs_ex.cs_sales_price > 180
    )
GROUP BY
    cp.cp_department,
    CASE
        WHEN cs.cs_sales_price >= 150 THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN cs.cs_sales_price >= 100 THEN 'Mid'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH date_inv_full AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        d.d_fy_quarter_seq,
        d.d_current_day,
        inv.inv_item_sk,
        inv.inv_warehouse_sk,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM date_dim d
    FULL OUTER JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
)
SELECT
    di.d_year,
    di.d_month_seq,
    sm.sm_type,
    tm.t_hour,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    MIN(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales,
    MAX(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
          AND ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    ) AS item_date_sales_cnt
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_inv_full di
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = di.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim tm
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = tm.t_time_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
WHERE di.d_year = 1998
  AND di.d_fy_quarter_seq = 13
  AND di.d_current_day = 'N'
  AND tm.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
  AND ws.ws_ext_list_price > 1000
  AND ws.ws_quantity >= 1
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inventory inv_check
        WHERE inv_check.inv_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
          AND inv_check.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      )
GROUP BY di.d_year, di.d_month_seq, sm.sm_type, tm.t_hour
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs_order_number,
        cs_quantity,
        cs_net_paid_inc_ship,
        cs_net_profit,
        cs_ext_discount_amt
    FROM catalog_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5)
    WHERE cs_net_paid_inc_ship > 3000
      AND cs_quantity >= 2
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    w.w_state,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS orders,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    MIN(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS min_discount,
    MAX(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS max_discount,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cs2.cs_net_paid_inc_ship)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
          AND cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    ) AS same_day_warehouse_sales
FROM filtered_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_site ws
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2002
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
  AND hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (1, 2)
  AND ws.web_country = 'United States'
  AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk IN (
        SELECT c2.c_customer_sk
        FROM customer c2
        WHERE c2.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    )
  AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship > (
        SELECT AVG(cs3.cs_net_paid_inc_ship)
        FROM catalog_sales cs3
        WHERE cs3.cs_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    )
GROUP BY d_sold.d_year,
         w.w_state,
         cd.cd_gender,
         hd.hd_buy_potential
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT 2452300 AS date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1 FROM date_series WHERE date_sk < 2452309
),
base_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        inv.inv_item_sk,
        inv.inv_warehouse_sk,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_current_price,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        s.s_hours,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_county,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    bs.s_store_name,
    bs.w_warehouse_name,
    bs.i_brand,
    SUM(bs.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS store_sales_total,
    (SELECT SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax)
     FROM web_sales ws
     WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = bs.ss_item_sk
       AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = bs.inv_warehouse_sk
       AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = bs.ss_sold_date_sk) AS web_sales_total,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    AVG(bs.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price,
    MIN(bs.ss_quantity) AS min_quantity,
    MAX(bs.ss_quantity) AS max_quantity
FROM base_sales bs
JOIN date_series ds ON bs.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.date_sk
WHERE bs.s_hours = '8AM-8AM'
  AND bs.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 100
  AND bs.w_county IN ('Mobile County', 'Walker County')
  AND bs.inv_quantity_on_hand > 50
  AND bs.ss_net_paid_inc_tax > 500
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = bs.ss_item_sk
          AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = bs.inv_warehouse_sk
          AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = bs.ss_sold_date_sk
    )
GROUP BY bs.s_store_name, bs.w_warehouse_name, bs.i_brand
ORDER BY store_sales_total DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
        cp.cp_department AS category,
        td.t_sub_shift AS sub_shift,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_quantity > 10 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Single' END AS sale_category,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM
        catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) AS cs
        JOIN catalog_page AS cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN promotion AS p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN time_dim AS td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        td.t_time BETWEEN 10 AND 16
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY
        p.p_promo_id,
        cp.cp_department,
        td.t_sub_shift,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_quantity > 10 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Single' END
    HAVING
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 5000
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
        wp.wp_type AS category,
        td.t_sub_shift AS sub_shift,
        CASE WHEN ws.ws_quantity > 10 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Single' END AS sale_category,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM
        web_sales AS ws
        JOIN promotion AS p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN web_page AS wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        JOIN time_dim AS td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        td.t_time BETWEEN 10 AND 16
        AND ws.ws_net_paid > 0
        AND wp.wp_char_count > 1500
    GROUP BY
        p.p_promo_id,
        wp.wp_type,
        td.t_sub_shift,
        CASE WHEN ws.ws_quantity > 10 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Single' END
    HAVING
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) > 5000
)
SELECT
    promo_id,
    category,
    sub_shift,
    sale_category,
    total_net_paid,
    order_cnt,
    'catalog' AS source
FROM catalog_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT
    promo_id,
    category,
    sub_shift,
    sale_category,
    total_net_paid,
    order_cnt,
    'web' AS source
FROM web_agg
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'store' AS sales_source,
        d.d_date AS sales_date,
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost), 0)
         FROM promotion p
         WHERE p.p_start_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk
           AND p.p_end_date_sk >= d.d_date_sk) AS total_promo_cost
    FROM
        store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 2000
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk)
    GROUP BY
        d.d_date, c.c_customer_id, d.d_date_sk
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'web' AS sales_source,
        d.d_date AS sales_date,
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost), 0)
         FROM promotion p
         WHERE p.p_start_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk
           AND p.p_end_date_sk >= d.d_date_sk) AS total_promo_cost
    FROM
        web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) ws
        JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 2000
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM promotion p WHERE p.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk)
    GROUP BY
        d.d_date, c.c_customer_id, d.d_date_sk
)
SELECT
    sales_source,
    sales_date,
    customer_id,
    total_net_paid,
    total_quantity,
    avg_sales_price,
    total_promo_cost
FROM store_sales_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT
    sales_source,
    sales_date,
    customer_id,
    total_net_paid,
    total_quantity,
    avg_sales_price,
    total_promo_cost
FROM web_sales_agg
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH page_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_type,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cr.cr_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE
        cp.cp_department IN ('Books', 'Electronics', 'Fashion', 'Home', 'Sports')
        AND cp.cp_type = 'Online'
        AND cp.cp_catalog_number BETWEEN 5 AND 25
        AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 1
        AND cr.cr_return_amount >= 10.00
        AND cr.cr_refunded_cash < 2000.00
        AND cr.cr_reversed_charge BETWEEN 30.00 AND 400.00
        AND cp.cp_description LIKE '%goods%'
    GROUP BY
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_type,
        cp.cp_catalog_number
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 500.00
),
dept_summary AS (
    SELECT
        cp_department,
        AVG(total_return_amount) AS avg_page_return_amount,
        SUM(total_return_amount) AS dept_total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS page_count
    FROM page_returns
    GROUP BY cp_department
    HAVING AVG(total_return_amount) > 1000.00
)
SELECT
    pr.cp_catalog_page_id,
    pr.cp_department,
    pr.cp_type,
    pr.cp_catalog_number,
    pr.total_return_amount,
    pr.total_refunded_cash,
    pr.total_return_quantity,
    pr.avg_return_amount,
    pr.return_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.cp_department ORDER BY pr.total_return_amount DESC) AS department_rank,
    SUM(pr.total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY pr.cp_department) AS dept_total_return_amount,
    ds.avg_page_return_amount,
    ds.page_count
FROM page_returns pr
JOIN dept_summary ds
    ON pr.cp_department = ds.cp_department
ORDER BY pr.total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

goal: Calculate sales performance by state, brand, and ship mode for customers whose billing and shipping addresses overlap, applying key filters and reporting aggregated metrics across multiple grouping sets.

SELECT
  ca.ca_state,
  ca.ca_county,
  i.i_category,
  i.i_brand,
  p.p_promo_name,
  sm.sm_type,
  r.r_reason_desc,
  td.t_hour,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_net_paid,
  SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid,
  SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_net_loss,
  AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_catalog_discount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS catalog_order_cnt,
  (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid) FROM catalog_sales cs2) AS overall_avg_catalog_net_paid
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk AND ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE ca.ca_county IN ('York County', 'Oldham County')
  AND ca.ca_street_number = '362'
  AND td.t_time = 14
  AND td.t_minute = 18
  AND wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = 1258950
GROUP BY
  ca.ca_state,
  ca.ca_county,
  i.i_category,
  i.i_brand,
  p.p_promo_name,
  sm.sm_type,
  r.r_reason_desc,
  td.t_hour
ORDER BY total_catalog_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'Store' AS channel,
        s.s_store_name AS location,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY s.s_store_name, i.i_item_id
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'Web' AS channel,
        w.web_name AS location,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE sm.sm_code = 'AIR' AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY w.web_name, i.i_item_id
)
SELECT
    channel,
    location,
    item_id,
    total_net_paid,
    transaction_count,
    total_quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS channel_rank
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_agg
) combined
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH page_summary AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        cp.cp_department,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM
        catalog_page cp
        JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE
        cp.cp_end_date_sk BETWEEN 2450800 AND 2450900
    GROUP BY
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        cp.cp_department
),

later_page_summary AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        cp.cp_department,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM
        catalog_page cp
        JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE
        cp.cp_end_date_sk >= 2450901
    GROUP BY
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        cp.cp_department
)

SELECT
    ps.cp_catalog_page_number,
    ps.cp_catalog_number,
    ps.cp_department,
    'early' AS period,
    ps.total_return_amount,
    ps.total_net_loss,
    ps.return_cnt,
    ps.distinct_customers,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cr_sub.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr_sub
        WHERE cr_sub.cr_catalog_page_sk = ps.cp_catalog_page_sk
    ) AS avg_return_amount_overall
FROM page_summary ps
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_returns cr_exist
    WHERE cr_exist.cr_catalog_page_sk = ps.cp_catalog_page_sk
      AND cr_exist.cr_return_amount > 1000
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
    lp.cp_catalog_page_number,
    lp.cp_catalog_number,
    lp.cp_department,
    'later' AS period,
    lp.total_return_amount,
    lp.total_net_loss,
    lp.return_cnt,
    lp.distinct_customers,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cr_sub.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr_sub
        WHERE cr_sub.cr_catalog_page_sk = lp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    ) AS avg_return_amount_overall
FROM later_page_summary lp
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_returns cr_exist
    WHERE cr_exist.cr_catalog_page_sk = lp.cp_catalog_page_sk
      AND cr_exist.cr_return_amount > 1000
)
ORDER BY
    period,
    total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT
    hd_demo_sk,
    income_range,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    hd_dep_count,
    vehicle_per_dep,
    vehicle_status
FROM (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        CONCAT(ib.ib_lower_bound, '-', ib.ib_upper_bound) AS income_range,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        CASE WHEN hd.hd_dep_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE hd.hd_vehicle_count * 1.0 / hd.hd_dep_count END AS vehicle_per_dep,
        CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count >= hd.hd_dep_count THEN 'Sufficient' ELSE 'Insufficient' END AS vehicle_status
    FROM household_demographics hd
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (SELECT ib_income_band_sk FROM income_band WHERE ib_upper_bound <= 120000)
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 120000

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        CONCAT(ib.ib_lower_bound, '-', ib.ib_upper_bound) AS income_range,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        CASE WHEN hd.hd_dep_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE hd.hd_vehicle_count * 1.0 / hd.hd_dep_count END AS vehicle_per_dep,
        CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count >= hd.hd_dep_count THEN 'Sufficient' ELSE 'Insufficient' END AS vehicle_status
    FROM household_demographics hd
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (SELECT ib_income_band_sk FROM income_band WHERE ib_lower_bound > 120000)
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound > 120000
) AS combined
ORDER BY income_range, hd_demo_sk
LIMIT 100

WITH sub AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_sk,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode_id,
        sm.sm_carrier AS carrier,
        ca.ca_city AS city,
        regexp_extract(p.p_promo_name, '^([A-Za-z]+)', 1) AS promo_first_word
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE
        regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@example\\.com$', 'i')
        AND ca.ca_city LIKE 'San%'
        AND sm.sm_carrier LIKE 'U%'
)
SELECT
    ship_mode_id,
    carrier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN net_paid >= 5000 THEN net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_net_paid,
    concat('Carrier: ', carrier, ', Mode: ', ship_mode_id) AS carrier_mode_desc,
    substring(city, 1, 3) AS city_prefix,
    promo_first_word
FROM sub
GROUP BY ship_mode_id, carrier, promo_first_word, substring(city, 1, 3)
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_desc,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '^([^ ]+)', 1) AS item_first_word,
        CASE WHEN sr.sr_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_flag
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(s.s_store_name, '^Store [0-9]+$')
      AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%wireless%'
)
SELECT
    s_store_name,
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
    COUNT(*) AS return_transactions,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(sr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN SUM(sr_net_loss) > 2000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(sr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category
FROM filtered_returns
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (s_store_name, d_year, d_month_seq),
    (s_store_name, d_year),
    (s_store_name),
    ()
)
HAVING SUM(sr_net_loss) > 1000
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH warehouse_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_city,
        w.w_state,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty
    FROM warehouse w
    JOIN inventory i
        ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state
)
SELECT
    combined.date_key,
    combined.w_warehouse_name,
    combined.transaction_type,
    combined.total_amount,
    combined.amount_category,
    combined.daily_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_key,
        wi.w_warehouse_name,
        'RETURN' AS transaction_type,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS amount_category,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM catalog_returns cr2
         WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk
           AND cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS daily_count
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN warehouse_inventory wi
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = wi.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2450948
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                  FROM reason r2
                  WHERE r2.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
                    AND r2.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damage%')
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, wi.w_warehouse_name

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_key,
        wi.w_warehouse_name,
        'SALE' AS transaction_type,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship) > 50000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS amount_category,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM web_sales ws2
         WHERE ws2.ws_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
           AND ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS daily_count
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN warehouse_inventory wi
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wi.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2450948
      AND ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship > 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                  FROM promotion p2
                  WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
                    AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y')
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, wi.w_warehouse_name
) AS combined
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_addresses AS (
    SELECT
        ca_address_sk,
        ca_city,
        ca_state,
        ca_zip,
        ca_street_name,
        ca_street_type,
        ca_street_number,
        CONCAT(ca_street_number, ' ', ca_street_name, ' ', ca_street_type) AS full_address,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(ca_street_name, '(\\d+)', 1) AS extracted_number
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE
        REGEXP_LIKE(ca_street_name, '\\d')
        AND ca_city LIKE 'S%'
        AND CONCAT(ca_street_number, ' ', ca_street_name, ' ', ca_street_type) LIKE '%Park%'
)
SELECT
    fa.ca_city,
    fa.ca_state,
    fa.extracted_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_sales_orders,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales_net_paid,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_sales_net_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS store_return_tickets,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_sk) AS distinct_warehouses
FROM filtered_addresses fa
LEFT JOIN store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) AS sr
    ON sr.sr_addr_sk = fa.ca_address_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = fa.ca_address_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE w.w_street_type LIKE '%Ave%'
GROUP BY
    fa.ca_city,
    fa.ca_state,
    fa.extracted_number
ORDER BY
    total_store_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        dd.d_quarter_name AS d_quarter_name,
        wh.w_warehouse_name AS w_warehouse_name,
        td.t_hour AS t_hour,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_count,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_quantity > 10 THEN cs.cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS high_qty_sales,
        MIN(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales_price,
        MAX(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales_price
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN warehouse wh ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer cust ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    WHERE
        dd.d_quarter_name = '1901Q4'
        AND wh.w_gmt_offset = -6.00
        AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        AND cs.cs_net_profit > 0
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
    GROUP BY dd.d_quarter_name, wh.w_warehouse_name, td.t_hour
)
SELECT
    d_quarter_name,
    w_warehouse_name,
    t_hour,
    total_sales,
    total_net_profit,
    avg_net_profit,
    order_count,
    total_return_loss,
    high_qty_sales,
    min_sales_price,
    max_sales_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS rn
FROM agg
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT 2450000 AS date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_range
    WHERE date_sk < 2450100
),
selected_returns AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_order_number,
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_account_credit,
        wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk,
        wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk,
        hd_ret.hd_income_band_sk AS ret_income_band,
        hd_ret.hd_vehicle_count AS ret_vehicle_cnt,
        hd_ref.hd_income_band_sk AS ref_income_band,
        hd_ref.hd_vehicle_count AS ref_vehicle_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_ret
        ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_ref
        ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(date_sk) FROM date_range) AND (SELECT MAX(date_sk) FROM date_range)
      AND hd_ret.hd_income_band_sk IN (7, 12, 13)
