      AND hd_ret.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
      AND wr.wr_account_credit > 10
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity >= 1
),
order_number_diff AS (
    SELECT wr_order_number
    FROM web_returns
    WHERE wr_returning_hdemo_sk IN (
        SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_dep_count >= 3
    )
    EXCEPT
    SELECT wr_order_number
    FROM web_returns
    WHERE wr_refunded_hdemo_sk IN (
        SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
    )
),
ranked_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.ret_income_band ORDER BY sr.wr_returned_date_sk DESC) AS rn_income_band,
        SUM(sr.wr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.ret_income_band ORDER BY sr.wr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amt,
        CASE WHEN sr.wr_return_amt > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_severity,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_returns wr2 WHERE wr2.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = sr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk AND wr2.wr_return_amt > sr.wr_return_amt) AS higher_return_count
    FROM selected_returns sr
    WHERE sr.wr_order_number IN (SELECT wr_order_number FROM order_number_diff)
)
SELECT
    rr.wr_order_number,
    rr.wr_returned_date_sk,
    rr.wr_return_amt AS return_amount,
    rr.ret_income_band,
    rr.ret_vehicle_cnt,
    rr.return_severity,
    rr.rn_income_band,
    rr.cumulative_return_amt,
    rr.higher_return_count
FROM ranked_returns rr
ORDER BY rr.rn_income_band ASC, rr.wr_returned_date_sk DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id,
           i.i_product_name,
           p.p_promo_name,
           cd.cd_gender,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS store_sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_demo = 'N'
      AND p.p_response_target = 1
      AND ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost > 1000
      AND ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
      AND cd.cd_dep_college_count >= 2
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM inventory inv
          WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
      )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, p.p_promo_name, cd.cd_gender
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id,
           i.i_product_name,
           p.p_promo_name,
           cd.cd_gender,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS web_sales_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_demo = 'N'
      AND p.p_response_target = 1
      AND ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost > 1000
      AND ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
      AND cd.cd_dep_college_count >= 2
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM inventory inv
          WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
      )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, p.p_promo_name, cd.cd_gender
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(sa.i_item_id, wa.i_item_id) AS i_item_id,
    COALESCE(sa.i_product_name, wa.i_product_name) AS i_product_name,
    COALESCE(sa.p_promo_name, wa.p_promo_name) AS p_promo_name,
    COALESCE(sa.cd_gender, wa.cd_gender) AS cd_gender,
    COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit, 0) AS combined_net_profit,
    COALESCE(sa.store_sales_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_sales_cnt, 0) AS total_sales_cnt,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit, 0), COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit, 0)) AS max_channel_net_profit
FROM store_agg sa
FULL OUTER JOIN web_agg wa
  ON sa.i_item_id = wa.i_item_id
 AND sa.i_product_name = wa.i_product_name
 AND sa.p_promo_name = wa.p_promo_name
 AND sa.cd_gender = wa.cd_gender
ORDER BY combined_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH joined_base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS cs_net_profit,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS ss_net_profit,
        wr.wr_return_amt AS wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_net_loss AS wr_net_loss,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_month,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_education_status,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        p.p_channel_catalog
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
       AND ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
       AND ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
       AND ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
       AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
       AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND p.p_channel_catalog = 'N'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '5000-10000'
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 20000
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_store_name,
        s_state,
        sum(cs_ext_sales_price) + sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,
        sum(cs_net_profit) + sum(ss_net_profit) AS profit_amount,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS return_amount,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS loss_amount
    FROM joined_base
    GROUP BY s_store_id, s_store_name, s_state
),
agg_returns AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_store_name,
        s_state,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS sales_amount,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS profit_amount,
        sum(wr_return_amt) AS return_amount,
        sum(wr_net_loss) AS loss_amount
    FROM joined_base
    GROUP BY s_store_id, s_store_name, s_state
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM agg_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM agg_returns
),
final_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_store_name,
        s_state,
        sum(sales_amount) AS total_sales_amount,
        sum(profit_amount) AS total_profit_amount,
        sum(return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        sum(loss_amount) AS total_loss_amount,
        sum(profit_amount) - sum(loss_amount) AS net_profit_after_loss,
        sum(sales_amount) - sum(return_amount) AS net_sales_after_return
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY s_store_id, s_store_name, s_state
    HAVING sum(sales_amount) > 1000
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    s_store_name,
    s_state,
    total_sales_amount,
    total_profit_amount,
    total_return_amount,
    total_loss_amount,
    net_profit_after_loss,
    net_sales_after_return
FROM final_agg
WHERE s_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY')
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE hour_series AS (
    SELECT 0 AS hour
    UNION ALL
    SELECT hour + 1 FROM hour_series WHERE hour < 23
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour,
        s.s_store_id,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt,
        CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 2000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_reason_sk IN (29, 38)
      AND sr.sr_return_ship_cost > 20
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND t.t_meal_time = 'lunch'
    GROUP BY t.t_hour, s.s_store_id
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 5000 THEN 'Big' ELSE 'Small' END AS amt_category
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 100
      AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk IN (816, 2368, 5919)
      AND t.t_meal_time = 'lunch'
    GROUP BY t.t_hour
),
intersect_hours AS (
    SELECT t_hour FROM store_agg
    INTERSECT
    SELECT t_hour FROM web_agg
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        sa.t_hour,
        sa.s_store_id,
        sa.store_net_loss,
        sa.store_return_cnt,
        sa.loss_category,
        wa.web_net_loss,
        wa.web_return_cnt,
        wa.amt_category,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.t_hour ORDER BY sa.store_net_loss DESC) AS store_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.t_hour ORDER BY (sa.store_net_loss + wa.web_net_loss) DESC) AS overall_row_num
    FROM store_agg sa
    JOIN web_agg wa ON sa.t_hour = wa.t_hour
    JOIN intersect_hours ih ON sa.t_hour = ih.t_hour
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_agg wa2
        WHERE wa2.t_hour = sa.t_hour
          AND wa2.web_net_loss > 1000
    )
)
SELECT
    c.t_hour,
    c.s_store_id,
    c.store_net_loss,
    c.web_net_loss,
    c.store_return_cnt,
    c.web_return_cnt,
    c.loss_category,
    c.amt_category,
    c.store_rank,
    c.overall_row_num
FROM hour_series hs
JOIN combined c ON hs.hour = c.t_hour
ORDER BY c.t_hour, c.store_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cc_division,
    i_sales.i_class_id,
    d_sold.d_year,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
  JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  JOIN item i_sales
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
  JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d_cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
  JOIN call_center cc_ret
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_ret.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm_ret
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_ret.sm_ship_mode_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_return
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
  JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
    AND cc.cc_division IN (1, 3, 5)
  GROUP BY
    cc.cc_division,
    i_sales.i_class_id,
    d_sold.d_year
)
SELECT
  base.cc_division,
  base.i_class_id,
  base.d_year,
  base.total_net_profit,
  base.total_net_paid,
  base.distinct_orders,
  CASE 
    WHEN base.total_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'HIGH'
    WHEN base.total_net_profit BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
    ELSE 'LOW'
  END AS profit_category,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY base.cc_division, base.d_year
    ORDER BY base.total_net_profit DESC
  ) AS profit_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC, profit_rank ASC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_cte AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_date,
        d_year,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        lvl + 1
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN date_cte dc ON d.d_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND lvl < 30
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    cs.cs_order_number,
    d.d_date AS sale_date,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    c.c_customer_id,
    cd.cd_gender,
    CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'F' THEN 'Female' ELSE 'Male' END AS gender_label,
    s.s_store_name,
    ss.ss_quantity,
    ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax,
    ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax AS web_net_paid_inc_tax,
    we.web_name AS website_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_sales_price)
     FROM web_sales ws2
     WHERE ws2.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_web_sales_price
FROM call_center cc
FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
JOIN date_cte d
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN item i
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   AND ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_site we
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
   AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE
    d.d_year = 2001
    AND i.i_current_price > 100
    AND c.c_birth_month = 7
ORDER BY
    sales_rank,
    d.d_date

WITH
  sales_keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_web_page_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 0
  ),
  page_keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk
    FROM web_page wp
    WHERE wp.wp_char_count > 1500
  ),
  common_keys AS (
    SELECT ws_web_page_sk
    FROM sales_keys
    INTERSECT
    SELECT wp_web_page_sk
    FROM page_keys
  ),
  sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      ws.ws_web_site_sk,
      ws.ws_web_page_sk,
      SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
      SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
      COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN common_keys ck
      ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = ck.ws_web_page_sk
    WHERE
      ws.ws_ship_date_sk BETWEEN 2451400 AND 2453000
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 1
      AND ws.ws_promo_sk NOT IN (1256, 1178)
      AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 0
    GROUP BY
      ws.ws_web_site_sk,
      ws.ws_web_page_sk
  ),
  page_agg AS (
    SELECT
      wp.wp_web_page_sk,
      wp.wp_type,
      AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_char_cnt,
      MAX(wp.wp_max_ad_count) AS max_ad_cnt
    FROM web_page wp
    JOIN common_keys ck
      ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ck.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE
      wp.wp_max_ad_count >= 1
      AND wp.wp_type IS NOT NULL
      AND wp.wp_url LIKE '%example%'
      AND wp.wp_char_count > 1500
    GROUP BY
      wp.wp_web_page_sk,
      wp.wp_type
  ),
  full_combined AS (
    SELECT
      s.ws_web_site_sk,
      s.ws_web_page_sk,
      s.total_sales,
      s.total_profit,
      s.transaction_cnt,
      p.wp_type,
      p.avg_char_cnt,
      p.max_ad_cnt
    FROM sales_agg s
    FULL OUTER JOIN page_agg p
      ON s.ws_web_page_sk = p.wp_web_page_sk
  ),
  site_joined AS (
    SELECT
      fc.ws_web_site_sk,
      ws_site.web_name,
      fc.ws_web_page_sk,
      fc.total_sales,
      fc.total_profit,
      fc.transaction_cnt,
      fc.wp_type,
      fc.avg_char_cnt,
      fc.max_ad_cnt
    FROM full_combined fc
    LEFT OUTER JOIN web_site ws_site
      ON fc.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
  )
SELECT
  COALESCE(sj.web_name, 'Unknown Site') AS site_name,
  sj.wp_type,
  SUM(sj.total_sales) AS sum_sales,
  SUM(sj.total_profit) AS sum_profit,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sj.ws_web_page_sk) AS distinct_pages,
  AVG(sj.avg_char_cnt) AS avg_page_char_cnt,
  MAX(sj.max_ad_cnt) AS max_ad_per_page
FROM site_joined sj
WHERE sj.total_sales IS NOT NULL OR sj.max_ad_cnt IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  (COALESCE(sj.web_name, 'Unknown Site'), sj.wp_type),
  (COALESCE(sj.web_name, 'Unknown Site')),
  (sj.wp_type),
  ()
)
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(sj.web_name, 'Unknown Site') ASC,
  sj.wp_type ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH ws_base AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
)
SELECT
    sm.sm_type,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    wsit.web_name,
    dd.d_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws_base.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(ws_base.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(ws_base.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cr_sub.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr_sub
        WHERE cr_sub.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    ) AS avg_return_amount_per_warehouse
FROM ws_base
FULL OUTER JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON ws_base.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse w
    ON ws_base.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim dd
    ON ws_base.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c_bill
    ON ws_base.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site wsit
    ON ws_base.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN store s
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
   AND cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
WHERE
    dd.d_year = 2001
    AND dd.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
    AND dd.d_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
    AND sm.sm_type = 'OVERNIGHT'
    AND wsit.web_zip = '49532'
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND ws_base.ws_quantity > 5
GROUP BY
    sm.sm_type,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    wsit.web_name,
    dd.d_year
HAVING
    SUM(ws_base.ws_net_paid) > 10000
ORDER BY
    total_net_paid DESC,

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_date AS sold_date,
    t_sold.t_meal_time,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    cs_agg.total_sales,
    cs_agg.total_quantity,
    cs_agg.total_profit,
    COALESCE(wr_sum.return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
    (cs_agg.total_sales - COALESCE(wr_sum.return_amount, 0)) AS net_sales,
    LAG(cs_agg.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY d_sold.d_date) AS prev_day_sales,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_sales - COALESCE(wr_sum.return_amount, 0))
        OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY d_sold.d_date
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_net_sales,
    u.qty_variant
FROM cs_agg
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON cs_agg.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sold
    ON cs_agg.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN item i
    ON cs_agg.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs_agg.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs_agg.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_amount
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk
) wr_sum
    ON wr_sum.wr_item_sk = cs_agg.cs_item_sk
    AND wr_sum.wr_returned_date_sk = cs_agg.cs_sold_date_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[cs_agg.total_quantity, cs_agg.total_quantity + 10]) AS u(qty_variant)
WHERE
    d_sold.d_year = 1904
    AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#23'
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND cs_agg.total_sales > 1000
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM item i2
        WHERE i2.i_item_sk = cs_agg.cs_item_sk
          AND i2.i_category = 'Electronics'
    )
HAVING
    (cs_agg.total_sales - COALESCE(wr_sum.return_amount, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY
    net_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT 2451545 AS date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1 FROM date_series WHERE date_sk < 2451549
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_state,
        i.i_category,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                     AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
                     AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
                     AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
                     AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk
    JOIN date_series ds ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ds.date_sk
    WHERE
        cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
        AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
        AND w.w_state = 'TX'
        AND s.web_country = 'United States'
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 2
        AND ws.ws_net_paid > 500
        AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
        AND i.i_rec_end_date <= DATE '1999-12-31'
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM web_page wp
            WHERE wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
              AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
        )
),
agg_data AS (
    SELECT
        cc_state,

        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,

        SUM(CASE WHEN cs_quantity > 5 THEN cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS high_qty_sales
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (cc_state, i_category),
        (cc_state),
        (i_category),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    cc_state,
    i_category,
    is_profitable,
    total_sales,
    avg_net_paid,
    txn_count,
    min_profit,
    max_profit,
    high_qty_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS row_num
FROM agg_data
ORDER BY total_sales DESC, row_num

WITH
promo_catalog AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_sales_cnt,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS catalog_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS catalog_total_discount,
        MIN(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS catalog_min_net_paid,
        MAX(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS catalog_max_net_paid
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_country = 'United States'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax > 500
    GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk
),
promo_store AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS store_sales_cnt,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS store_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_total_discount,
        MIN(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS store_min_net_paid,
        MAX(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS store_max_net_paid,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss
    FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 2
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 150000
    GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk
),
promo_intersect AS (
    SELECT promo_sk FROM promo_catalog
    INTERSECT
    SELECT promo_sk FROM promo_store
),
promo_details AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_start_date_sk,
        p.p_end_date_sk,
        p.p_channel_email,
        pc.catalog_sales_cnt,
        pc.catalog_net_paid,
        ps.store_sales_cnt,
        ps.store_net_paid,
        ps.total_return_loss,
        (pc.catalog_net_paid + ps.store_net_paid - ps.total_return_loss) AS total_net,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (pc.catalog_net_paid + ps.store_net_paid - ps.total_return_loss) DESC) AS net_rank
    FROM tpcds.promotion p
    JOIN promo_catalog pc ON p.p_promo_sk = pc.promo_sk
    JOIN promo_store ps ON p.p_promo_sk = ps.promo_sk
    JOIN promo_intersect pi ON p.p_promo_sk = pi.promo_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tpcds.store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_ticket_number IN (
            SELECT ss2.ss_ticket_number
            FROM tpcds.store_sales ss2
            WHERE ss2.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        )
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p_promo_id,
    p_promo_name,
    p_start_date_sk,
    p_end_date_sk,
    p_channel_email,
    catalog_sales_cnt,
    store_sales_cnt,
    total_net,
    net_rank
FROM promo_details
ORDER BY net_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_summary AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_txn_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_ticket_number) AS row_num,
    ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
    d_sales.d_date,
    s.s_store_name,
    p_sales.p_promo_name,
    cd_sales.cd_gender,
    ca_sales.ca_city,
    ss.ss_quantity,
    ss.ss_net_paid,
    sr.sr_return_quantity,
    wr.wr_return_quantity,
    cs.cs_quantity AS catalog_quantity,
    (
        SELECT MAX(p_inner.p_cost)
        FROM promotion p_inner
        WHERE p_inner.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
    ) AS max_promo_cost,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM reason r2
        WHERE r2.r_reason_id = r_sr.r_reason_id
          AND r2.r_reason_desc = r_sr.r_reason_desc
    ) THEN 'Known' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS reason_known_flag,
    ss_sum.total_net_paid,
    ss_sum.total_net_profit,
    ss_sum.sales_txn_cnt
FROM store_sales ss
FULL OUTER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sales
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_sales
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_sales.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_sales
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_sales.ca_address_sk
JOIN promotion p_sales
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_sales.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
LEFT JOIN reason r_sr
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr
    ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_sr
    ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_wr
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr
    ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr
    ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p_cs
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cs.p_promo_sk
JOIN sales_summary ss_sum
    ON ss_sum.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   AND ss_sum.ss_sold_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
WHERE d_sales.d_year = 2001
  AND s.s_country = 'United States'
ORDER BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_ticket_number
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH
cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name
),
store_ret AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS d_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk AS t_time_sk,
        ca_sr.ca_state,
        d_sr.d_year,
        d_sr.d_month_seq,
        r_sr.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        'store' AS source
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d_sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_time_sk, ca_sr.ca_state, d_sr.d_year, d_sr.d_month_seq, r_sr.r_reason_desc
),
web_ret AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS d_date_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk AS t_time_sk,
        ca_wr.ca_state,
        d_wr.d_year,
        d_wr.d_month_seq,
        r_wr.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        'web' AS source
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
    JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_returned_time_sk, ca_wr.ca_state, d_wr.d_year, d_wr.d_month_seq, r_wr.r_reason_desc
),
returns_union AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, t_time_sk, ca_state, d_year, d_month_seq, r_reason_desc, total_return_amt, total_net_loss, source FROM store_ret
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_date_sk, t_time_sk, ca_state, d_year, d_month_seq, r_reason_desc, total_return_amt, total_net_loss, source FROM web_ret
)
SELECT
    ru.d_year,
    ru.d_month_seq,
    ru.ca_state,
    ru.r_reason_desc,
    ru.source,
    cs.w_warehouse_name,
    SUM(ru.total_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    SUM(ru.total_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    SUM(cs.total_sales) AS total_sales,
    SUM(cs.total_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(cs.total_profit) AS total_profit
FROM returns_union ru
JOIN cs_agg cs ON ru.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
GROUP BY ru.d_year, ru.d_month_seq, ru.ca_state, ru.r_reason_desc, ru.source, cs.w_warehouse_name
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
    (SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(wr.wr_net_loss)) AS total_net_loss
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN time_dim td_cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td_cr.t_time_sk
JOIN reason r_cr
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer cust_refund_cr
    ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = cust_refund_cr.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer cust_return_cr
    ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = cust_return_cr.c_customer_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
JOIN time_dim td_wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td_wr.t_time_sk
JOIN customer cust_refund_wr
    ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = cust_refund_wr.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer cust_return_wr
    ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = cust_return_wr.c_customer_sk
JOIN filtered_wp wp
    ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN customer cust_wp
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = cust_wp.c_customer_sk
WHERE cr.cr_reason_sk IN (
    SELECT r2.r_reason_sk
    FROM reason r2
    WHERE r2.r_reason_desc LIKE '%defect%'
)
GROUP BY ROLLUP(
    r_cr.r_reason_desc,
    COALESCE(td_cr.t_hour, td_wr.t_hour)
)
HAVING (SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(wr.wr_net_loss)) > 1000
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC, reason_desc, hour_of_day
LIMIT 100

WITH date_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND d_date = DATE '2001-12-01'
),
item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name, i_manufact_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id IN (338, 294)
),
store_filtered AS (
    SELECT s_closed_date_sk, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state = 'CA'
),
inventory_sampled AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk, inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.cr_item_sk ORDER BY d.d_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_filtered d
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item_filtered i
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_filtered s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, i.i_product_name
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 1000
),
web_return_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_wr_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS wr_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wr.wr_item_sk ORDER BY d.d_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_filtered d
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item_filtered i
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
       AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, i.i_product_name
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 500
),
union_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i_product_name,
        total_return_amount AS total_amount,
        return_cnt AS cnt,
        rn
    FROM catalog_agg
    UNION
    SELECT
        wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i_product_name,
        total_wr_amount AS total_amount,
        wr_cnt AS cnt,
        rn
    FROM web_return_agg
),
inventory_promo_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT inv.inv_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM inventory_sampled inv
    JOIN date_filtered d
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON p.p_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
       AND p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
),
no_web_return_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM item_filtered i
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr
        WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    )
),
intersect_items AS (
    SELECT item_sk FROM union_agg
    INTERSECT
    SELECT item_sk FROM no_web_return_items
)
SELECT
    ua.item_sk,
    ua.i_product_name,
    ua.total_amount,
    ua.cnt,
    ua.rn,
    CASE WHEN ipi.item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_inventory_promo
FROM union_agg ua
JOIN intersect_items ii
    ON ua.item_sk = ii.item_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory_promo_items ipi
    ON ua.item_sk = ipi.item_sk
LIMIT 100

WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM date_dim d
    INNER JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim t
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound > 50000
      AND hd.hd_dep_count >= 3
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1940 AND 1980
      AND sr.sr_net_loss > 0
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_site ws2
          WHERE ws2.web_state = ws.web_state
            AND ws2.web_tax_percentage < 5
      )
    GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 1000
)
SELECT
    s_store_name,
    CONCAT(ib_lower_bound, '-', ib_upper_bound) AS income_band_range,
    total_net_loss,
    distinct_customers,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound) AS total_loss_by_income_band,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.c_customer_sk) FROM customer c2) AS total_customers
FROM agg
WHERE s_store_sk IN (
    SELECT s_store_sk FROM store WHERE s_state = 'CA'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT sr_store_sk FROM store_returns WHERE sr_return_quantity > 10
)
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        cc.cc_name,
        wsite.web_state,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS sum_cs_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS sum_ss_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS sum_ws_net_paid,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS sum_cr_return_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS sum_sr_return_amt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS cnt_orders
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON wsite.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_month_seq = 200107
      AND t.t_hour = 12
      AND sm.sm_carrier = 'USPS'
      AND cc.cc_class = 'Retail'
      AND wsite.web_state = 'CA'
      AND cs.cs_sales_price > 100.00
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2
            WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
              AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 50.00
        )
    GROUP BY
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        cc.cc_name,
        wsite.web_state,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk
    HAVING (SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) + SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) + SUM(ws.ws_net_paid)) > 100000
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    sm_carrier,
    cc_name,
    web_state,
    cd_gender,
    hd_income_band_sk,
    sum_cs_net_paid,
    sum_ss_net_paid,
    sum_ws_net_paid,
    sum_cr_return_amount,
    sum_sr_return_amt,
    cnt_orders,
    CASE WHEN (sum_cs_net_paid + sum_ss_net_paid + sum_ws_net_paid) > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,
    SUM(sum_cs_net_paid + sum_ss_net_paid + sum_ws_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year) AS yearly_total_net_paid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (sum_cs_net_paid + sum_ss_net_paid + sum_ws_net_paid) DESC) AS rank_by_total_net
FROM base
ORDER BY profit_category DESC, yearly_total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH store_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
    ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
    ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
    ss.ss_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales_total,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS store_txn_count
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
    AND i.i_current_price > 50
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
    AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 0
  GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk
),

web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
    ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
    ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
    ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales_total,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS web_txn_count
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
    AND i.i_current_price > 50
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
    AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 0
  GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk
),

store_ret_agg AS (
  SELECT
    sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
    sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS store_return_total,
    SUM(sr.sr_fee) AS store_return_fee
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
    AND i.i_current_price > 50
  GROUP BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_item_sk
),

web_ret_agg AS (
  SELECT
    wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
    wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_total,
    SUM(wr.wr_fee) AS web_return_fee
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
    AND i.i_current_price > 50
  GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_item_sk
)

SELECT
  d.d_year,
  d.d_month_seq,
  i.i_category,
  cd.cd_gender,
  SUM(sa.store_sales_total) AS total_store_sales,
  SUM(wa.web_sales_total) AS total_web_sales,
  SUM(sr.store_return_total) AS total_store_returns,
  SUM(wr.web_return_total) AS total_web_returns,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.customer_sk) AS distinct_store_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wa.customer_sk) AS distinct_web_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_credit_rating = 'A' THEN sa.store_sales_total + wa.web_sales_total ELSE 0 END) AS premium_customer_sales,
  SUM(sa.store_sales_total + wa.web_sales_total) OVER (
    PARTITION BY d.d_year
    ORDER BY d.d_month_seq
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_yearly_sales
FROM store_agg sa
JOIN web_agg wa
  ON sa.date_sk = wa.date_sk
  AND sa.item_sk = wa.item_sk
  AND sa.customer_sk = wa.customer_sk
  AND sa.cdemo_sk = wa.cdemo_sk
JOIN store_ret_agg sr
  ON sr.date_sk = sa.date_sk
  AND sr.item_sk = sa.item_sk
JOIN web_ret_agg wr
  ON wr.date_sk = wa.date_sk
  AND wr.item_sk = wa.item_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON sa.date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON sa.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sa.cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_page wp
    JOIN web_sales ws ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk = sa.date_sk
      AND ws.ws_item_s

/*
Goal: Rank items by their combined net paid sales across store, catalog, and web channels, filter for a specific manufacturer and positive inventory, include return counts, and restrict to high‑selling items.
*/
WITH item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_manufact,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0)) AS store_sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0)) AS catalog_sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS web_sales,
        MAX(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_qty_on_hand
    FROM
        item i
        LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        LEFT JOIN customer c_ss ON c_ss.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
        LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_ss ON hd_ss.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
        LEFT JOIN customer c_cs ON c_cs.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
        LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_cs ON hd_cs.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
        LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
        LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
        LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_cs ON sm_cs.sm_ship_mode_sk = cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
        LEFT JOIN customer c_ws ON c_ws.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
        LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_ws ON hd_ws.hd_demo_sk = ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk
        LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk = ws.ws_ship_mode_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    WHERE
        i.i_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
        AND i.i_manufact = 'anti'
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM call_center cc2
            WHERE cc2.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
              AND cc2.cc_company_name = 'pri'
        )
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_manufact
    HAVING
        (SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0)) +
         SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0)) +
         SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0))) > 1000
)
SELECT
    i_sales.i_item_id,
    i_sales.i_manufact,
    i_sales.store_sales,
    i_sales.catalog_sales,
    i_sales.web_sales,
    i_sales.max_qty_on_hand,
    (i_sales.store_sales + i_sales.catalog_sales + i_sales.web_sales) AS total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (i_sales.store_sales + i_sales.catalog_sales + i_sales.web_sales) DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
          AND sr2.sr_return_quantity > 0
    ) AS store_return_count,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
          AND wr2.wr_return_quantity > 0
    ) AS web_return_count
FROM item_sales i_sales
ORDER BY total_sales DESC, i_sales.i_item_id ASC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH address_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ca_address_sk,
        ca_city,
        ca_state,
        ARRAY[ca_city, ca_state] AS city_state_arr
    FROM customer_address
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        sm_store.sm_type AS sm_type,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        cc.cc_country,
        wp.wp_char_count,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS store_net_profit,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS web_net_profit,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS return_net_loss,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ca_arr.city_state_arr
    FROM date_dim d
    -- store_sales branch
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN address_cte ca_arr
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_arr.ca_address_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_store
        ON ss.ss_ship_mode_sk = sm_store.sm_ship_mode_sk
    -- web_sales branch
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td_ws.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_bill
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ws_bill
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_ws_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ws
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    -- catalog_returns branch
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td_cr.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_cr_refund
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_refund.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_cr_refund
        ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_cr_refund.ca_address_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_cr
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
    -- optional left join to inventory (outer join requirement)
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2001
      AND cc.cc_country = 'USA'
      AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%Damaged%'
      AND wp.wp_char_count > 1000
      AND sm_store.sm_type = 'AIR'
)
SELECT
    j.d_year,
    j.sm_type,
    j.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(j.store_net_profit) AS total_store_profit,
    SUM(j.web_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
    SUM(j.return_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(COALESCE(j.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0)) AS total_inventory_qty,
    (SUM(j.store_net_profit) + SUM(j.web_net_profit) - SUM(j.return_net_loss)) AS net_profit,
    (
        SELECT AVG(sub.net_profit)
        FROM (
            SELECT
                sm2.sm_type,
                SUM(ss2.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws2.ws_net_profit) - SUM(cr2.cr_net_loss) AS net_profit
            FROM date_dim d2
            JOIN store_sales ss2 ON ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            JOIN web_sales ws2 ON ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            JOIN catalog_returns cr2 ON cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            JOIN ship_mode sm2 ON ss2.ss_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
            WHERE d2.d_year = j.d_year
            GROUP BY sm2.sm_type
        ) sub
    ) AS avg_year_profit,
    city_state_elem
FROM joined j
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(j.city_state_arr) AS t (city_state_elem)
GROUP BY j.d_year, j.sm_type, j.r_reason_desc, city_state_elem
HAVING SUM(j.store_net_profit) > 10000
ORDER BY net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_seq AS (
    SELECT 1000 AS t_time_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t_time_sk + 1 FROM time_seq WHERE t_time_sk < 1010
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        cp.cp_department AS department,
        cc.cc_state AS call_center_state,
        w.w_state AS warehouse_state,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
        NULL AS return_loss,
        NULL AS ship_cost
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_seq ts ON t.t_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND cp.cp_department = 'Books'
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    GROUP BY
        GROUPING SETS (
            (cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cp.cp_department, cc.cc_state, w.w_state, p.p_promo_name),
            (cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cp.cp_department, p.p_promo_name),
            (cs.cs_sold_date_sk, p.p_promo_name),
            (cs.cs_sold_date_sk)
        )
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 5000
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        NULL AS department,
        NULL AS call_center_state,
        NULL AS warehouse_state,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS return_loss,
        NULL AS ship_cost
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN time_seq ts ON t.t_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 10 AND 18
        AND ss.ss_quantity > 0
        AND ss.ss_sales_price > 0
    GROUP BY
        ROLLUP (ss.ss_sold_date_sk, p.p_promo_name)
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 5000
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        NULL AS department,
        NULL AS call_center_state,
        w.w_state AS warehouse_state,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
        NULL AS return_loss,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS ship_cost
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN time_seq ts ON t.t_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND ws.ws_ext_ship_cost > 0
        AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 20
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    GROUP BY
        CUBE (ws.ws_sold_date_sk, p.p_promo_name)
    HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 5000
)
SELECT
    combined.sold_date_s

SELECT
    s.s_state,
    s.s_store_id,
    MIN(s.s_store_name) AS store_name,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_return_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_sales_txns,
    AVG(p.p_cost) AS avg_promo_cost,
    MIN(ss.ss_sales_price) AS min_sales_price,
    MAX(ss.ss_sales_price) AS max_sales_price,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_state) AS total_state_sales,
    MIN(lr.return_cnt) AS store_return_count
FROM
    store_sales ss
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
           AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
           AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
           AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
           AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
           AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
           AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
           AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
           AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
           AND ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
           AND ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
           AND ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
           AND cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
           AND cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    ) AS lr
WHERE
    s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
    AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
    AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 10001
    AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
    AND cr.cr_refunded_cash > 1000
    AND ws.ws_quantity > 3
    AND ss.ss_quantity > 2
GROUP BY
    ROLLUP (s.s_state, s.s_store_id, hd.hd_buy_potential)
HAVING
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 10000
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) >= 5
ORDER BY
    total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
      AND d_month_seq = (
          SELECT MIN(d_month_seq)
          FROM date_dim
          WHERE d_year = 1999
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dh.d_date_sk + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d.d_year = 1999
),
common_orders AS (
    SELECT cs_order_number AS order_number FROM catalog_sales
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws_order_number AS order_number FROM web_sales
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    c.c_customer_id,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    p.p_promo_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END AS sales_tier
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk AND i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
                     AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
                     AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN promotion p2 ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                    AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN web_page wp2 ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp2.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sr_returned ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr_returned.d_date_sk
JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN common_orders co ON cs.cs_order_number = co.order_number
WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_hierarchy)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr_excl
      WHERE wr_excl.wr_refunded_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
  )
GROUP BY d_sold.d_year, c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_gender, hd.hd_income_band_sk, p.p_promo_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_class_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_quantity,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_quantity,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS catalog_return_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS web_return_loss,
        AVG(p.p_cost) AS avg_promo_cost,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_demo_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM item i
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cs ON t_cs.t_time_sk = cs.cs_sold_time_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ss ON t_ss.t_time_sk = ss.ss_sold_time_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws ON t_ws.t_time_sk = ws.ws_sold_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE i.i_class_id IN (8, 9)
      AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 5000
      AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND t_cs.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM income_band ib
          WHERE ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
            AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
      )
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_class_id
)
SELECT
    isum.i_category,
    AVG(isum.catalog_net_profit + isum.store_net_profit + isum.web_net_profit - (isum.catalog_return_loss + isum.web_return_loss)) AS avg_total_net_profit,
    SUM(isum.catalog_quantity + isum.store_quantity + isum.web_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT isum.i_item_id) AS distinct_items,
    AVG(isum.avg_promo_cost) AS avg_item_promo_cost,
    SUM(isum.distinct_customers) AS total_distinct_customers
FROM item_sales isum
GROUP BY isum.i_category
HAVING AVG(isum.catalog_net_profit + isum.store_net_profit + isum.web_net_profit - (isum.catalog_return_loss + isum.web_return_loss)) > 1000
ORDER BY avg_total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE time_series AS (
    SELECT t_time_sk, t_time, t_meal_time, t_shift
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_time = 9
    UNION ALL
    SELECT td.t_time_sk, td.t_time, td.t_meal_time, td.t_shift
    FROM time_dim td
    JOIN time_series ts ON td.t_time = ts.t_time + 1
    WHERE td.t_time <= 11
),
base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sm.sm_type AS sm_type,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        sm.sm_code
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    FULL OUTER JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_state,
    ts.t_meal_time,
    SUM(bs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(bs.cs_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
    COUNT(*) AS record_cnt,
    MIN(bs.cs_quantity) AS min_quantity,
    MAX(bs.cs_quantity) AS max_quantity,
    (SELECT MAX(p2.p_cost) FROM promotion p2) AS max_promo_cost_global
FROM base_sales bs
LEFT JOIN time_series ts ON bs.cs_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON bs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON bs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_cs ON bs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_cs.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON hd_cs.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_cs ON bs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_cs.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = bs.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN call_center cc_cr ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_cr.cc_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_cr_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_ref.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_cr_ret ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_ret.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_cr_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_cr_ref.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_cr_ret ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_cr_ret.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p_ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
WHERE
    ts.t_meal_time = 'lunch'
    AND ts.t_shift = 'first'
    AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND r_cr.r_reason_desc = 'Package was damaged'
    AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM store_returns sr2 WHERE sr2.sr_ticket_number = bs.cs_order_number
    )
GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
        (cc.cc_state, ts.t_meal_time),
        (cc.cc_state),
        (ts.t_meal_time),
        ()
    )
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT sr_store_sk,
       COUNT(*) AS returns_count,
       SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       MAX(sr_return_date_sk) AS last_return_date_sk
FROM tpcds.store_returns
WHERE sr_return_ship_cost > 1000
  AND sr_reversed_charge > 500
GROUP BY sr_store_sk
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
  Goal: Identify high‑selling "Deluxe" or "Premium" items purchased by customers with an "@example.com" email address, showing their sales performance, discount category, overall average net profit, and the richness of their product description (distinct word count). The query uses regexp_like, LIKE, string concatenation, a CASE expression, a scalar subquery, a HAVING filter, ordering, a LIMIT, and expands a derived array via UNNEST.
*/
WITH item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_color,
        i.i_size,
        i.i_brand,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity)                             AS total_qty,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)                           AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt)                     AS total_discount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '(?i)deluxe|premium')
      AND c.c_email_address LIKE '%@example.com'
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_color,
        i.i_size,
        i.i_brand
)
SELECT
    isales.i_item_id,
    isales.i_product_name,
    isales.i_brand,
    concat(isales.i_color, '-', isales.i_size)        AS color_size,
    isales.total_qty,
    isales.total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN isales.total_discount / nullif(isales.total_qty, 0) > 50 THEN 'High Discount'
        ELSE 'Low Discount'
    END                                            AS discount_category,
    (SELECT avg(ss2.ss_net_profit) FROM store_sales ss2) AS overall_avg_net_profit,
    wc.word_cnt
FROM item_sales isales
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(DISTINCT word) AS word_cnt
    FROM UNNEST(split(isales.i_item_desc, ' ')) AS t(word)
) wc ON TRUE
HAVING isales.total_net_profit > 0
   AND wc.word_cnt > 3
ORDER BY isales.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE
  income_chain (ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound) AS (
    SELECT ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound
    FROM income_band
    WHERE ib_income_band_sk = (SELECT MIN(ib_income_band_sk) FROM income_band)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM income_band ib
    JOIN income_chain ic ON ib.ib_income_band_sk = ic.ib_income_band_sk + 1
  ),
  distinct_households AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hd_demo_sk, hd_income_band_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_vehicle_count >= 2
  )
SELECT
  ic.ib_income_band_sk,
  ic.ib_lower_bound,
  ic.ib_upper_bound,
  'catalog' AS sales_channel,
  SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
  AVG(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship) AS avg_net_paid,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws_inner.ws_bill_customer_sk)
    FROM web_sales ws_inner
    JOIN household_demographics hd_inner ON ws_inner.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_inner.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE hd_inner.hd_income_band_sk = ic.ib_income_band_sk
      AND ws_inner.ws_net_paid > 500
  ) AS web_customer_cnt_high_net
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN distinct_households dh ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = dh.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_chain ic ON dh.hd_income_band_sk = ic.ib_income_band_sk
WHERE cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship > 1000
  AND cs.cs_ship_date_sk BETWEEN 2450826 AND 2450883
GROUP BY ic.ib_income_band_sk, ic.ib_lower_bound, ic.ib_upper_bound

UNION

SELECT
  ic.ib_income_band_sk,
  ic.ib_lower_bound,
  ic.ib_upper_bound,
  'web' AS sales_channel,
  SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
  AVG(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship) AS avg_net_paid,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws_inner2.ws_bill_customer_sk)
    FROM web_sales ws_inner2
    JOIN household_demographics hd_inner2 ON ws_inner2.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_inner2.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE hd_inner2.hd_income_band_sk = ic.ib_income_band_sk
      AND ws_inner2.ws_net_paid > 500
  ) AS web_customer_cnt_high_net
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN distinct_households dh ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = dh.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_chain ic ON dh.hd_income_band_sk = ic.ib_income_band_sk
WHERE ws.ws_net_paid > 1000
  AND ws.ws_ship_date_sk BETWEEN 2450826 AND 2450883
GROUP BY ic.ib_income_band_sk, ic.ib_lower_bound, ic.ib_upper_bound

ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_fy_year = 1905
),
returned_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
),
items_sold_not_returned AS (
    SELECT item_sk FROM sales_items
    EXCEPT
    SELECT item_sk FROM returned_items
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i.*
    FROM items_sold_not_returned isnr
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = isnr.item_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '[0-9]{3}')
      AND i.i_product_name LIKE 'S%'
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    derived.item_code_color,
    derived.extracted_code,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    (SELECT max(d2.d_date)
     FROM catalog_sales cs2
     JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
     WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS latest_sale_date
FROM filtered_items i
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        concat(i.i_item_id, '-', i.i_color) AS item_code_color,
        regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '(\\d{3})') AS extracted_code
) AS derived
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    derived.item_code_color,
    derived.extracted_code,
    p.p_promo_name
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT nd.d_date_sk, nd.d_date
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim nd ON nd.d_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE nd.d_date <= DATE '1998-12-31'
),
promo_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_product_name,
        p.p_promo_name,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        s.s_state,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_date,
        CASE
            WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 0 THEN 'POSITIVE'
            WHEN ss.ss_net_profit < 0 THEN 'NEGATIVE'
            ELSE 'ZERO'
        END AS profit_flag
    FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '(?i)discount')
      AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%BLACK%'
),
base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ps.d_year,
        ps.s_store_id,
        ps.s_store_name,
        ps.i_category,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        SUM(ps.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(ps.ss_net_profit) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS avg_profit,
        CONCAT(ps.s_store_name, ' - ', ps.i_category) AS store_category_label
    FROM promo_sales ps
    JOIN date_series ds ON ps.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (ps.d_year, ps.s_store_id, ps.s_store_name, ps.i_category),
        (ps.d_year, ps.s_store_id, ps.s_store_name),
        (ps.d_year)
    )
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_profit) AS overall_avg_profit
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 1998
        GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk
    ) t
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        b.*, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.s_store_id ORDER BY b.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        o.overall_avg_profit
    FROM base_agg b
    LEFT JOIN overall_avg o ON true
    WHERE b.order_count > 10
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    s_store_id,
    s_store_name,
    i_category,
    order_count,
    total_profit,
    avg_profit,
    profit_rank,
    overall_avg_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN total_profit > overall_avg_profit THEN 'ABOVE_AVG'
        WHEN total_profit < overall_avg_profit THEN 'BELOW_AVG'
        ELSE 'EQUAL_AVG'
    END AS profit_comparison,
    store_category_label
FROM ranked
ORDER BY d_year DESC, total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk,
           d.d_date,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk,
           d_next.d_date,
           ds.lvl + 1
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d_next ON d_next.d_date = DATE_ADD('day', 1, ds.d_date)
    WHERE ds.lvl < 30
),
manager_parts AS (
    SELECT ws.web_site_sk,
           ws.web_market_manager,
           split(ws.web_market_manager, ' ') AS name_parts,
           ws.web_open_date_sk
    FROM web_site ws
    WHERE ws.web_market_manager IS NOT NULL
),
manager_words AS (
    SELECT mp.web_site_sk,
           mp.web_market_manager,
           mp.web_open_date_sk,
           name_part
    FROM manager_parts mp
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(mp.name_parts) AS t(name_part)
)
SELECT
    sm.sm_contract,
    MAX(regexp_extract(sm.sm_contract, '(\\d+)$', 1)) AS contract_digits,
    mp.name_part AS manager_word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS catalog_orders,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_net_loss,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_web_net_loss,
    AVG(cd.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate,
    (SELECT MAX(d_date) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS max_2001_date
FROM date_series ds
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN time_dim td
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN manager_words mp
    ON mp.web_open_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
WHERE
    regexp_like(sm.sm_contract, '^A.*')
    AND sm.sm_code LIKE 'A%'
    AND td.t_am_pm = 'AM'
    AND td.t_shift LIKE 'M%'
    AND mp.name_part LIKE 'J%'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inventory i
        WHERE i.inv_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
          AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    )
GROUP BY
    sm.sm_contract,
    mp.name_part
ORDER BY
    total_catalog_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH inv_agg AS (
    SELECT inv_warehouse_sk,
           SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42)
    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand >= 500
    GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT cs_warehouse_sk,
           cs_promo_sk,
           cs_item_sk,
           cs_order_number,
           SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price,
           AVG(cs_ext_tax) AS avg_tax,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_list_price > 100
      AND cs_ext_tax < 30
      AND cs_net_paid_inc_ship > 1000
    GROUP BY cs_warehouse_sk, cs_promo_sk, cs_item_sk, cs_order_number
)
SELECT
    w.w_city,
    w.w_state,
    p.p_promo_name,
    inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand,
    SUM(sales_agg.sum_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(sales_agg.avg_tax) AS avg_tax,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sales_agg.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    MIN(cr.cr_store_credit) AS min_store_credit,
    MAX(p.p_cost) AS max_promo_cost
FROM sales_agg
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = sales_agg.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = sales_agg.cs_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = sales_agg.cs_warehouse_sk
JOIN inv_agg
    ON inv_agg.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_promo_sk = sales_agg.cs_promo_sk
WHERE w.w_city IN ('Riverside', 'Pleasant Hill')
  AND w.w_state = 'CA'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
