  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
          AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 0
  )
GROUP BY w.w_city, w.w_state, p.p_promo_name, inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand

UNION

SELECT
    w.w_city,
    w.w_state,
    p.p_promo_name,
    inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand,
    SUM(sales_agg.sum_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(sales_agg.avg_tax) AS avg_tax,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sales_agg.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    MIN(cr.cr_store_credit) AS min_store_credit,
    MAX(p.p_cost) AS max_promo_cost
FROM sales_agg
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = sales_agg.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = sales_agg.cs_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = sales_agg.cs_warehouse_sk
JOIN inv_agg
    ON inv_agg.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_promo_sk = sales_agg.cs_promo_sk
WHERE w.w_city IN ('Fairview', 'Oak Grove')
  AND w.w_state = 'NV'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
          AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 0
  )
GROUP BY w.w_city, w.w_state, p.p_promo_name, inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH page_store_start AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_division_id AS division_id,
        s.s_division_name AS division_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN cp.cp_type = 'monthly' THEN 'M' 
            WHEN cp.cp_type = 'quarterly' THEN 'Q' 
            ELSE 'O' 
        END AS type_group,
        COUNT(cp.cp_catalog_page_sk) AS page_cnt,
        SUM(s.s_floor_space) AS total_floor_space,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM store s2
            WHERE s2.s_division_id = s.s_division_id
              AND s2.s_closed_date_sk IS NOT NULL
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM date_dim d2
                  WHERE d2.d_date_sk = s2.s_closed_date_sk
                    AND d2.d_current_month = 'Y'
              )
        ) AS closed_store_count_current_month
    FROM store s
    JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_current_month = 'Y'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_page cp2
          WHERE cp2.cp_catalog_number = cp.cp_catalog_number
            AND cp2.cp_type = cp.cp_type
      )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (
        s.s_division_id,
        s.s_division_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN cp.cp_type = 'monthly' THEN 'M' 
            WHEN cp.cp_type = 'quarterly' THEN 'Q' 
            ELSE 'O' 
        END
    )
),
page_store_end AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_division_id AS division_id,
        s.s_division_name AS division_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN cp.cp_type = 'monthly' THEN 'M' 
            WHEN cp.cp_type = 'quarterly' THEN 'Q' 
            ELSE 'O' 
        END AS type_group,
        COUNT(cp.cp_catalog_page_sk) AS page_cnt,
        SUM(s.s_floor_space) AS total_floor_space,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM store s2
            WHERE s2.s_division_id = s.s_division_id
              AND s2.s_closed_date_sk IS NOT NULL
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM date_dim d2
                  WHERE d2.d_date_sk = s2.s_closed_date_sk
                    AND d2.d_current_month = 'Y'
              )
        ) AS closed_store_count_current_month
    FROM store s
    JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_current_month = 'Y'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_page cp2
          WHERE cp2.cp_catalog_number = cp.cp_catalog_number
            AND cp2.cp_type = cp.cp_type
            AND cp2.cp_end_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
      )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (
        s.s_division_id,
        s.s_division_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN cp.cp_type = 'monthly' THEN 'M' 
            WHEN cp.cp_type = 'quarterly' THEN 'Q' 
            ELSE 'O' 
        END
    )
)
SELECT
    division_id,
    division_name,
    type_group,
    page_cnt,
    total_floor_space,
    closed_store_count_current_month
FROM page_store_start
UNION ALL
SELECT
    division_id,
    division_name,
    type_group,
    page_cnt,
    total_floor_space,
    closed_store_count_current_month
FROM page_store_end
ORDER BY division_id, type_group
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_quarter_name = '1902Q4'
      AND regexp_like(d.d_quarter_name, '^1902Q[1-4]$')
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_city,
    concat(s.s_city, ', ', s.s_state) AS city_state,
    sum(fs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_net_sales,
    regexp_extract(s.s_store_name, '(.*) Store', 1) AS base_store_name,
    substring(s.s_zip, 1, 5) AS zip_prefix,
    (
        SELECT avg(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_date_sk = s.s_closed_date_sk
    ) AS avg_inventory_qty_at_close,
    (
        SELECT sum(DISTINCT inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_date_sk = s.s_closed_date_sk
    ) AS sum_distinct_inventory_qty_at_close
FROM filtered_sales fs
JOIN date_dim d ON fs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON fs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE regexp_like(s.s_city, '.*(ville|town)$')
  AND sm.sm_carrier LIKE 'U%'
  AND sm.sm_type IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT sm2.sm_type
        FROM ship_mode sm2
        WHERE sm2.sm_carrier LIKE 'U%'
    )
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip,
    s.s_closed_date_sk,
    concat(s.s_city, ', ', s.s_state),
    regexp_extract(s.s_store_name, '(.*) Store', 1),
    substring(s.s_zip, 1, 5)
ORDER BY total_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_series AS (
    SELECT MIN(t_time_sk) AS t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t_time_sk + 1
    FROM time_series
    WHERE t_time_sk < (SELECT MAX(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim)
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ts.t_time_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS store_customer_cnt
    FROM time_series ts
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE c.c_last_name IS NOT NULL
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(c.c_last_name, '^[A-M]')
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound > 50000
    GROUP BY ts.t_time_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ts.t_time_sk,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(wsite.web_name, '^([A-Za-z]+)') AS site_prefix,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS web_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS web_customer_cnt,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk)
         FROM web_sales ws2
         WHERE ws2.ws_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk) AS distinct_web_customers
    FROM time_series ts
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site wsite
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c2
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c2.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd2
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib2
        ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE wsite.web_county LIKE '%County'
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(wsite.web_name, '^[A-Z]')
      AND ib2.ib_upper_bound > 50000
    GROUP BY ts.t_time_sk, site_prefix
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(s.t_time_sk, w.t_time_sk) AS time_sk,
    CONCAT('T', CAST(COALESCE(s.t_time_sk, w.t_time_sk) AS varchar)) AS time_label,
    COALESCE(s.store_net_paid, 0) AS store_net_paid,
    COALESCE(w.web_net_paid, 0) AS web_net_paid,
    COALESCE(s.store_customer_cnt, 0) AS store_customer_cnt,
    COALESCE(w.web_customer_cnt, 0) AS web_customer_cnt,
    w.site_prefix,
    w.distinct_web_customers
FROM store_agg s
FULL OUTER JOIN web_agg w
    ON s.t_time_sk = w.t_time_sk
ORDER BY time_sk
LIMIT 100

WITH store_fact AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        dd.d_date,
        dd.d_year,
        dd.d_month_seq,
        ti.t_hour,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_current_price,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit
    FROM
        store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) ss
        JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        JOIN time_dim ti ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = ti.t_time_sk
        JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE
        dd.d_year = 2001
        AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND ti.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
),
web_fact AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        dd.d_date,
        dd.d_year,
        dd.d_month_seq,
        ti.t_hour,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_current_price,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        wp.wp_type,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk
    FROM
        web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        JOIN time_dim ti ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = ti.t_time_sk
        JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    WHERE
        dd.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
        AND i.i_current_price > 100.00
        AND sm.sm_carrier = 'UPS'
        AND wp.wp_type = 'Home'
        AND wsite.web_mkt_class LIKE '%Labour%'
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'N'
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(sf.d_year, wf.d_year) AS year,
    COALESCE(sf.i_category, wf.i_category) AS category,
    COALESCE(sf.s_store_name, wf.wp_type) AS source_desc,
    (COALESCE(sf.ss_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wf.ws_net_profit, 0)) AS total_profit,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(sf.d_year, wf.d_year)
        ORDER BY (COALESCE(sf.ss_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wf.ws_net_profit, 0)) DESC
    ) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(sf.ss_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wf.ws_net_profit, 0)) > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (COALESCE(sf.ss_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wf.ws_net_profit, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category
FROM
    store_fact sf
FULL OUTER JOIN
    web_fact wf
ON
    sf.d_year = wf.d_year
    AND sf.i_category = wf.i_category
ORDER BY
    year,
    profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    d.d_year,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    d.d_date,
    i.i_item_id,
    wr.wr_return_quantity,
    wr.wr_return_amt,
    wr.wr_net_loss
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN date_dim d
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN reason r
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND p.p_end_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002
    AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 120 AND 130
    AND i.i_brand = 'BrandX'
    AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
    AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%size%'
    AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 1
    AND wr.wr_return_amt > 50.00
    AND wr.wr_net_loss > 0
    AND wr.wr_fee < 20.00
    AND wr.wr_refunded_cash BETWEEN 10.00 AND 500.00
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = wr.wr_returned_date_sk
          AND wr2.wr_return_quantity > wr.wr_return_quantity
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    d_date,
    SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
    SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    AVG(wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i_item_id) AS distinct_items,
    MIN(wr_net_loss) AS min_net_loss,
    MAX(wr_net_loss) AS max_net_loss
  FROM base
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand, i_category, d_date
  HAVING SUM(wr_return_amt) > 1000
),
final_main AS (
  SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    d_date,
    total_return_qty,
    total_return_amt,
    avg_return_amt,
    distinct_items,
    min_net_loss,
    max_net_loss,
    SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_sum_return_amt,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM promotion p2
     JOIN item i2 ON p2.p_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
     WHERE i2.i_brand = agg.i_brand) AS brand_promo_count
  FROM aggregated agg
),
final_exclude AS (
  SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    d_date,
    total_return_qty,
    total_return_amt,
    avg_return_amt,
    distinct_items,
    min_net_loss,
    max_net_loss,
    SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_sum_return_amt,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM promotion p2
     JOIN item i2 ON p2.p_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
     WHERE i2.i_brand = agg_excl.i_brand) AS brand_promo_count
  FROM aggregated agg_excl
  WHERE avg_return_amt <= 100
)
SELECT
  d_year,
  i_brand,
  i_category,
  d_date,
  total_return_qty,
  total_return_amt,
  avg_return_amt,
  distinct_items,
  min_net_loss,
  max_net_loss,
  moving_sum_return_amt,
  brand_promo_count
FROM final_main
EXCEPT
SELECT
  d_year,
  i_brand,
  i_category,
  d_date,
  total_return_qty,
  total_return_amt,
  avg_return_amt,
  distinct_items,
  min_net_loss,
  max_net_loss,
  moving_sum_return_amt,
  brand_promo_count
FROM final_exclude
ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 10

WITH catalog_data AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS order_count,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sr2.sr_net_loss), 0)
         FROM store_returns sr2
         WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS total_store_net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(sm.sm_contract, '')) AS u(contract_char)
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND u.contract_char = 'A'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM promotion p
          WHERE p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            AND p.p_end_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
      )
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 1000
       AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sr2.sr_net_loss), 0)
            FROM store_returns sr2
            WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) < 500
),
store_data AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS order_count
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
    HAVING SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 500
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    total_return_amount,
    order_count
FROM catalog_data
EXCEPT
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    total_return_amount,
    order_count
FROM store_data
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_state,
        t.t_hour,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_returns sr
        ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
        FROM income_band ib
        WHERE ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ib
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
      AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND s.s_country = 'United States'
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (s.s_state, t.t_hour)
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 10000
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.s_state, 'All States') AS store_state,
    a.t_hour,
    a.total_net_paid,
    a.total_quantity,
    a.distinct_tickets,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        JOIN store s2 ON sr2.sr_store_sk = s2.s_store_sk
        JOIN time_dim t2 ON sr2.sr_return_time_sk = t2.t_time_sk
        WHERE (a.s_state IS NULL OR s2.s_state = a.s_state)
          AND (a.t_hour IS NULL OR t2.t_hour = a.t_hour)
    ) AS total_returns_by_state_hour
FROM sales_agg a
ORDER BY store_state, a.t_hour

WITH agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        cc.cc_name,
        MIN(p.p_start_date_sk) AS promo_start_date_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_cs_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_cs_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_ss_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_ss_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_ws_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_ws_net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records,
        AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer c_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN tpcds.warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.inventory i ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
                                 AND i.inv_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
       AND ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
       AND ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
       AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 50
      AND d_cs.d_year = 2001
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND ws.ws_sales_price > 100
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, cc.cc_name
)
SELECT
    agg.p_promo_id,
    agg.p_promo_name,
    agg.cc_name,
    agg.total_cs_net_paid,
    agg.total_ss_net_paid,
    agg.total_ws_net_paid,
    (agg.total_cs_net_paid + agg.total_ss_net_paid + agg.total_ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    (agg.total_cs_net_profit + agg.total_ss_net_profit + agg.total_ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    agg.distinct_orders,
    agg.total_return_amount,
    agg.avg_inventory_qty,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM tpcds.promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_start_date_sk = agg.promo_start_date_sk
    ) AS promo_count_same_start,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (agg.total_cs_net_paid + agg.total_ss_net_paid + agg.total_ws_net_paid) DESC) AS rn
FROM agg_sales agg
WHERE agg.total_net_paid > 10000
  AND agg.total_return_amount > 0
  AND agg.avg_inventory_qty IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rn
LIMIT 100

/* Goal: Compute total return quantities and amounts by year and item brand across catalog and web returns, rank brands within each year, and calculate each brand's share of the year's total returns. */
WITH all_joins AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_item_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        r_cr.r_reason_desc AS catalog_reason_desc,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        r_sr.r_reason_desc AS store_reason_desc,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        r_wr.r_reason_desc AS web_reason_desc,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        i_inv.i_brand AS extra_brand
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       AND wr.wr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i_inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i_inv.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_ref.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr_ref.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_ret ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_ret.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr_ret ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_wr_ret.ca_address_sk
),
unioned_returns AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_brand,
        cr_return_quantity AS return_quantity,
        (cr_return_amount + cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS return_amount
    FROM all_joins
    WHERE cr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_brand,
        wr_return_quantity AS return_quantity,
        wr_return_amt_inc_tax AS return_amount
    FROM all_joins
    WHERE wr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_brand,
        SUM(return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
        SUM(return_amount) AS total_return_amount
    FROM unioned_returns
    GROUP BY d_year, i_brand
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand,
    total_return_quantity,
    total_return_amount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS brand_rank,
    total_return_amount / SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year) AS pct_of_year_total
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY d_year, total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_series(t_sk) AS (
    SELECT MIN(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t_sk + 1 FROM time_series
    WHERE t_sk < (SELECT MAX(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim)
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    r_sr.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cr_cc.cr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN cr_cc.cr_return_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_return_qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN sr.sr_return_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_store_return_qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN wr.wr_return_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_web_return_qty
FROM
    web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN time_series ts ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = ts.t_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ts.t_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = ts.t_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = ts.t_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT cr.*, cc.*
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        FULL OUTER JOIN call_center cc
            ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    ) cr_cc ON cr_cc.cr_returned_time_sk = ts.t_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr_cc.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_cr ON cr_cc.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w_cr ON cr_cc.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE
    cc.cc_rec_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2002-12-31'
    AND cc.cc_county = 'Bronx County'
    AND cr_cc.cr_store_credit > 100
    AND c.c_birth_month = 5
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    )
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    r_sr.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY
    total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS promo_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT promo_id + 1 FROM seq WHERE promo_id < 20
),

joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_birth_year,
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk,
        i.i_item_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        td.t_time,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        p.p_promo_id,
        s.s_store_id,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.cs_net_paid DESC) AS rn
    FROM income_band ib
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
),

promo_sales AS (
    SELECT
        jd.p_promo_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT jd.cs_order_number) AS orders,
        SUM(jd.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(jd.ss_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        CASE WHEN SUM(jd.ss_net_paid) > 50000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS sales_category
    FROM joined_data jd
    GROUP BY jd.p_promo_id
    HAVING SUM(jd.ss_net_paid) > 1000
),

promo_all AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.p_promo_id
    FROM promotion p
),

promo_union AS (
    SELECT p_promo_id FROM promo_sales
    UNION
    SELECT p_promo_id FROM promo_all
),

missing_promos AS (
    SELECT promo_id FROM seq
    EXCEPT
    SELECT p_promo_id FROM promo_union
)

SELECT
    jd.rn,
    jd.p_promo_id,
    ps.total_net_paid,
    ps.orders,
    ps.avg_quantity,
    ps.sales_category,
    jd.s_store_id,
    jd.sm_ship_mode_id
FROM joined_data jd
LEFT JOIN promo_sales ps ON ps.p_promo_id = jd.p_promo_id
WHERE jd.c_birth_year = 1975
  AND jd.ib_lower_bound >= 60000
  AND jd.t_time BETWEEN 2 AND 14
ORDER BY jd.rn
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_ext_tax,
        c.c_salutation,
        w.w_state,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        d_sold.d_year,
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
           AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2002
      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
      AND c.c_salutation = 'Mr.'
      AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 100.00
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#24'
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        d_year,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(ws_ext_tax) AS avg_tax,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty
    FROM base_sales
    GROUP BY i_category, d_year
),

high_inventory AS (
    SELECT i_category
    FROM sales_agg
    WHERE total_inventory_qty > 5000
),

low_inventory AS (
    SELECT i_category
    FROM sales_agg
    WHERE total_inventory_qty <= 5000
),

category_flags AS (
    SELECT i_category, 'High' AS inventory_flag FROM high_inventory
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i_category, 'Low' AS inventory_flag FROM low_inventory
)
SELECT
    sa.i_category,
    sa.d_year,
    sa.total_sales,
    sa.total_quantity,
    sa.avg_tax,
    cf.inventory_flag,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = (
            SELECT d_date_sk
            FROM date_dim d2
            WHERE d2.d_year = sa.d_year
        )
    ) AS sales_orders_in_year,
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_page wp2
            JOIN web_sales ws3 ON ws3.ws_web_page_sk = wp2.wp_web_page_sk
            WHERE wp2.wp_type = 'promo'
              AND ws3.ws_sold_date_sk = (
                  SELECT d_date_sk
                  FROM date_dim d3
                  WHERE d3.d_year = sa.d_year
              )
        ) THEN 'No Promo Page'
        ELSE 'Has Promo Page'
    END AS promo_page_flag
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN category_flags cf ON sa.i_category = cf.i_category
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_page wp4
    WHERE wp4.wp_web_page_sk = (
        SELECT ws4.ws_web_page_sk
        FROM web_sales ws4
        WHERE ws4.ws_sold_date_sk = (
            SELECT d_date_sk
            FROM date_dim d4
            WHERE d4.d_year = sa.d_year
        )
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM tpcds.date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2002-12-31'
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        hd.hd_buy_potential AS buy_pot,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS net_sales,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(15,2)) AS net_loss,
        'store' AS source
    FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(d.d_year, hd.hd_buy_potential)
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(d_sales.d_year, d_returns.d_year) AS year,
        'WEB' AS buy_pot,
        SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_ext_sales_price, 0)) AS net_sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS net_loss,
        'web' AS source
    FROM tpcds.web_sales ws
    FULL OUTER JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_sales
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_returns
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_returns.d_date_sk
    WHERE COALESCE(d_sales.d_date, d_returns.d_date) BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2002-12-31'
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(COALESCE(d_sales.d_year, d_returns.d_year))
),
aggregated_data AS (
    SELECT year, buy_pot, net_sales, net_loss, source FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year, buy_pot, net_sales, net_loss, source FROM web_agg
)
SELECT
    ad.year,
    ad.buy_pot,
    ad.source,
    SUM(ad.net_sales) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ad.net_loss) AS total_loss,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ad.net_sales) > SUM(ad.net_loss) THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE 'LOSS' END AS profit_flag,
    (
        SELECT SUM(ad2.net_sales)
        FROM aggregated_data ad2
        WHERE ad2.year = ad.year
    ) AS year_total_sales
FROM aggregated_data ad
GROUP BY ROLLUP(ad.year, ad.buy_pot, ad.source)
ORDER BY ad.year DESC NULLS LAST,
         profit_flag ASC,
         total_sales DESC
OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

WITH RECURSIVE return_bins AS ( SELECT 0 AS bin_lower, 1000 AS bin_upper UNION ALL SELECT bin_upper, bin_upper + 1000 FROM return_bins WHERE bin_upper < 10000 ), aggregated_returns AS ( SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk, wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk, wr.wr_web_page_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns wr WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 0 AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 0 AND wr.wr_fee IS NOT NULL AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk IS NOT NULL AND wr.wr_web_page_sk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk, wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk, wr.wr_web_page_sk ) SELECT d_ret.d_year, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, cd.cd_education_status, wp.wp_type, rb.bin_lower, rb.bin_upper, SUM(ar.total_return_amt) AS bucket_total_return_amt, AVG(ar.total_return_amt) AS bucket_avg_return_amt, COUNT(ar.wr_returned_date_sk) AS bucket_return_rows, CASE WHEN SUM(ar.total_return_amt) >= 5000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ar.total_return_amt) >= 1000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS bucket_return_category, (SELECT MAX(wr_max.wr_return_amt) FROM web_returns wr_max JOIN date_dim d_max ON wr_max.wr_returned_date_sk = d_max.d_date_sk WHERE d_max.d_year = d_ret.d_year) AS max_return_in_year, page_stats.page_return_cnt FROM aggregated_returns ar JOIN return_bins rb ON ar.total_return_amt BETWEEN rb.bin_lower AND rb.bin_upper JOIN date_dim d_ret ON ar.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ar.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ar.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ar.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN date_dim d_page_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_page_creation.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_return_cnt FROM web_returns wr_page WHERE wr_page.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk ) AS page_stats ON TRUE WHERE d_ret.d_year = 2001 AND ca.ca_state = 'TX' AND cd.cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree' AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate > 3000 AND wp.wp_type = 'Content' AND d_ret.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND ca.ca_zip LIKE '75%' GROUP BY d_ret.d_year, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, cd.cd_education_status, wp.wp_type, rb.bin_lower, rb.bin_upper, page_stats.page_return_cnt HAVING SUM(ar.total_return_amt) > 1000 ORDER BY bucket_total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sampled_cr AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM tpcds.catalog_returns
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42)
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_market_manager,
    sm.sm_carrier,
    t_dim.t_meal_time,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_net_loss,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_net_loss,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_net_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_ret.ca_city) AS distinct_return_cities,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cr_inner.cr_net_loss)
        FROM tpcds.catalog_returns cr_inner
    ) AS overall_catalog_net_loss
FROM sampled_cr cr
JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN time_dim t_dim ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_dim.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_dim.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_sr_addr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr_addr.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr_cdemo ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr_cdemo.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_sr_hdemo ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr_hdemo.hd_demo_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_dim.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_wr_addr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr_addr.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_cdemo ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_cdemo.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_hdemo ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_hdemo.hd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE wp.wp_rec_end_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tpcds.store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_return_time_sk = t_dim.t_time_sk
          AND sr2.sr_return_quantity > 0
    )
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_market_manager,
    sm.sm_carrier,
    t_dim.t_meal_time
LIMIT 100

WITH avg_net_loss AS (
    SELECT avg(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
)
SELECT
    final.cc_call_center_id,
    final.cc_name,
    final.total_net_loss,
    final.air_ship_count,
    final.above_avg
FROM (
    (
        SELECT
            cc.cc_call_center_id,
            cc.cc_name,
            SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
            sm_air.air_ship_count,
            CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > (SELECT avg_loss FROM avg_net_loss) THEN true ELSE false END AS above_avg
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        JOIN call_center cc
            ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        JOIN date_dim d
            ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS air_ship_count
            FROM catalog_returns cr2
            JOIN ship_mode sm
                ON cr2.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
            WHERE cr2.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
              AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
        ) AS sm_air
        WHERE d.d_year = 2022
        GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, sm_air.air_ship_count
    )
    UNION
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_name,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        sm_air.air_ship_count,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > (SELECT avg_loss FROM avg_net_loss) THEN true ELSE false END AS above_avg
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS air_ship_count
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        JOIN ship_mode sm
            ON cr2.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        WHERE cr2.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
          AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    ) AS sm_air
    WHERE d.d_year = 2023
    GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, sm_air.air_ship_count
    )
    EXCEPT
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_name,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        sm_air.air_ship_count,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > (SELECT avg_loss FROM avg_net_loss) THEN true ELSE false END AS above_avg
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS air_ship_count
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        JOIN ship_mode sm
            ON cr2.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        WHERE cr2.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
          AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    ) AS sm_air
    WHERE r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%Damaged%'
    GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, sm_air.air_ship_count
) AS final
ORDER BY final.total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_state,
    cc.cc_rec_start_date,
    cp.cp_department,
    p.p_promo_name,
    p.p_discount_active,
    sm.sm_carrier,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_net_paid,
    cs.cs_quantity,
    cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
    cs.cs_item_sk,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    cr.cr_fee,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    wr.wr_return_amt
  FROM call_center cc
  FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  LEFT JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  LEFT JOIN promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer c_bill
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill
    ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer c_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  LEFT JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
   AND inv.inv_date_sk = (
         SELECT max(inv2.inv_date_sk)
         FROM inventory inv2
         WHERE inv2.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
       )
  LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
   AND ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ss
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer c_wp
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c_wp.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wp
    ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wp.ca_address_sk
  WHERE
    (cc.cc_state = 'CA' OR cc.cc_state IS NULL)
    AND (cp.cp_department = 'Electronics' OR cp.cp_department IS NULL)
    AND (cr.cr_fee > 50.00 OR cr.cr_fee IS NULL)
    AND (p.p_discount_active = 'Y' OR p.p_discount_active IS NULL)
    AND (r.r_reason_desc = 'Customer not interested' OR r.r_reason_desc IS NULL)
    AND (sm.sm_carrier = 'UPS' OR sm.sm_carrier IS NULL)
    AND (inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0 OR inv.inv_quantity_on_hand IS NULL)
    AND cc.cc_rec_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inventory inv_exists
        WHERE inv_exists.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
          AND inv_exists.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    )
)
SELECT
  cc_name AS call_center_name,
  cp_department AS department,
  p_promo_name AS promo_name,
  r_reason_desc AS return_reason,
  sm_carrier AS ship_carrier,
  w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
  SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_sales,
  SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
  SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
  SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
  AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS distinct_order_count,
  SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand
FROM base
GROUP BY
  cc_name,
  cp_department,
  p_promo_name,
  r_reason_desc,
  sm_carrier,
  w_warehouse_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_current_price,
        i.i_item_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_discount_amt,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        td.t_hour,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT *
        FROM catalog_page cp
        WHERE cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cr.cr_catalog_page_sk
    ) cp_lateral
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_site wsi ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsi.web_site_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    s_state,
    i_item_id,
    CASE WHEN i_current_price > 100 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Affordable' END AS price_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number) AS num_tickets,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_web_return_loss,
    AVG(ss_net_profit) AS avg_store_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r_reason_desc = 'Package was damaged' THEN cr_return_amount ELSE 0 END) AS damaged_return_amount,
    (SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_ext_discount_amt)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i_item_sk) AS avg_item_discount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_sales ss3
        WHERE ss3.ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
          AND ss3.ss_net_profit > 1000) AS high_profit_txns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT word) AS distinct_reason_words
FROM base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(split(r_reason_desc, ' ')) AS t(word)
WHERE
    t_hour = 12
    AND i_current_price > 50
    AND ib_upper_bound = 120000
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws_order_number
          AND wr2.wr_net_loss > 0
    )
GROUP BY
    s_store_id,
    s_state,
    i_item_id,
    CASE WHEN i_current_price > 100 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Affordable' END
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_wholesale_cost,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 100
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_call_center_id,
    CONCAT(cc.cc_city, ',', cc.cc_state) AS city_state,
    SUBSTRING(cc.cc_name FROM 1 FOR 5) AS short_name,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(cc.cc_zip, '(\\d{3})', 1) AS zip_prefix,
    td.t_meal_time,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_order_cnt,
    SUM(DISTINCT fs.cs_net_profit) AS distinct_net_profit_sum,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cs_inner.cs_wholesale_cost)
        FROM catalog_sales cs_inner
        WHERE cs_inner.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    ) AS avg_wholesale_cost,
    (
        SELECT MAX(cs_inner2.cs_ext_discount_amt)
        FROM catalog_sales cs_inner2
        WHERE cs_inner2.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    ) AS max_discount_amt
FROM filtered_sales fs
JOIN call_center cc
    ON fs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN time_dim td
    ON fs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
WHERE
    REGEXP_LIKE(cc.cc_street_name, 'Hill|Road')
    AND td.t_meal_time IN ('lunch', 'dinner')
    AND cc.cc_zip LIKE '9%'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_sales cs_exist
        WHERE cs_exist.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
          AND cs_exist.cs_ext_discount_amt > 100
    )
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_call_center_id,
    cc.cc_city,
    cc.cc_state,
    td.t_meal_time
ORDER BY distinct_order_cnt DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    cc.cc_division_name,
    w.w_state,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    sm.sm_type,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(l_ret.total_return_amount) AS total_lateral_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_count
FROM catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cs
JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer cust_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = cust_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer cust_ship ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = cust_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN call_center cc_ret ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_ret.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp_ret ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp_ret.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_ret ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_ret.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_ret ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_ret.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer cust_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = cust_refunded.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT SUM(cr2.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount
    FROM catalog_returns cr2
    WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
) AS l_ret ON TRUE
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_returns cr_ex
    JOIN reason r_ex ON cr_ex.cr_reason_sk = r_ex.r_reason_sk
    WHERE cr_ex.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
      AND r_ex.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
)
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (cc.cc_division_name, w.w_state),
    (r.r_reason_desc, sm.sm_type),
    ()
)
LIMIT 100

/* Goal: Calculate net revenue by year, customer gender, household buying potential and ship mode, include subtotal rows with ROLLUP, rank revenues within each year, compare to the average store net paid per year, and demonstrate sampling, aggregation in a CTE, a correlated subquery and window functions. */
WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_ext_sales_price,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS cs_order_count
    FROM catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) REPEATABLE (42) AS cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_ship_date_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
),
ss_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_total_ext_sales_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS ss_total_net_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS ss_order_count
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk, ss.ss_hdemo_sk
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    cd_s.cd_gender,
    hd_s.hd_buy_potential,
    sm.sm_type,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales_ext_sales,
    SUM(ss_agg.ss_total_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales_ext_sales,
    COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_return_amount,
    (SUM(cs_agg.total_net_paid) + SUM(ss_agg.ss_total_net_paid) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0)) AS net_revenue,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY d_sold.d_year
        ORDER BY (SUM(cs_agg.total_net_paid) + SUM(ss_agg.ss_total_net_paid) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0)) DESC
    ) AS revenue_rank,
    (
        SELECT AVG(inner_ss.ss_total_net_paid)
        FROM ss_agg inner_ss
        JOIN date_dim inner_d ON inner_ss.ss_sold_date_sk = inner_d.d_date_sk
        WHERE inner_d.d_year = d_sold.d_year
    ) AS avg_store_net_paid_year
FROM cs_agg
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs_agg.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs_agg.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON d_ship.d_date_sk = wr.wr_returned_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wp_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_ref.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_ref.hd_demo_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs_agg.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN ss_agg ON ss_agg.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_s ON ss_agg.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_s.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_s ON ss_agg.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_s.hd_demo_sk
WHERE
    d_sold.d_year = 2001
    AND cd_s.cd_gender = 'M'
    AND hd_s.hd_vehicle_count >= 0
    AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    AND wp.wp_type = 'HOME'
    AND cs_agg.total_net_paid > 10000
GROUP BY ROLLUP (d_sold.d_year, cd_s.cd_gender, hd_s.hd_buy_potential, sm.sm_type)
ORDER BY d_sold.d_year, revenue_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH store_ret AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_id,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        'Store' AS return_channel,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS sr
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_id, r.r_reason_desc
),
web_ret AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_id,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        'Web' AS return_channel,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM web_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS wr
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_id, r.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT *
FROM store_ret
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM web_ret
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    sampled_returns AS (
        SELECT
            r.r_reason_desc,
            COUNT(*) AS sampled_return_count
        FROM
            catalog_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cr
            JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        GROUP BY
            r.r_reason_desc
    ),
    sales_with_returns AS (
        SELECT
            cc.cc_call_center_id,
            td.t_hour,
            SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
            COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS total_orders,
            r.r_reason_desc,
            'Returned' AS category
        FROM
            catalog_sales cs
            JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
            JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
            JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
            JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        WHERE
            td.t_shift = 'AM'
            AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        GROUP BY
            cc.cc_call_center_id,
            td.t_hour,
            r.r_reason_desc
    ),
    sales_without_returns AS (
        SELECT
            cc.cc_call_center_id,
            td.t_hour,
            SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
            COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS total_orders,
            CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS r_reason_desc,
            'NoReturn' AS category
        FROM
            catalog_sales cs
            JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
            JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        WHERE
            td.t_shift = 'AM'
            AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
            )
        GROUP BY
            cc.cc_call_center_id,
            td.t_hour
    )
SELECT
    combined.cc_call_center_id,
    combined.t_hour,
    combined.total_profit,
    combined.total_orders,
    combined.r_reason_desc,
    combined.category,
    sr.sampled_return_count
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM sales_with_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM sales_without_returns
) AS combined
LEFT JOIN sampled_returns sr ON combined.r_reason_desc = sr.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY combined.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH high_profit_items AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_profit > 1000
),
high_paid_items AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax > 2000
),
intersect_items AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk FROM high_profit_items
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cs_item_sk FROM high_paid_items
),
sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        d.d_year,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
        i.i_manufact_id,
        i.i_manager_id
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND i.i_wholesale_cost > 10
      AND cs.cs_item_sk IN (SELECT cs_item_sk FROM intersect_items)
)
SELECT
    group_type,
    group_id,
    d_year,
    profit_category,
    sum_profit,
    sum_paid
FROM (
    SELECT
        'Manufacturer' AS group_type,
        i_manufact_id AS group_id,
        d_year,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs_net_profit) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS sum_profit,
        SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS sum_paid
    FROM sales_base
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_manufact_id, d_year)

    UNION DISTINCT

    SELECT
        'Manager' AS group_type,
        i_manager_id AS group_id,
        d_year,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs_net_profit) > 500 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS sum_profit,
        SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS sum_paid
    FROM sales_base
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_manager_id, d_year)
) AS combined
ORDER BY
    group_type,
    group_id,
    d_year,
    profit_category
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_keys AS (
    SELECT MIN(cs_sold_date_sk) AS date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_keys
    WHERE date_sk < (SELECT MAX(cs_sold_date_sk) FROM catalog_sales)
),
customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        w.w_state,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_keys dk ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dk.date_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_profit > 0
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, w.w_state
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > (
        SELECT AVG(net_profit)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(cs3.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit
            FROM catalog_sales cs3
            JOIN date_keys dk3 ON cs3.cs_sold_date_sk = dk3.date_sk
            GROUP BY cs3.cs_bill_customer_sk
        ) avg_sub
    )
)
SELECT final.c_customer_id,
       final.total_profit,
       final.w_state
FROM (
    SELECT cs.c_customer_id,
           cs.total_profit,
           cs.w_state,
           cs.c_customer_sk
    FROM customer_sales cs
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_returns sr
        WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.c_customer_sk
    )
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cs.c_customer_id,
           cs.total_profit,
           cs.w_state,
           cs.c_customer_sk
    FROM customer_sales cs
    WHERE cs.w_state = 'NY'
) final
ORDER BY final.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d_next.d_date_sk,
        d_next.d_date,
        dh.level + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d_next
        ON d_next.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-31'
)

SELECT
    d.d_date AS return_date,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    cr.cr_return_quantity,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    w.w_state,
    ca_refund.ca_city AS refunded_city,
    ca_return.ca_city AS returning_city,
    hd_refund.hd_income_band_sk AS refunded_income_band,
    hd_return.hd_income_band_sk AS returning_income_band,
    inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) OVER (
        PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk
        ORDER BY d.d_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_return_amount,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY d.d_year
        ORDER BY cr.cr_return_amount DESC
    ) AS return_amount_rank,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
          AND cr2.cr_returned_date_sk IN (
              SELECT dh2.d_date_sk
              FROM date_hierarchy dh2
              WHERE dh2.level <= 7
          )
    ) AS avg_return_amount_7days
FROM
    catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_refund
        ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refund.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_return
        ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_refund
        ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refund.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_return
        ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_return.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE
    d.d_year = 2001
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND hd_refund.hd_income_band_sk >= 15
    AND s.s_store_sk = 10
    AND d.d_date IN (SELECT d_h.d_date FROM date_hierarchy d_h)
ORDER BY
    cumulative_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    items_with_words AS (
        SELECT
            i_item_sk,
            i_item_id,
            i_item_desc,
            i_brand,
            i_category,
            i_product_name,
            split(i_item_desc, ' ') AS words
        FROM item
    ),
    exploded_words AS (
        SELECT
            i_item_sk,
            word
        FROM items_with_words
        CROSS JOIN UNNEST(words) AS t(word)
        WHERE regexp_like(word, '(?i)station|industrial|manufact|gate')
    ),
    store_return_items AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2000
    ),
    promoted_items AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT p.p_item_sk AS item_sk
        FROM promotion p
        JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk
        JOIN date_dim d_end   ON p.p_end_date_sk   = d_end.d_date_sk
        WHERE d_start.d_year = 2000 OR d_end.d_year = 2000
    ),
    intersect_items AS (
        SELECT item_sk FROM store_return_items
        INTERSECT
        SELECT item_sk FROM promoted_items
    ),
    final_agg AS (
        SELECT
            i.i_item_sk,
            i.i_item_id,
            SUBSTR(i.i_item_id, 1, 5) AS item_prefix,
            i.i_product_name,
            i.i_brand,
            i.i_category,
            CONCAT(i.i_brand, ' - ', i.i_category) AS brand_category,
            SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
            COUNT(*) AS return_count,
            MIN(d.d_date) AS first_return_date,
            MAX(d.d_date) AS last_return_date
        FROM intersect_items ii
        JOIN item i ON ii.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN store_returns sr ON i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN exploded_words ew ON i.i_item_sk = ew.i_item_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2000
          AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%station%'
          AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)station')
          AND i.i_brand LIKE 'B%'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM catalog_returns cr
                WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          )
        GROUP BY
            i.i_item_sk,
            i.i_item_id,
            SUBSTR(i.i_item_id, 1, 5),
            i.i_product_name,
            i.i_brand,
            i.i_category,
            CONCAT(i.i_brand, ' - ', i.i_category)
        HAVING total_net_loss > 0
    )
SELECT *
FROM final_agg
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC, return_count DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    w.w_state,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    cr.cr_order_number,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    cr.cr_fee,
    CASE
        WHEN cr.cr_return_amount > 200 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN cr.cr_return_amount > 100 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS return_amount_category,
    i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    ws.ws_net_paid,
    COALESCE(wp.wp_url, 'NoPage') AS page_url,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY cr.cr_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_reason_desc ORDER BY ws.ws_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rownum
FROM catalog_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) AS cr
JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN inventory i
    ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_returning
    ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
WHERE
    r.r_reason_desc IN ('Did not like the model', 'Found a better price in a store')
    AND cr.cr_fee > 20
    AND ca_refunded.ca_state = 'NY'
    AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand < 10
    AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, return_amount_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH sampled_returns AS (
    SELECT cr.*
    FROM catalog_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cr
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        sr.cr_returned_time_sk,
        sr.cr_returned_date_sk,

        w1.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,

    FROM sampled_returns sr

    JOIN call_center cc1

    JOIN call_center cc2

    JOIN catalog_page cp2
        ON sr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp2.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w1
        ON sr.cr_warehouse_sk = w1.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN warehouse w2
        ON sr.cr_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE td1.t_hour IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        cc_sk,
        cc_name,

        warehouse_name,

        warehouse_state,
        t_hour,

        cp_type,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,

    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY
        cc_sk,
        cc_name,
        cc_division,

    t_am_pm,

    cp_type,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_quantity,

    CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 5000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_name ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_call_center_sk = aggregated.cc_sk) AS overall_avg_return_amount

        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM filtered_returns fr2
            WHERE fr2.wr_web_page_sk = a.wp_web_page_sk
              AND fr2.wr_fee > 50

    )
SELECT DISTINCT
    rn,
