-- Goal: Analyze net sales and profit for stores whose names start with "A", for items with specific code patterns, purchased by customers with a specific email domain, and that had a return. The query uses string functions, correlated subqueries, aggregation, and pagination.
WITH sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_moy,
        i.i_item_desc,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        p.p_promo_name,
        c.c_email_address,
        ss.ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE s.s_store_name LIKE 'A%'
      AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3}')
      AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%special%'
      AND regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, 'Discount')
      AND regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '@example\\.com$')
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_returns sr
            WHERE sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
              AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
      )
)
SELECT
    s_store_id AS store_id,
    CONCAT(s_store_name, ' (', s_city, ')') AS store_full_name,
    d_year AS year,
    d_moy AS month,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(i_item_desc, '([A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3})', 1) AS extracted_code,
    SUBSTRING(i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 10) AS item_desc_prefix,
    SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number) AS num_transactions,
    AVG(ss_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ss3.ss_customer_sk)
        FROM store_sales ss3
        JOIN date_dim d3 ON ss3.ss_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
        WHERE ss3.ss_store_sk = ss_store_sk
          AND d3.d_year = d_year
          AND d3.d_moy = d_moy
    ) AS distinct_customers_in_month
FROM sales_filtered
GROUP BY
    s_store_id,
    s_store_name,
    s_city,
    d_year,
    d_moy,
    i_item_desc
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH page_words AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_description,
        split(cp.cp_description, ' ') AS words_arr
    FROM catalog_page cp
    WHERE regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)\\breturn\\b')
),
unnested_words AS (
    SELECT
        pw.cp_catalog_page_id,
        w.word
    FROM page_words pw
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(pw.words_arr) AS t(word)
    WHERE word LIKE 's%'
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_department,
        sum(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        sum(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department
),
reason_agg AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_desc,
        sum(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss_by_reason,
        count(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
),
intersect_pages AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id
    FROM catalog_page cp
    WHERE regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)promo')
      AND cp.cp_catalog_page_id LIKE 'A%'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cp2.cp_catalog_page_id
    FROM catalog_page cp2
    JOIN catalog_returns cr2 ON cp2.cp_catalog_page_sk = cr2.cr_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN reason r2 ON cr2.cr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(r2.r_reason_desc, '(?i)customer')
      AND r2.r_reason_id LIKE 'AAAAAA%'
)
SELECT
    ca.cp_catalog_page_id,
    ca.cp_department,
    substring(ca.cp_department FROM 1 FOR 3) AS dept_prefix,
    concat(ca.cp_department, '_', ca.cp_catalog_page_id) AS dept_page_key,
    ca.total_net_loss,
    ca.total_return_qty,
    CASE WHEN ip.cp_catalog_page_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS in_intersect,
    (SELECT max(ra.total_net_loss_by_reason)
       FROM reason_agg ra
       WHERE ra.r_reason_desc LIKE '%customer%') AS max_reason_net_loss,
    global_avg.global_avg_net_loss,
    uw_agg.description_words
FROM catalog_agg ca
LEFT JOIN intersect_pages ip
    ON ca.cp_catalog_page_id = ip.cp_catalog_page_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, array_agg(DISTINCT word) AS description_words
    FROM unnested_words
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
) uw_agg
    ON ca.cp_catalog_page_id = uw_agg.cp_catalog_page_id
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT avg(total_net_loss) AS global_avg_net_loss
    FROM catalog_agg
) global_avg
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unnested_words uw
    WHERE uw.cp_catalog_page_id = ca.cp_catalog_page_id
      AND uw.word = 'sale'
)
ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE hd_chain AS (
    -- Anchor: start from returns where the refunded household matches a demographic with a specific buy potential
    SELECT 
        wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
        1 AS depth
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE hd.hd_buy_potential = '501-1000'
      AND wr.wr_return_amt > 100
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step: follow returns that reference the current household as the returning household
    SELECT 
        wr2.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk,
        hc.depth + 1
    FROM hd_chain hc
    JOIN web_returns wr2 ON wr2.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hc.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON wr2.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE hc.depth < 3
)
SELECT 
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    hc.depth,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS num_orders,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
    MAX(wr.wr_return_amt) AS max_return_amt,
    MIN(wr.wr_return_amt) AS min_return_amt,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    (SELECT AVG(wr3.wr_return_amt) FROM web_returns wr3) AS overall_avg_return_amt
FROM hd_chain hc
JOIN household_demographics hd ON hc.hd_demo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON (wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk OR wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk)
WHERE hd.hd_vehicle_count = 0
  AND wr.wr_account_credit > 200
  AND wr.wr_return_ship_cost < 1000
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr4
      WHERE (wr4.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk OR wr4.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk)
        AND wr4.wr_return_quantity > 5
  )
GROUP BY hd.hd_buy_potential, hc.depth
ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH orders_sub1 AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
      AND td.t_second BETWEEN 10 AND 16
      AND ws.ws_ext_tax > (SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_ext_tax) FROM web_sales ws2)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_returns wr
          WHERE wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
            AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
      )
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MAX(wr2.wr_return_amt) AS max_ret_amt
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    ) AS lr
),
orders_sub2 AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
      AND td.t_second IN (1, 8, 10, 19)
      AND ws.ws_ext_tax > 5.0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_returns wr
          WHERE wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
      )
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p2.p_discount_active
        FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
    ) AS promo(disc_active)
),
common_orders AS (
    SELECT ws_order_number FROM orders_sub1
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws_order_number FROM orders_sub2
)
SELECT
    ws.ws_order_number AS order_number,
    ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
    ws.ws_net_paid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ws.ws_order_number) AS row_num
FROM web_sales ws
WHERE ws.ws_order_number IN (SELECT ws_order_number FROM common_orders)
ORDER BY ws.ws_order_number
OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY

/*
  Goal: Identify top-selling Premium items (with unit types starting with 'B') across categories and warehouses, showing inventory levels, profit classification, and whether the item has any store returns. The query uses regular expression filtering, LIKE pattern matching, string concatenation, a CASE expression, a scalar subquery, an EXISTS subquery, distinct aggregates, and a window ranking function.
*/
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT
        i_item_sk,
        i_brand,
        i_category,
        i_product_name,
        i_units
    FROM item
    WHERE regexp_like(i_product_name, '(?i)Premium')
      AND i_units LIKE 'B%'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand AS brand,
        i.i_category AS category,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '(?i)Premium') THEN 'Premium'
            ELSE 'Standard'
        END AS product_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_item_sk) AS distinct_item_count,
        SUM(DISTINCT inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand_distinct,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > (
                SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_profit)
                FROM web_sales ws2
            ) THEN 'AboveAvgProfit'
            ELSE 'BelowAvgProfit'
        END AS profit_category,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_returns sr
            WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
              AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
        ) AS has_store_return
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim td
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN inventory inv
        ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    GROUP BY
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '(?i)Premium') THEN 'Premium'
            ELSE 'Standard'
        END
)
SELECT
    brand,
    category,
    brand || '_' || category AS brand_category,
    warehouse_name,
    product_type,
    distinct_item_count,
    total_inventory_on_hand_distinct,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    sales_transactions,
    profit_category,
    has_store_return,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS category_sales_rank
FROM agg
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_year,
           d_moy,
           d_day_name,
           d_holiday,
           d_current_month
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = (SELECT MIN(d_date) FROM date_dim)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dd.d_date_sk,
           dd.d_date,
           dd.d_year,
           dd.d_moy,
           dd.d_day_name,
           dd.d_holiday,
           dd.d_current_month
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim dd
      ON dd.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE dd.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-15'
)
SELECT
    ds.d_year,
    ds.d_moy,
    ANY_VALUE(CONCAT(ds.d_day_name, ' ', CAST(ds.d_year AS VARCHAR))) AS day_year,
    ANY_VALUE(SUBSTR(ds.d_day_name, 1, 3)) AS day_abbrev,
    ANY_VALUE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(ds.d_day_name, '(\\w+)', 1)) AS day_word,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_returns sr2 WHERE sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk AND sr2.sr_return_quantity > 5) AS high_qty_returns
FROM
    date_series ds
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
WHERE
    (REGEXP_LIKE(ds.d_holiday, '^.*[Hh]oliday.*$') OR ds.d_day_name LIKE 'S%')
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_returns sr3
        WHERE sr3.sr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
          AND sr3.sr_net_loss > 1000
    )
GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS ((ds.d_year, ds.d_moy), (ds.d_year), ())
HAVING
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 0

UNION

SELECT
    ds.d_year,
    ds.d_moy,
    ANY_VALUE(CONCAT(ds.d_day_name, ' ', CAST(ds.d_year AS VARCHAR))) AS day_year,
    ANY_VALUE(SUBSTR(ds.d_day_name, 1, 3)) AS day_abbrev,
    ANY_VALUE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(ds.d_day_name, '(\\w+)', 1)) AS day_word,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_returns sr2 WHERE sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk AND sr2.sr_return_quantity > 5) AS high_qty_returns
FROM
    date_series ds
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
WHERE
    ds.d_current_month = 'Y'
    AND ds.d_holiday LIKE '%Day%'
GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS ((ds.d_year, ds.d_moy), (ds.d_year), ())
HAVING
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 0
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_department,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_category,
        ca.ca_address_sk,
        ca.ca_state,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amount,
        s.s_store_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        wp.wp_type
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY')
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT *
    FROM joined_data
    WHERE FALSE
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        i_category,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_returns,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS orders,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) > 0 THEN SUM(cr_return_amount) / SUM(cs_ext_sales_price)
            ELSE 0
        END AS return_rate
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY ca_state, i_category
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    i_category,
    total_sales,
    total_returns,
    return_rate,
    AVG(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS avg_sales_state
FROM aggregated
WHERE total_sales > 1000
  AND total_returns > 0
  AND orders >= 5
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH new_brands_1998 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_brand AS brand
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_rec_start_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-12-31'
)
SELECT
    combined.brand,
    combined.sales_channel,
    combined.total_sales,
    combined.total_profit
FROM (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand AS brand,
        'store' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_current_price > 100
      AND i.i_brand IN (SELECT brand FROM new_brands_1998)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr
          JOIN item i2 ON cr.cr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
          WHERE i2.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
      )
    GROUP BY i.i_brand

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        i.i_brand AS brand,
        'web' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_current_price > 100
      AND i.i_brand IN (SELECT brand FROM new_brands_1998)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_returns wr
          WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
      )
    GROUP BY i.i_brand
) AS combined
WHERE combined.total_sales > 0
ORDER BY combined.total_profit DESC, combined.brand
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    -- start with the earliest date in 2020
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2020
    ORDER BY d_date
    LIMIT 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dh.d_date)
    WHERE dh.lvl < 5
),

sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        dh.d_date,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        t.t_meal_time,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        CONCAT('Item_', i.i_item_id) AS item_label,
        regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '\\d+') AS numeric_part,
        CASE WHEN regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)blue') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_blue,
        i_l.short_desc
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion promo ON cs.cs_promo_sk = promo.p_promo_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT substr(i.i_item_desc, 1, 20) AS short_desc
    ) AS i_l
    WHERE i.i_item_desc LIKE '%steel%'
      AND t.t_meal_time LIKE '%Lunch%'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM promotion p2
          WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
            AND regexp_like(p2.p_promo_name, '(?i)discount')
      )
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        c_customer_id,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        d_date,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i_item_id) AS distinct_items,
        MAX(item_label) AS item_label,
        MAX(numeric_part) AS numeric_part,
        MAX(has_blue) AS has_blue,
        MAX(t_meal_time) AS meal_time,
        MAX(short_desc) AS short_desc
    FROM sales_base
    GROUP BY c_customer_sk, c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_date
),

customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        SUM(total_net_paid) AS cust_total_net
    FROM sales_agg
    GROUP BY c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    a.c_customer_id,
    a.c_first_name,
    a.c_last_name,
    a.d_date,
    a.total_net_paid,
    a.total_quantity,
    a.distinct_items,
    a.item_label,
    a.numeric_part,
    a.has_blue,
    a.meal_time,
    a.short_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.c_customer_sk ORDER BY a.d_date DESC) AS recency_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ct.cust_total_net DESC) AS customer_global_rank
FROM sales_agg a
JOIN customer_totals ct ON a.c_customer_sk = ct.c_customer_sk
ORDER BY a.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_path AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_month_seq,
           d_year,
           0 AS depth
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk,
           d2.d_date,
           d2.d_month_seq,
           d2.d_year,
           dp.depth + 1
    FROM date_path dp
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = dp.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '1998-12-31'
),

daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        dp.d_year,
        dp.d_month_seq,
        dp.d_date,
        COUNT(ss.ss_ticket_number) AS transactions,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS discount_amount,
        AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_path dp ON d.d_date_sk = dp.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_coupon_amt > 100.00                -- predicate 1
      AND ss.ss_list_price >= 15.00                -- predicate 2
      AND ss.ss_quantity > 0                      -- predicate 3
      AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost > 0                 -- predicate 4
      AND d.d_holiday = 'N'                        -- predicate 5
      AND d.d_weekend = 'N'                        -- predicate 6
    GROUP BY dp.d_year, dp.d_month_seq, dp.d_date
),

monthly_summary AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        SUM(sales_amount) AS month_sales,
        SUM(discount_amount) AS month_discount,
        AVG(avg_profit) AS month_avg_profit,
        COUNT(transactions) AS days_with_sales
    FROM daily_sales
    GROUP BY d_year, d_month_seq
    HAVING SUM(sales_amount) > 5000.00            -- additional filter
)
SELECT
    ms.d_year,
    ms.d_month_seq,
    ms.month_sales,
    ms.month_discount,
    ms.month_avg_profit,
    ms.days_with_sales
FROM monthly_summary ms
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_site ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq = ms.d_month_seq
      AND d.d_year = ms.d_year
      AND ws.web_tax_percentage > 0.05           -- predicate a
      AND ws.web_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5.00 AND 5.00 -- predicate b
      AND ws.web_class = 'Shopping'               -- predicate c
      AND ws.web_state = 'CA'                     -- predicate d
      AND ws.web_name LIKE '%Online%'             -- predicate e
      AND ws.web_rec_end_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'-- predicate f
      AND d.d_following_holiday = 'N'             -- predicate g
)
ORDER BY ms.month_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH 
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        i_sales.i_item_id,
        d_sold.d_year,
        d_sold.d_month_seq,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sales_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i_sales ON cs.cs_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON i_sales.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM inventory inv2 
        WHERE inv2.inv_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk 
          AND inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
    )
    GROUP BY i_sales.i_item_id, d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_month_seq
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        i_return.i_item_id,
        d_return.d_year,
        d_return.d_month_seq,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS return_qty,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS return_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d_return ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_return ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i_return ON sr.sr_item_sk = i_return.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_closed ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY i_return.i_item_id, d_return.d_year, d_return.d_month_seq
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.i_item_id,
        sa.d_year,
        sa.d_month_seq,
        sa.sold_qty,
        sa.sales_profit,
        COALESCE(ra.return_qty, 0) AS return_qty,
        COALESCE(ra.return_loss, 0) AS return_loss,
        (sa.sales_profit - COALESCE(ra.return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit,
        CASE 
            WHEN (sa.sales_profit - COALESCE(ra.return_loss, 0)) > 10000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN (sa.sales_profit - COALESCE(ra.return_loss, 0)) > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM sales_agg sa
    LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra
        ON sa.i_item_id = ra.i_item_id
        AND sa.d_year = ra.d_year
        AND sa.d_month_seq = ra.d_month_seq
),
extra_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_item_id
    FROM item i
    JOIN promotion p ON i.i_item_sk = p.p_item_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
)
SELECT 
    c.i_item_id,
    c.d_year,
    c.d_month_seq,
    c.sold_qty,
    c.return_qty,
    c.net_profit,
    c.profit_category,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_sales_price) 
     FROM catalog_sales cs2 
     WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i_sales_sub.i_item_sk) AS avg_sales_price,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM extra_items ei 
     WHERE ei.i_item_id = c.i_item_id) AS extra_promo_flag
FROM combined c
JOIN item i_sales_sub ON i_sales_sub.i_item_id = c.i_item_id
WHERE c.i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM extra_items)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    c2.i_item_id,
    c2.d_year,
    c2.d_month_seq,
    c2.sold_qty,
    c2.return_qty,
    c2.net_profit,
    c2.profit_category,
    NULL AS avg_sales_price,
    0 AS extra_promo_flag
FROM combined c2
WHERE c2.net_profit < 0
EXCEPT
SELECT 
    i_item_id,
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    sold_qty,
    return_qty,
    net_profit,
    profit_category,
    avg_sales_price,
    extra_promo_flag
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.i_item_id,
        c.d_year,
        c.d_month_seq,
        c.sold_qty,
        c.return_qty,
        c.net_profit,
        c.profit_category,
        (SELECT AVG(cs3.cs_sales_price) 
         FROM catalog_sales cs3 
         WHERE cs3.cs_item_sk = i_sales_sub2.i_item_sk) AS avg_sales_price,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) 
         FROM extra_items ei2 
         WHERE ei2.i_item_id = c.i_item_id) AS extra_promo_flag
    FROM combined c
    JOIN item i_sales_sub2 ON i_sales_sub2.i_item_id = c.i_item_id
    WHERE c.net_profit = 0
) AS zero_profit_items
ORDER BY net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE sales_path AS (
    -- Base case: start with a sample of orders (e.g., every 1000th order) to keep recursion bounded
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_order_number % 1000 = 0
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive case: walk forward to the next order number for the same item (max 5 steps)
    SELECT
        ws2.ws_order_number,
        ws2.ws_item_sk,
        ws2.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws2.ws_net_profit,
        ws2.ws_quantity,
        ws2.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
        ws2.ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
        ws2.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws2.ws_ship_mode_sk,
        sp.lvl + 1
    FROM sales_path sp
    JOIN web_sales ws2
      ON ws2.ws_order_number = sp.ws_order_number + 1
     AND ws2.ws_item_sk = sp.ws_item_sk
    WHERE sp.lvl < 5
),
base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws_site.web_site_id,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        cd_bill.cd_gender AS bill_gender,
        cd_ship.cd_gender AS ship_gender,
        SUM(sp.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(sp.ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sp.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        l_ret.total_ret_amt
    FROM sales_path sp
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_bill
      ON sp.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_ship
      ON sp.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_site AS ws_site
      ON sp.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    JOIN ship_mode AS sm
      ON sp.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    -- second alias for ship_mode to increase join count
    JOIN ship_mode AS sm_alt
      ON sp.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_alt.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns AS wr_item
      ON sp.ws_item_sk = wr_item.wr_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns AS wr_order
      ON sp.ws_order_number = wr_order.wr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_refunded
      ON wr_item.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_returning
      ON wr_item.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(wr_sub.wr_return_amt) AS total_ret_amt
        FROM web_returns wr_sub
        WHERE wr_sub.wr_order_number = sp.ws_order_number
    ) AS l_ret ON TRUE
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (ws_site.web_site_id, sm.sm_carrier, cd_bill.cd_gender, cd_ship.cd_gender),
        (ws_site.web_site_id, sm.sm_carrier),
        (cd_bill.cd_gender, cd_ship.cd_gender),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    ba.web_site_id,
    ba.sm_carrier,
    ba.bill_gender,
    ba.ship_gender,
    ba.total_net_profit,
    ba.avg_quantity,
    ba.order_cnt,
    ba.total_ret_amt,
    overall.avg_profit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ba.web_site_id ORDER BY ba.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM base_agg ba
CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit FROM web_sales) AS overall
ORDER BY ba.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy(lvl) AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM hierarchy WHERE lvl < 3
),

base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        td.t_time_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        td.t_minute,
        td.t_second,
        td.t_meal_time,
        cs.cs_ship_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_wholesale_cost,
        cs.cs_list_price,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_wholesale_cost > 50 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS cost_category,
        ARRAY[CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS double), cs.cs_wholesale_cost] AS qty_wholesale_arr,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_ext_sales_price,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM
        time_dim td
        FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_sales cs
            ON td.t_time_sk = cs.cs_sold_time_sk
    WHERE
        (cs.cs_ship_customer_sk IN (3116427, 931351, 10425383) OR cs.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL) -- predicate 1
        AND (cs.cs_wholesale_cost > 20 OR cs.cs_wholesale_cost IS NULL)                     -- predicate 2
        AND (cs.cs_wholesale_cost < 90 OR cs.cs_wholesale_cost IS NULL)                     -- predicate 3
        AND (cs.cs_list_price <= 150 OR cs.cs_list_price IS NULL)                         -- predicate 4
        AND (td.t_meal_time = 'lunch' OR td.t_meal_time IS NULL)                          -- predicate 5
        AND (td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17 OR td.t_hour IS NULL)                              -- predicate 6
    GROUP BY
        td.t_time_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        td.t_minute,
        td.t_second,
        td.t_meal_time,
        cs.cs_ship_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_wholesale_cost,
        cs.cs_list_price,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_wholesale_cost > 50 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END
),

array_expanded AS (
    SELECT
        bs.*, 
        metric_val
    FROM base_sales bs
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(bs.qty_wholesale_arr) AS t(metric_val)
),

metric_rowed AS (
    SELECT
        ae.*, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ae.cs_ship_customer_sk ORDER BY ae.metric_val DESC NULLS LAST) AS metric_rn
    FROM array_expanded ae
),

combined_metrics AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mr.cs_ship_customer_sk,
        mr.cost_category,
        mr.total_ext_sales_price,
        mr.metric_rn,
        mr.metric_val
    FROM metric_rowed mr
    WHERE mr.cost_category = 'high' AND mr.metric_rn <= 3

    UNION ALL

    SELECT DISTINCT
        mr.cs_ship_customer_sk,
        mr.cost_category,
        mr.total_ext_sales_price,
        mr.metric_rn,
        mr.metric_val
    FROM metric_rowed mr
    WHERE mr.cost_category = 'low' AND mr.metric_rn <= 5
)

SELECT
    cm.cs_ship_customer_sk,
    cm.cost_category,
    h.lvl,
    AVG(cm.total_ext_sales_price) AS avg_total_ext_sales_price,
    MAX(cm.metric_val) AS max_metric_val,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_per_group
FROM combined_metrics cm
JOIN hierarchy h ON h.lvl = cm.metric_rn
GROUP BY
    cm.cs_ship_customer_sk,
    cm.cost_category,
    h.lvl
ORDER BY avg_total_ext_sales_price DESC
LIMIT 100
deep_join_analysis

/* Goal: Identify top-selling product categories and states for items that have both high inventory levels and active promotions, applying string-pattern filters, intersecting item sets, and aggregating sales from catalog and web channels. */
WITH sampled_inv AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM inventory TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
),
item_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_color,
        regexp_extract(i.i_product_name, '(?i)([A-Za-z]+)\\s+([A-Za-z]+)', 1) AS first_word,
        regexp_extract(i.i_product_name, '(?i)([A-Za-z]+)\\s+([A-Za-z]+)', 2) AS second_word
    FROM item i
    WHERE regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '(?i)chair|table|sofa')
      AND i.i_product_name LIKE '% %'
),
store_returns_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_quantity
    FROM store_returns sr
    WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 0
),
sub_a AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk
    FROM item_filtered i
    JOIN store_returns_filtered sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN sampled_inv si ON si.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE si.inv_quantity_on_hand > 500
),
sub_b AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk
    FROM item_filtered i
    JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND i.i_color LIKE 'Red%'
),
intersected_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM sub_a
    INTERSECT
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM sub_b
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        w.w_state,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
        CONCAT('Category: ', i.i_category) AS category_label,
        SUBSTRING(i.i_product_name FROM 1 FOR 10) AS short_name
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM intersected_items)
    GROUP BY CUBE(i.i_category, w.w_state)
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        w.w_state,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
        CONCAT('Category: ', i.i_category) AS category_label,
        SUBSTRING(i.i_product_name FROM 1 FOR 10) AS short_name
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM intersected_items)
    GROUP BY CUBE(i.i_category, w.w_state)
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    w_state,
    total_sales,
    sales_cnt,
    category_label,
    short_name
FROM catalog_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT
    i_category,
    w_state,
    total_sales,
    sales_cnt,
    category_label,
    short_name
FROM web_agg
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH inv_agg AS (
    SELECT
        inv.inv_item_sk,
        inv.inv_date_sk,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM inventory TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS inv
    GROUP BY inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_date_sk
)
SELECT
    d_sales.d_year AS year,
    p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_sales_net_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_net_loss,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_returns_net_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_returns_net_loss,
    SUM(inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand) AS total_inventory_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold
FROM store_sales AS ss
JOIN date_dim AS d_sales
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN item AS i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_ss
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
JOIN promotion AS p
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN store_returns AS sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d_sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_sr
    ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns AS cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d_cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
JOIN call_center AS cc
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode AS sm_cr
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_cr_refund
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_refund.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_sales AS ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d_ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN ship_mode AS sm_ws
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion AS p_ws
    ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
JOIN web_returns AS wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
   AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d_wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_wr_refund
    ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_refund.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd_wr_returning
    ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_returning.cd_demo_sk
JOIN inv_agg
    ON inv_agg.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d_inv
    ON inv_agg.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
GROUP BY
    d_sales.d_year,
    p.p_promo_name,
    cc.cc_name
ORDER BY
    d_sales.d_year DESC,
    store_sales_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_chain AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS level
    FROM tpcds.date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, c.level + 1
    FROM tpcds.date_dim d
    JOIN date_chain c ON d.d_date = DATE_ADD('day', 1, c.d_date)
    WHERE c.level < 7
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    d_sales.d_date,
    p.p_promo_name,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    i1.i_brand,
    i1.i_category,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_net_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_net_loss,
    SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_profit, 0)) AS total_web_net_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_orders,
    (SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_profit)
     FROM tpcds.store_sales ss2
     WHERE ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk) AS avg_profit_all_stores,
    (SELECT SUM(ws2.ws_net_profit)
     FROM tpcds.web_sales ws2
     WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
       AND ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk) AS total_web_profit_for_promo_date
FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_sales
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN date_chain dc
  ON d_sales.d_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_sales
  ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk
JOIN tpcds.item i1
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer c
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
  ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.income_band ib
  ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca
  ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN tpcds.store s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN tpcds.promotion p
  ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
LEFT JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_return
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_return
  ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer c_return
  ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_return.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_return
  ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_return.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_return
  ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.store s_return
  ON sr.sr_store_sk = s_return.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_ws_sold
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_ws
  ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.item i2
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_page wp
  ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer c_ws_bill
  ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_ws_bill.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_ws_bill
  ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_bill.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_ws_bill
  ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_ws_bill.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer c_ws_ship
  ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c_ws_ship.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_ws_ship
  ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_ship.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_ws_ship
  ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ws_ship.ca_address_sk
WHERE
    hd.hd_buy_potential = '501-1000'
    AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 25000
    AND p.p_purpose = 'Unknown'
    AND t_sales.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    d_sales.d_date,
    p.p_promo_name,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    i1.i_brand,
    i1.i_category
ORDER BY
    total_store_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_year) AS d_year
    FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_year + 1
    FROM years
    WHERE d_year < (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim)
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        dr.d_year,
        dr.d_month_seq,
        sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk AS cr_ship_mode_sk,
        sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_id AS cr_ship_mode_id,
        sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk AS ws_ship_mode_sk,
        sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_id AS ws_ship_mode_id,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_coupon_amt,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws_site.web_name,
        hd_refund.hd_buy_potential AS refund_buy_potential,
        hd_return.hd_vehicle_count AS return_vehicle_count,
        hd_bill.hd_buy_potential AS bill_buy_potential,
        hd_ship.hd_vehicle_count AS ship_vehicle_count,
        ARRAY[cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, ws.ws_ship_mode_sk] AS ship_mode_array,
        (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
         FROM catalog_returns cr2
         WHERE cr2.cr_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk) AS avg_return_amt_by_reason
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim dr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_refund
        ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refund.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_return
        ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_return.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_cr
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ws
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim dsh
        ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = dsh.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim dopen
        ON ws_site.web_open_date_sk = dopen.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim dclose
        ON ws_site.web_close_date_sk = dclose.d_date_sk
    JOIN years y
        ON dr.d_year = y.d_year
),
unnested AS (
    SELECT
        j.*,
        sm_unn.sm_ship_mode_id AS unnested_ship_mode_id
    FROM joined j
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(j.ship_mode_array) AS t(ship_mode_sk)
    JOIN ship_mode sm_unn
        ON t.ship_mode_sk = sm_unn.sm_ship_mode_sk
)
SELECT
    unnested.d_year,
    unnested.d_month_seq,
    unnested.cr_ship_mode_id,
    unnested.ws_ship_mode_id,
    unnested.unnested_ship_mode_id,
    unnested.web_name,
    SUM(unnested.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(unnested.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    AVG(unnested.ws_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon_amt,
    CASE WHEN SUM(unnested.cr_net_loss) > 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Gain' END AS loss_flag,
    AVG(unnested.avg_return_amt_by_reason) AS avg_return_amount_by_reason,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(unnested.cr_return_amount) DESC) AS return_rank
FROM unnested
GROUP BY
    unnested.d_year,
    unnested.d_month_seq,
    unnested.cr_ship_mode_id,
    unnested.ws_ship_mode_id,
    unnested.unnested_ship_mode_id,
    unnested.web_name
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    item_sales AS (
        SELECT
            ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
            SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
            AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
            COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
            MIN(ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS first_sale_date_sk,
            MAX(ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS last_sale_date_sk
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN time_dim td
            ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk
    ),
    store_return_agg AS (
        SELECT
            sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
            SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_net_loss,
            COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt,
            MAX(sr.sr_reason_sk) AS latest_reason_sk
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN time_dim td
            ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        JOIN item i
            ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN customer c
            ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd
            ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca
            ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN store s
            ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        WHERE i.i_units = 'Pound'
          AND s.s_state = 'TX'
        GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk
    ),
    catalog_return_agg AS (
        SELECT
            cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
            SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
            COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        JOIN catalog_page cp
            ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        WHERE cp.cp_type = 'Promotion'
        GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
    ),
    web_return_agg AS (
        SELECT
            wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
            SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
            COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt
        FROM web_returns wr
        JOIN web_sales ws
            ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
        WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
        GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk
    ),
    web_sales_detail AS (
        SELECT
            ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
            MIN(ws.ws_web_page_sk) AS web_page_sk,
            MIN(ws.ws_web_site_sk) AS web_site_sk,
            MIN(ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS first_sold_date_sk
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN time_dim td
            ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk
    )
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_units,
    p.p_promo_name,
    COALESCE(isales.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
    COALESCE(isales.sales_cnt, 0) AS sales_cnt,
    COALESCE(isales.avg_sales_price, 0) AS avg_sales_price,
    COALESCE(sret.total_store_net_loss, 0) AS total_store_net_loss,
    COALESCE(sret.store_return_cnt, 0) AS store_return_cnt,
    COALESCE(creturn.total_catalog_return_amount, 0) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    COALESCE(creturn.catalog_return_cnt, 0) AS catalog_return_cnt,
    COALESCE(wret.total_web_return_amount, 0) AS total_web_return_amount,
    COALESCE(wret.web_return_cnt, 0) AS web_return_cnt,
    CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS promo_status,
    r_desc.r_reason_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(isales.total_sales, 0) DESC) AS global_rownum,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY COALESCE(isales.total_sales, 0) DESC) AS category_rownum
FROM item i
JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN item_sales isales
    ON isales.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN store_return_agg sret
    ON sret.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_return_agg creturn
    ON creturn.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN web_return_agg wret
    ON wret.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales_detail wsdet
    ON wsdet.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wsdet.web_page_sk
JOIN web_site webs
    ON webs.web_site_sk = wsdet

WITH
  store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      ss.ss_store_sk,
      ss.ss_promo_sk,
      ss.ss_ship_mode_sk,
      ss.ss_customer_sk,
      ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
      SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales_ext_sales,
      SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk, ss.ss_ship_mode_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk
  ),
  catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      cs.cs_item_sk,
      cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
      cs.cs_promo_sk,
      cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
      cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
      cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
      SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales_ext_sales,
      SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_catalog_page_sk, cs.cs_promo_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
  ),
  web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      ws.ws_item_sk,
      ws.ws_promo_sk,
      ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
      ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
      ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
      SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales_ext_sales,
      SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_promo_sk, ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk
  ),
  store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
      sr.sr_item_sk,
      SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS store_return_amt,
      SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk
  ),
  web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
      wr.wr_item_sk,
      SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amt,
      SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk
  ),
  inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT
      inv.inv_item_sk,
      SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory inv
    GROUP BY inv.inv_item_sk
  )
SELECT
  i.i_item_id,
  i.i_product_name,
  i.i_category,
  i.i_class,
  s.s_store_name,
  sm_store.sm_type AS store_ship_type,
  sm_catalog.sm_type AS catalog_ship_type,
  sm_web.sm_type AS web_ship_type,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT p_store.p_promo_name) AS store_promo_names,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT p_catalog.p_promo_name) AS catalog_promo_names,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT p_web.p_promo_name) AS web_promo_names,
  COALESCE(SUM(ssa.store_sales_ext_sales), 0) AS store_sales_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(ssa.store_net_profit), 0) AS store_net_profit,
  COALESCE(SUM(csa.catalog_sales_ext_sales), 0) AS catalog_sales_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(csa.catalog_net_profit), 0) AS catalog_net_profit,
  COALESCE(SUM(wsa.web_sales_ext_sales), 0) AS web_sales_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(wsa.web_net_profit), 0) AS web_net_profit,
  COALESCE(SUM(sr_agg.store_return_amt), 0) AS store_return_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(sr_agg.store_net_loss), 0) AS store_return_loss_total,

## Goal
Summarize total sales, returns, inventory and gender‑specific sales by year, warehouse and ship mode, distinguishing return vs. sale transactions.

## Query
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        w_cr.w_warehouse_name AS cr_warehouse_name,
        w_inv.w_warehouse_name AS inv_warehouse_name,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        cd_ref.cd_gender AS refunded_gender,
        cd_returning.cd_gender AS returning_gender,
        cd_ss.cd_gender AS ss_gender,
        hd_ref.hd_buy_potential AS ref_buy_potential,
        hd_returning.hd_buy_potential AS ret_buy_potential,
        ss.ss_quantity AS ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS ss_net_paid,
        sr.sr_return_quantity AS sr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS cr_return_amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN cr.cr_return_amount > 0 THEN 'return'
            ELSE 'sale'
        END AS transaction_type,
        (
            SELECT SUM(inv_sub.inv_quantity_on_hand)
            FROM inventory inv_sub
            WHERE inv_sub.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        ) AS total_inventory_on_date
    FROM date_dim d
    -- store_sales and its dimensions
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ss
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
    -- store_returns (linked to same date and to store_sales)
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN time_dim t_sr
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret
        ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ret
        ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
    -- catalog_returns and its dimensions
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning
        ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ref
        ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_returning
        ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_cr
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
    -- inventory and its warehouse
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_inv
        ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_inv.w_warehouse_sk
    -- income band via household demographics (choose one household reference)
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd_ss.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    -- web site open and close dates
    JOIN web_site ws_open
        ON ws_open.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_close
        ON ws_close.web_close_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
)
-- First SELECT – all transaction types

WITH

    store_returns_agg AS (
        SELECT
            sr_item_sk,

            sr_cdemo_sk,
            sr_hdemo_sk,
            COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
            SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt
        FROM store_returns
        GROUP BY sr_item_sk, sr_returned_time_sk, sr_cdemo_sk, sr_hdemo_sk
    ),
    -- Catalog sales aggregated, excluding orders that have a catalog return (anti‑join)
    catalog_sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            cs_item_sk,
            cs_sold_time_sk,
            cs_call_center_sk,
            cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
            cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
            SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
            SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr
            WHERE cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        )
        GROUP BY cs_item_sk, cs_sold_time_sk, cs_call_center_sk, cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs_bill_hdemo_sk
    ),
    -- Web sales aggregated
    web_sales_agg AS (
        SELECT

            ws_bill_hdemo_sk,

        FROM web_sales
        GROUP BY ws_item_sk, ws_sold_time_sk, ws_web_site_sk, ws_bill_cdemo_sk, ws_bill_hdemo_sk

    -- Combine catalog and web sales (set operation)
    combined_sales AS (

            ws_bill_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk,

            total_web_sales_amount AS total_sales_amount,
            total_web_qty AS total_quantity,
            'web' AS source
        FROM web_sales_agg
    )

WITH RECURSIVE ship_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor: smallest ship_mode key
    SELECT
        sm.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sm.sm_type,
        sm.sm_code,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        sm.sm_contract,

        1 AS level
    FROM ship_mode sm
    WHERE sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = (
        SELECT MIN(sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk) FROM ship_mode sm2
    )
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step: next ship_mode key = previous key + 1
    SELECT
        sm_child.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sm_child.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sm_child.sm_type,
        sm_child.sm_code,
        sm_child.sm_carrier,
        sm_child.sm_contract,
        sh.sm_ship_mode_sk AS parent_ship_mode_sk,
        sh.level + 1 AS level
    FROM ship_hierarchy sh
    JOIN ship_mode sm_child
        ON sm_child.sm_ship_mode_sk = sh.sm_ship_mode_sk + 1
),

ship_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sh.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sh.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sh.sm_carrier,
        sh.sm_contract,
        sh.level,
        COUNT(cr.cr_order_number) AS total_returns,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM ship_hierarchy sh
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sh.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE
        cr.cr_reason_sk IN (13, 48, 42, 30, 9)
        AND cr.cr_return_quantity >= 2
        AND cr.cr_return_ship_cost > 500
        AND sh.sm_carrier IN ('DHL', 'AIRBORNE')
        AND sh.sm_contract LIKE 'A5B%'
    GROUP BY
        sh.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sh.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sh.sm_carrier,
        sh.sm_contract,
        sh.level
),

carrier_summary AS (
    SELECT
        sm_carrier,
        SUM(total_returns) AS carrier_total_returns,
        SUM(total_return_amount) AS carrier_total_return_amount,
        AVG(avg_ship_cost) AS carrier_avg_ship_cost,
        SUM(total_return_qty) AS carrier_total_return_qty
    FROM ship_returns_agg
    GROUP BY sm_carrier
)

SELECT
    cs.sm_carrier,
    cs.carrier_total_returns,
    cs.carrier_total_return_amount,
    cs.carrier_avg_ship_cost,
    cs.carrier_total_return_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.carrier_total_return_amount DESC) AS row_num
FROM carrier_summary cs
WHERE cs.carrier_total_return_amount > 10000
ORDER BY cs.carrier_total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE item_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_category_id,
           i.i_brand_id,
           1 AS level
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_item_sk = 1000
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i2.i_item_sk,
           i2.i_category_id,
           i2.i_brand_id,
           h.level + 1
    FROM item i2
    JOIN item_hierarchy h
      ON i2.i_item_sk = h.i_item_sk + 1
    WHERE i2.i_item_sk <= 1010
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sm.sm_type,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        i.i_brand,
        h.level,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS order_count,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty,
        MIN(cr.cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount,
        MAX(cr.cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount
    FROM
        item_hierarchy h
    JOIN item i
        ON h.i_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE
        i.i_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 0.5 AND 30.00
        AND i.i_size IN ('small', 'petite', 'extra large')
        AND i.i_container = 'Unknown'
        AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 1
        AND cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax > 10.00
        AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Low Risk'
        AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'M'
        AND sm.sm_type = 'Standard'
    GROUP BY
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sm.sm_type,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        i.i_brand,
        h.level
    HAVING
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 500
)
SELECT
    sm_ship_mode_id,
    sm_type,
    cd_credit_rating,
    cd_marital_status,
    i_brand,
    level,
    order_count,
    total_net_loss,
    avg_return_qty,
    min_return_amount,
    max_return_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm_ship_mode_id ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM
    aggregated
ORDER BY
    total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH profit_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_profit > (
            SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit)
            FROM catalog_sales cs2
          )
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
      AND ca.ca_state = 'CO'
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
),

ranked_profit_customers AS (
    SELECT
        pc.c_customer_sk,
        pc.c_first_name,
        pc.c_last_name,
        pc.total_net_profit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pc.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
    FROM profit_customers pc
),

web_page_visitors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        w.wp_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk
    FROM web_page w
    JOIN customer c
        ON w.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE w.wp_type = 'Home'
      AND c.c_birth_country = 'JAPAN'
),

final_customers AS (
    SELECT
        rpc.c_customer_sk,
        rpc.c_first_name,
        rpc.c_last_name,
        rpc.total_net_profit,
        rpc.profit_rank
    FROM ranked_profit_customers rpc
    EXCEPT
    SELECT
        rpc.c_customer_sk,
        rpc.c_first_name,
        rpc.c_last_name,
        rpc.total_net_profit,
        rpc.profit_rank
    FROM ranked_profit_customers rpc
    JOIN web_page_visitors wv
        ON rpc.c_customer_sk = wv.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    fc.c_customer_sk,
    fc.c_first_name,
    fc.c_last_name,
    fc.total_net_profit,
    fc.profit_rank
FROM final_customers fc
ORDER BY fc.profit_rank ASC

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_year
    FROM tpcds.date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk,
           d2.d_date,
           d2.d_year
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date = date_add('day', 1, ds.d_date)
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2001-12-31'
),
target_customers AS (
    SELECT c1.c_customer_sk
    FROM tpcds.customer c1
    WHERE c1.c_email_address LIKE '%.org'
    EXCEPT
    SELECT c2.c_customer_sk
    FROM tpcds.customer c2
    WHERE c2.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_gender,
        ds.d_year,
        cc.cc_name,
        p.p_promo_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)      AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*)                  AS transaction_cnt,
        MAX(p.p_cost)             AS max_promo_cost,
        (SELECT MAX(p3.p_cost)
         FROM tpcds.promotion p3
         WHERE p3.p_channel_email = 'Y') AS max_email_promo_cost
    FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
    JOIN date_series ds
      ON ds.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer c
      ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd
      ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca
      ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p
      ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc
      ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.web_page wp
      ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
     AND wp.wp_creation_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    WHERE ds.d_year = 2001
      AND ss.ss_quantity > 2
      AND ca.ca_county = 'Williams County'
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1970
      AND cc.cc_employees > 100
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM tpcds.promotion p_sub
          WHERE p_sub.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
            AND p_sub.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      )
      AND c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT c_customer_sk FROM target_customers)
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_gender,
        ds.d_year,
        cc.cc_name,
        p.p_promo_name
),
final_stats AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
        SUM(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender) AS gender_total_sales
    FROM sales_agg
    WHERE total_sales > (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM sales_agg)
)
SELECT
    c_customer_sk,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    cd_gender,
    d_year,
    cc_name,
    p_promo_name,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    transaction_cnt,
    max_promo_cost,
    max_email_promo_cost,
    sales_rank,
    gender_total_sales
FROM final_stats
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series (d_date_sk, d_date) AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_date = (
            SELECT MIN(d2.d_date)
            FROM date_dim d2
            WHERE d2.d_year = 2001
        )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date
    FROM date_dim d_next
    JOIN date_series ds ON d_next.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d_next.d_year = 2001
),

distinct_warehouses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_sk,
                    w.w_warehouse_id,
                    w.w_city,
                    w.w_gmt_offset
    FROM warehouse w
    WHERE w.w_country = 'United States'
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dw.w_warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_amount,
        'sales' AS src,
        CASE WHEN dw.w_gmt_offset >= 0 THEN 'East' ELSE 'West' END AS region
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN distinct_warehouses dw ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = dw.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE dw.w_gmt_offset > (SELECT AVG(w2.w_gmt_offset) FROM warehouse w2)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM income_band ib
          WHERE ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
            AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 30000
      )
    GROUP BY dw.w_warehouse_id, sm.sm_type, dw.w_gmt_offset
),

returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        NULL AS warehouse_id,
        NULL AS ship_mode,
        -SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS net_amount,
        'returns' AS src
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(warehouse_id, 'ALL_WAREHOUSES') AS warehouse_id,
    COALESCE(ship_mode, 'ALL_SHIP_MODES') AS ship_mode,
    src,
    SUM(net_amount) AS total_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(net_amount) > 0 THEN 'Profit'
        WHEN SUM(net_amount) < 0 THEN 'Loss'
        ELSE 'Break-even'
    END AS profit_status
FROM (
    SELECT warehouse_id, ship_mode, net_amount, src FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT warehouse_id, ship_mode, net_amount, src FROM returns_agg
) combined
GROUP BY ROLLUP(warehouse_id, ship_mode, src)
ORDER BY warehouse_id, ship_mode, src
LIMIT 100

WITH sampled_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs_quantity,
        cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
)
SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    d_sold.d_year,
    cp.cp_catalog_number,
    cp.cp_department,
    cs.cs_quantity,
    cs.cs_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
    sr.sr_return_quantity,
    sr.sr_return_amt,
    (
        SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_return_amt)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    ) AS total_return_amt_for_day,
    page_sales.page_total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY cs.cs_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_by_warehouse,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY cs.cs_net_profit DESC) AS profit_row_num
FROM sampled_sales cs
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site ws
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT SUM(cs2.cs_ext_sales_price) AS page_total_sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
      AND cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
) AS page_sales
WHERE
    d_sold.d_year = 2001
    AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
    AND cs.cs_quantity > 10
    AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
    AND w.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 20000
    AND ws.web_class = 'A'
ORDER BY profit_rank_by_warehouse, w.w_warehouse_name, cs.cs_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH cs_base AS (
    SELECT cs.*, ARRAY[cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk] AS iw_arr
    FROM catalog_sales cs
),
cs_unnested AS (
    SELECT cs_base.*, u.iw_val
    FROM cs_base
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cs_base.iw_arr) AS t(iw_val)
),
agg_data AS (
    SELECT
        w1.w_warehouse_name,
        t_cs1.t_hour,
        SUM(cs_unnested.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_unnested.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        AVG(cs_unnested.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        SUM(cs_unnested.iw_val) AS sum_iw_vals
    FROM cs_unnested
    JOIN time_dim t_cs1
      ON cs_unnested.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs1.t_time_sk
    JOIN warehouse w1
      ON cs_unnested.cs_warehouse_sk = w1.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs_dup
      ON cs_dup.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs1.t_time_sk
    JOIN warehouse w2
      ON cs_dup.cs_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss1
      ON ss1.ss_sold_time_sk = t_cs1.t_time_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr1
      ON sr1.sr_item_sk = ss1.ss_item_sk
     AND sr1.sr_ticket_number = ss1.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN time_dim t_sr1
      ON sr1.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr1.t_time_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss2
      ON ss2.ss_item_sk = sr1.sr_item_sk
     AND ss2.ss_ticket_number = sr1.sr_ticket_number
     AND ss2.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sr1.t_time_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ss2
      ON ss2.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss2.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY w1.w_warehouse_name, t_cs1.t_hour
)
SELECT
    agg.w_warehouse_name,
    agg.t_hour,
    agg.total_sales,
    agg.distinct_orders,
    agg.avg_discount,
    agg.sum_iw_vals,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agg.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
        SELECT cs1.cs_order_number FROM catalog_sales cs1 WHERE cs1.cs_ext_sales_price > 500
        EXCEPT
        SELECT ss1.ss_ticket_number FROM store_sales ss1 WHERE ss1.ss_ext_sales_price > 500
    ) diff) AS diff_key_count
FROM agg_data agg
ORDER BY agg.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH demography AS (
    SELECT
        cd_demo_sk,
        cd_gender,
        cd_credit_rating,
        cd_purchase_estimate
    FROM customer_demographics
),

customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        dem.cd_demo_sk,
        dem.cd_gender,
        dem.cd_credit_rating,
        dem.cd_purchase_estimate
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN demography dem
        ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = dem.cd_demo_sk
),

store_sales_enh AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS order_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_demo_sk,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
        promo.p_promo_name
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customers c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN demography cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion promo
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = promo.p_promo_sk
),

catalog_sales_full AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cust.c_customer_id,
        cust.c_first_name,
        cust.c_last_name,
        dem.cd_demo_sk,
        dem.cd_gender,
        dem.cd_credit_rating,
        dem.cd_purchase_estimate,
        promo.p_promo_name
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    LEFT JOIN customers cust
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN demography dem
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = dem.cd_demo_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse wh
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion promo
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = promo.p_promo_sk
),

web_sales_enh AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        cust.c_customer_id,
        cust.c_first_name,
        cust.c_last_name,
        dem.cd_demo_sk,
        dem.cd_gender,
        dem.cd_credit_rating,
        dem.cd_purchase_estimate,
        promo.p_promo_name
    FROM web_sales ws
    LEFT JOIN customers cust
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN demography dem
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = dem.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse wh
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion promo
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = promo.p_promo_sk
),

all_sales AS (
    SELECT
        'store' AS sales_channel,
        ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        order_number,
        quantity,
        net_paid,
        net_profit,
        c_customer_id,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        cd_demo_sk,
        cd_gender,
        cd_credit_rating,
        cd_purchase_estimate,
        p_promo_name
    FROM store_sales_enh

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'catalog' AS sales_channel,
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs_order_number,
        cs_quantity,
        cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
        cs_net_profit,
        c_customer_id,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        cd_demo_sk,
        cd_gender,
        cd_credit_rating,
        cd_purchase_estimate,
        p_promo_name
    FROM catalog_sales_full

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'web' AS sales_channel,
        ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws_order_number,
        ws_quantity,
        ws_net_paid,
        ws_net_profit,
        c_customer_id,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        cd_demo_sk,
        cd_gender,
        cd_credit_rating,
        cd_purchase_estimate,
        p_promo_name
    FROM web_sales_enh
),

sales_with_words AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        w.word
    FROM all_sales a
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(COALESCE(a.p_promo_name, ''), ' ')) AS t(word)
)

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT DATE '2000-01-01' AS dt
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dt + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM date_seq
    WHERE dt < DATE '2000-01-07'
),
base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        p.p_promo_name,
        td.t_hour,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        c.c_customer_id,
        cc.cc_manager,
        cp.cp_department,
        dt.dt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_cs ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_cs.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r2 ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_seq dt ON cc.cc_rec_start_date <= dt.dt AND cc.cc_rec_end_date >= dt.dt
    WHERE
        cc.cc_manager = 'Miguel Bird'
        AND c.c_birth_month = 5
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_page wp
            WHERE wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
                AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
        )
)
SELECT
    s_store_name,
    s_state,
    p_promo_name,
    t_hour,
    dt,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) AS sum_store_net_profit,
    SUM(ws_net_profit) AS sum_web_net_profit,
    SUM(cs_net_profit) AS sum_catalog_net_profit,
    SUM(sr_net_loss) AS sum_store_return_loss,
    SUM(wr_net_loss) AS sum_web_return_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS uniq_customers,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY s_store_name
        ORDER BY (
            SUM(ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws_net_profit) + SUM(cs_net_profit)
            - COALESCE(SUM(sr_net_loss), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(wr_net_loss), 0)
        ) DESC
    ) AS profit_rank
FROM base_sales
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (s_store_name, s_state, p_promo_name, t_hour, dt),
    (s_store_name, p_promo_name, dt),
    (p_promo_name, dt),
    (dt)
)
ORDER BY (
    SUM(ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws_net_profit) + SUM(cs_net_profit)
    - COALESCE(SUM(sr_net_loss), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(wr_net_loss), 0)
) DESC,
    s_store_name,
    t_hour

WITH
  promo_details AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           p.p_promo_id,
           split(p.p_channel_details, ',') AS channel_arr
    FROM promotion p
