    WHERE p.p_channel_event = 'N'
  ),
  promo_channels AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pd.p_promo_sk,
                    pd.p_promo_id,
                    TRIM(cd.channel_detail) AS channel_detail
    FROM promo_details pd
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(pd.channel_arr) AS t(channel_detail)
  ),
  web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS event_date_sk,
           ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS event_time_sk,
           ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS amount,
           hd.hd_buy_potential,
           pc.channel_detail,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk ORDER BY ws.ws_ext_sales_price DESC) AS row_num
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promo_channels pc ON ws.ws_promo_sk = pc.p_promo_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE td.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
      AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 2000
  ),
  store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS event_date_sk,
           sr.sr_return_time_sk AS event_time_sk,
           -sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax AS amount,
           hd.hd_buy_potential,
           CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS channel_detail,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax ASC) AS row_num
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE td.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
      AND sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax > 500
  )
SELECT event_date_sk,
       event_time_sk,
       amount,
       hd_buy_potential,
       channel_detail,
       row_num
FROM web_sales_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT event_date_sk,
       event_time_sk,
       amount,
       hd_buy_potential,
       channel_detail,
       row_num
FROM store_returns_agg
ORDER BY event_date_sk, row_num

WITH inv_agg AS (
    SELECT inv_date_sk, MAX(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_qty
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_date_sk
),
sales_raw AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        d_sales.d_year,
        d_sales.d_month_seq,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cd_bill.cd_gender,
        inv_agg.max_qty AS max_inventory_qty_for_date,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        wp.wp_url,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_rank,
        CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_amt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_return_flag,
        (SELECT MAX(ii.inv_quantity_on_hand)
         FROM inventory ii
         WHERE ii.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
           AND ii.inv_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS max_inventory_for_item_on_date,
        cd_ret.cd_gender AS ret_gender
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sales
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sales
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
        ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN inv_agg
        ON inv_agg.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_return
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret
        ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_open
        ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_closed
        ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sales.d_year = 2001
)
SELECT
    sr.cc_name,
    sr.d_year,
    sr.d_month_seq,
    sr.cs_item_sk,
    SUM(sr.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(sr.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sr.cd_gender = 'M' THEN sr.cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS male_net_paid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sr.cd_gender = 'F' THEN sr.cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS female_net_paid,
    MAX(sr.max_inventory_qty_for_date) AS max_inventory_qty_for_date,
    MAX(sr.max_inventory_for_item_on_date) AS max_inventory_for_item_on_date,
    AVG(sr.net_paid_rank) AS avg_net_paid_rank,
    SUM(sr.has_return_flag) AS total_returns_flagged,
    CASE WHEN SUM(sr.cs_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category
FROM sales_raw sr
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_returns sr2
    WHERE sr2.sr_item_sk = sr.cs_item_sk
      AND sr2.sr_net_loss > 100
)
GROUP BY
    sr.cc_name,
    sr.d_year,
    sr.d_month_seq,
    sr.cs_item_sk
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH
  -- Aggregate store sales per promotion
  store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_promo_sk          AS promo_sk,
      SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)   AS store_net_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN store s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
      ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim td
      ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
      ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk
  ),

  -- Aggregate catalog sales per promotion
  catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      cs.cs_promo_sk          AS promo_sk,
      SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)   AS catalog_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN call_center cc
      ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
      ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
      ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim td
      ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_bill
      ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_ship
      ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND cp.cp_type = 'Online'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cs.cs_quantity >= 10
    GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk
  ),

  -- Aggregate web sales per promotion
  web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      ws.ws_promo_sk          AS promo_sk,
      SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)   AS web_net_profit,
      wsite.web_state,
      wp.wp_type
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN web_page wp
      ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    INNER JOIN web_site wsite
      ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
      ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim td
      ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_bill
      ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_ship
      ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    WHERE wsite.web_state = 'CA'
      AND wp.wp_type = 'content'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 5
    GROUP BY ws.ws_promo_sk
  ),

  -- Aggregate store returns per promotion (linked via ticket & item)
  store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_promo_sk          AS promo_sk,
      SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)    AS store_return_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    INNER JOIN store_sales ss
      ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
     AND sr.sr_item_sk       = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN store s
      ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
      ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim td
      ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
      ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk
  ),

  -- Aggregate catalog returns per promotion
  catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
      cs.cs_promo_sk          AS promo_sk,
      SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)     AS catalog_return_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs
      ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
     AND cr.cr_item_sk      = cs.cs_item_sk
    INNER JOIN call_center cc
      ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
      ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
      ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim td
      ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_refund
      ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refund.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_return
      ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17

WITH sales_agg AS (
  SELECT
    d_ss.d_year AS year,
    p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode_id,
    cc.cc_state AS call_center_state,
    ca.ca_state AS cust_state,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales_amount,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales_amount,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS store_returns_loss,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS web_returns_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_transactions
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d_ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
   AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
  JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
  WHERE d_ss.d_year = 2002
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    AND ss.ss_quantity > 1
    AND wsite.web_state = 'CA'
  GROUP BY d_ss.d_year, p.p_promo_id, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, cc.cc_state, ca.ca_state
)
SELECT
  year,
  promo_id,
  ship_mode_id,
  call_center_state,
  cust_state,
  store_sales_amount,
  web_sales_amount,
  (store_sales_amount + web_sales_amount) AS total_sales,
  (store_net_profit + web_net_profit) AS total_profit,
  (store_returns_loss + web_returns_loss) AS total_return_loss,
  ((store_sales_amount + web_sales_amount) - (store_returns_loss + web_returns_loss)) AS net_sales,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ss2.ss_customer_sk)
    FROM store_sales ss2
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p2 ON ss2.ss_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = sales_agg.year
      AND p2.p_promo_id = sales_agg.promo_id
  ) AS distinct_customers,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY ((store_sales_amount + web_sales_amount) - (store_returns_loss + web_returns_loss)) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY year, net_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '2023-01-31'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON d.d_date = dh.d_date - INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d.d_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
)
SELECT
    dh.d_date AS sale_date,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '@example\\.com$') THEN c.c_customer_sk END) AS example_com_customers,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) > 100000 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS sales_category,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) > 0 THEN 'InStock'
        ELSE 'OutOfStock'
    END AS inventory_status,
    MAX(regexp_extract(cp.cp_description, '(\\d{4})', 1)) AS extracted_year,
    MAX(CONCAT(cp.cp_department, '-', cp.cp_type)) AS dept_type_concat,
    MAX(substr(cp.cp_department, 1, 3)) AS dept_prefix,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0)
     FROM catalog_returns cr
     WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk) AS total_returns_amount,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    ) THEN 'HasReturn' ELSE 'NoReturn' END AS return_flag
FROM date_hierarchy dh
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
    AND cp.cp_type LIKE 'A%'
    AND regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '\\d{4}')
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
GROUP BY dh.d_date
ORDER BY dh.d_date DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS step, DATE '2023-01-01' AS cur_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT step + 1, cur_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM date_seq
    WHERE step < 5
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_color,
        cd.cd_gender,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_minute,
        w.web_name,
        w.web_city,
        w.web_market_manager,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_returned_time_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_site w
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451545 AND 2452555
      AND i.i_color IN ('purple', 'smoke')
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 18
      AND w.web_market_manager LIKE '%Smith%'
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 2
      AND t.t_hour IN (SELECT step FROM date_seq)
),
order_numbers_all AS (
    SELECT ws_order_number FROM filtered_sales
),
order_numbers_returned AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2451545 AND 2452555
),
order_numbers_not_returned AS (
    SELECT ws_order_number FROM order_numbers_all
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cr_order_number FROM order_numbers_returned
),
top_items_by_profit AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451545 AND 2452555
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk
    ORDER BY total_profit DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
top_items_by_quantity AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_qty
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451545 AND 2452555
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk
    ORDER BY total_qty DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
combined_top_items AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk FROM top_items_by_profit
    UNION
    SELECT ws_item_sk FROM top_items_by_quantity
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        fs.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fs.ws_item_sk ORDER BY fs.ws_net_paid DESC) AS rn_item_net_paid,
        SUM(fs.ws_net_paid) OVER (
            PARTITION BY fs.ws_item_sk
            ORDER BY fs.ws_sold_date_sk
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cum_net_paid,
        CASE
            WHEN fs.ws_net_profit > 0 THEN 'PROFIT'
            WHEN fs.ws_net_profit = 0 THEN 'BREAKEVEN'
            ELSE 'LOSS'
        END AS profit_flag
    FROM filtered_sales fs
)
SELECT
    rs.ws_order_number,
    rs.ws_sold_date_sk,
    rs.i_item_id,
    rs.i_color,
    rs.t_hour,
    rs.web_name,
    rs.web_city,
    rs.profit_flag,
    rs.rn_item_net_paid,
    rs.cum_net_paid,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_sales) AS total_filtered_sales,
    (SELECT AVG(ws.ws_net_paid) FROM web_sales ws WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451545 AND 2452555) AS avg_net_paid
FROM ranked_sales rs
WHERE rs.rn_item_net_paid <= 5
  AND rs.ws_order_number IN (SELECT ws_order_number FROM order_numbers_not_returned)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = rs.ws_order_number
    )
  AND rs.ws_item_sk IN (SELECT ws_item_sk FROM combined_top_items)
ORDER BY rs.cum_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_keys AS (
    SELECT MIN(t_time_sk) AS t_sk,
           MAX(t_time_sk) AS max_sk
    FROM time_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t_sk + 1, max_sk
    FROM time_keys
    WHERE t_sk < max_sk
),
intersect_items AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS i_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost > 2000.00
      AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk IN (SELECT t_sk FROM time_keys)
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost > 2000.00
      AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk IN (SELECT t_sk FROM time_keys)
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_sk,
    i.i_item_sk,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)               AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount)           AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid)                AS total_ws_net_paid,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amount)          AS total_wr_return_amount,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)                AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*)                           AS transaction_count,
    MIN(tp.t_hour)                     AS min_hour,
    MAX(tp.t_hour)                     AS max_hour
FROM time_dim tp
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = tp.t_time_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
JOIN reason rs ON rs.r_reason_sk = sr.sr_reason_sk
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = sr.sr_cdemo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = tp.t_time_sk
    AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND cr.cr_reason_sk = rs.r_reason_sk
    AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    AND cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk = tp.t_time_sk
    AND cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    AND cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
    AND cc.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
    AND sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cr.cr_ship_mode_sk
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = tp.t_time_sk
    AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = tp.t_time_sk
    AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    AND wr.wr_reason_sk = rs.r_reason_sk
    AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE c.c_last_review_date BETWEEN 2452292 AND 2452633
  AND cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost > 2000.00
  AND cr.cr_call_center_sk IN (2, 20, 34)
  AND i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM intersect_items)
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (c.c_customer_sk, i.i_item_sk),
    (c.c_customer_sk),
    (i.i_item_sk),
    ()
)
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 1000
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_ship_mode_sk,
        cr.cr_reason_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_returns wr
            WHERE wr.wr_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
      )
      AND cr.cr_order_number NOT IN (
            SELECT wr.wr_order_number
            FROM web_returns wr
      )
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name,
    CONCAT(cc.cc_city, ', ', cc.cc_state) AS call_center_location,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    ca.ca_zip,
    CASE
        WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count > 2 THEN 'High Vehicle'
        WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count = 2 THEN 'Medium Vehicle'
        ELSE 'Low Vehicle'
    END AS vehicle_category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
    SUM(fr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(fr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    AVG(fr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
    (SELECT AVG(cr3.cr_return_amount)
     FROM catalog_returns cr3
     WHERE cr3.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk) AS avg_return_amount_by_center,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(fr.cr_return_amount) > 10000 THEN 'High Value'
        ELSE 'Low Value'
    END AS return_value_category,
    SUBSTR(ca.ca_city, 1, 3) AS city_prefix,
    CASE
        WHEN regexp_like(r.r_reason_desc, '.*defect.*') THEN 'Defect'
        WHEN regexp_like(r.r_reason_desc, '.*damage.*') THEN 'Damage'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS reason_category
FROM filtered_returns fr
JOIN call_center cc ON fr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON fr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN reason r ON fr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON fr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON fr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
WHERE regexp_like(ca.ca_zip, '^9[0-9]{4}$')
  AND ca.ca_city LIKE '%town%'
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_city,
    cc.cc_state,
    sm.sm_type,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    ca.ca_zip,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    ca.ca_city
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE sales_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor member: store_sales with required dimensions
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_addr_sk AS addr_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number AS ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity AS quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_category = 'Women'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive member – limited to two levels to keep the recursion bounded
    SELECT
        sh.sold_date_sk,
        sh.sold_time_sk,
        sh.item_sk,
        sh.customer_sk,
        sh.cdemo_sk,
        sh.addr_sk,
        sh.store_sk,
        sh.promo_sk,
        sh.ticket_number,
        sh.quantity,
        sh.net_paid,
        sh.net_profit,
        lvl + 1
    FROM sales_hierarchy sh
    WHERE sh.lvl < 2
),
store_ret AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_return_time_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_category = 'Women'
),
web_ret AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk,
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_net_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_net_paid > 500
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    i.i_category,
    td.t_hour,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sh.ticket_number) AS store_order_cnt,
    SUM(sh.net_paid) AS store_total_net_paid,
    AVG(sh.net_profit) AS store_avg_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS catalog_total_discount,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS web_total_discount,
    COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt), 0) AS total_store_return_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_web_return_amount,
    MIN(i.i_current_price) AS min_item_price,
    MAX(i.i_current_price) AS max_item_price
FROM sales_hierarchy sh
JOIN store s ON sh.store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN item i ON sh.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim td ON sh.sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c ON sh.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON sh.addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sh.cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN promotion p ON sh.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = sh.sold_time_sk
    AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = sh.customer_sk
    AND cs.cs_item_sk = sh.item_sk
    AND cs.cs_promo_sk = sh.promo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = sh.sold_time_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = sh.customer_sk
    AND ws.ws_item_sk = sh.item_sk
    AND ws.ws_promo_sk = sh.promo_sk
FULL OUTER JOIN

WITH promo_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(p_cost) AS total_dmail_cost
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    p.p_promo_name,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    wp_sales.wp_type AS sales_page_type,
    wp_returns.wp_type AS return_page_type,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
    SUM(wr_order.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    MAX(l.avg_discount) AS avg_discount,
    pt.total_dmail_cost
FROM promotion p
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN warehouse w2 ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p2 ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
JOIN web_page wp_sales ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp_sales.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_page wp_extra ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp_extra.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_returns wr_order ON ws.ws_order_number = wr_order.wr_order_number
JOIN web_returns wr_item ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr_item.wr_item_sk
JOIN web_page wp_returns ON wr_order.wr_web_page_sk = wp_returns.wp_web_page_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM web_sales ws2
    WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
) AS l
CROSS JOIN (SELECT total_dmail_cost FROM promo_total) AS pt
WHERE
    p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
    AND wp_sales.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND wp_sales.wp_rec_end_date <= DATE '2022-12-31'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr_ex
        WHERE wr_ex.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
          AND wr_ex.wr_net_loss > 1000
    )
GROUP BY ROLLUP (p.p_promo_name, w.w_warehouse_name, wp_sales.wp_type)
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        p_start_date_sk,
        p_end_date_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS promo_cnt,
        SUM(p_cost) AS total_cost,
        AVG(p_cost) AS avg_cost
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_response_target = 1
      AND p_channel_radio = 'N'
      AND p_channel_details LIKE '%prizes%'
    GROUP BY p_start_date_sk, p_end_date_sk
),
date_closed AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_year,
        d_fy_quarter_seq,
        d_quarter_name,
        d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
date_start AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_year,
        d_fy_quarter_seq,
        d_quarter_name,
        d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_call_center_id,
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_state,
    dc.d_year AS closed_year,
    dc.d_quarter_name AS closed_quarter,
    ds.d_year AS start_year,
    pa.promo_cnt,
    pa.total_cost,
    pa.avg_cost,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dc.d_year ORDER BY pa.total_cost DESC) AS cost_rank_by_year,
    CASE
        WHEN cc.cc_employees > 1000 THEN 'Large'
        WHEN cc.cc_employees BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Small'
    END AS size_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dc.d_year ORDER BY cc.cc_employees DESC) AS employee_rn
FROM call_center cc
JOIN date_closed dc
    ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk
JOIN promo_agg pa
    ON pa.p_start_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk
JOIN date_start ds
    ON pa.p_end_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
WHERE cc.cc_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5.00 AND -3.00
  AND cc.cc_employees > 500
  AND cc.cc_country = 'United States'
ORDER BY dc.d_year DESC, cost_rank_by_year ASC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT
    c.cc_call_center_id,
    CONCAT(c.cc_city, ', ', c.cc_state) AS location,
    SUBSTR(c.cc_name, 1, 5) AS cc_name_prefix,
    CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN regexp_like(i.i_product_name, 'COCOA') THEN cs.cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS cocoa_sales,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid)
       FROM catalog_sales cs2
       WHERE cs2.cs_call_center_sk = c.cc_call_center_sk) AS avg_net_paid_per_cc,
    lc.product_code
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN call_center c
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = c.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN item i
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN time_dim t
    ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT regexp_extract(i.i_product_name, '[0-9]+', 1) AS product_code
) lc
WHERE regexp_like(c.cc_name, 'Center')
  AND c.cc_city LIKE 'A%'
  AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
  AND (i.i_product_name LIKE '%COCOA%' OR i.i_product_name LIKE '%CHOCOLATE%')
GROUP BY
    c.cc_call_center_id,
    c.cc_city,
    c.cc_state,
    SUBSTR(c.cc_name, 1, 5),
    CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END,
    lc.product_code
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > 100000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        ca.ca_city,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_rec_start_date,
        p.p_promo_name,
        time.t_hour
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN time_dim time ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = time.t_time_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '(?i)discount')
      AND ca.ca_city LIKE 'New%'
      AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)model')
      AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
),
aggregated_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.i_item_id,
        bs.i_item_desc,
        SUM(bs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(bs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(bs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount,
        promo_stats.distinct_promo_cnt,
        promo_extracted.promo_code
    FROM base_sales bs
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs2.cs_promo_sk) AS distinct_promo_cnt
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = bs.cs_item_sk
    ) AS promo_stats ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT regexp_extract(p_inner.p_promo_name, '(?i)(discount\s*\d+%?)', 1) AS promo_code
        FROM promotion p_inner
        WHERE p_inner.p_promo_sk = bs.cs_promo_sk
        FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
    ) AS promo_extracted ON TRUE
    GROUP BY 
        bs.i_item_id,
        bs.i_item_desc,
        promo_stats.distinct_promo_cnt,
        promo_extracted.promo_code
    HAVING SUM(bs.cs_net_profit) > (
        SELECT AVG(cs_net_profit) FROM catalog_sales
    )
)
SELECT 
    i_item_id,
    i_item_desc,
    CONCAT(SUBSTR(i_item_desc, 1, 20), '...') AS short_desc,
    total_quantity,
    total_net_profit,
    avg_discount_amount,
    distinct_promo_cnt,
    promo_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_item_id ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM aggregated_sales
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(ss_sold_date_sk) AS date_sk FROM store_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1 FROM date_range
    WHERE date_sk < (SELECT MIN(ss_sold_date_sk) + 30 FROM store_sales)
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    date_sk,
    item_sk,
    customer_sk,
    net_paid,
    profit_category,
    promo_name,
    gender,
    income_band_sk,
    avg_total_net_profit,
    row_num_customer
FROM (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid,
        CASE
            WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 1000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_customer_sk ORDER BY ss.ss_net_paid DESC) AS row_num_customer,
        (SELECT AVG(comb_profit) FROM (
            SELECT ss2.ss_net_profit AS comb_profit FROM store_sales ss2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT ws2.ws_net_profit FROM web_sales ws2
        ) AS profit_union) AS avg_total_net_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_range)
      AND ss.ss_quantity > 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid,
        CASE
            WHEN ws.ws_net_profit > 1000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN ws.ws_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY ws.ws_net_paid DESC) AS row_num_customer,
        (SELECT AVG(comb_profit) FROM (
            SELECT ss2.ss_net_profit AS comb_profit FROM store_sales ss2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT ws2.ws_net_profit FROM web_sales ws2
        ) AS profit_union) AS avg_total_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_range)
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 1
) combined
ORDER BY net_paid DESC, profit_category
LIMIT 100

WITH inv_agg AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk,
           SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand,
           COUNT(DISTINCT inv_warehouse_sk) AS warehouse_cnt
    FROM inventory
    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 600
    GROUP BY inv_item_sk
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department AS cp_department,
        i.i_brand AS i_brand,
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        cd.cd_gender AS cd_gender,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_sales,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(COALESCE(inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand, 0)) AS total_inventory_qty,
        SUM(i.i_current_price) AS sum_item_price
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN inv_agg ON i.i_item_sk = inv_agg.inv_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax > 6000
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
      AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'M'
      AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY cp.cp_department, i.i_brand, i.i_category, cd.cd_gender, sm.sm_type
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department AS cp_department,
        i.i_brand AS i_brand,
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        cd.cd_gender AS cd_gender,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_returns,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS return_order_cnt,
        SUM(COALESCE(inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand, 0)) AS total_inventory_qty
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN inv_agg ON i.i_item_sk = inv_agg.inv_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 100
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
      AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'M'
    GROUP BY cp.cp_department, i.i_brand, i.i_category, cd.cd_gender, sm.sm_type
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(s.cp_department, r.cp_department) AS department,
    COALESCE(s.i_brand, r.i_brand) AS brand,
    COALESCE(s.i_category, r.i_category) AS category,
    COALESCE(s.cd_gender, r.cd_gender) AS gender,
    COALESCE(s.ship_mode_type, r.ship_mode_type) AS ship_mode_type,
    COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
    COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS total_returns,
    COALESCE(s.order_cnt, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(r.return_order_cnt, 0) AS return_order_count,
    COALESCE(s.total_inventory_qty, r.total_inventory_qty) AS total_inventory_qty,
    (COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0)) AS net_sales,
    (
        SELECT MAX(p2.p_cost)
        FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_item_sk = (
            SELECT i2.i_item_sk
            FROM item i2
            WHERE i2.i_brand = COALESCE(s.i_brand, r.i_brand)
              AND i2.i_category = COALESCE(s.i_category, r.i_category)
            LIMIT 1
        )
    ) AS max_promo_cost,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM sales_agg s
FULL OUTER JOIN returns_agg r
    ON s.cp_department = r.cp_department
   AND s.i_brand = r.i_brand
   AND s.i_category = r.i_category
   AND s.cd_gender = r.cd_gender
   AND s.ship_mode_type = r.ship_mode_type
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE level_cte AS (
       SELECT 1 AS lvl
       UNION ALL
       SELECT lvl + 1 FROM level_cte WHERE lvl < 5
   ),
   customers_union AS (
       SELECT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS c_sk
       FROM catalog_returns cr
       WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cash > 500
       UNION ALL
       SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk
       FROM web_returns wr
       WHERE wr.wr_refunded_cash > 500
   ),
   per_reason AS (
       SELECT r.r_reason_desc,
              SUM(cr.cr_return_amount)          AS cat_return_amount,
              SUM(wr.wr_return_amt)            AS web_return_amount,
              COUNT(*)                         AS total_returns
       FROM catalog_returns cr
       JOIN customer cu ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = cu.c_customer_sk
       JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
       JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
       JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
       JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
       WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20000101 AND 20000131
         AND cr.cr_refunded_cash > 200
         AND cr.cr_reversed_charge < 150
         AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
         AND cd.cd_dep_college_count >= 2
         AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%defect%'
         AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
         AND wr.wr_refunded_cash > 150
         AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk IN (SELECT c_sk FROM customers_union)
       GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
   ),
   aggregated AS (
       SELECT pr.r_reason_desc,
              pr.cat_return_amount,
              pr.web_return_amount,
              pr.total_returns,
              (pr.cat_return_amount + pr.web_return_amount)               AS total_amount,
              (pr.cat_return_amount + pr.web_return_amount) / pr.total_returns AS avg_amount
       FROM per_reason pr
       WHERE (pr.cat_return_amount + pr.web_return_amount) > (
               SELECT AVG(total_amount)
               FROM (
                   SELECT SUM(cr2.cr_return_amount) + SUM(wr2.wr_return_amt) AS total_amount
                   FROM catalog_returns cr2
                   JOIN reason r2 ON cr2.cr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
                   JOIN web_returns wr2 ON wr2.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
                   GROUP BY r2.r_reason_sk
               ) t
           )
   )
SELECT a.r_reason_desc,
       a.total_returns,
       a.total_amount,
       a.avg_amount,
       l.lvl
FROM aggregated a
JOIN level_cte l ON l.lvl = MOD(HASH(a.r_reason_desc), 5) + 1
WHERE EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_page wp2
          WHERE wp2.wp_type = 'Content'
            AND wp2.wp_web_page_sk = (
                SELECT wr2.wr_web_page_sk
                FROM web_returns wr2
                WHERE wr2.wr_reason_sk = (
                        SELECT r2.r_reason_sk
                        FROM reason r2
                        WHERE r2.r_reason_desc = a.r_reason_desc
                    )
                LIMIT 1
            )
      )
ORDER BY a.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_profit) AS total_profit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost > 10
      AND ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 20 AND 200
      AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
      AND cd.cd_dep_count <= 2
    GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, cd.cd_gender, hd.hd_income_band_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) DESC) AS return_rank
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 5
      AND wr.wr_fee < 50
      AND cd.cd_dep_count <= 2
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = 'High'
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, cd.cd_gender, hd.hd_income_band_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        s.date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        s.gender,
        s.income_band_sk,
        s.total_sales,
        s.total_profit,
        s.sales_rank,
        r.total_return_amt,
        r.total_net_loss,
        r.return_rank
    FROM sales_agg s
    FULL OUTER JOIN returns_agg r
        ON s.date_sk = r.date_sk
        AND s.gender = r.gender
        AND s.income_band_sk = r.income_band_sk
)
SELECT
    sold_date_sk,
    gender,
    income_band_sk,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    total_return_amt,
    total_net_loss,
    sales_rank,
    return_rank,
    (COALESCE(total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(total_return_amt, 0)) AS net_sales_minus_returns
FROM combined
WHERE total_sales IS NOT NULL OR total_return_amt IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
    sold_date_sk,
    gender,
    income_band_sk,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    total_return_amt,
    total_net_loss,
    sales_rank,
    return_rank,
    (COALESCE(total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(total_return_amt, 0)) AS net_sales_minus_returns
FROM combined
WHERE gender = 'Female' AND total_sales > 10000
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS seq_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT seq_num + 1 FROM seq WHERE seq_num < 10
),
agg_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss_item_sk,
        ss_customer_sk,
        ss_addr_sk,
        ss_store_sk,
        ss_ticket_number,
        SUM(ss_net_paid)   AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*)           AS sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_ext_tax > 0.5
      AND ss_wholesale_cost > 5
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_addr_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_ticket_number
),
agg_store_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr_ticket_number,
        array_agg(r.r_reason_desc) AS reason_descs,
        SUM(sr_net_loss)   AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_store_credit > 10
    GROUP BY sr_ticket_number
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_net_profit DESC) AS global_rank,
    seq.seq_num,
    c.c_customer_id,
    ca.ca_address_id,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_current_price,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_country,
    ss.total_net_paid,
    ss.total_net_profit,
    ss.sales_cnt,
    sr.total_net_loss,
    sr.total_return_amt,
    r.reason_desc,
    ws.ws_net_paid,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    wp.wp_url,
    wp.wp_type
FROM seq
CROSS JOIN agg_store_sales ss
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN agg_store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(sr.reason_descs) AS r(reason_desc) ON true
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
   AND wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics'
  AND s.s_country = 'United States'
  AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
  AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 200
  AND ws.ws_net_paid > 500
  AND ss.total_net_profit > 1000
  AND (sr.total_net_loss IS NULL OR sr.total_net_loss < 2000)
ORDER BY global_rank
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT i.i_brand,
       i.i_category,
       i.i_item_id,
       hd.hd_income_band_sk,
       SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
       AVG(ss.ss_net_paid) AS avg_store_net_paid,
       SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_profit,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
       SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_quantity,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wr2.wr_return_amt), 0)
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND wr2.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk) AS total_return_amount
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    AND cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 50
  AND ss.ss_ext_discount_amt > 1000.00
  AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 250
  AND hd.hd_dep_count >= 3
  AND cs.cs_list_price > 100
GROUP BY i.i_brand, i.i_category, i.i_item_id, hd.hd_income_band_sk
ORDER BY total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_series AS (
    SELECT
        t_time_sk,
        t_time,
        t_hour,
        t_minute,
        t_second,
        t_shift
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_time = (SELECT MIN(t_time) FROM time_dim)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        td.t_time_sk,
        td.t_time,
        td.t_hour,
        td.t_minute,
        td.t_second,
        td.t_shift
    FROM time_series ts
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON td.t_time = ts.t_time + 1
    WHERE td.t_time <= (SELECT MIN(t_time) FROM time_dim) + 10
),

refunded_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_refunded.ca_city AS city,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_inc_tax,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_series ts
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_refunded
        ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
    WHERE ts.t_shift = 'first'
      AND ca_refunded.ca_city = 'Springfield'
    GROUP BY ca_refunded.ca_city
),

returning_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_returning.ca_city AS city,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_series ts
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_returning
        ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
    WHERE ts.t_shift = 'second'
      AND ca_returning.ca_city = 'Lakeview'
    GROUP BY ca_returning.ca_city
),

union_agg AS (
    SELECT
        city,
        total_return_inc_tax AS total_return,
        return_cnt,
        'refunded' AS address_type
    FROM refunded_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        city,
        total_return_amt AS total_return,
        return_cnt,
        'returning' AS address_type
    FROM returning_agg
),

fee_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.city AS city,
        SUM(wr.wr_fee) AS total_fee
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.city
)

SELECT
    ua.city,
    ua.address_type,
    ua.total_return,
    ua.return_cnt,
    fa.total_fee,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_returns wr2 WHERE wr2.wr_return_quantity > 20) AS high_qty_return_cnt
FROM union_agg ua
FULL OUTER JOIN fee_agg fa
    ON ua.city = fa.city
WHERE ua.city IS NOT NULL OR fa.city IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ua.city, ua.address_type
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ext_ship_cost,
        ws.ws_list_price,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        ws_site.web_company_name,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        t.t_hour
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim td_ret ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td_ret.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE hd.hd_dep_count = 1
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '501-1000'
      AND ws.ws_list_price > 100
      AND ws.ws_ext_ship_cost < 500
      AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND ws_site.web_company_name = 'anti'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 500
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_brand,
        web_company_name,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount
    FROM filtered_sales
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (i_category, i_brand, web_company_name),
        (i_category, i_brand),
        (i_category)
    )
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    i_brand,
    web_company_name,
    total_sales,
    avg_discount,
    distinct_orders,
    total_profit,
    total_return_amount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank_in_category
FROM agg_sales
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_year,
           d_month_seq
    FROM   date_dim
    WHERE  d_date = CURRENT_DATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk,
           d2.d_date,
           d2.d_year,
           d2.d_month_seq
    FROM   date_dim d2
    JOIN   date_hierarchy dh ON d2.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk - 1
    WHERE  d2.d_date_sk >= dh.d_date_sk - 30
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_city,
    CASE
        WHEN s.s_floor_space >= 20000 THEN 'Large'
        WHEN s.s_floor_space >= 10000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Small'
    END AS store_size_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id)                         AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(p.p_cost)                                           AS total_promo_cost,
    AVG(
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM   promotion p_sub
         WHERE  p_sub.p_start_date_sk = dh_promo_start.d_date_sk
                AND p_sub.p_promo_id = p.p_promo_id)
    )                                                       AS avg_promos_per_start_date,
    MIN(cp.cp_start_date_sk)                                AS earliest_catalog_start_sk,
    MAX(cp_end.cp_end_date_sk)                              AS latest_catalog_end_sk
FROM
    store s
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh_store_closed     ON s.s_closed_date_sk = dh_store_closed.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh_store_closed2    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = dh_store_closed2.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws                         ON ws.web_open_date_sk = dh_store_closed.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws2                        ON ws2.web_close_date_sk = dh_store_closed2.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp                     ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = dh_store_closed.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp_end                 ON cp_end.cp_end_date_sk = dh_store_closed2.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p                         ON p.p_start_date_sk = dh_store_closed.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p_end                     ON p_end.p_end_date_sk = dh_store_closed2.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c                         ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = dh_store_closed.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c_ship                    ON c_ship.c_first_shipto_date_sk = dh_store_closed2.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd           ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh_promo_start      ON p.p_start_date_sk = dh_promo_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh_promo_end        ON p_end.p_end_date_sk = dh_promo_end.d_date_sk
WHERE
    s.s_country = 'United States'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM   promotion p_anti
        WHERE  p_anti.p_promo_id = p.p_promo_id
               AND p_anti.p_start_date_sk = dh_store_closed.d_date_sk
               AND p_anti.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    )
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_city,
    CASE
        WHEN s.s_floor_space >= 20000 THEN 'Large'
        WHEN s.s_floor_space >= 10000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Small'
    END
ORDER BY
    total_promo_cost DESC,
    distinct_customers DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE offsets AS (
    SELECT 0 AS offset_val
    UNION ALL
    SELECT offset_val + 100 FROM offsets WHERE offset_val < 400
),
bill_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        CONCAT('Band ', CAST(ib.ib_income_band_sk AS VARCHAR)) AS band_label,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 5000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(ws.ws_sales_price AS VARCHAR), '(\\d+\\.\\d{2})') AS sales_price_str,
        MIN(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS lower_bound,
        MAX(ib.ib_upper_bound) AS upper_bound,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE hd.hd_buy_potential LIKE '%5000%'
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(CAST(ws.ws_sales_price AS VARCHAR), '^[3-5][0-9]\\.\\d{2}$')
    GROUP BY ib.ib_income_band_sk
),
ship_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        CONCAT('Band ', CAST(ib.ib_income_band_sk AS VARCHAR)) AS band_label,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 5000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(ws.ws_sales_price AS VARCHAR), '(\\d+\\.\\d{2})') AS sales_price_str,
        MIN(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS lower_bound,
        MAX(ib.ib_upper_bound) AS upper_bound,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE hd.hd_buy_potential LIKE '%1000%'
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(CAST(ws.ws_sales_price AS VARCHAR), '^6[0-9]\\.\\d{2}$')
    GROUP BY ib.ib_income_band_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM bill_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ship_sales
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT 
        band_label,
        total_sales,
        order_cnt,
        sales_category,
        sales_price_str,
        lower_bound,
        upper_bound,
        total_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rn
    FROM combined
),
paged AS (
    SELECT 
        n.band_label,
        n.total_sales,
        n.order_cnt,
        n.sales_category,
        n.sales_price_str,
        n.lower_bound,
        n.upper_bound,
        n.total_quantity,
        n.rn,
        o.offset_val
    FROM numbered n
    CROSS JOIN offsets o
    WHERE n.rn > o.offset_val AND n.rn <= o.offset_val + 100
)
SELECT 
    band_label,
    total_sales,
    order_cnt,
    sales_category,
    sales_price_str,
    CONCAT(CAST(lower_bound AS VARCHAR), '-', CAST(upper_bound AS VARCHAR)) AS income_range,
    total_quantity
FROM paged
WHERE offset_val = 0
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

)

        SELECT AVG(sr2.cr_return_amount)

JOIN warehouse w ON sr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-01-31'
  AND sr.cr_return_quantity > (
        SELECT AVG(sr3.cr_return_quantity)

SELECT

        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS amount_category,

    (

WITH base_sales AS (
   SELECT
     ss.ss_store_sk,
     td.t_sub_shift,
     sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
     sum(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
     count(*) AS sales_cnt,
     avg(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS avg_wholesale,
     map(
         array['quantity','list_price'],
         array[cast(ss.ss_quantity AS decimal(7,2)), ss.ss_list_price]
     ) AS metric_map
   FROM store_sales ss
   JOIN time_dim td
     ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
   WHERE
     td.t_sub_shift = 'morning'                                     -- predicate 1
     AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 6 AND 12                                 -- predicate 2
     AND td.t_second > 0                                            -- predicate 3
     AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost > 20.00                               -- predicate 4
     AND ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 5.00 AND 200.00                   -- predicate 5
     AND ss.ss_addr_sk IN (1272622, 1528940, 1563266)                -- predicate 6
     AND ss.ss_quantity >= 1                                        -- predicate 7
   GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, td.t_sub_shift
),
expanded_metrics AS (
   SELECT
     bs.ss_store_sk,
     bs.t_sub_shift,
     m.metric_name,
     m.metric_value
   FROM base_sales bs
   CROSS JOIN UNNEST(bs.metric_map) AS m(metric_name, metric_value)
),
filtered_sales AS (
   SELECT *
   FROM base_sales bs
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM store_sales ss2
      WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = bs.ss_store_sk
        AND ss2.ss_wholesale_cost > 500.00
   )
)
SELECT
   fs.t_sub_shift AS shift,
   avg(fs.total_sales) AS avg_sales_per_store,
   sum(fs.total_profit) AS total_profit_all,
   count(*) AS store_count,
   sum(em.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE em.metric_name = 'list_price') AS total_list_price_metric,
   (SELECT count(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_wholesale_cost > 50) AS high_wholesale_store_sales
FROM filtered_sales fs
LEFT JOIN expanded_metrics em
  ON fs.ss_store_sk = em.ss_store_sk
 AND fs.t_sub_shift = em.t_sub_shift
GROUP BY fs.t_sub_shift
HAVING avg(fs.total_sales) > 1000.0
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_store DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH per_day_gender AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        COALESCE(cd.cd_gender, cd_ws.cd_gender) AS gender,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    FULL OUTER JOIN date_dim d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year >= 1998
        AND d.d_year <= 2000
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 5
        AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate > 500
        AND cd_ws.cd_purchase_estimate > 500
        AND (r.r_reason_desc IS NULL OR r.r_reason_desc <> 'Lost my job')
    GROUP BY
        d.d_date,
        COALESCE(cd.cd_gender, cd_ws.cd_gender)
)
SELECT
    d_date,
    gender,
    catalog_net_profit,
    web_net_profit,
    total_return_loss,
    (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit - total_return_loss) AS net_profit_adj,
    CASE
        WHEN (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE total_return_loss / (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit)
    END AS loss_ratio
FROM per_day_gender
WHERE
    (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit - total_return_loss) > (
        SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_paid)
        FROM web_sales ws2
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr2
        JOIN reason r2 ON wr2.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
        WHERE wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = (
            SELECT d3.d_date_sk
            FROM date_dim d3
            WHERE d3.d_date = per_day_gender.d_date
        )
        AND r2.r_reason_desc = 'Lost my job'
    )
ORDER BY net_profit_adj DESC, loss_ratio ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (

WITH
base AS (
   SELECT
     s.s_store_name,
     d.d_year,
     r.r_reason_desc,
     d.d_date_sk,
     cr.cr_return_amount,
     sr.sr_return_amt,
     wr.wr_return_amt,
     inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
     t.t_hour,
     ca.ca_state,
     sr.sr_return_quantity
   FROM store_returns sr
   JOIN date_dim d
     ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   JOIN time_dim t
     ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
   JOIN store s
     ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   JOIN reason r
     ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
   JOIN customer_address ca
     ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
     ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
   LEFT JOIN reason r_cr
     ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
   LEFT JOIN inventory inv
     ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
     ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
   LEFT JOIN reason r_wr
     ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
   LEFT JOIN web_page wp
     ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
   WHERE
     d.d_year = 2001
     AND s.s_state = 'CA'
     AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
     AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
     AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
     AND r.r_reason_id = 'AAAAAAAABAAAAAAA'
     AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
     AND (cr.cr_return_amount IS NULL OR cr.cr_return_amount > 10)
),
aggregated AS (
   SELECT
     s_store_name,
     d_year,
     reason_desc,
     d_date_sk,
     SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount,0) + COALESCE(sr_return_amt,0) + COALESCE(wr_return_amt,0)) AS total_return_amount,
     COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
   FROM base
   GROUP BY CUBE(s_store_name, d_year, reason_desc, d_date_sk)
),
ranked AS (
   SELECT
     s_store_name,
     d_year,
     reason_desc,
     d_date_sk,
     total_return_amount,
     return_cnt,
     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_name ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS rn,
     CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category,
     (SELECT SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) FROM inventory i WHERE i.inv_date_sk = d_date_sk) AS total_inventory_for_date
   FROM aggregated
)
SELECT *
FROM (
   SELECT
     s_store_name,
     d_year,
     reason_desc,
     total_return_amount,
     return_category,
     rn,
     total_inventory_for_date
   FROM ranked
   WHERE rn <= 10
   EXCEPT
   SELECT
     s_store_name,
     d_year,
     reason_desc,
     total_return_amount,
     return_category,

),
agg_per_customer AS (

    FROM base_join bj

),
filtered_customers AS (

union_set AS (
