intersect_items AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS i_item_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 50
    INTERSECT
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 50
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.c_customer_sk,
    u.total_transactions,
    u.total_net_paid,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_paid)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = u.c_customer_sk
    ) AS avg_customer_net_paid,
    i.i_class,
    i.i_current_price
FROM union_set u
JOIN intersect_items it
    ON it.i_item_sk = (
        SELECT ss3.ss_item_sk
        FROM store_sales ss3
        WHERE ss3.ss_customer_sk = u.c_customer_sk
        LIMIT 1
    )
JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = it.i_item_sk
ORDER BY u.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
  store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_customer_id
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  ),
  web_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_customer_id
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  ),
  store_not_web_customers AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id FROM store_customers
    EXCEPT
    SELECT c_customer_id FROM web_customers
  ),
  agg_data AS (
    SELECT
      d.d_year,
      i.i_brand,
      CASE WHEN i.i_current_price > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS price_category,
      r.r_reason_desc,
      SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS sum_store_return_amount,
      SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS sum_catalog_return_amount,
      SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS sum_web_return_amount,
      SUM(sr.sr_net_loss + cr.cr_net_loss + wr.wr_net_loss) AS sum_total_net_loss,
      SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS sum_sr_return_inc_tax,
      COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
               AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
               AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                   AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                   AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
                AND cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
                AND wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND i.i_current_price > 75
      AND c.c_birth_country = 'MONACO'
      AND c.c_customer_id IN (SELECT c_customer_id FROM store_not_web_customers)
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (
      d.d_year,
      i.i_brand,
      CASE WHEN i.i_current_price > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END,
      r.r_reason_desc
    )
    HAVING SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 0
  )
SELECT
  d_year,
  i_brand,
  price_category,
  r_reason_desc,
  sum_store_return_amount,
  sum_catalog_return_amount,
  sum_web_return_amount,
  sum_total_net_loss,
  distinct_customers,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY sum_store_return_amount DESC) AS rn_by_year,
  SUM(sum_sr_return_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY d_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_store_return_inc_tax
FROM agg_data
ORDER BY d_year DESC, i_brand, sum_store_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_without_returns AS (
   SELECT ss_ticket_number
   FROM store_sales
   EXCEPT
   SELECT sr_ticket_number
   FROM store_returns
),
aggregated AS (
   SELECT
       d1.d_year AS d_year,
       s.s_store_name AS s_store_name,
       p1.p_promo_name AS p_promo_name,
       r1.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc,
       SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_returns,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
       SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_sales_orders,
       (
           SELECT AVG(p2.p_cost)
           FROM promotion p2
           WHERE p2.p_start_date_sk <= d1.d_date_sk
             AND p2.p_end_date_sk >= d1.d_date_sk
       ) AS avg_active_promo_cost,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_without_returns) AS sales_without_returns_count,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr_check WHERE wr_check.wr_reason_sk = r1.r_reason_sk
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_web_return_reason
   FROM date_dim d1
   INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
   INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   INNER JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   INNER JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
   INNER JOIN reason r1 ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r1.r_reason_sk
   INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
   INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
   INNER JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   INNER JOIN reason r2 ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
   INNER JOIN promotion p1 ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p1.p_promo_sk
   INNER JOIN warehouse w1 ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w1.w_warehouse_sk
   INNER JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
   INNER JOIN promotion p2 ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
   INNER JOIN warehouse w2 ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
   INNER JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
   INNER JOIN reason r3 ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r3.r_reason_sk
   GROUP BY d1.d_year, s.s_store_name, p1.p_promo_name, r1.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    s_store_name,
    p_promo_name,
    r_reason_desc,
    total_store_sales,
    total_store_returns,
    total_catalog_sales,
    total_web_sales,
    store_sales_orders,
    avg_active_promo_cost,
    sales_without_returns_count,
    has_web_return_reason,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_name ORDER BY total_store_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_name,
        i.i_category,
        tp1.t_hour,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS catalog_sales_ext_sales,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS store_sales_net_paid,
        sr.sr_refunded_cash AS store_return_refunded,
        wr.wr_refunded_cash AS web_return_refunded,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS catalog_net_profit,
        ss.ss_ticket_number
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim tp1 ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = tp1.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim tp2 ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = tp2.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                     AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 1
      AND c.c_birth_month IN (1, 5, 7)
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 500
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND tp1.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 18
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_name,
        i_category,
        t_hour,
        SUM(catalog_sales_ext_sales) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(store_sales_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(store_return_refunded, 0) + COALESCE(web_return_refunded, 0)) AS total_returns,
        SUM(catalog_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number) AS ticket_numbers
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(s_store_name, i_category, t_hour)
)
SELECT
    s_store_name,
    i_category,
    t_hour,
    total_catalog_sales,
    total_store_sales,
    total_returns,
    total_profit,
    tn AS ticket_number,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_name ORDER BY total_store_sales DESC) AS store_sales_rank,
    GROUPING_ID(s_store_name, i_category, t_hour) AS grp_id
FROM agg
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ticket_numbers) AS t(tn)
ORDER BY grp_id, total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department AS cp_department,
        sm1.sm_type AS sm_type,
        hd_store.hd_vehicle_count AS hd_vehicle_count,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_sales_profit,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_return_loss,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_sales_profit,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_return_loss
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm1
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm1.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_catalog
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_catalog.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN reason r_cr
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_cr_refunded
        ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_refunded.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_cr_returning
        ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_returning.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_refunded.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_store
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_store.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN reason r_sr
        ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_sr
        ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_store.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ws_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_ship.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm2
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_web
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_web.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    JOIN reason r_wr
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_refunded
        ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_refunded.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_returning
        ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_returning.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp2
        ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp2.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_web.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (cp.cp_department, sm1.sm_type, hd_store.hd_vehicle_count)
)
SELECT
    cp_department,
    sm_type,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    total_store_sales_profit,
    total_store_return_loss,
    total_catalog_return_loss,
    total_web_sales_profit,
    total_web_return_loss,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_store_sales_profit DESC) AS rn_sales_profit,
    (SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_profit) FROM store_sales ss2) AS avg_store_net_profit
FROM base_agg
ORDER BY total_store_sales_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH intersect_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number AS order_number
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 500
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 1
      AND cr.cr_return_tax > 10
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number AS order_number
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 1000
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 2
      AND ws.ws_coupon_amt < 50
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_state,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        cp.cp_type,
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_amount,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        ca_refunded.ca_state,
        cd_refunded.cd_gender
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
),
filtered_data AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM joined_data jd
    WHERE jd.cr_order_number IN (SELECT order_number FROM intersect_orders)
       OR jd.ws_order_number IN (SELECT order_number FROM intersect_orders)
),
agg_by_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        w_warehouse_name,
        p_promo_name,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr_refunded_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM filtered_data
    GROUP BY d_year, w_warehouse_name, p_promo_name
),
final_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        AVG(total_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
        SUM(total_return_amount) AS sum_return_amount,
        SUM(total_net_profit) AS sum_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT w_warehouse_name) AS warehouse_count
    FROM agg_by_warehouse
    GROUP BY d_year
    HAVING AVG(total_net_loss) > 1500
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    avg_net_loss,
    sum_return_amount,
    sum_net_profit,
    warehouse_count
FROM final_agg
ORDER BY sum_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH distinct_promos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
),
base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_promo_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 0
)
SELECT
    we.web_name,
    cc.cc_division_name,
    d_sales.d_year,
    t_sales.t_hour,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_web_return_amount,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cr2.cr_return_amount), 0)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number) AS catalog_return_per_order,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY we.web_name ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Unprofitable' END AS profit_status
FROM base_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d_sales ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sales ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk
JOIN distinct_promos p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk
    AND cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk
    AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_refund ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refund.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_ship ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_ship.cd_demo_sk
WHERE d_sales.d_year = 2002
  AND t_sales.t_am_pm = 'PM'
  AND cc.cc_manager = 'Bob Belcher'
  AND we.web_state = 'CA'
  AND cp.cp_department = 'Sports'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2 WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number)
GROUP BY ROLLUP (we.web_name, cc.cc_division_name, d_sales.d_year, t_sales.t_hour, p.p_promo_name)
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS level
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, dr.level + 1
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE dr.level < 30
),
sales_per_customer AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_email_address,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status,
        MAX(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(sm.sm_contract, '^A.*') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contract_starts_with_A,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_promo_sk) AS distinct_promos,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_promo_name) AS promo_names
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_range dr ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE dr.level <= 30
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(sm.sm_contract, '^A.*')
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_email_address
),
returns_per_customer AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return,
        CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 0 THEN 'Has Returns' ELSE 'No Returns' END AS return_status,
        MAX(s.s_store_name) AS store_name
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_range dr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE dr.level <= 30
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id
),
union_customers AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id FROM sales_per_customer
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_id FROM returns_per_customer
),

WITH active_orders AS (

    ON cust_returning.c_customer_sk = pc.c_customer_sk

INNER JOIN household_demographics hd

    ON ssa.ss_customer_sk = pc.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales_agg wsa
    ON wsa.ws_customer_sk = pc.c_customer_sk

        JOIN item_excl ie ON i.i_item_id = ie.i_item_id
        JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
          AND cc.cc_city = 'Glendale'
          AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
          AND w.w_city = 'Seattle'
          AND ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax > 1000
          AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM ship_mode sm
              WHERE sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = ws.ws_ship_mode_sk
                AND sm.sm_carrier = 'FedEx'
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM store_returns sr
              WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
                AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          )
        GROUP BY
            c.c_customer_sk,
            c.c_customer_id,
            i.i_item_sk,
            i.i_item_id,
            i.i_product_name,
            cc.cc_city,
            w.w_warehouse_sk,
            w.w_warehouse_name,
            p.p_promo_name,
            ib.ib_lower_bound,
            ib.ib_upper_bound
    )
SELECT
    ad.c_customer_id,
    ad.i_item_id,
    ad.i_product_name,
    ad.cc_city,
    si.s_store_name,
    si.s_state,
    ad.w_warehouse_name,
    ad.p_promo_name,
    (
        SELECT sm.sm_carrier
        FROM ship_mode sm
        WHERE sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = (
            SELECT ws2.ws_ship_mode_sk
            FROM web_sales ws2
            WHERE ws2.ws_item_sk = ad.i_item_sk
              AND ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = ad.c_customer_sk
            LIMIT 1
        )
    ) AS ship_carrier,
    ad.ib_lower_bound,
    ad.ib_upper_bound,
    ad.order_cnt,
    ad.total_sales,
    ad.avg_sales,
    ad.min_sales,
    ad.max_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad.c_customer_id ORDER BY ad.total_sales DESC) AS rn
FROM agg_data ad
LEFT JOIN store_info si
    ON si.sr_customer_sk = ad.c_customer_sk
   AND si.sr_item_sk = ad.i_item_sk
WHERE ad.order_cnt > 1
ORDER BY ad.total_sales DESC, ad.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100

WITH
    inventory_agg AS (
        SELECT
            inv_warehouse_sk,
            SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_quantity
        FROM inventory
        GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk
    ),

    cat_sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            cs.cs_order_number,
            cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
            c.c_customer_id,
            cp.cp_department,
            w.w_warehouse_name,
            sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
            SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_sales_amount,
            COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
            SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
            COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS distinct_return_dates
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN catalog_page cp
            ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN customer c
            ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm
            ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN warehouse w
            ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
            ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        JOIN customer_address ca
            ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd
            ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd
            ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        WHERE cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship > 5000
          AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'

          AND (cr.cr_return_amount IS NULL OR cr.cr_return_amount > 200)
        GROUP BY
            cs.cs_order_number,

    ),

    web_sales_agg AS (
        SELECT

            ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
            c.c_customer_id,
            wp.wp_type AS department_or_type,
            w.w_warehouse_name,
            sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
            SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_sales_amount,
            COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
            SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
            COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_returned_date_sk) AS distinct_return_dates
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN web_page wp
            ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        JOIN customer c
            ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm
            ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN warehouse w
            ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
            ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        JOIN customer_address ca
            ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd
            ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd
            ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        WHERE ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship > 3000
          AND wp.wp_type = 'Product'
          AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate > 2500
          AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
          AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
          AND (wr.wr_return_amt IS NULL OR wr.wr_return_amt > 100)
        GROUP BY
            ws.ws_order_number,
            ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
            c.c_customer_id,
            wp.wp_type,
            w.w_warehouse_name,
            sm.sm_type
    ),

    combined_sales AS (
        SELECT
            cs_order_number AS order_number,
            cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_sk,
            c_customer_id,
            cp_department AS department_or_type,
            w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
            ship_mode_type,
            total_sales_amount,
            distinct_items,
            total_return_amount,

WITH distinct_categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i_category
    FROM item
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_sales.d_year AS d_year,
        d_sales.d_month_seq AS d_month_seq,
        i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_current_price,
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca.ca_country,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_coupon_amt,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        s.s_store_id,
        web.web_site_id,
        cp.cp_type,
        CASE WHEN ws.ws_sales_price >= 30 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS price_category,
        latest_promo.latest_promo_name
    FROM web_sales ws
    RIGHT JOIN date_dim d_sales
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site web
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = web.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p2.p_promo_name AS latest_promo_name
        FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND p2.p_start_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
        ORDER BY p2.p_start_date_sk DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS latest_promo
    JOIN distinct_categories dc
        ON i.i_category = dc.i_category
    WHERE
        d_sales.d_year = 2002
        AND i.i_current_price > 20.00
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
        AND ws.ws_quantity >= 2
        AND web.web_state = 'CA'
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM promotion p3
            WHERE p3.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
              AND p3.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        )
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        i_category,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i_item_id) AS distinct_items_sold,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        MAX(ws_net_paid) AS max_net_paid,
        MIN(ws_coupon_amt) AS min_coupon_amt,
        price_category,
        latest_promo_name,
        MAX(cp_type) AS catalog_type,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq
                                     ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_sales_by_category
    FROM sales_agg
    GROUP BY
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        i_category,
        price_category,
        latest_promo_name
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    i_category,
    distinct_items_sold,
    total_sales,
    avg_sales_price,
    max_net_paid,
    min_coupon_amt,
    price_category,
    latest_promo_name,
    catalog_type,
    running_total_sales_by_category
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_per_customer AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        w.w_state,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE 
            WHEN ib.ib_upper_bound < 30000 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN ib.ib_upper_bound < 80000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS income_category
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE w.w_state = 'CA'
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 20000
      AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 1000
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = 'High'
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, w.w_state, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    w_state,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    income_category,
    SUM(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY w_state ORDER BY total_sales ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales_by_state,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w_state ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM sales_per_customer
ORDER BY w_state, profit_rank
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH customer_returns AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_birth_year,
        c.c_first_sales_date_sk,
        COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS store_net_loss,
        COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS web_net_loss,
        ARRAY_AGG(
            ROW(
                sr.sr_item_sk,
                sr.sr_return_quantity,
                sr.sr_return_amt
            )
        ) AS store_return_items
    FROM tpcds.customer c
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_country IN ('MONACO', 'IRELAND', 'NEW ZEALAND', 'BHUTAN')
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1965
      AND sr.sr_return_amt > 100
      AND wr.wr_return_amt > 100
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_birth_year,
        c.c_first_sales_date_sk
)

SELECT
    cr.c_customer_id,
    cr.c_birth_country,
    cr.c_birth_year,
    cr.store_net_loss,
    cr.web_net_loss,
    (cr.store_net_loss + cr.web_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN (cr.store_net_loss + cr.web_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS'
        WHEN (cr.store_net_loss + cr.web_net_loss) > 2000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS'
        ELSE 'LOW_LOSS'
    END AS loss_category,
    r.rank_in_country,
    ri.item_sk,
    ri.return_quantity,
    ri.return_amount
FROM customer_returns cr
JOIN (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c_birth_country ORDER BY (store_net_loss + web_net_loss) DESC) AS rank_in_country
    FROM customer_returns
) r
    ON r.c_customer_sk = cr.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(cr.store_return_items) AS ri(item_sk, return_quantity, return_amount)
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tpcds.store_returns sr2
    WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = cr.c_customer_sk
      AND sr2.sr_store_credit > 500
)
ORDER BY cr.c_birth_country, total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH aggregated_catalog AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS metric_value
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_type = 'B'
      AND d.d_holiday = 'N'
    GROUP BY d.d_year
),
catalog_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        'catalog' AS source_type,
        year,
        metric_value,
        CASE WHEN metric_value > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Non-positive' END AS profit_flag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY metric_value DESC) AS rn
    FROM aggregated_catalog
),
aggregated_web AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        CAST(SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS double) AS metric_value
    FROM web_page wp
    JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
      AND d.d_holiday = 'N'
    GROUP BY d.d_year
),
web_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        'web' AS source_type,
        year,
        metric_value,
        CASE WHEN metric_value > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Non-positive' END AS profit_flag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY metric_value DESC) AS rn
    FROM aggregated_web
),
unioned AS (
    SELECT source_type, year, metric_value, profit_flag, rn FROM catalog_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT source_type, year, metric_value, profit_flag, rn FROM web_metrics
),
final_with_lateral AS (
    SELECT
        u.source_type,
        u.year,
        u.metric_value,
        u.profit_flag,
        u.rn,
        lt.max_date
    FROM unioned u
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT max(d_date) AS max_date
        FROM date_dim d
        WHERE d.d_year = u.year
    ) lt
)
SELECT source_type,
       year,
       metric_value,
       profit_flag,
       max_date
FROM final_with_lateral
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY year DESC, metric_value DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        ca.ca_state,
        cd.cd_gender,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_txn_count,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_return_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 1000 THEN 'High Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
           AND wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity >= 50
      AND p.p_channel_press = 'Y'
      AND p.p_start_date_sk BETWEEN 2450300 AND 2450700
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY')
      AND wr.wr_fee > 10
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        ca.ca_state,
        cd.cd_gender
)
SELECT
    s.c_customer_id,
    s.c_first_name,
    s.c_last_name,
    s.ca_state,
    s.cd_gender,
    s.store_txn_count,
    s.total_net_paid,
    s.total_net_profit,
    s.total_return_amount,
    s.profit_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.ca_state ORDER BY s.total_net_profit DESC) AS state_profit_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(wr_sub.wr_return_amt)
     FROM web_returns wr_sub
     WHERE wr_sub.wr_refunded_customer_sk = s.c_customer_sk) AS avg_refunded_return_amt
FROM sales_agg s
ORDER BY state_profit_rank ASC, s.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS rn
    UNION ALL
    SELECT rn + 1
    FROM seq
    WHERE rn < 10
),
all_returns AS (
    SELECT sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
           sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
           sr_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk,
           sr_net_loss AS net_loss,
           sr_return_quantity AS return_qty
    FROM store_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
           wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
           wr_refunded_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk,
           wr_net_loss AS net_loss,
           wr_return_quantity AS return_qty
    FROM web_returns
),
item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_product_name,
           i.i_item_desc,
           i.i_brand,
           i.i_category,
           CONCAT(i.i_brand, '-', i.i_category) AS brand_category,
           SUBSTRING(i.i_product_name, 1, 7) AS product_prefix,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(i.i_item_id, '[0-9]+') AS item_id_numeric
    FROM item i
    WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_item_desc, '\\d{3}')
      AND i.i_product_name LIKE '%Premium%'
),
agg_returns AS (
    SELECT 
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.brand_category,
        i.product_prefix,
        i.item_id_numeric,
        SUM(ar.net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(ar.return_qty) AS total_return_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ar.cdemo_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(*) AS total_return_rows
    FROM all_returns ar
    JOIN item_filtered i
        ON ar.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ar.cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_education_status LIKE 'Advanced%'
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(cd.cd_credit_rating, '^A[0-9]')
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.brand_category, i.product_prefix, i.item_id_numeric
    HAVING SUM(ar.net_loss) > (SELECT AVG(net_loss) FROM all_returns) * 1.5
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ar.*, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ar.total_net_loss DESC) AS rn
    FROM agg_returns ar
),
final AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        r.brand_category,
        r.product_prefix,
        r.item_id_numeric,
        r.total_net_loss,
        r.total_return_qty,
        r.distinct_customers
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN seq s
        ON r.rn = s.rn
)
SELECT 
    brand_category,
    product_prefix,
    item_id_numeric,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_qty,
    distinct_customers
FROM final
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
OFFSET 0
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        d.d_year,
        cc.cc_state,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        p.p_channel_email
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
      AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%size%'
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    i_category,
    i_brand,
    SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
    SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_quantity,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS total_return_amount,
    CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_quantity, 0)) > 0 THEN 'RETURNED' ELSE 'NO_RETURN' END AS return_flag,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY SUM(cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank_within_category
FROM sales_data
JOIN item i ON sales_data.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON sales_data.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN promotion p ON sales_data.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_category, i_brand
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
OFFSET 0
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT MIN(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy
    WHERE date_sk + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) FROM catalog_sales cs)
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 3000
      AND cd.cd_dep_count <= 3
    GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd.cd_dep_employed_count >= 1
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk
),
full_agg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ca.date_sk, wa.date_sk) AS date_sk,
        ca.distinct_orders AS catalog_distinct_orders,
        wa.distinct_orders AS web_distinct_orders,
        ca.total_sales AS catalog_total_sales,
        wa.total_sales AS web_total_sales,
        ca.total_profit AS catalog_total_profit,
        wa.total_profit AS web_total_profit
    FROM catalog_agg ca
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_agg wa
      ON ca.date_sk = wa.date_sk
),
per_date AS (
    SELECT
        dh.date_sk,
        COALESCE(fa.catalog_distinct_orders, 0) + COALESCE(fa.web_distinct_orders, 0) AS total_distinct_orders,
        COALESCE(fa.catalog_total_sales, 0) + COALESCE(fa.web_total_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
        COALESCE(fa.catalog_total_profit, 0) + COALESCE(fa.web_total_profit, 0) AS total_profit
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    LEFT JOIN full_agg fa ON dh.date_sk = fa.date_sk
),
combined_summary AS (
    SELECT
        -1 AS date_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS total_distinct_orders,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_purchase_estimate > 4000

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        -2 AS date_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS total_distinct_orders,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_purchase_estimate > 4000
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    result.date_sk,
    result.total_distinct_orders,
    result.total_sales,
    result.total_profit
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM per_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM combined_summary
) AS result
ORDER BY result.date_sk

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS level
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2023-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk,
           d_next.d_date,
           dh.level + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d_next
      ON d_next.d_date = DATE_ADD('day', -1, dh.d_date)
    WHERE dh.level < 7
),

inventory_warehouse_date AS (
    SELECT inv.inv_warehouse_sk,
           inv.inv_date_sk,
           inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
           d.d_date,
           w.w_warehouse_name
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
),

inventory_summary AS (
    SELECT inv_warehouse_sk,
           SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk
),

return_union AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS w_warehouse_sk,
           cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS d_date_sk,
           cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss,
           cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
           'catalog' AS return_type
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
           wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
           wr.wr_net_loss,
           wr.wr_return_quantity,
           'web' AS return_type
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
     AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
)
SELECT
    d_sales.d_date AS sale_date,
    w_ws.w_warehouse_name,
    s.s_store_name,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(ru.net_loss, 0)) AS total_net_loss,
    SUM(COALESCE(isum.total_qty_on_hand, 0)) AS total_inventory_qty,
    SUM(COALESCE(iwd.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0)) AS sum_qty_by_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ru.return_type) AS distinct_return_types,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_paid_inc_tax)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    ) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d_sales
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship
  ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN warehouse w_ws
  ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN return_union ru
  ON ru.w_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
 AND ru.d_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory_summary isum
  ON isum.w_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN date_hierarchy dh
  ON dh.d_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory_warehouse_date iwd
  ON iwd.inv_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
 AND iwd.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
WHERE dh.level IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ROLLUP(d_sales.d_date, w_ws.w_warehouse_name, s.s_store_name)
ORDER BY d_sales.d_date DESC,
         w_ws.w_warehouse_name ASC
LIMIT 100

/* goal: Summarize net profit and related metrics by call center, promotion, ship mode, and catalog department for the year 2000, applying realistic filters, ranking, and window calculations. */
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        d1.d_year,
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_country,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sm.sm_type,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_type,
        wp.wp_link_count,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        we.web_site_id,
        we.web_country,
        c.c_customer_id,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cs
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    WHERE d1.d_year = 2000
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND cc.cc_country = 'USA'
      AND cp.cp_department = 'Books'
      AND wp.wp_link_count > 20
      AND cs.cs_order_number IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT cr2.cr_order_number
          FROM catalog_returns cr2
          WHERE cr2.cr_return_quantity > 0
      )
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        cc_call_center_id,
        p_promo_id,
        sm_ship_mode_id,
        cp_department,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_cs_net_paid,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_ws_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        AVG(cs_net_profit) AS avg_cs_net_profit,
        SUM(cs_net_profit + ws_net_profit) AS total_combined_profit,
        MIN(cs_net_paid) AS min_cs_net_paid,
        MAX(cs_net_paid) AS max_cs_net_paid
    FROM base
    GROUP BY d_year, cc_call_center_id, p_promo_id, sm_ship_mode_id, cp_department
    HAVING SUM(cs_net_paid) > 10000
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    cc_call_center_id,
    p_promo_id,
    sm_ship_mode_id,
    cp_department,
    total_cs_net_paid,
    total_ws_net_paid,
    distinct_orders,
    avg_cs_net_profit,
    total_combined_profit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_combined_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(total_combined_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_id) AS promo_total_profit,
    (SELECT AVG(cs3.cs_net_paid) FROM catalog_sales cs3) AS global_avg_net_paid
FROM agg
ORDER BY total_combined_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH
  combined_sales AS (
    -- Catalog sales side
    SELECT
      cs.cs_order_number AS order_number,
      cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
      ds.d_date AS sold_date,
      cs.cs_ship_date_sk AS ship_date_sk,
      ds_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
      cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
      cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid,
      cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
      cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
      cs.cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
      cs.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk,
      cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
      CASE
        WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' AND cs.cs_net_paid > 1000 THEN 'High Discount'
        WHEN cs.cs_net_paid > 5000 THEN 'High Value'
        ELSE 'Regular'
      END AS sales_category
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim ds ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim ds_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = ds_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim ts ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE ds.d_year = 2001
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND p.p_cost > 50
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND cc.cc_division = 10
      AND cp.cp_type = 'PROMOTION'
      AND ts.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
      AND c.c_birth_year = 1975
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
    UNION ALL
    -- Web sales side
    SELECT
      ws.ws_order_number AS order_number,
      ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
      ds.d_date AS sold_date,
      ws.ws_ship_date_sk AS ship_date_sk,
      ds_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
      ws.ws_quantity AS quantity,
      ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid,
      ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
      ws.ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
      NULL AS call_center_sk,
      ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
      CASE
        WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' AND ws.ws_net_paid > 1000 THEN 'High Discount'
        WHEN ws.ws_net_paid > 5000 THEN 'High Value'
        ELSE 'Regular'
      END AS sales_category
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim ds ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim ds_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = ds_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim ts ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE ds.d_year = 2001
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND p.p_cost > 50
      AND ts.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
      AND c.c_birth_year = 1975
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 5
      AND c.c_salutation = 'Ms.'
  ),
  order_reasons AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_order_number AS order_number, r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr.wr_order_number AS order_number, r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  ),
  promo_max_cost AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           lc.max_cost
    FROM promotion p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT MAX(p2.p_cost) AS max_cost
      FROM promotion p2
      WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    ) AS lc
  )
SELECT
  cs.customer_sk,
  d.d_year,
  sm.sm_type,
  cs.sales_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.order_number) AS num_orders,
  SUM(cs.net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
  AVG(cs.quantity) AS avg_quantity,
  MIN(cs.net_paid) AS min_net_paid,
  MAX(cs.net_paid) AS max_net_paid,
  SUM(cs.net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.customer_sk ORDER BY cs.sold_date ROWS UNBOUNDED

SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d_sold.d_date,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_sales_profit,
    (SUM(ss.ss_quantity) + SUM(ws.ws_quantity)) AS total_quantity,
    CASE
        WHEN (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)) > 10000 THEN 'Big Profit'
        ELSE 'Small Profit'
    END AS profit_category
FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_sold
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_sold
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN tpcds.web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
   AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer c_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_ws_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_bill.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer c_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c_ws_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_ship.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_store_closed
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_store_closed.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
  AND d_sold.d_date < DATE '1999-01-01'
GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, d_sold.d_date
ORDER BY s.s_store_id, d_sold.d_date
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    d_sales.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales_net_paid,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_returns_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns_amount,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price,
    MIN(cs.cs_net_paid) AS min_sales_net_paid,
    MAX(cs.cs_net_paid) AS max_sales_net_paid
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_sales
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sales
  ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
  ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN item i
  ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN promotion p
  ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer c_bill
  ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_ship
  ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
 AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
 AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim t_return
  ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
JOIN date_dim d_return
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c_return
  ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_return.c_customer_sk
JOIN store s
  ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d_closed
  ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
  ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN date_dim d_cr_return
  ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr_return.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_cr_return
  ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr_return.t_time_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp_cr
  ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp_cr.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN warehouse w_cr
  ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
 AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_ws_sold
  ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN warehouse w_ws
  ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p_ws
  ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
WHERE
    d_sales.d_year = 2001
  AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND d_return.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1200 AND 1212
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM promotion p2
         WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
           AND p2.p_start_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
           AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      )
GROUP BY ROLLUP (s.s_store_name, d_sales.d_year, i.i_category, p.p_promo_name)
ORDER BY s.s_store_name, d_sales.d_year DESC, total_sales_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE
    ws AS (
        SELECT
            d.d_date_sk,
            d.d_date,
            d.d_year,
            cd.cd_gender,

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
  SELECT 1 AS seq_n
  UNION ALL
  SELECT seq_n + 1 FROM seq WHERE seq_n < 3
),
master AS (
  SELECT
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
    cr.cr_order_number AS cr_order_number,
    cr.cr_net_loss,
    cr.cr_call_center_sk AS cr_call_center_sk,
    cr.cr_catalog_page_sk AS cr_catalog_page_sk,
    cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
    cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
    cr.cr_reason_sk AS cr_reason_sk,
    cc_cs.cc_company_name AS cc_company_name_sales,
    cc_cr.cc_company_name AS cc_company_name_return,
    cp_cs.cp_department AS cp_department_sales,
    cp_cr.cp_department AS cp_department_return,
    cd_bill.cd_gender AS bill_gender,
    cd_ship.cd_gender AS ship_gender,
    cd_refunded.cd_gender AS refunded_gender,
    cd_returning.cd_gender AS returning_gender,
    r_cr.r_reason_desc AS cr_reason_desc,
    r_wr.r_reason_desc AS wr_reason_desc,
    ws.ws_order_number,
    ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax,
    ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
    ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
    ws.ws_web_page_sk,
    wr.wr_net_loss,
    wr.wr_reason_sk,
    wp.wp_type,
    cd_ws_bill.cd_gender AS ws_bill_gender,
    cd_ws_ship.cd_gender AS ws_ship_gender,
    seq.seq_n
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
  LEFT JOIN call_center cc_cs
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc_cs.cc_call_center_sk
  LEFT JOIN call_center cc_cr
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_cr.cc_call_center_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp_cs
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_cs.cp_catalog_page_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp_cr
    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp_cr.cp_catalog_page_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning
    ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN reason r_cr
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
    ON cs.cs_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
  LEFT JOIN reason r_wr
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_bill.cd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_ship.cd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  CROSS JOIN seq
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
    WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
  )
),
catalog_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cr_reason_desc, wr_reason_desc) AS reason_desc,
    seq_n,
    SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_catalog_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS catalog_orders
  FROM master
  GROUP BY COALESCE(cr_reason_desc, wr_reason_desc), seq_n
),
web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cr_reason_desc, wr_reason_desc) AS reason_desc,
    seq_n,
    SUM(ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_web_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS web_orders
  FROM master
  WHERE ws_order_number IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(cr_reason_desc, wr_reason_desc), seq_n
),
agg_union AS (
  SELECT
    reason_desc,
    seq_n,
    total_sales,
    total_catalog_loss,
    CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_web_sales,
    CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_web_loss,
    catalog_orders AS order_cnt,
    'catalog' AS source
  FROM catalog_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    reason_desc,
    seq_n,
    CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_sales,
    CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_catalog_loss,
    total_web_sales,
    total_web_loss,
    web_orders AS order_cnt,
    'web' AS source
  FROM web_agg
)
SELECT
  source,
  reason_desc,
  seq_n,
  total_sales,
  total_catalog_loss,
  total_web_sales,
  total_web_loss,
  order_cnt

WITH promo_keys_intersect AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_start.d_year = 2001
    INTERSECT
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN date_dim d_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_end.d_year = 2001
)
SELECT
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
    d_sold.d_date AS sold_date,
    p.p_promo_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    wp.wp_url,
    item_stats.avg_item_sales_price,
    item_stats.item_sales_count,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cr3.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr3
        WHERE cr3.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    ) AS total_return_amount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_name ORDER BY cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax DESC) AS promo_sales_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax DESC) AS global_sales_rank
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sm.sm_ship_mode_sk,
           sm.sm_type,
           sm.sm_carrier
    FROM ship_mode sm
    WHERE sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
) AS sm
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN date_dim d_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_sales_price) AS avg_item_sales_price,
           COUNT(*) AS item_sales_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
) AS item_stats
WHERE
    d_sold.d_year = 2001
    AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
    AND cr.cr_return_amount > 20
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    AND wp.wp_type = 'HOME'
    AND wp.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
    AND p.p_promo_sk IN (SELECT p_promo_sk FROM promo_keys_intersect)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
          AND cr2.cr_reason_sk IN (
              SELECT DISTINCT r2.r_reason_sk
              FROM reason r2
              WHERE r2.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
          )
    )
ORDER BY promo_sales_rank, cs.cs_order_number
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH
  date_filt AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
  ),
  item_filt AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM item
    WHERE i_color = 'red'
      AND i_size = 'large'
      AND i_brand = 'Brand#12'
  ),
  store_filt AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state = 'CA'
      AND s_gmt_offset > 0
  ),
  call_center_filt AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM call_center
    WHERE cc_company_name = 'Company A'
      AND cc_tax_percentage < 10.0
  ),
  ship_mode_filt AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ship_mode
    WHERE sm_type = 'AIR'
  ),
  catalog_page_filt AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM catalog_page
    WHERE cp_type = 'PROMO'
  ),
  web_page_filt AS (
    SELECT wp.*
    FROM web_page wp
    JOIN date_filt d ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_type = 'home'
  ),
  inventory_filt AS (
    SELECT inv.*
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN date_filt d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item_filt i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
  ),
  catalog_sales_filt AS (
    SELECT cs.*
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_filt d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item_filt i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN call_center_filt cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode_filt sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN catalog_page_filt cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 0
  ),
  catalog_returns_filt AS (
    SELECT cr.*
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_filt d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item_filt i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales_filt cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
  ),
  store_full AS (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      ss.ss_store_sk,
      ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
      ss.ss_customer_sk,
      ss.ss_quantity,
      ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
      sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
      sr.sr_item_sk,
      sr.sr_store_sk,
      sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
      sr.sr_return_quantity,
      sr.sr_return_amt
    FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_returns sr
      ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  ),
  intersect_items AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS i_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales_filt cs
    INTERSECT
    SELECT inv.inv_item_sk
    FROM inventory_filt inv
  )

WITH RECURSIVE agg_returns AS (

        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,

      AND cr_return_quantity > 0
      AND cr_catalog_page_sk IN (2, 18, 66)
      AND cr_returning_hdemo_sk BETWEEN 2000 AND 8000
      AND cr_return_amount > 50.00
    GROUP BY cr_warehouse_sk, cr_returning_addr_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cr_warehouse_sk, cr_returning_addr_sk, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, return_cnt, avg_store_credit
    FROM agg_returns
    WHERE FALSE
)

    ar.cr_warehouse_sk,

    w.w_state,
    w.w_county,
    ca_ret.ca_address_id,
    ca_ret.ca_state AS returning_state,
    ca_ret.ca_county AS returning_county,
    ar.total_return_amount,
    ar.total_net_loss,
    ar.return_cnt,
    ar.avg_store_credit,
    CASE WHEN ar.total_net_loss > 100000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS net_loss_category,

  ON ar.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ret
  ON ar.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk
WHERE
    w.w_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY')
    AND w.w_county LIKE '%County'
    AND ca_ret.ca_state NOT IN ('FL', 'GA')
    AND ca_ret.ca_zip LIKE '9%'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = ar.cr_warehouse_sk
          AND cr2.cr_returning_addr_sk = ar.cr_returning_addr_sk
          AND cr2.cr_return_quantity > 2
    )

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        td.t_hour,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        ca.ca_state,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_type,
        ws_site.web_name,
        ws_site.web_site_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    WHERE
        wp.wp_type = 'product'
        AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
        AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 2000
        AND ws.ws_net_profit > 500
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 2
        AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 18
)
SELECT
    bs.web_name,
    bs.wp_url,
    cp.cp_department,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    bs.t_hour,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bs.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(bs.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(bs.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_web_return_amount,
    AVG(bs.ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_profit)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_web_site_sk = bs.web_site_sk
    ) AS site_avg_profit
FROM base_sales bs
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = bs.ws_sold_time_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = bs.ws_sold_time_sk
    AND wr.wr_order_number = bs.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_item_sk = bs.ws_item_sk
LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON bs.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = bs.ws_sold_time_sk
    AND ss.ss_hdemo_sk = bs.ws_bill_hdemo_sk
    AND ss.ss_addr_sk = bs.ws_bill_addr_sk
WHERE
    cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
    AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 100000
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_page cp2
        WHERE cp2.cp_catalog_page_sk = cr.cr_catalog_page_sk
          AND cp2.cp_type = 'monthly'
    )
GROUP BY
    bs.web_name,

    JOIN reason rs2

    JOIN web_sales ws

    JOIN ship_mode sm2

    JOIN warehouse w2
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv

    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND cc.cc_employees > 500000
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound BETWEEN 50000 AND 150000
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 2

      AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
),

aggregated_data AS (

max_return_per_cc AS (

WHERE ad.call_center_name IN (
