SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    d_date.d_year,
    cp.cp_department,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_returns,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_returns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_store_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_web_customers,
    SUM(DISTINCT ss.ss_sales_price) AS distinct_sum_store_sales_price,
    AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_store_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) THEN 'Store Higher' ELSE 'Web Higher' END AS sales_channel_comparison,
    (SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales ss2 WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk) AS max_store_sale_date_sk,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_quantity
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d_date ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_date.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_time ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_time.t_time_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
JOIN date_dim d_sr_return ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr_return.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sr_return ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr_return.t_time_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cr_return ON 1=1
JOIN time_dim t_cr_return ON 1=1
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr_return.d_date_sk
    AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr_return.t_time_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cp_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_cp_start.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cp_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_cp_end.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold ON 1=1
JOIN time_dim t_ws_sold ON 1=1
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
    AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_site_open ON wsite.web_open_date_sk = d_ws_site_open.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_site_close ON wsite.web_close_date_sk = d_ws_site_close.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wr_return ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr_return.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_wr_return ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr_return.t_time_sk
JOIN date_dim d_inv ON 1=1
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_store_closed ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_store_closed.d_date_sk
WHERE
    d_date.d_year = 2001
    AND d_date.d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    AND t_time.t_meal_time = 'lunch'
    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND wsite.web_class = 'CLASS1'
    AND cp.cp_type = 'D'
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2 WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    )
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    d_date.d_year,
    cp.cp_department
ORDER BY
    total_store_sales DESC,
    s.s_store_name ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS sum_cs_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS sum_ws_net_paid,
        SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS sum_cr_refunded_cash,
        SUM(wr.wr_refunded_cash) AS sum_wr_refunded_cash,
        SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS sum_sr_refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
        AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE w.w_zip IN ('63451', '78370')
      AND ws_site.web_gmt_offset = -7.00
      AND i.i_current_price > 20.00
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1990
      AND t_cs.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (w.w_warehouse_name, c.c_customer_id, i.i_product_name)
)
SELECT 
    warehouse_name,
    customer_id,
    product_name,
    sum_cs_net_paid,
    sum_ws_net_paid,
    sum_cr_refunded_cash,
    sum_wr_refunded_cash,
    sum_sr_refunded_cash,
    (COALESCE(sum_cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(sum_ws_net_paid, 0) - COALESCE(sum_cr_refunded_cash, 0) - COALESCE(sum_wr_refunded_cash, 0) - COALESCE(sum_sr_refunded_cash, 0)) AS net_total,
    CASE 
        WHEN (COALESCE(sum_cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(sum_ws_net_paid, 0) - COALESCE(sum_cr_refunded_cash, 0) - COALESCE(sum_wr_refunded_cash, 0) - COALESCE(sum_sr_refunded_cash, 0)) > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (COALESCE(sum_cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(sum_ws_net_paid, 0) - COALESCE(sum_cr_refunded_cash, 0) - COALESCE(sum_wr_refunded_cash, 0) - COALESCE(sum_sr_refunded_cash, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS sales_category,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY warehouse_name 
        ORDER BY (COALESCE(sum_cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(sum_ws_net_paid, 0) - COALESCE(sum_cr_refunded_cash, 0) - COALESCE(sum_wr_refunded_cash, 0) - COALESCE(sum_sr_refunded_cash, 0)) DESC
    ) AS rank_by_warehouse
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY net_total DESC, warehouse_name
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        p.p_promo_name,
        i.i_units,
        i.i_size,
        td.t_am_pm,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
        COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
        MAX(ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS last_sale_date_sk,
        latp.latest_promo_start_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MAX(p2.p_start_date_sk) AS latest_promo_start_sk
        FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ) AS latp
    WHERE
        i.i_units = 'Pallet'
        AND i.i_size = 'large'
        AND td.t_am_pm = 'PM'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND ss.ss_quantity > 5
        AND s.s_rec_start_date >= DATE '1995-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        p.p_promo_name,
        i.i_units,
        i.i_size,
        td.t_am_pm,
        latp.latest_promo_start_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_catalog_return_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_web_return_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS num_catalog_returns,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS num_web_returns
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc
        ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
        AND cr.cr_return_amount > 100
        AND wr.wr_return_amount > 200
        AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 18
        AND cc.cc_country = 'United States'
        AND cp.cp_type IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id
),
union_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.p_promo_name AS name, 'promotion' AS src
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT cp.cp_type AS name, 'catalog_page' AS src
    FROM catalog_page cp
    WHERE cp.cp_type IS NOT NULL
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        sa.s_store_id,
        sa.s_store_name,
        sa.s_state,
        sa.p_promo_name,
        sa.total_net_paid,
        ra.total_return_loss,
        (sa.total_net_paid - ra.total_return_loss) AS net_profit,
        sa.latest_promo_start_sk
    FROM sales_agg sa
    JOIN returns_agg ra
        ON sa.s_store_id = ra.s_store_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        SUM(c.net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY c.s_state) AS state_total_profit
    FROM combine

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_date,
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        1 AS level
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        nd.d_date_sk,
        nd.d_date,
        nd.d_year,
        nd.d_month_seq,
        dh.level + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim nd
        ON nd.d_date = dh.d_date + INTERVAL '1' month
    WHERE dh.level < 12
),
filtered_promos AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_channel_event = 'N'
    EXCEPT
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
),
sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_date_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        ws.ws_promo_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ext_ship_cost
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 0
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d_sold.d_year,
        d_sold.d_month_seq,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        p.p_promo_name,
        SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(s.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        MIN(s.ws_net_paid) AS min_net_paid,
        MAX(s.ws_net_paid) AS max_net_paid
    FROM sales_base s
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON s.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p
        ON s.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_promo_start
        ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_promo_end
        ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON s.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON s.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh
        ON d_sold.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_year = 1998
      AND d_sold.d_date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
      AND d_sold.d_date <= DATE '1998-12-31'
      AND i.i_manager_id = 23
      AND i.i_brand_id = 1002001
      AND (p.p_channel_details LIKE '%wooden%' OR p.p_promo_sk IS NULL)
      AND (wp.wp_type = 'Content' OR wp.wp_web_page_sk IS NULL)
      AND s.ws_ext_ship_cost > 500
      AND (p.p_promo_sk IS NULL OR p.p_promo_sk IN (SELECT p_promo_sk FROM filtered_promos))
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_month_seq, i.i_brand, i.i_category, p.p_promo_name),
        (d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_month_seq, i.i_brand, i.i_category),
        (d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_month_seq, i.i_brand),
        (d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_month_seq),
        (d_sold.d_year),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    p_promo_name,
    total_sales,
    avg_discount,
    order_cnt,
    min_net_paid,
    max_net_paid,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank_year
FROM agg_sales
ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
   SELECT
      td.t_hour AS hour,
      p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
      SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
      SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
   FROM catalog_sales cs
   JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
   JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
   GROUP BY CUBE (hour, promo_id)

   SELECT
      td.t_hour AS hour,
      p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
      SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
      SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
   FROM web_sales ws
   JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
   JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
   GROUP BY CUBE (hour, promo_id)
)

SELECT

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (

    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim nd ON nd.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE nd.d_date <= DATE '1910-01-07'
),

store_part AS (
    SELECT
        'store' AS channel,
        d.d_year,
        i.i_category_id,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS return_net_loss,
        s.s_state,
        ca.ca_state AS customer_state,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        (SELECT AVG(inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand) FROM inventory inv2 WHERE inv2.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_inventory,
        CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_paid > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sale_category
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_closed ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sr_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr_ret.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_sr.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_current ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca_current.ca_address_sk
    WHERE d.d_fy_year = 1910
      AND i.i_category_id = 5

WITH filtered_demo AS (
    SELECT
        hd_demo_sk,
        hd_income_band_sk,
        hd_buy_potential,
        hd_dep_count,
        hd_vehicle_count
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_vehicle_count BETWEEN 1 AND 4
      AND hd_dep_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5
      AND hd_buy_potential IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
      AND hd_income_band_sk IS NOT NULL
),
left_data AS (
    SELECT
        fd.hd_demo_sk,
        fd.hd_buy_potential,
        fd.hd_dep_count,
        fd.hd_vehicle_count,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM filtered_demo fd
    LEFT OUTER JOIN income_band ib
        ON fd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE (ib.ib_upper_bound <= 150000 OR ib.ib_upper_bound IS NULL)
      AND (ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000 OR ib.ib_lower_bound IS NULL)
),
inner_data AS (
    SELECT
        fd.hd_demo_sk,
        fd.hd_buy_potential,
        fd.hd_dep_count,
        fd.hd_vehicle_count,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM filtered_demo fd
    INNER JOIN income_band ib
        ON fd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE ib.ib_upper_bound <= 150000
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
),
unmatched_demo AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk,
           hd_buy_potential,
           hd_dep_count,
           hd_vehicle_count,
           ib_lower_bound,
           ib_upper_bound
    FROM left_data
    EXCEPT
    SELECT hd_demo_sk,
           hd_buy_potential,
           hd_dep_count,
           hd_vehicle_count,
           ib_lower_bound,
           ib_upper_bound
    FROM inner_data
)
SELECT
    hd_buy_potential,
    CASE
        WHEN ib_lower_bound IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
        ELSE CAST(ib_lower_bound AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(ib_upper_bound AS VARCHAR)
    END AS income_band_range,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hd_demo_sk) AS household_count,
    SUM(hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicles,
    AVG(hd_dep_count) AS avg_dependents,
    MIN(hd_vehicle_count) AS min_vehicles,
    MAX(hd_vehicle_count) AS max_vehicles
FROM unmatched_demo
GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
        (hd_buy_potential,
         CASE
            WHEN ib_lower_bound IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
            ELSE CAST(ib_lower_bound AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(ib_upper_bound AS VARCHAR)
         END),
        (hd_buy_potential),
        ()
    )
ORDER BY
    household_count DESC,
    hd_buy_potential,
    income_band_range
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE demo_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk, 0 AS level
    FROM household_demographics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT h.hd_demo_sk, d.level + 1
    FROM household_demographics h
    JOIN demo_hierarchy d ON h.hd_demo_sk = d.hd_demo_sk + 1
    WHERE d.level < 5
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        'store' AS channel,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        MAX(CASE WHEN regexp_like(hd.hd_buy_potential, '^\\d+-\\d+$') THEN true ELSE false END) AS is_range,
        MIN(CAST(lb.lower_bound AS integer)) AS lower_bound
    FROM
        store_sales ss
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN demo_hierarchy dh ON hd.hd_demo_sk = dh.hd_demo_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT regexp_extract(hd.hd_buy_potential, '^([0-9]+)', 1) AS lower_bound
        ) AS lb
    WHERE
        dh.level = 0
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential LIKE '%-%'
        AND CAST(lb.lower_bound AS integer) > 500
    GROUP BY
        hd.hd_buy_potential
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        'web' AS channel,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        MAX(CASE WHEN regexp_like(hd.hd_buy_potential, '^\\d+-\\d+$') THEN true ELSE false END) AS is_range,
        MIN(CAST(lb.lower_bound AS integer)) AS lower_bound
    FROM
        web_sales ws
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN demo_hierarchy dh ON hd.hd_demo_sk = dh.hd_demo_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT regexp_extract(hd.hd_buy_potential, '^([0-9]+)', 1) AS lower_bound
        ) AS lb
    WHERE
        dh.level = 0
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential LIKE '%-%'
        AND CAST(lb.lower_bound AS integer) > 500
    GROUP BY
        hd.hd_buy_potential
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        hd_buy_potential,
        channel,
        total_sales,
        txn_count,
        total_profit,
        is_range,
        lower_bound
    FROM store_sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        hd_buy_potential,
        channel,
        total_sales,
        txn_count,
        total_profit,
        is_range,
        lower_bound
    FROM web_sales_agg
)
SELECT
    channel,
    CASE
        WHEN hd_buy_potential IS NULL THEN 'All Potentials'
        ELSE CONCAT('Potential ', hd_buy_potential)
    END AS buy_potential_label,
    SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales,
    SUM(txn_count) AS txn_count,
    SUM(total_profit) AS total_profit,
    MAX(is_range) AS is_range,
    MIN(lower_bound) AS lower_bound
FROM combined
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, hd_buy_potential)
HAVING NOT (channel IS NULL AND hd_buy_potential IS NULL)
ORDER BY
    channel,
    CASE WHEN hd_buy_potential IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT period_year,
       period_month,
       state,
       source,
       total_amount,
       category
FROM (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS period_year,
        d.d_month AS period_month,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        'sales' AS source,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 50000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS category
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2021-01-01' AND DATE '2021-12-31'
      AND sm.sm_carrier = 'UPS'
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month, ca.ca_state

    UNION

    SELECT
        d.d_year AS period_year,
        d.d_month AS period_month,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        'returns' AS source,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 0 THEN 'POS' ELSE 'NEG' END AS category
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2021-01-01' AND DATE '2021-12-31'
      AND s.s_market_id = 1
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month, ca.ca_state
) combined
WHERE state NOT IN (
    SELECT ca_state FROM customer_address WHERE ca_state = 'AK'
)
ORDER BY period_year, period_month, state, source
LIMIT 100

WITH high_value_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk
    FROM
        tpcds.customer c
        JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 5000
        AND hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (14, 15)
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    sale_date_sk,
    net_paid,
    net_profit,
    sales_detail,
    channel,
    last_store_sale_date
FROM (
    SELECT
        hv.c_customer_id               AS customer_id,
        hv.c_first_name               AS first_name,
        hv.c_last_name                AS last_name,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk            AS sale_date_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid                AS net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit              AS net_profit,
        cp.cp_department              AS sales_detail,
        CAST('Catalog' AS varchar)    AS channel,
        (
            SELECT MAX(ss.ss_sold_date_sk)
            FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
            WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk = hv.c_customer_sk
        )                              AS last_store_sale_date
    FROM
        high_value_customers hv
        JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) AS cs
            ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = hv.c_customer_sk
        JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp
            ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE
        cs.cs_quantity > 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        hv.c_customer_id               AS customer_id,
        hv.c_first_name               AS first_name,
        hv.c_last_name                AS last_name,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk            AS sale_date_sk,
        ws.ws_net_paid                AS net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit              AS net_profit,
        wsit.web_name                 AS sales_detail,
        CAST('Web' AS varchar)       AS channel,
        (
            SELECT MAX(ss.ss_sold_date_sk)
            FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
            WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk = hv.c_customer_sk
        )                              AS last_store_sale_date
    FROM
        high_value_customers hv
        JOIN tpcds.web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) AS ws
            ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = hv.c_customer_sk
        JOIN tpcds.web_site wsit
            ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    WHERE
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tpcds.web_returns wr
            WHERE wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
              AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL
        )
) AS combined
ORDER BY net_paid DESC, last_store_sale_date DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH billing_info AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ca.ca_city,
        ca.ca_state,
        SUBSTRING(ca.ca_street_name, 1, 5) AS street_prefix,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(ca.ca_street_name, '(Washington)', 1) AS street_keyword
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(ca.ca_street_name, 'Washington')
      AND ca.ca_city LIKE 'Washington%'
), agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        hd_buy_potential,
        street_prefix,
        ca_city,
        ca_state,
        CONCAT(ca_city, ', ', ca_state) AS location,
        MIN(street_keyword) AS street_keyword,
        SUM(ws_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM billing_info
    GROUP BY
        hd_buy_potential,
        street_prefix,
        ca_city,
        ca_state
)
SELECT
    a.hd_buy_potential,
    a.street_prefix,
    a.ca_city,
    a.ca_state,
    a.location,
    a.street_keyword,
    a.total_net_paid,
    a.avg_profit,
    a.distinct_customers,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ws_in.ws_net_paid_inc_ship)
        FROM web_sales ws_in
        JOIN household_demographics hd_in ON ws_in.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_in.hd_demo_sk
        WHERE hd_in.hd_buy_potential = a.hd_buy_potential
    ) AS max_net_paid_for_potential
FROM agg_sales a
ORDER BY a.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE joined_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity AS ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_sales_price AS ss_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS ss_net_profit,
        ca.ca_state,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_education_status,
        p.p_item_sk,
        p.p_channel_dmail,
        p.p_discount_active,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk AS ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity AS ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_sales_price AS ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS ws_net_profit,

        w.w_suite_number
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'

      AND w.w_city = 'Seattle'
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    cd_gender,
