WITH
  sampled_sales AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM catalog_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42)
    WHERE cs_net_paid_inc_tax > 100
  ),
  sales_join AS (
    SELECT
      i.i_category,
      i.i_brand,
      cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
      cc.cc_mkt_desc,
      cc.cc_name,
      sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
      c.c_customer_sk,
      c.c_first_name,
      c.c_last_name,
      CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS full_name,
      d.d_year
    FROM sampled_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(cc.cc_mkt_desc, '(?i)electrical|new')
      AND cc.cc_name LIKE '%Center%'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM customer_demographics cd
        WHERE cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
          AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      )
  ),
  sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      i_category,
      i_brand,
      SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
      'sales' AS metric_type,
      COUNT(DISTINCT full_name) AS distinct_count
    FROM sales_join
    GROUP BY i_category, i_brand
  ),
  stock_agg AS (
    SELECT
      i.i_category,
      i.i_brand,
      SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock,
      'stock' AS metric_type,
      COUNT(DISTINCT inv.inv_warehouse_sk) AS distinct_count
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '^.*[Aa]dvanced.*$')
      AND i.i_product_name LIKE '%Standard%'
    GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_brand
  ),
  combined AS (
    SELECT i_category, i_brand, total_sales AS metric, metric_type, distinct_count
    FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i_category, i_brand, total_stock AS metric, metric_type, distinct_count
    FROM stock_agg
  ),
  filtered_combined AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM combined
    WHERE metric > 1000
  )
SELECT
  i_category,
  i_brand,
  metric_type,
  SUM(metric) AS metric_total,
  SUM(distinct_count) AS distinct_entities,
  GROUPING(i_category) AS g_category,
  GROUPING(i_brand) AS g_brand,
  GROUPING(metric_type) AS g_metric_type,
  (SELECT MAX(i_current_price) FROM item) AS max_item_price
FROM filtered_combined
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  (i_category, i_brand, metric_type),
  (i_category, metric_type),
  (metric_type),
  ()
)
ORDER BY metric_total DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department AS department,
        cp.cp_description AS description,
        sm.sm_carrier AS carrier,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
        cs.cs_order_number AS order_number
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_description LIKE '%discount%'
      AND cp.cp_department LIKE 'A%'
      AND regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)clearance')
), sales_with_word AS (
    SELECT
        b.department,
        b.carrier,
        b.description,
        b.sales_price,
        b.net_profit,
        b.quantity,
        b.order_number,
        l.first_word
    FROM base_sales b
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT regexp_extract(b.description, '^([A-Za-z]+)', 1) AS first_word
    ) AS l
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tpcds.catalog_returns cr
        WHERE cr.cr_order_number = b.order_number
          AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
    )
), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        department,
        carrier,
        first_word,
        SUM(sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
        SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        GROUPING(department) AS department_group,
        GROUPING(carrier) AS carrier_group,
        GROUPING(first_word) AS first_word_group
    FROM sales_with_word
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (department, carrier, first_word)
    HAVING SUM(net_profit) > (SELECT AVG(cs_net_profit) FROM tpcds.catalog_sales)
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS rn,
    department,
    carrier,
    first_word,
    SUBSTRING(first_word FROM 1 FOR 3) AS first_word_prefix,
    total_sales_amount,
    total_net_profit,
    avg_quantity,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(department, 'ALL'), '-', COALESCE(carrier, 'ALL')) AS dept_carrier,
    department_group,
    carrier_group,
    first_word_group
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY rn
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

/* Goal: Calculate total return amount and quantity by region and item category across two perspectives – returns linked to call centers and returns linked to warehouses – and provide subtotals per region, per category, and a grand total. */
WITH returns_refunded AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_state AS region,
        i.i_category AS category,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_quantity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_rec_start_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-01-01' AND DATE '2000-12-31'
      AND i.i_formulation LIKE '%plum%'
      AND hd_ref.hd_dep_count >= 5
),
returns_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_state AS region,
        i.i_category AS category,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_quantity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE w.w_city = 'New York'
      AND hd_ret.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
      AND i.i_size = 'small'
      AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2451000 AND 2451070
)
SELECT
    region,
    category,
    SUM(return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
    GROUPING(region) AS region_grouping,
    GROUPING(category) AS category_grouping
FROM (
    SELECT region, category, return_amount, return_quantity FROM returns_refunded
    UNION ALL
    SELECT region, category, return_amount, return_quantity FROM returns_warehouse
) u
GROUP BY ROLLUP (region, category)
ORDER BY region, category
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE category_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor: distinct top‑level categories
    SELECT
        i.i_category_id AS node_id,
        i.i_category AS node_name,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS parent_id,
        1 AS depth,
        'category' AS node_type
    FROM item i
    GROUP BY i.i_category_id, i.i_category

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: leaf items under each category
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk AS node_id,
        i.i_product_name AS node_name,
        ch.node_id AS parent_id,
        ch.depth + 1 AS depth,
        'item' AS node_type
    FROM item i
    JOIN category_hierarchy ch
        ON i.i_category_id = ch.node_id
        AND ch.node_type = 'category'
        AND ch.depth = 1
),
item_sales_array AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk AS ws_item_sk,
        ARRAY_AGG(ws.ws_quantity) AS qty_array,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        MIN(ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS min_coupon_amt,
        MAX(ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS max_coupon_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_count
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_coupon_amt > 500.0
          AND i.i_manufact = 'barcallyese'
          AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '1999-01-01'
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ch.node_id AS category_id,
        ch.node_name AS category_name,
        SUM(s.total_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.ws_item_sk) AS item_count
    FROM category_hierarchy ch
    JOIN item i
        ON i.i_category_id = ch.node_id
        AND ch.node_type = 'category'
    JOIN item_sales_array s
        ON i.i_item_sk = s.ws_item_sk
    GROUP BY ch.node_id, ch.node_name
)
SELECT
    entity_type,
    entity_name,
    value1,
    value2
FROM (
    SELECT
        'category' AS entity_type,
        cs.category_name AS entity_name,
        cs.total_net_paid AS value1,
        cs.item_count AS value2
    FROM category_sales cs

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'item_quantity' AS entity_type,
        i.i_product_name AS entity_name,
        s.total_net_paid AS value1,
        q AS value2
    FROM item_sales_array s
    JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = s.ws_item_sk
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.qty_array) AS t(q)
) AS combined
ORDER BY entity_type, value1 DESC
LIMIT 100

goal: Identify items whose description includes a numeric code, have both store sales and catalog returns, are shipped via air, and compute their total sales, total return amount, current inventory and overall average inventory, ordered by sales.

query: |
  WITH filtered_items AS (
      SELECT
          i_item_sk,
          i_item_desc,
          regexp_extract(i_item_desc, '(\\d{3})', 1) AS model_number,
          i_category,
          i_brand,
          i_color,
          substr(i_item_desc, 1, 30) AS short_desc
      FROM
          item
      WHERE
          regexp_like(i_item_desc, '\\d{3}')
          AND i_brand LIKE 'Brand_%'
          AND i_category LIKE 'Electronics%'
  ),
  store_sales_agg AS (
      SELECT
          ss_item_sk,
          SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
      FROM
          store_sales
      WHERE
          ss_quantity > 0
      GROUP BY
          ss_item_sk
  ),
  catalog_returns_agg AS (
      SELECT
          cr_item_sk,
          SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount
      FROM
          catalog_returns
      WHERE
          cr_return_quantity > 0
      GROUP BY
          cr_item_sk
  ),
  intersect_items AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_item_sk AS i_item_sk
      FROM
          store_sales ss
      JOIN filtered_items fsi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fsi.i_item_sk
      WHERE
          ss.ss_quantity > 0
      INTERSECT
      SELECT DISTINCT cr.cr_item_sk AS i_item_sk
      FROM
          catalog_returns cr
      JOIN filtered_items fcr ON cr.cr_item_sk = fcr.i_item_sk
      WHERE
          cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
  )
  SELECT
      fi.i_item_sk,
      fi.i_item_desc,
      fi.model_number,
      fi.short_desc,
      CONCAT(fi.i_brand, ' - ', fi.i_category) AS brand_category,
      COALESCE(ssa.total_sales, 0) AS total_store_sales,
      COALESCE(cra.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
      inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
      (SELECT avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) FROM inventory) AS avg_inventory_all
  FROM
      filtered_items fi
  JOIN intersect_items ii ON ii.i_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_sales_agg ssa ON ssa.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns_agg cra ON cra.cr_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  WHERE
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_sales cs
          JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
          WHERE cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
            AND sm.sm_type LIKE 'AIR%'
      )
  ORDER BY
      total_store_sales DESC
  LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor: start from the earliest ship date key
    SELECT
        cs.cs_ship_date_sk AS ship_date_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_ship_date_sk = (
        SELECT MIN(cs_ship_date_sk)
        FROM tpcds.catalog_sales
    )
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step: walk forward one ship_date_sk at a time
    SELECT
        cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh
        ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = dh.ship_date_sk + 1
),

billed_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dh.ship_date_sk,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        cd.cd_gender,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS avg_net_paid,
        (
            SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_coupon_amt)
            FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs2
            WHERE cs2.cs_ship_date_sk = dh.ship_date_sk
        ) AS max_coupon_for_date
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = dh.ship_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_marital_status = 'M'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs_exists
          WHERE cs_exists.cs_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
            AND cs_exists.cs_coupon_amt > 500
      )
    GROUP BY dh.ship_date_sk, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_gender
),

shipped_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dh.ship_date_sk,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        cd.cd_gender,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS avg_net_paid,
        (
            SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_coupon_amt)
            FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs2
            WHERE cs2.cs_ship_date_sk = dh.ship_date_sk
        ) AS max_coupon_for_date
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = dh.ship_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs_exists
          WHERE cs_exists.cs_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
            AND cs_exists.cs_coupon_amt > 500
      )
    GROUP BY dh.ship_date_sk, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_gender
)
SELECT
    ship_date_sk,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_gender,
    total_net_paid,
    avg_net_paid,
    max_coupon_for_date
FROM billed_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT
    ship_date_sk,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_gender,
    total_net_paid,
    avg_net_paid,
    max_coupon_for_date
FROM shipped_agg
ORDER BY ship_date_sk DESC, total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    stores_meeting_name AS (
        SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        WHERE regexp_like(s.s_store_name, '.*Market.*')
          AND td.t_am_pm = 'PM'
        GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
    ),
    stores_meeting_reason AS (
        SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        WHERE regexp_like(r.r_reason_desc, '(?i)(damage|defect)')
          AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damage%'
        GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk
        HAVING SUM(sr.sr_return_amount) > 500
    ),
    intersected_stores AS (
        SELECT store_sk FROM stores_meeting_name
        INTERSECT
        SELECT store_sk FROM stores_meeting_reason
    )
SELECT
    i.store_sk,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_state,
    concat(s.s_store_name, ' - ', s.s_city) AS store_label,
    substr(s.s_store_name, 1, 10) AS store_name_prefix,
    COUNT(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS total_returns,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    round(AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity), 2) AS avg_return_qty
FROM intersected_stores i
JOIN store s ON i.store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 18
GROUP BY i.store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

Goal: Analyze net paid performance of store and web sales by product brand/category and household buying potential, filtering items by description patterns using regular expressions, applying LIKE pattern matching, concatenating brand and category, categorizing buying potential with a CASE expression, combining store and web results with a UNION ALL, ranking groups, ordering the final result and limiting to 100 rows.

Query:
WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'store' AS source,
        concat(i_brand, ' ', i_category) AS brand_category,
        CASE
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%>10000%' THEN 'High'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%5001-10000%' THEN 'Medium'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%1001-5000%' THEN 'Low-Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS buy_potential_group,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number) AS transaction_count
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i_item_desc, '(?i)pack|box')
      AND time_dim.t_meal_time LIKE 'Dinner%'
      AND c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    GROUP BY
        concat(i_brand, ' ', i_category),
        CASE
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%>10000%' THEN 'High'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%5001-10000%' THEN 'Medium'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%1001-5000%' THEN 'Low-Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'web' AS source,
        concat(i_brand, ' ', i_category) AS brand_category,
        CASE
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%>10000%' THEN 'High'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%5001-10000%' THEN 'Medium'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%1001-5000%' THEN 'Low-Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS buy_potential_group,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS transaction_count
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN item ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics ON web_sales.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_site ON web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i_item_desc, '(?i)organic')
      AND web_site.web_name LIKE '%Market%'
      AND c_preferred_cust_flag = 'N'
    GROUP BY
        concat(i_brand, ' ', i_category),
        CASE
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%>10000%' THEN 'High'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%5001-10000%' THEN 'Medium'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '%1001-5000%' THEN 'Low-Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_agg
)
SELECT
    source,
    brand_category,
    buy_potential_group,
    total_net_paid,
    total_quantity,
    transaction_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source, buy_potential_group ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS rank_within_group
FROM combined
ORDER BY source, rank_within_group
LIMIT 100

WITH item_desc_split AS (
   SELECT
       i.i_item_sk,
       i.i_item_id,
       i.i_item_desc,
       i.i_current_price,
       i.i_brand,
       regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '(\\d{5,})', 1) AS numeric_code,
       split(i.i_item_desc, ' ') AS desc_words
   FROM tpcds.item i
   WHERE regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '\\d{5,}')
),
item_words AS (
   SELECT
       ids.i_item_sk,
       ids.i_item_id,
       ids.i_brand,
       ids.numeric_code,
       w.word
   FROM item_desc_split ids
   CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ids.desc_words) AS t(word)
   WHERE word LIKE '%steel%' OR regexp_like(word, '^[A-Z]+$')
),
sales_agg AS (
   SELECT
       cs.cs_promo_sk,
       cs.cs_item_sk,
       sum(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
       avg(cs.cs_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
   FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
   GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk, cs.cs_item_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
   SELECT
       wr.wr_item_sk,
       sum(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
       count(DISTINCT r.r_reason_desc) AS distinct_return_desc
   FROM tpcds.web_returns wr
   JOIN tpcds.reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
   GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk
)
SELECT DISTINCT
   p.p_promo_name,
   concat(p.p_promo_name, ' - ', iw.word) AS promo_word,
   iw.i_item_id,
   iw.numeric_code,
   s.total_net_profit,
   r.total_return_loss,
   r.distinct_return_desc,
   CASE WHEN s.avg_sales_price > 100 THEN 'high_price' ELSE 'low_price' END AS price_category
FROM item_words iw
JOIN sales_agg s
   ON iw.i_item_sk = s.cs_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.promotion p
   ON s.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r
   ON iw.i_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk
WHERE p.p_purpose LIKE '%Unknown%'
ORDER BY s.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE page_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_type,
        1 AS depth
    FROM web_page wp
    WHERE wp.wp_web_page_sk = (SELECT MIN(wp_web_page_sk) FROM web_page)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_type,
        ph.depth + 1
    FROM page_hierarchy ph
    JOIN web_page wp
      ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ph.wp_web_page_sk + 1
    WHERE ph.depth < 5
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ph.wp_web_page_sk,
        ph.wp_url,
        ph.wp_type,
        COUNT(ws.ws_order_number) AS sale_cnt,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        array_agg(ws.ws_sales_price) AS sales_price_array,
        (
            SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_ext_list_price)
            FROM web_sales ws2
            WHERE ws2.ws_web_page_sk = ph.wp_web_page_sk
        ) AS max_ext_list_price
    FROM page_hierarchy ph
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = ph.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE
        REGEXP_LIKE(ph.wp_url, '^https?://[^/]+/sports')
        AND ph.wp_type LIKE 'C%'
        AND ph.wp_web_page_sk IN (
            SELECT ws3.ws_web_page_sk
            FROM web_sales ws3
            WHERE ws3.ws_quantity >= 2
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_sales ws_ex
            WHERE ws_ex.ws_web_page_sk = ph.wp_web_page_sk
              AND ws_ex.ws_ext_discount_amt > 1000
        )
    GROUP BY ph.wp_web_page_sk, ph.wp_url, ph.wp_type
)
SELECT
    sa.wp_web_page_sk,
    CONCAT('Page: ', sa.wp_url) AS page_desc,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(sa.wp_url, '^https?://([^/]+)/') AS domain,
    SUBSTRING(sa.wp_type FROM 1 FOR 3) AS type_prefix,
    sa.sale_cnt,
    sa.total_net_paid,
    sa.avg_sales_price,
    sa.max_ext_list_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_net_paid DESC) AS revenue_rank,
    t.sales_price
FROM sales_agg sa
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sa.sales_price_array) AS t (sales_price)
WHERE t.sales_price > 10
ORDER BY sa.total_net_paid DESC, t.sales_price
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range(date_sk) AS (
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(cs_sold_date_sk) FROM catalog_sales)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_range
    WHERE date_sk < (SELECT MAX(cs_sold_date_sk) FROM catalog_sales)
),
sales_with_window AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.cs_promo_sk
            ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cum_sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_range)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM promotion p
          WHERE p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
            AND p.p_channel_press = 'N'
      )
)
SELECT
    combined.p_promo_id,
    combined.metric_type,
    combined.metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id,
        'sales' AS metric_type,
        SUM(s.cum_sales) AS metric_value
    FROM sales_with_window s
    JOIN promotion p ON s.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_id
    HAVING SUM(s.cum_sales) > 1000
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id,
        'returns' AS metric_type,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS metric_value
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
                          AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_radio = 'N'
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_id
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 0
) AS combined
ORDER BY combined.metric_value DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE promo_levels(p_promo_sk, lvl) AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk, 1 AS lvl
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pl.p_promo_sk, pl.lvl + 1
    FROM promo_levels pl
    WHERE pl.lvl < 3
),

pre_agg_cs AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
           cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
           cs.cs_promo_sk,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 0
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 50
    GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
             cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
             cs.cs_promo_sk
),

pre_agg_ss AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk,
           ss.ss_promo_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_net_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS store_txn_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 0
      AND ss.ss_net_paid > 10
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk,
             ss.ss_promo_sk
),

promo_channels AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           ARRAY[p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_dmail, p.p_channel_tv] AS channels
    FROM promotion p
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.p_promo_name,
    s.s_store_name,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    t.channel,
    pl.lvl,
    pc.total_sales,
    pc.total_profit,
    ps.total_store_net_paid,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pl.lvl ORDER BY pc.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(pc.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY pc.total_sales ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales
FROM pre_agg_cs pc
JOIN promotion p ON pc.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON pc.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON pc.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN pre_agg_ss ps ON pc.cs_promo_sk = ps.ss_promo_sk
JOIN store s ON ps.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN promo_levels pl ON p.p_promo_sk = pl.p_promo_sk
JOIN promo_channels pcch ON p.p_promo_sk = pcch.p_promo_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(pcch.channels) AS t(channel)
WHERE sm.sm_code IN ('AIR', 'SEA')
  AND w.w_state = 'CA'
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND t.channel = 'Y'
ORDER BY profit_rank ASC, pc.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_addr_sk,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_ship.ca_city AS ship_city,
        ca_current.ca_location_type AS current_loc_type,
        cc.cc_name,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_channel_details,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        ca_return.ca_zip AS return_zip
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c_ship
        ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_bill
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_ship
        ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_current
        ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca_current.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_return
        ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
)

SELECT
    jd.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    jd.p_channel_details,
    SUM(jd.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(jd.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(jd.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(jd.sr_net_loss), 0) AS net_profit_after_returns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT jd.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT jd.p_promo_id) AS distinct_promotions,
    AVG(jd.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    (
        SELECT MAX(cs3.cs_ext_sales_price)
        FROM catalog_sales cs3
        WHERE cs3.cs_bill_customer_sk = jd.c_customer_sk
    ) AS max_sales_price_for_customer
FROM joined_data jd
WHERE jd.cs_ext_discount_amt > 50
  AND jd.p_channel_details LIKE '%available%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = jd.c_customer_sk
          AND sr2.sr_return_amt > 1000
    )
GROUP BY jd.cc_name, jd.p_channel_details
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT t_time_sk, 1 AS level
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_time_sk = (SELECT MIN(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.t_time_sk, h.level + 1
    FROM time_hierarchy h
    JOIN time_dim t ON t.t_time_sk = h.t_time_sk + 1
    WHERE h.level < 10
)
SELECT
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    r_wr.r_reason_desc,
    wsit.web_name,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount,
    MIN(ws.ws_net_paid) AS min_net_paid,
    MAX(ws.ws_net_paid) AS max_net_paid,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p2 WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS promotion_count,
    promo.promo_name,
    promo.p_discount_active
FROM
    web_sales ws
JOIN
    item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN
    time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN
    time_hierarchy th ON th.t_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN
    web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN
    web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
JOIN
    ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN
    warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.promo_name, p.p_discount_active
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
) AS promo
JOIN
    store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                     AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN
    reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
JOIN
    catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                         AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN
    call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN
    catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN
    ship_mode sm_cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN
    warehouse w_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN
    reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
JOIN
    web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                     AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
                     AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
                     AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
JOIN
    reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
WHERE
    i.i_category = 'Sports'
    AND w_ws.w_state = 'CA'
    AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    AND ws.ws_quantity > 2
    AND promo.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    )
GROUP BY
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    r_wr.r_reason_desc,
    wsit.web_name,
    promo.promo_name,
    promo.p_discount_active
ORDER BY
    total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date, dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_dim d_next
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON d_next.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dh.d_date)
    WHERE dh.lvl < 7
),
base_returns AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_ship_cost,
        d.d_year,
        t.t_hour
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND t.t_hour = 14
      AND wr.wr_return_ship_cost > 100.00
),
catalog_pages AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_department,
        d.d_date_sk
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN date_dim d ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
),
call_center_lateral AS (
    SELECT
        dh.d_date_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_manager
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cc_name, cc_manager
        FROM call_center cc
        WHERE cc.cc_closed_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
        ORDER BY cc.cc_employees DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS cc
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        ccl.cc_name,
        cp.cp_department,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(br.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        AVG(br.wr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost,
        COUNT(DISTINCT br.wr_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM base_returns br
    JOIN date_dim d ON br.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center_lateral ccl ON d.d_date_sk = ccl.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_pages cp ON d.d_date_sk = cp.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ccl.cc_name, cp.cp_department, d.d_year
    HAVING SUM(br.wr_return_amt) > 1000
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.cc_name ORDER BY a.total_return_amt DESC) AS rn
    FROM aggregated a
),
union_set AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_order_number
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr2.wr_order_number
    FROM web_returns wr2
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = 2002
),
intersect_set AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_order_number
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
    INTERSECT
    SELECT wr2.wr_order_number
    FROM web_returns wr2
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = 2002
)
SELECT
    w.rn,
    w.cc_name,
    w.cp_department,
    w.d_year,
    w.total_return_amt,
    w.avg_ship_cost,
    w.distinct_orders,
    us.union_count,
    isect.intersect_count
FROM windowed w
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS union_count FROM union_set
) us ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS intersect_count FROM intersect_set
) isect ON TRUE
ORDER BY w.total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH intersect_items AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i.i_formulation, '^[0-9]{5}')
      AND ca.ca_street_type LIKE 'St%'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN item i2 ON sr.sr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i2.i_formulation, '^[0-9]{5}')
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
           SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 1000
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
           SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
           SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM store_returns sr
    WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 0
    GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk
),
union_agg AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           total_sales_price,
           total_quantity,
           CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_return_amount,
           CAST(NULL AS integer) AS total_return_qty
    FROM sales_agg
    UNION
    SELECT item_sk,
           CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_sales_price,
           CAST(NULL AS integer) AS total_quantity,
           total_return_amount,
           total_return_qty
    FROM returns_agg
),
item_strings AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_item_id,
           i.i_product_name,
           i.i_formulation,
           regexp_extract(i.i_formulation, '([0-9]+)', 1) AS formulation_number,
           CASE
               WHEN i.i_formulation LIKE '%steel%' THEN 'steel'
               WHEN i.i_formulation LIKE '%olive%' THEN 'olive'
               ELSE 'other'
           END AS formulation_category
    FROM item i
)
SELECT
    is.i_item_id,
    is.i_product_name,
    is.i_formulation,
    is.formulation_number,
    is.formulation_category,
    SUM(COALESCE(ua.total_sales_price, 0)) AS total_sales_price,
    SUM(COALESCE(ua.total_quantity, 0)) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(COALESCE(ua.total_return_amount, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(ua.total_return_qty, 0)) AS total_return_qty,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr
        WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = is.i_item_sk
          AND sr.sr_return_amt > 0
    ) AS return_transactions_count
FROM union_agg ua
RIGHT OUTER JOIN item_strings is
    ON ua.item_sk = is.i_item_sk
WHERE is.i_item_sk IN (SELECT item_sk FROM intersect_items)
  AND (is.i_formulation LIKE '%steel%' OR is.i_formulation LIKE '%olive%')
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (is.i_item_id, is.i_product_name, is.i_formulation, is.formulation_number, is.formulation_category, is.i_item_sk),
    (is.i_item_id, is.i_formulation, is.formulation_number, is.formulation_category, is.i_item_sk),
    (is.i_item_id, is.formulation_number, is.formulation_category, is.i_item_sk)
)
ORDER BY total_sales_price DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        i.i_category AS category,
        td_cs.t_meal_time AS meal_time,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_ext_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN cs.cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS promo_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_net_paid,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amt
    FROM
        catalog_sales cs
        JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        JOIN time_dim td_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td_cs.t_time_sk
        JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
        JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN time_dim td_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td_sr.t_time_sk
        JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
        JOIN time_dim td_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td_ws.t_time_sk
        JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        JOIN time_dim td_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td_wr.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        td_cs.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1975
        AND i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT DISTINCT sr2.sr_item_sk FROM store_returns sr2)
        AND cs.cs_order_number IN (
            SELECT cs2.cs_order_number FROM catalog_sales cs2
            EXCEPT
            SELECT ws2.ws_order_number FROM web_sales ws2
        )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (s.s_store_name, i.i_category, td_cs.t_meal_time)
)
SELECT
    store_name,
    category,
    meal_time,
    total_net_paid,
    promo_sales,
    CASE WHEN total_net_paid > 0 THEN promo_sales / total_net_paid ELSE 0 END AS promo_ratio,
    distinct_orders,
    CASE WHEN total_return_amt > 0 THEN 'Has Returns' ELSE 'No Returns' END AS return_flag
FROM agg
WHERE
    promo_ratio > 0.05
ORDER BY
    total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

goal: Compute per‑item, per‑date sales and inventory metrics for items sold in 2002 in California, joining all 15 TPC‑DS tables, applying multiple filters, expanding customer email addresses with UNNEST, excluding items that had any returns on the same date via an anti‑join, and showing a correlated average net‑paid per item.

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_addr_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_wholesale_cost,
        ss.ss_list_price,
        ss.ss_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_discount_amt,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost,
        ss.ss_ext_list_price,
        ss.ss_ext_tax,
        ss.ss_coupon_amt,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax,
        ss.ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    p.p_promo_name AS promotion_name,
    ca.ca_city AS city,
    ca.ca_state AS state,
    c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS num_tickets,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    MIN(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales,
    MAX(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ss3.ss_ext_sales_price)
        FROM store_sales ss3
        WHERE ss3.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) AS max_customer_sale
FROM filtered_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
WHERE
    d.d_year = 2002
    AND p.p_promo_name = 'Holiday Discount'
    AND ca.ca_state = 'TX'
    AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000
    AND ss.ss_quantity > (
        SELECT AVG(ss4.ss_quantity)
        FROM store_sales ss4
        WHERE ss4.ss_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM promotion p_ex
        WHERE p_ex.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
          AND p_ex.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    )
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ca.ca_city,
    ca.ca_state,
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_customer_sk
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sampled_ws AS (
    SELECT
        ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws_bill_hdemo_sk,
        ws_ship_customer_sk,
        ws_ship_hdemo_sk,
        ws_ext_wholesale_cost,
        ws_net_paid_inc_tax,
        ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42)
),

customers_billed_not_shipped AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM sampled_ws ws
    WHERE ws.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    EXCEPT
    SELECT
        ws2.ws_ship_customer_sk
    FROM sampled_ws ws2
    WHERE ws2.ws_ship_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM sampled_ws ws
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost > 1000
      AND ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax < 2000
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 0
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1990
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_sales ws2
          WHERE ws2.ws_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            AND ws2.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
            AND ws2.ws_ext_wholesale_cost > 1000
      )
      AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk IN (SELECT customer_sk FROM customers_billed_not_shipped)
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk
),

income_band_summary AS (
    SELECT
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        (ib.ib_upper_bound - ib.ib_lower_bound) AS band_width
    FROM income_band ib
    WHERE ib.ib_lower_bound >= 80000
),

band_sales_full AS (
    SELECT
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        COALESCE(sa.total_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit,
        COALESCE(sa.sales_cnt, 0) AS sales_cnt,
        COALESCE(sa.avg_net_paid_inc_tax, 0) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM income_band_summary ib
    FULL OUTER JOIN sales_agg sa
        ON ib.ib_income_band_sk = sa.hd_income_band_sk
),

overall_agg AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(total_net_profit) AS avg_total_net_profit,
        SUM(total_net_profit) AS sum_total_net_profit,
        SUM(sales_cnt) AS sum_sales_cnt
    FROM band_sales_full
    WHERE total_net_profit > 0
)
SELECT
    b.ib_income_band_sk,
    b.ib_lower_bound,
    b.ib_upper_bound,
    b.total_net_profit,
    b.sales_cnt,
    b.avg_net_paid_inc_tax,
    oa.avg_total_net_profit,
    oa.sum_total_net_profit,
    oa.sum_sales_cnt,
    CASE WHEN b.sales_cnt > 0 THEN b.total_net_profit / b.sales_cnt ELSE NULL END AS avg_profit_per_sale
FROM band_sales_full b
CROSS JOIN overall_agg oa
WHERE b.total_net_profit > 5000
ORDER BY b.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH RECURSIVE date_cte AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk
    FROM date_cte dc
    JOIN date_dim d_next ON d_next.d_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE dc.d_date_sk < (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998)
),
raw_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ds_sold.d_year AS sale_year,
        i.i_category AS item_category,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid,
        c_bill.c_customer_sk AS customer_key
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim ds_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ds_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim ds_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = ds_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer c_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib_bill ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib_bill.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN customer c_ship ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib_ship ON hd_ship.hd_income_band_sk = ib_ship.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    JOIN date_dim ds_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ds_return.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer cr_refund_cust ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = cr_refund_cust.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics cr_refund_hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = cr_refund_hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer cr_return_cust ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = cr_return_cust.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics cr_return_hd ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = cr_return_hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ds_sr_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ds_sr_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer sr_cust ON sr.sr_customer_sk = sr_cust.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics sr_hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = sr_hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ds_wr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ds_wr_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer wr_ref_cust ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = wr_ref_cust.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics wr_ref_hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = wr_ref_hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer wr_ret_cust ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = wr_ret_cust.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics wr_ret_hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = wr_ret_hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim ds_wp_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = ds_wp_creation.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim ds_wp_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = ds_wp_access.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer wp_cust ON wp.wp_customer_sk = wp_cust.c_customer_sk
    WHERE i.i_current_price > 20.00
      AND ds_sold.d_year = 1998
      AND hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = 3
      AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_cte)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_site ws
          WHERE ws.web_open_date_sk = ds_sold.d_date_sk
            AND ws.web_close_date_sk > ds_sold.d_date_sk
      )
)
SELECT
    sale_year,
    item_category,
    SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS distinct_customers,
    CASE WHEN SUM(net_paid) > 1000000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS sales_level,
    (SELECT MAX(ib_upper_bound) FROM income_band) AS max_income_upper
FROM raw_sales
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (sale_year, item_category),
    (sale_year),
    (item_category),
    ()
)
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH filtered_ship_modes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm_code
    FROM ship_mode
    WHERE sm_contract IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year AS year,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    sm.sm_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
    COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS store_return_loss,
    COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS web_return_loss,
    SUM(wh.w_warehouse_sq_ft) AS total_warehouse_sq_ft,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_web_pages,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    ) AS avg_daily_catalog_profit
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse wh
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
   AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
   AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
   AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
   AND ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation
    ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wp_access
    ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
   AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
   AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_refund
    ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refund.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning
    ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
WHERE sm.sm_code IN (SELECT sm_code FROM filtered_ship_modes)
GROUP BY
    d_sold.d_year,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    sm.sm_code
ORDER BY
    year DESC,
    catalog_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

WITH reason_agg AS (
    SELECT
        r_reason_sk,
        array_agg(r_reason_desc) AS reason_descs
    FROM reason
    GROUP BY r_reason_sk
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    ws.ws_order_number,
    d_sold.d_year,
    c_bill.c_customer_id,
    ca_bill.ca_state,
    cd_bill.cd_gender,
    cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    sr.sr_return_amt,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    ra.reason_desc,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d_sold.d_year) AS orders_per_year,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_store_return_loss,
    MIN(cr.cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount,
    MAX(ws.ws_net_profit) AS max_net_profit,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_quantity)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    ) AS max_quantity_for_customer
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
FULL OUTER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN reason_agg ra
    ON r.r_reason_sk = ra.r_reason_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ra.reason_descs) AS t (reason_desc)
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2002
  AND ca_bill.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND cd_bill.cd_gender = 'F'
  AND cp.cp_type = 'A'
  AND ws.ws_quantity > 5
  AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 200.00
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    )
GROUP BY
    ws.ws_order_number,
    d_sold.d_year,
    c_bill.c_customer_id,
    ca_bill.ca_state,
    cd_bill.cd_gender,
    cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    sr.sr_return_amt,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    ra.reason_desc
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  d.d_year,
  s.s_state,
  sm.sm_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
  SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
  SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_returns,
  AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
  MIN(ss.ss_net_paid) AS min_sale,
  MAX(ss.ss_net_paid) AS max_sale,
  SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
  SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_returns
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t
  ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN item i
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
  ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN income_band ib
  ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
  ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
WHERE
  d.d_year = 2000
  AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND sm.sm_code = 'AIR'
  AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM income_band ib2
    WHERE ib2.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
      AND ib2.ib_upper_bound <= 100000
      AND ib2.ib_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  )
GROUP BY
  d.d_year,
  s.s_state,
  sm.sm_code
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sr_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
        td.t_hour AS hour,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_sr_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS sr_return_cnt
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, td.t_hour
)

SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    we.web_site_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(sr_agg.total_sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_list_price) AS avg_list_price,
    (SELECT MAX(ib2.ib_upper_bound) FROM income_band ib2) AS max_income_upper_bound
FROM sr_agg
JOIN store s
    ON sr_agg.store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
JOIN time_dim t_cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd_ref.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
JOIN time_dim t_ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site we
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
WHERE
    t_cr.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 90000
    AND ws.ws_ext_list_price > 1000
    AND we.web_market_manager = 'James Brewer'
GROUP BY s.s_store_name, we.web_site_id
HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 10000

UNION DISTINCT

SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    we.web_site_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(sr_agg.total_sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_list_price) AS avg_list_price,
    (SELECT MAX(ib2.ib_upper_bound) FROM income_band ib2) AS max_income_upper_bound
FROM sr_agg
JOIN store s
    ON sr_agg.store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
JOIN time_dim t_cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd_ref.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
JOIN time_dim t_ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site we
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
WHERE
    t_cr.t_hour BETWEEN 18 AND 23
    AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 90000
    AND ws.ws_ext_list_price > 1000
    AND we.web_market_manager = 'James Brewer'
GROUP BY s.s_store_name, we.web_site_id
HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 10000

ORDER BY total_web_profit DESC

/* Goal: Compute total net paid and profit for items across catalog and web channels, rank categories (or brands) by profit, include maximum sales price, and compare using a full outer join with advanced grouping and window functions. */
WITH
    cat AS (
        SELECT
            i.i_item_sk,
            i.i_category,
            i.i_brand,
            d.d_year,
            SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS cat_total_net_paid,
            SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cat_total_profit,
            COUNT(*) AS cat_txn_count,
            (
                SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_sales_price)
                FROM catalog_sales cs2
                WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            ) AS max_sales_price
        FROM
            catalog_sales cs
            JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
            JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
            JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
            JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
            JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
            LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
            LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
            LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        WHERE
            d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
            AND i.i_current_price > 100
            AND sm.sm_ship_mode_id = 'AAAAAAAADBAAAAAA'
            AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
            AND w.w_state = 'CA'
            AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        GROUP BY
            ROLLUP (i.i_item_sk, i.i_category, i.i_brand, d.d_year)
    ),
    web AS (
        SELECT
            i.i_item_sk,
            i.i_category,
            i.i_brand,
            d.d_year,
            SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS web_total_net_paid,
            SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_total_profit,
            SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_total_quantity,
            (
                SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_sales_price)
                FROM web_sales ws2
                WHERE ws2.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            ) AS max_web_sales_price
        FROM
            web_sales ws
            JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
            JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
            JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
            JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
            JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk

WITH key_set AS (
    SELECT s.s_store_id AS store_id,
           d_sales.d_year   AS d_year
    FROM   store_sales ss
    JOIN   store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN   date_dim d_sales ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    WHERE  d_sales.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, d_sales.d_year
    INTERSECT
    SELECT s.s_store_id AS store_id,
           d_returns.d_year AS d_year
    FROM   store_returns sr
    JOIN   store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN   date_dim d_returns ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_returns.d_date_sk
    WHERE  d_returns.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, d_returns.d_year
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ks.store_id,
        ks.d_year,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)                     AS total_sales_profit,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)                       AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)                     AS total_web_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) - SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS net_profit,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)             AS total_inventory
    FROM   key_set ks
    JOIN   store s ON ks.store_id = s.s_store_id
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sales ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_returns ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_returns.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_closed ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_closed.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_open   ON cc.cc_open_date_sk   = d_cc_open.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE
        s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND d_sales.d_year = ks.d_year
        AND d_returns.d_year = ks.d_year
        AND d_ws.d_year = ks.d_year
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
        AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 5
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(ks.d_year, s.s_store_name, ks.store_id)
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    s_store_name,
    store_id,
    total_sales_profit,
    total_return_loss,
    total_web_profit,
    net_profit,
    total_inventory,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE WHEN net_profit > 0 THEN 'POS' ELSE 'NEG' END AS profit_indicator
FROM   sales_agg
WHERE  net_profit IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d_year, profit_rank
LIMIT 100
