WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date, d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date, d.d_date_sk, d.d_year
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON d.d_date = dh.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d.d_date <= DATE '2001-12-31'
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        dh.d_year,
        sm.sm_type,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_count,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory,
        MIN(cc_lateral.cc_name) AS call_center_name,
        MIN(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS income_lower_bound,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS row_num
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cc.cc_name
        FROM call_center cc
        WHERE cc.cc_open_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) cc_lateral
    WHERE
        ws.ws_quantity > 5
        AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 1000
        AND dh.d_year = 2001
        AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'M'
        AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
        AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
            WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
              AND wr2.wr_return_quantity > 0
        )
    GROUP BY
        ROLLUP(s.s_store_id, dh.d_year, sm.sm_type)
    HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 5000
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    d_year,
    sm_type,
    total_sales,
    total_quantity,
    total_profit,
    order_count,
    total_inventory,
    call_center_name,
    income_lower_bound,
    row_num,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    GROUPING(s_store_id) AS g_store,
    GROUPING(d_year) AS g_year,
    GROUPING(sm_type) AS g_ship_mode
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY total_sales DESC, s_store_id
LIMIT 100

WITH
  -- Alias time dimensions for different roles
  t_sold AS (SELECT * FROM time_dim),
  t_cat  AS (SELECT * FROM time_dim),
  t_ret  AS (SELECT * FROM time_dim),
  t_cr   AS (SELECT * FROM time_dim),
  t_wr   AS (SELECT * FROM time_dim)
SELECT
  s.s_store_id,
  i.i_category,
  t_sold.t_hour AS sale_hour,
  SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)                         AS store_sales_total,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax)                  AS catalog_sales_total,
  SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)                         AS store_returns_total,
  SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)                         AS catalog_returns_total,
  SUM(wr.wr_net_loss)                         AS web_returns_total,
  (SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) + SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) -
   (SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) + SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(wr.wr_net_loss))) AS net_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN (SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) + SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) -
          (SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) + SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(wr.wr_net_loss))) > 0
    THEN 'Profit'
    ELSE 'Loss'
  END AS profit_status
FROM
  store_sales ss
  JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN t_sold t_sold
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
  JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN customer c_ss
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca_ss
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ss
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd_ss.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  -- Catalog sales and related dimensions
  JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN t_cat t_cat
    ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cat.t_time_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm_cs
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_cs.sm_ship_mode_sk
  JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  -- Catalog returns and related dimensions
  JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN t_cr t_cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm_cr
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
  -- Store returns and related dimensions
  JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
  JOIN t_ret t_ret
    ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_ret.t_time_sk
  -- Web returns and related dimensions
  JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN t_wr t_wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
  JOIN customer c_wr
    ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_wr.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY
  s.s_store_id,
  i.i_category,
  t_sold.t_hour
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dd.d_date_sk, dd.d_date
  FROM date_dim dd
  JOIN date_range dr ON dd.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk + 1
  WHERE dd.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-31'
),
store_sales_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss_item_sk AS item_sk
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 1998
),
inventory_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT inv_item_sk AS item_sk
  FROM inventory inv TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5)
  JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 1998
),
common_items AS (
  SELECT item_sk FROM store_sales_items
  INTERSECT
  SELECT item_sk FROM inventory_items
),
catalog_returns_items AS (
  SELECT cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr_return_amount AS return_amt
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 1998
),
web_returns_items AS (
  SELECT wr_item_sk AS item_sk, wr_return_amt AS return_amt
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 1998
),
combined_returns AS (
  SELECT item_sk, return_amt FROM catalog_returns_items
  UNION ALL
  SELECT item_sk, return_amt FROM web_returns_items
),
final_agg AS (
  SELECT
    d.d_year,
    i.i_brand,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_sales,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_return_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_return_loss,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_return_loss,
    SUM(crt.return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS order_count,
    AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price
  FROM date_range dr
  JOIN date_dim d ON dr.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
  JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
  JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = cs.cs_bill_addr_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
  JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
  JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN common_items ci ON ci.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN combined_returns crt ON crt.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_year = 1998
    AND i.i_current_price > 100
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    AND cp.cp_type = 'A'
    AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 5 AND 10
    AND i.i_color = 'Red'
    AND ws.web_class = 'Unknown'
  GROUP BY
    d.d_year,
    i.i_brand,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    p.p_promo_name
  HAVING
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) > 10000
)
SELECT
  d_year,
  i_brand,
  w_warehouse_name,
  cp_department,
  p_promo_name,
  total_sales,
  store_return_loss,
  catalog_return_loss,
  web_return_loss,
  total_return_amount,
  order_count,
  avg_item_price
FROM final_agg
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    dd.d_year AS sales_year,
    i.i_category,
    concat(i.i_item_id, '-', ws.web_site_id) AS item_site_key,
    regexp_extract(i.i_product_name, '([0-9]{3})$', 1) AS product_code,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    AVG(inv_l.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_on_sale_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim dd
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN item i
  ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_site ws
  ON ws.web_open_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory inv
    WHERE inv.inv_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
      AND inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LIMIT 1
) AS inv_l (inv_quantity_on_hand)
WHERE dd.d_year = 2001
  AND ws.web_suite_number LIKE 'Suite 3%'
  AND regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '.*[0-9]{3}$')
  AND substr(ws.web_site_id, 1, 3) = 'www'
GROUP BY
    dd.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    concat(i.i_item_id, '-', ws.web_site_id),
    regexp_extract(i.i_product_name, '([0-9]{3})$', 1)
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH sales_sample AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) REPEATABLE (12345)
),
joined_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_ext_ship_cost,
        cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        -- Reused dimension columns for additional joins
        cc2.cc_name AS cc_name_2,
        cc2.cc_state AS cc_state_2,
        sm2.sm_carrier AS sm_carrier_2,
        i2.i_brand AS i_brand_2,
        ca_other.ca_state AS other_state
    FROM sales_sample cs
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_bill
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_ship
        ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.call_center cc2
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc2.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm2
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.item i2
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca_other
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_other.ca_address_sk
),
valid_orders AS (
    SELECT cs_order_number
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_quantity > 10
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cs_order_number
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_net_profit > 0
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cs_order_number
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_ext_ship_cost > 1000
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        js.cc_name,
        js.bill_state,
        js.i_category,
        CASE WHEN SUM(js.cs_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_bucket,
        SUM(js.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(js.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT js.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM joined_sales js
    WHERE js.cs_order_number IN (SELECT cs_order_number FROM valid_orders)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM tpcds.item i_ex
          WHERE i_ex.i_category = js.i_category
            AND i_ex.i_current_price > 5000
      )
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (js.cc_name, js.bill_state, js.i_category),
        (js.cc_name, js.bill_state),
        (js.cc_name),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    cc_name,
    bill_state,
    i_category,
    profit_bucket,
    total_net_paid,
    total_quantity,
    order_cnt
FROM agg_sales
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE reason_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT r_reason_sk,
           r_reason_id,
           r_reason_desc,
           1 AS level
    FROM reason
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 10
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.r_reason_sk,
           r.r_reason_id,
           r.r_reason_desc,
           h.level + 1
    FROM reason r
    JOIN reason_hierarchy h ON r.r_reason_sk = h.r_reason_sk + 1
    WHERE r.r_reason_sk <= 12
),
shift_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        'Shift' AS category,
        t.t_shift AS key,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_fee) > 200 THEN 'High Fee' ELSE 'Low Fee' END AS fee_category,
        (SELECT AVG(wr2.wr_return_amt)
         FROM web_returns wr2
         WHERE wr2.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk) AS avg_return_amt
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim t
      ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE t.t_shift IN ('first', 'second')
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_returns wr2
            WHERE wr2.wr_returning_customer_sk = wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
              AND wr2.wr_fee > 30
      )
    GROUP BY t.t_shift
),
reason_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        'Reason' AS category,
        rh.r_reason_desc AS key,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_fee) > 200 THEN 'High Fee' ELSE 'Low Fee' END AS fee_category,
        (SELECT AVG(wr2.wr_return_amt)
         FROM web_returns wr2
         WHERE wr2.wr_reason_sk = rh.r_reason_sk) AS avg_return_amt
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN reason_hierarchy rh
      ON wr.wr_reason_sk = rh.r_reason_sk
    WHERE rh.r_reason_desc LIKE 'Did not%'
    GROUP BY rh.r_reason_desc, rh.r_reason_sk
)
SELECT
    sa.category,
    sa.key,
    sa.total_return_amt,
    sa.return_count,
    sa.fee_category,
    sa.avg_return_amt
FROM shift_aggregates sa
UNION ALL
SELECT
    ra.category,
    ra.key,
    ra.total_return_amt,
    ra.return_count,
    ra.fee_category,
    ra.avg_return_amt
FROM reason_aggregates ra
ORDER BY category, total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    store_sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            d.d_date AS sales_date,
            'store' AS sales_type,
            SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        GROUP BY d.d_date
    ),
    catalog_sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            d.d_date AS sales_date,
            'catalog' AS sales_type,
            SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr
            WHERE cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        )
        GROUP BY d.d_date
    ),
    sales_union AS (
        SELECT sales_date, sales_type, total_sales
        FROM store_sales_agg
        UNION ALL
        SELECT sales_date, sales_type, total_sales
        FROM catalog_sales_agg
    ),
    inventory_agg AS (
        SELECT
            d.d_date AS inv_date,
            SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty
        FROM inventory i
        JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        GROUP BY d.d_date
    )
SELECT
    COALESCE(s.sales_date, i.inv_date) AS sales_date,
    s.sales_type,
    s.total_sales,
    i.total_inventory_qty
FROM sales_union s
FULL OUTER JOIN inventory_agg i
    ON s.sales_date = i.inv_date
ORDER BY sales_date DESC NULLS LAST, s.sales_type
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT
    d.d_year,
    d.d_moy,
    i.i_category,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    CASE WHEN r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%' THEN 'Damaged' ELSE 'Other' END AS reason_category,
    CASE WHEN d.d_current_year = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Historical' END AS year_type,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    AVG(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity,
    AVG(ib_refunded.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_refunded_income_lower,
    AVG(ib_returning.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_returning_income_lower,
    (SELECT SUM(inv_sub.inv_quantity_on_hand)
       FROM inventory inv_sub
      WHERE inv_sub.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS total_item_inventory
FROM web_returns wr
JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_returning ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib_refunded ON hd_refunded.hd_income_band_sk = ib_refunded.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_returning ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib_returning ON hd_returning.hd_income_band_sk = ib_returning.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE d.d_weekend = 'Y'
GROUP BY
    d.d_year,
    d.d_moy,
    i.i_category,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    CASE WHEN r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%' THEN 'Damaged' ELSE 'Other' END,
    CASE WHEN d.d_current_year = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Historical' END
UNION
SELECT
    d.d_year,
    d.d_moy,
    i.i_category,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    CASE WHEN r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%' THEN 'Damaged' ELSE 'Other' END AS reason_category,
    CASE WHEN d.d_current_year = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Historical' END AS year_type,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    AVG(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity,
    AVG(ib_refunded.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_refunded_income_lower,
    AVG(ib_returning.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_returning_income_lower,
    (SELECT SUM(inv_sub.inv_quantity_on_hand)
       FROM inventory inv_sub
      WHERE inv_sub.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS total_item_inventory
FROM web_returns wr
JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_returning ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib_refunded ON hd_refunded.hd_income_band_sk = ib_refunded.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_returning ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib_returning ON hd_returning.hd_income_band_sk = ib_returning.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE d.d_weekend = 'N'
GROUP BY
    d.d_year,
    d.d_moy,
    i.i_category,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    CASE WHEN r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%' THEN 'Damaged' ELSE 'Other' END,
    CASE WHEN d.d_current_year = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Historical' END
ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date
  FROM date_hierarchy dh
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date = DATE_ADD('day', -1, dh.d_date)
  WHERE d2.d_date >= DATE '2021-12-01'
),

store_sales_agg AS (
  SELECT
    dh.d_date,
    s.s_store_sk,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_returns,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.c_customer_sk)
      FROM store_sales ss2
      JOIN customer c2 ON ss2.ss_customer_sk = c2.c_customer_sk
      WHERE ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
        AND ss2.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    ) AS distinct_customers
  FROM date_hierarchy dh
  JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
  JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  WHERE
    s.s_tax_percentage > 0.05
    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    AND EXTRACT(year FROM dh.d_date) = 2022
    AND r.r_reason_desc IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    dh.d_date,
    s.s_store_sk,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    p.p_promo_name
),

web_sales_agg AS (
  SELECT
    dh.d_date,
    ws.ws_web_site_sk,
    ws_site.web_site_id,
    ws_site.web_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS total_transactions,
    0.0 AS total_returns,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.c_customer_sk)
      FROM web_sales ws2
      JOIN customer c2 ON ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = c2.c_customer_sk
      WHERE ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
        AND ws2.ws_web_site_sk = ws.ws_web_site_sk
    ) AS distinct_customers
  FROM date_hierarchy dh
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE
    ws_site.web_tax_percentage > 0.07
    AND w.w_state = 'WA'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    AND EXTRACT(year FROM dh.d_date) = 2022
    AND wp.wp_type = 'article'
  GROUP BY
    dh.d_date,
    ws.ws_web_site_sk,
    ws_site.web_site_id,
    ws_site.web_name,
    p.p_promo_name
),

combined_sales AS (
  SELECT
    d_date,
    'Store' AS channel,
    s_store_id AS location_id,

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year, d_month_seq, 1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2020-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_year, d2.d_month_seq, dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date = dh.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE dh.lvl < 30
),
base_join AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active,
        sm.sm_type,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ws.web_state,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        -- Running total of sales price per year
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sales,
        -- Previous return amount per order
        LAG(cr.cr_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_order_number ORDER BY d.d_date) AS prev_return_amount
    FROM date_hierarchy d
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sales
      ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
      ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
      ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN promotion p
      ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
      ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
      ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
     AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
     AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
     AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
      ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
     AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws
      ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2020
      AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 12
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 2
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
      AND p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND ws.web_state = 'CA'
),
agg1 AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return,
        AVG(cs_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        MIN(cs_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales_price,
        MAX(cs_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales_price
    FROM base_join
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (d_year, d_month_seq)
),
agg2 AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        NULL AS d_month_seq,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return,
        AVG(cs_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        MIN(cs_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales_price,
        MAX(cs_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales_price
    FROM base_join
    WHERE cs_ext_sales_price > 1000
    GROUP BY d_year
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM agg1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM agg2
) AS final_agg
ORDER BY d_year DESC, d_month_seq NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

/*
  Goal: Compare return amounts across store, web, and catalog channels by return reason and hour of day, using a UNION ALL, a FULL OUTER JOIN, a CASE expression, a scalar subquery, a TABLESAMPLE, and an EXISTS filter.
*/
WITH store_ret AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason,
        t.t_hour AS hour_of_day,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 500 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_severity
    FROM store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS sr
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc, t.t_hour
),
web_ret AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason,
        t.t_hour AS hour_of_day,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 500 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_severity
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc, t.t_hour
),
combined_ret AS (
    SELECT reason, hour_of_day, total_return_amount, return_severity FROM store_ret
    UNION ALL
    SELECT reason, hour_of_day, total_return_amount, return_severity FROM web_ret
),
catalog_ret AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason,
        t.t_hour AS hour_of_day,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 500 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_severity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc, t.t_hour
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(c.reason, cat.reason) AS reason,
    COALESCE(c.hour_of_day, cat.hour_of_day) AS hour_of_day,
    c.total_return_amount AS store_web_return_amount,
    cat.total_return_amount AS catalog_return_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN c.total_return_amount IS NULL THEN 'OnlyCatalog'
        WHEN cat.total_return_amount IS NULL THEN 'OnlyStoreWeb'
        ELSE 'Both'
    END AS source_flag,
    (SELECT AVG(cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns) AS avg_catalog_return_amount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income_band ib WHERE ib.ib_upper_bound > 50000) AS high_income_band_count
FROM combined_ret c
FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_ret cat
    ON c.reason = cat.reason
   AND c.hour_of_day = cat.hour_of_day
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM reason r2
    WHERE r2.r_reason_desc = COALESCE(c.reason, cat.reason)
      AND r2.r_reason_desc LIKE '%Customer%'
)
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.total_return_amount, 0) DESC
LIMIT 100

/* Goal: Compare month‑wise net revenue for store and web channels for each product category (including the total amount returned) over the year 2000. */
WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        d.d_moy AS month,
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS net_revenue,
        COUNT(*) AS transactions,
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax), 0)
            FROM store_returns sr
            JOIN date_dim d_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
            JOIN item i_ret ON sr.sr_item_sk = i_ret.i_item_sk
            WHERE i_ret.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
              AND d_ret.d_year = d.d_year
              AND d_ret.d_moy = d.d_moy
        ) AS returns_amount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2000-12-31'
      AND s.s_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy, i.i_category, i.i_item_sk
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        d.d_moy AS month,
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS net_revenue,
        COUNT(*) AS transactions,
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax), 0)
            FROM store_returns sr
            JOIN date_dim d_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
            JOIN item i_ret ON sr.sr_item_sk = i_ret.i_item_sk
            WHERE i_ret.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
              AND d_ret.d_year = d.d_year
              AND d_ret.d_moy = d.d_moy
        ) AS returns_amount
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk

    LEFT JOIN lvl l ON rh.lvl_calc = l.lvl
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_desc,
        i.i_item_id,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(i.i_formulation, '(\\d{4})', 1) AS formulation_code,
        CONCAT(i.i_item_id, '-', i.i_product_name) AS full_item_key
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_formulation, '^\\d{4}')
      AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%steel%'
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc, i.i_item_id, i.i_formulation, i.i_product_name
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_desc,
        i.i_item_id,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(i.i_formulation, '(\\d{4})', 1) AS formulation_code,
        CONCAT(i.i_item_id, '-', i.i_product_name) AS full_item_key
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_formulation, '^\\d{4}')
      AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%steel%'
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc, i.i_item_id, i.i_formulation, i.i_product_name
),
union_returns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r_reason_desc, i_item_id, total_net_loss, return_cnt
    FROM catalog_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT r_reason_desc, i_item_id, total_net_loss, return_cnt
    FROM web_agg
)
SELECT
    rl.r_reason_desc,
    rl.hierarchy_level,
    SUM(COALESCE(u.total_net_loss, 0)) AS total_net_loss,
    SUM(COALESCE(u.return_cnt, 0)) AS total_return_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.i_item_id) AS distinct_items,
    (SELECT AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) FROM catalog_returns cr) AS avg_catalog_net_loss,
    (SELECT AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) FROM web_returns wr) AS avg_web_net_loss
FROM union_returns u
RIGHT OUTER JOIN reason_with_lvl rl ON u.r_reason_desc = rl.r_reason_desc
GROUP BY rl.r_reason_desc, rl.hierarchy_level
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(u.total_net_loss, 0)) > (SELECT AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) FROM catalog_returns cr)
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_cdemo_sk,
        sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        sr.sr_return_tax,
        sr.sr_fee
    FROM store_returns sr
    WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 200.00
      AND sr.sr_return_tax < 5.00
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store s
          CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(s.s_hours, ',')) AS t(hour)
          WHERE s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
            AND s.s_state = 'CA'
            AND trim(t.hour) = '09:00-10:00'
      )
)
SELECT
    c.c_salutation,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
    SUM(fr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    AVG(fr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_inc_tax,
    MIN(fr.sr_return_tax) AS min_return_tax,
    MAX(fr.sr_fee) AS max_fee,
    (
        SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_return_amt)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) AS total_return_per_customer
FROM filtered_returns fr
JOIN customer c ON fr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON fr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON fr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
WHERE c.c_salutation = 'Mr.'
  AND c.c_birth_year = 1978
  AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '501-1000'
GROUP BY c.c_salutation, cd.cd_gender, hd.hd_buy_potential
ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE years (yr) AS (
    SELECT 2015
    UNION ALL
    SELECT yr + 1 FROM years WHERE yr < 2020
),
store_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_customer_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_profit
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE 
        c.c_email_address LIKE '%@example.com'
        AND regexp_like(c.c_first_name, '^[AB]')
        AND substring(ca.ca_zip, 1, 1) = '4'
        AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT yr FROM years)
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk
),
web_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_customer_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_profit
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk
),
customer_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_email_address,
        ca.ca_zip,
        sp.store_profit,
        COALESCE(wp.web_profit, 0) AS web_profit,
        sp.store_profit + COALESCE(wp.web_profit, 0) AS total_profit
    FROM store_profit sp
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = sp.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_profit wp ON wp.c_customer_sk = sp.c_customer_sk
    WHERE sp.store_profit + COALESCE(wp.web_profit, 0) > 5000
),
customers_with_returns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0) > 1000
),
selected_customer_ids AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk
    FROM customer_profit
    EXCEPT
    SELECT c_customer_sk
    FROM customers_with_returns
),
final_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.c_customer_sk,
        cp.c_first_name,
        cp.c_last_name,
        CONCAT(cp.c_first_name, ' ', cp.c_last_name) AS full_name,
        cp.c_email_address,
        cp.store_profit,
        cp.web_profit,
        cp.total_profit,
        regexp_extract(cp.c_email_address, '@(.*)$', 1) AS email_domain,
        CASE 
            WHEN cp.total_profit >= 20000 THEN 'Platinum'
            WHEN cp.total_profit >= 10000 THEN 'Gold'
            WHEN cp.total_profit >= 5000 THEN 'Silver'
            ELSE 'Bronze'
        END AS profit_tier,
        ( (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) 
           FROM store_returns sr 
           WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = cp.c_customer_sk)
          + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0)
           FROM web_returns wr
           WHERE wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = cp.c_customer_sk)
        ) AS total_returns_amount,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item_sk) FROM (
             SELECT ss2.ss_item_sk AS item_sk
             FROM store_sales ss2
             WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = cp.c_customer_sk
             UNION ALL
             SELECT ws2.ws_item_sk AS item_sk
             FROM web_sales ws2
             WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = cp.c_customer_sk
        ) i) AS distinct_items_purchased,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
    FROM selected_customer_ids scid
    JOIN customer_profit cp ON cp.c_customer_sk = scid.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT 
    c_customer_sk,
    full_name,
    email_domain,
    profit_tier,
    total_profit,
    store_profit,
    web_profit,
    total_returns_amount,
    distinct_items_purchased,
    profit_rank
FROM final_metrics
WHERE profit_rank <= 100
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT DATE '1998-01-01' AS dt
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_add('day', 1, dt)
    FROM date_series
    WHERE dt < DATE '1998-01-07'
),
date_keys AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN date_series ds ON d.d_date = ds.dt
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        cd.cd_gender,
        dk.d_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS catalog_discount
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_keys dk ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dk.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE i.i_brand_id > 5
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 0
    GROUP BY i.i_category, cd.cd_gender, dk.d_date
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        cd.cd_gender,
        dk.d_date,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_discount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_keys dk ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dk.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 1
      AND ss.ss_net_paid > 100
      AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 0
    GROUP BY i.i_category, cd.cd_gender, dk.d_date
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ca.i_category, sa.i_category) AS i_category,
        COALESCE(ca.cd_gender, sa.cd_gender) AS cd_gender,
        COALESCE(ca.d_date, sa.d_date) AS sale_date,
        ca.catalog_sales,
        ca.catalog_discount,
        ca.distinct_orders,
        sa.store_sales,
        sa.store_discount
    FROM catalog_agg ca
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_agg sa
        ON ca.i_category = sa.i_category
        AND ca.cd_gender = sa.cd_gender
        AND ca.d_date = sa.d_date
),
final_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        cd_gender,
        sale_date,
        COALESCE(catalog_sales, 0) AS catalog_sales,
        COALESCE(store_sales, 0) AS store_sales,
        COALESCE(catalog_discount, 0) AS catalog_discount,
        COALESCE(store_discount, 0) AS store_discount,
        COALESCE(distinct_orders, 0) AS distinct_orders,
        (COALESCE(catalog_sales, 0) + COALESCE(store_sales, 0)) AS total_sales
    FROM combined
),
 totals AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        cd_gender,
        CAST(NULL AS date) AS sale_date,
        SUM(catalog_sales) AS catalog_sales,
        SUM(store_sales) AS store_sales,
        SUM(catalog_discount) AS catalog_discount,
        SUM(store_discount) AS store_discount,
        SUM(distinct_orders) AS distinct_orders,
        SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales
    FROM final_rollup
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, cd_gender)
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    cd_gender,
    sale_date,
    catalog_sales,
    store_sales,
    total_sales,
    distinct_orders
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM final_rollup
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM totals
) all_results
ORDER BY i_category, cd_gender, sale_date
OFFSET 10 ROWS
FETCH NEXT 20 ROWS ONLY

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT MIN(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_series
    WHERE date_sk + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(ss.ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales ss)
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_address_sk,
        ca.ca_city,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS catalog_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_paid > 0
      AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_series)
    GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_quantity) > 10
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_address_sk,
        ca.ca_city,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE s.s_country = 'United States'
      AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_series)
    GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity) > 5
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.ca_address_sk, s.ca_address_sk) AS address_sk,
        COALESCE(c.ca_city, s.ca_city) AS city,
        c.catalog_net_paid,
        s.store_net_paid
    FROM catalog_agg c
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_agg s
      ON c.ca_address_sk = s.ca_address_sk
),
filtered_combined AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM combined c
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        WHERE cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = c.address_sk
          AND cs.cs_net_paid > 50000
    )
),
unioned AS (
    SELECT address_sk, city, catalog_net_paid AS net_paid, 'Catalog' AS source
    FROM filtered_combined
    WHERE catalog_net_paid IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT address_sk, city, store_net_paid AS net_paid, 'Store' AS source
    FROM filtered_combined
    WHERE store_net_paid IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    address_sk,
    city,
    source,
    net_paid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY net_paid DESC) AS city_rank
FROM unioned
WHERE net_paid > (
    SELECT AVG(net_paid) FROM unioned
)
ORDER BY net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH call_center_enh AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_city,
        cc.cc_state,
        cc.cc_zip,
        CONCAT(cc.cc_city, ', ', cc.cc_state) AS location,
        SUBSTRING(cc.cc_name, 1, 10) AS short_name,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(cc.cc_zip, '(\\d{5})') AS zip5,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(cc.cc_name, '^([^ ]+)') AS first_word
    FROM call_center cc
    WHERE cc.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(cc.cc_name, '^.*Center.*$')
      AND cc.cc_city LIKE 'A%'
),
global_profit AS (
    SELECT SUM(cs2.cs_net_profit) AS total_global_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs2
)
SELECT
    ce.cc_call_center_id,
    ce.location,
    ce.short_name,
    ce.zip5,
    ce.first_word,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / (SELECT total_global_profit FROM global_profit) * 100) AS profit_pct
FROM call_center_enh ce
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = ce.cc_call_center_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_page cp
    WHERE cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
      AND cp.cp_description LIKE '%Electronics%'
)
GROUP BY
    ce.cc_call_center_id,
    ce.location,
    ce.short_name,
    ce.zip5,
    ce.first_word
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH store_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sales_date_sk,
    s.s_store_name AS channel_name,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_revenue,
    (
      SELECT SUM(ss2.ss_net_profit)
      FROM store_sales ss2
      WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    ) AS total_channel_profit,
    'store' AS channel_type
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax > 100
  GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_store_sk
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity) > 1
),
web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sales_date_sk,
    web.web_name AS channel_name,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_revenue,
    (
      SELECT SUM(ws2.ws_net_profit)
      FROM web_sales ws2
      WHERE ws2.ws_web_site_sk = web.web_site_sk
    ) AS total_channel_profit,
    'web' AS channel_type
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN web_site web ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = web.web_site_sk
  JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax > 100
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM warehouse w
      WHERE w.w_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
        AND w.w_city = 'Shiloh'
    )
  GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, web.web_name, web.web_site_sk
  HAVING SUM(ws.ws_quantity) > 5
)
SELECT
  sales_date_sk,
  channel_name,
  total_revenue,
  total_channel_profit,
  channel_type
FROM (
  SELECT sales_date_sk, channel_name, total_revenue, total_channel_profit, channel_type
  FROM store_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sales_date_sk, channel_name, total_revenue, total_channel_profit, channel_type
  FROM web_agg
) AS combined
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_return_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_tax,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_return_ship_cost,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ARRAY[hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count] AS demo_counts
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_return_ship_cost > 100
      AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 1
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 1
)
SELECT
    jd.sr_return_date_sk,
    demo_val,
    SUM(jd.sr_return_amt) AS sum_return_amt,
    AVG(jd.sr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax,
    COUNT(DISTINCT jd.sr_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
    MIN(jd.sr_return_amt) AS min_return_amt,
    MAX(jd.sr_return_amt) AS max_return_amt,
    AVG(jd.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_income_lower_bound
FROM joined_data jd
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(jd.demo_counts) AS t(demo_val)
GROUP BY jd.sr_return_date_sk, demo_val
ORDER BY sum_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
  Goal: Summarize morning sales for items whose manufacturer starts with "bar".
  The query shows call‑center performance, categorises net profit, counts distinct
  words from the item description, and displays sample string manipulations.
  It demonstrates REGEXP_LIKE, REGEXP_EXTRACT, LIKE, SUBSTRING, CONCAT, a CASE
  expression, a scalar subquery, and UNNEST of a derived array.
*/
WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        i.i_manufact,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_manufact_id,
        t.t_hour,
        /* extract the first word of the description */
        regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '^([A-Za-z]+)', 1) AS first_word,
        /* prefix of description for illustration */
        substring(i.i_item_desc, 1, 3) AS item_desc_prefix,
        /* concatenate a label */
        concat('Item ', i.i_item_id) AS item_label
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim t
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE t.t_hour < 12
      AND regexp_like(i.i_manufact, '^bar')
),
item_word_expansion AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        w.word
    FROM item i
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(i.i_item_desc, ' ')) AS t(word)
    WHERE i.i_item_desc IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    fs.cc_name,
    fs.cc_state,
    fs.i_manufact,
    CASE
        WHEN fs.cs_net_profit >= 2000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN fs.cs_net_profit >= 1000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS profit_category,
    COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions,
    SUM(fs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    (SELECT AVG(cs_inner.cs_net_profit) FROM catalog_sales cs_inner) AS avg_net_profit_all,
    COUNT(DISTINCT iwe.word) AS distinct_desc_word_cnt,
    MAX(fs.item_desc_prefix) AS example_desc_prefix,
    MIN(fs.item_label) AS sample_item_label
FROM filtered_sales fs
LEFT JOIN item_word_expansion iwe
    ON fs.cs_item_sk = iwe.i_item_sk
WHERE fs.first_word LIKE 'A%'
GROUP BY
    fs.cc_name,
    fs.cc_state,
    fs.i_manufact,
    CASE
        WHEN fs.cs_net_profit >= 2000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN fs.cs_net_profit >= 1000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE inv_agg AS (
    SELECT
        inv_item_sk,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    WHERE inv_warehouse_sk IN (16, 9, 15)
      AND inv_date_sk BETWEEN 2450800 AND 2451100
    GROUP BY inv_item_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        inv_item_sk,
        total_on_hand
    FROM inv_agg
    WHERE FALSE
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(sr.sr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    inv_agg.total_on_hand,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 5000 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS return_level,
    (
        SELECT SUM(p2.p_cost)
        FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND p2.p_purpose = 'Unknown'
          AND p2.p_channel_press = 'N'
    ) AS total_promo_cost
FROM inv_agg
JOIN item i
    ON inv_agg.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE i.i_current_price > 30.00
  AND p.p_purpose = 'Unknown'
  AND p.p_channel_press = 'N'
  AND sr.sr_return_tax > 0.5
  AND sr.sr_return_ship_cost < 90
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    inv_agg.total_on_hand,
    i.i_item_sk
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS category,
        t.t_hour AS return_hour,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS sum_net_loss,
        AVG(cr.cr_fee) AS avg_fee,
        ARRAY[cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_fee] AS amounts_array
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_fee > 50
      AND r.r_reason_sk IN (
            SELECT r2.r_reason_sk
            FROM reason r2
            WHERE r2.r_reason_desc LIKE '%Damaged%'
        )
    GROUP BY sm.sm_ship_mode_id, t.t_hour, r.r_reason_desc
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 1000
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_type AS category,
        t.t_hour AS return_hour,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS sum_net_loss,
        AVG(wr.wr_fee) AS avg_fee,
        ARRAY[wr.wr_return_amt, wr.wr_fee] AS amounts_array
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_fee > 30
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_page wp2
            WHERE wp2.wp_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
              AND wp2.wp_url LIKE 'http%'
        )
    GROUP BY wp.wp_type, t.t_hour, r.r_reason_desc
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) > 500
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM catalog_agg
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM web_agg
)
SELECT
    c.category,
    c.return_hour,
    c.reason_desc,
    c.sum_net_loss,
    c.avg_fee,
    u.amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category ORDER BY c.sum_net_loss DESC) AS rn
FROM combined c
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(c.amounts_array) AS u (amount)
ORDER BY c.category, c.sum_net_loss DESC, u.amount DESC

WITH store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        s.s_store_name,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt,
        MAX(i.i_formulation) AS i_formulation,
        substring(s.s_store_name, 1, 5) AS short_store_name
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_category LIKE 'Shoes%'
      AND regexp_like(i.i_formulation, '(?i)blue')
    GROUP BY d.d_date, s.s_store_name
    HAVING SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 0
),
catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        MAX(i.i_formulation) AS i_formulation
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_category LIKE 'Shoes%'
      AND regexp_like(i.i_formulation, '(?i)blue')
    GROUP BY d.d_date, cc.cc_name
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 0
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(sra.d_date, cra.d_date) AS return_date,
    sra.s_store_name,
    cra.call_center_name,
    sra.total_store_return_amt,
    cra.total_catalog_return_amt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sra.d_date, cra.d_date) DESC) AS rn,
    concat(COALESCE(sra.s_store_name, ''), ' | ', COALESCE(cra.call_center_name, '')) AS combined_name,
    regexp_extract(COALESCE(sra.i_formulation, cra.i_formulation), '(\\d{3})') AS extracted_digits,
    sra.short_store_name
FROM store_returns_agg sra
FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_returns_agg cra
    ON sra.d_date = cra.d_date
WHERE COALESCE(sra.total_store_return_amt, 0) > 1000
   OR COALESCE(cra.total_catalog_return_amt, 0) > 1000
ORDER BY return_date DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2020-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d_next
      ON d_next.d_date = dh.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '2020-01-07'
),
sample_inventory AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM inventory
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        dh.d_date,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) DESC) AS sales_rank,
        (
            SELECT i_inner.i_product_name
            FROM store_sales ss2
            JOIN item i_inner ON ss2.ss_item_sk = i_inner.i_item_sk
            WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = (
                  SELECT MAX(ss3.ss_sold_date_sk)
                  FROM store_sales ss3
                  WHERE ss3.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              )
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS latest_product_name
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN sample_inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    )
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, dh.d_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        dh.d_date,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) DESC) AS sales_rank,
        (
            SELECT i_inner.i_product_name
            FROM web_sales ws2
            JOIN item i_inner ON ws2.ws_item_sk = i_inner.i_item_sk
            WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = (
                  SELECT MAX(ws3.ws_sold_date_sk)
                  FROM web_sales ws3
                  WHERE ws3.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              )
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS latest_product_name
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN sample_inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    )
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, dh.d_date
) AS combined
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand AS i_brand,
        cd.cd_gender AS cd_gender,
        hd.hd_buy_potential AS hd_buy_potential,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sum_cs_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sum_ws_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) + SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_units) AS unit_array
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    WHERE
        i.i_class_id IN (9, 10, 14)
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
        AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 100.00
        AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt < 500.00
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_site ws2
            WHERE ws2.web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
              AND ws2.web_state = 'CA'
        )
        AND i.i_brand_id IN (
            SELECT i2.i_brand_id
            FROM item i2
            WHERE i2.i_units = 'Pound'
        )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_brand, cd.cd_gender, hd.hd_buy_potential)
)
SELECT
    a.i_brand,
    a.cd_gender,
    a.hd_buy_potential,
    a.total_sales,
    a.txn_count,
    u.unit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.i_brand ORDER BY a.total_sales DESC) AS brand_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM sales_agg) AS avg_total_sales_all_groups
FROM sales_agg a
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(a.unit_array) AS t(unit)
WHERE a.total_sales > 0
ORDER BY a.total_sales DESC, brand_rank
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    i.i_category AS item_category,
    i.i_brand AS item_brand,
    cd_returning.cd_gender AS returning_customer_gender,
    cd_refund.cd_gender AS refunded_customer_gender,
    hd_refund.hd_income_band_sk AS refunded_income_band,
    hd_returning.hd_income_band_sk AS returning_income_band,
    p.p_promo_name AS promotion_name,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount_inc_tax,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    AVG(p.p_cost) AS avg_promo_cost,
    SUM(p2.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost_alt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_url) AS distinct_page_urls
FROM web_returns wr
JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refund.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refund.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_returning ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning.hd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN item i2 ON wr.wr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
JOIN promotion p2 ON p2.p_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
WHERE p.p_channel_email = 'N'
  AND cd_returning.cd_dep_employed_count >= 1
  AND hd_refund.hd_vehicle_count > 0
GROUP BY
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    cd_returning.cd_gender,
    cd_refund.cd_gender,
    hd_refund.hd_income_band_sk,
    hd_returning.hd_income_band_sk,
    p.p_promo_name
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH promo_stores AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_store_sk AS s_store_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '(?i)discount')
),
reason_stores AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sr.sr_store_sk AS s_store_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%'
),
intersected_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk FROM promo_stores
    INTERSECT
    SELECT s_store_sk FROM reason_stores
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        CONCAT('Store: ', s.s_store_name) AS store_label,
        SUBSTRING(s.s_store_name, 1, 5) AS store_prefix,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(s.s_store_name, '([A-Za-z]+)', 1) AS store_first_word,
        COALESCE(SUM(ss.ss_net_profit), 0) AS total_net_profit,
        COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS sales_transactions,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS return_transactions
    FROM intersected_stores ist
    JOIN store s ON ist.s_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    store_label,
    store_prefix,
    store_first_word,
    total_net_profit,
    total_net_loss,
    sales_transactions,
    return_transactions,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(total_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit
FROM store_agg
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE page_seq AS (
    SELECT MIN(cp_catalog_page_sk) AS cp_catalog_page_sk
    FROM catalog_page
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk + 1
    FROM page_seq
    WHERE cp_catalog_page_sk < (SELECT MIN(cp_catalog_page_sk) FROM catalog_page) + 4
),
pos_profit AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk AS catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_department AS department,
        cs.cs_order_number AS order_number,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department ORDER BY cs.cs_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns cr2) AS avg_return_amount
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_catalog_page_sk IN (SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk FROM page_seq)
      AND cs.cs_net_profit > 0
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr2
            WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
              AND cr2.cr_return_quantity > 0
        )
),
non_pos_profit AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk AS catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_department AS department,
        cs.cs_order_number AS order_number,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department ORDER BY cs.cs_net_profit ASC) AS profit_rank,
        (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns cr2) AS avg_return_amount
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_catalog_page_sk IN (SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk FROM page_seq)
      AND cs.cs_net_profit <= 0
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr2
            WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
              AND cr2.cr_return_quantity > 0
        )
)
SELECT
    catalog_page_sk,
    department,
    order_number,
    net_profit,
    reason_desc,
    profit_rank,
    avg_return_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        catalog_page_sk,
        department,
        order_number,
        net_profit,
        reason_desc,
        profit_rank,
        avg_return_amount
    FROM pos_profit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        catalog_page_sk,
        department,
        order_number,
        net_profit,
        reason_desc,
        profit_rank,
        avg_return_amount
    FROM non_pos_profit
) AS combined
WHERE order_number NOT IN (
    SELECT cr_order_number
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_return_amount > 5000
)
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        w.w_city,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM
        store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
    JOIN time_dim t_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        AND wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        t_ss.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 20
        AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1990
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 0
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_returns wr2
            WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
              AND wr2.wr_return_amt > 5.00
        )
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        w_city,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws_net_profit) + SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM base
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, w_city)
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    w_city,
    store_net_profit,
    web_net_profit,
    catalog_net_profit,
    total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_profit > (SELECT AVG(cs_net_profit) FROM catalog_sales) THEN 'Above Catalog Avg'
        ELSE 'Below Catalog Avg'
    END AS profit_vs_catalog_avg,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Positive'
        ELSE 'Non-Positive'
    END AS profit_sign,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_returns AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ss.ss_store_sk, sr.sr_store_sk) AS store_sk,
        COALESCE(ss.ss_sold_date_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk) AS date_sk,
        COALESCE(ss.ss_customer_sk, sr.sr_customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number AS ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity AS quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid,
        sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_quantity,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM store_sales ss
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_returns sr
        ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
        AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d.d_date,
    c.c_customer_id,
    regexp_extract(c.c_email_address, '@([^@.]+)\\.', 1) AS email_domain,
    substring(c.c_last_name, 1, 1) AS last_name_initial,
    wp.wp_url,
    concat(s.s_store_name, ' - ', cast(d.d_date AS varchar)) AS store_date_label,
    SUM(COALESCE(net_paid, 0)) AS total_sales_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss,
    (SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_net_loss)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
          AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk) AS cumulative_store_return_loss,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND ss2.ss_sold_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk) AS customer_sales_to_date,
    (SELECT AVG(ss3.ss_net_paid)
        FROM store_sales ss3) AS avg_sales_overall
FROM sales_returns sr
LEFT JOIN store s
    ON sr.store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d
    ON sr.date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c
    ON sr.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE
    regexp_like(wp.wp_url, '^https?://[^/]+/(promo|promotion)/')
    AND c.c_email_address LIKE '%@gmail.com'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM store_returns r
        WHERE r.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    )
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d.d_date,
    c.c_customer_id,
    regexp_extract(c.c_email_address, '@([^@.]+)\\.', 1),
    substring(c.c_last_name, 1, 1),
    wp.wp_url,
    concat(s.s_store_name, ' - ', cast(d.d_date AS varchar))
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH promo_diff AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    EXCEPT
    SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
),
filtered_promotions AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk,
           p.p_promo_name,
           p.p_channel_email
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '\\d{2,}')
      AND p.p_channel_email LIKE '%@%'
)
SELECT
    cs.cs_promo_sk,
    fp.p_promo_name,
    regexp_extract(fp.p_promo_name, '(\\d+)', 1) AS promo_number,
    sm.sm_type,
    sm.sm_contract,
    p_lat.promo_alpha_prefix,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_profit,
    AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_bill_customers,
    (
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ss2.ss_net_profit), 0)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
    ) AS total_store_profit_all,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ss3.ss_customer_sk)
        FROM store_sales ss3
        WHERE ss3.ss_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
          AND ss3.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    ) AS store_customers_same_demo
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN filtered_promotions fp ON cs.cs_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN promo_diff pd ON cs.cs_promo_sk = pd.promo_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT regexp_extract(fp.p_promo_name, '([A-Z]+)', 1) AS promo_alpha_prefix
) AS p_lat
WHERE sm.sm_contract LIKE 'Xjy%'
  AND regexp_like(sm.sm_type, '^(REG|EXP)')
GROUP BY
    cs.cs_promo_sk,
    fp.p_promo_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    sm.sm_contract,
    p_lat.promo_alpha_prefix,
    regexp_extract(fp.p_promo_name, '(\\d+)', 1)
ORDER BY total_catalog_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_sales_sample AS (
    SELECT ss.*
    FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) ss
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS sales_year,
        d.d_month_seq AS sales_month,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        'Store' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets
    FROM store_sales_sample ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2002
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM promotion p2
          WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
            AND p2.p_cost > 10
      )
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS sales_year,
        d.d_month_seq AS sales_month,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        'Web' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2002
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM promotion p2
          WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
            AND p2.p_cost > 10
      )
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        sales_year,
        sales_month,
        i_item_id,
        i_item_desc,
        sales_channel,
        total_net_profit,
        total_quantity,
        distinct_tickets AS distinct_count
    FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        sales_year,
        sales_month,
        i_item_id,
        i_item_desc,
        sales_channel,
        total_net_profit,
        total_quantity,
        distinct_orders AS distinct_count
    FROM web_agg
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        sales_year,
        sales_month,
        i_item_id,
        i_item_desc,
        sales_channel,
        total_net_profit,
        total_quantity,
        distinct_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sales_year, sales_month, i_item_id ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS rn
    FROM combined
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    sales_year,
    sales_month,
    i_item_id,
    i_item_desc,
    sales_channel,
    total_net_profit,
    total_quantity,
    distinct_count,
    rn
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY sales_year DESC, sales_month, total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_no_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    EXCEPT
    SELECT
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        cr.cr_call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_ship_mode_sk,
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer),
        CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2))
    FROM catalog_returns cr
)
SELECT
    i.i_category,
    cc.cc_state,
    SUBSTRING(cc.cc_name FROM 1 FOR 5) AS cc_name_prefix,
    CONCAT(i.i_category, '-category') AS category_label,
    SUM(snr.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
    SUM(snr.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    AVG(snr.cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(snr.cs_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN SUM(snr.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
        ELSE 'Negative'
    END AS profit_bucket,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        JOIN item i2 ON cs2.cs_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
        WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i2.i_item_desc, '(?i)steel')
    ) AS overall_avg_steel_profit
FROM sales_no_returns snr
JOIN item i ON snr.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON snr.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON snr.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON snr.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)steel')
  AND cc.cc_name LIKE '%East%'
  AND (i.i_size = 'large' OR i.i_size = 'extra large')
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (i.i_category, cc.cc_state, SUBSTRING(cc.cc_name FROM 1 FOR 5)),
    (i.i_category, SUBSTRING(cc.cc_name FROM 1 FOR 5)),
    (cc.cc_state, SUBSTRING(cc.cc_name FROM 1 FOR 5)),
    (SUBSTRING(cc.cc_name FROM 1 FOR 5)),
    ()
)
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_ret AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        'store' AS return_source,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS loss_category,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM store_returns sr2
            WHERE sr2.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        ) AS total_related_returns,
        (
