            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM promotion p
            WHERE p.p_start_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk
              AND p.p_end_date_sk >= d.d_date_sk
        ) AS active_promo_count,
        inv_summary.total_inventory
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    ) AS inv_summary
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    GROUP BY d.d_year, inv_summary.total_inventory
),
web_ret AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        'web' AS return_source,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) > 8000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) > 800 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS loss_category,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM web_returns wr2
            WHERE wr2.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        ) AS total_related_returns,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM promotion p
            WHERE p.p_start_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk
              AND p.p_end_date_sk >= d.d_date_sk
        ) AS active_promo_count,
        inv_summary.total_inventory
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    ) AS inv_summary
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    GROUP BY d.d_year, inv_summary.total_inventory
)
SELECT *
FROM store_ret
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM web_ret
ORDER BY year DESC, total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_join AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name AS i_product_name,
        i.i_category_id AS i_category_id,
        i.i_size AS i_size,
        i.i_rec_start_date AS i_rec_start_date,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS w_warehouse_name,
        sm.sm_type AS sm_type,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
       AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE i.i_category_id = 9
      AND i.i_size = 'medium'
      AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND cs.cs_ship_date_sk BETWEEN 2450825 AND 2450870
),
order_intersect AS (
    SELECT cs_order_number FROM base_join WHERE cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax > 2000
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cs_order_number FROM base_join WHERE cr_return_amount > 500
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        i_category_id,
        i_size,
        w_warehouse_name,
        sm_type,
        SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amt,
        AVG(cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS avg_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS orders_cnt,
        MIN(cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS min_net_paid,
        MAX(cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS max_net_paid,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM base_join
    JOIN order_intersect oi
        ON base_join.cs_order_number = oi.cs_order_number
    GROUP BY i_item_id, i_product_name, i_category_id, i_size, w_warehouse_name, sm_type
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    i_product_name,
    i_category_id,
    i_size,
    w_warehouse_name,
    sm_type,
    total_net_paid,
    total_return_amt,
    avg_net_paid,
    orders_cnt,
    min_net_paid,
    max_net_paid,
    total_on_hand,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM agg
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH item_returns AS (
    SELECT 
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_manufact_id,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        MIN(d.d_date) AS first_return_date,
        MAX(d.d_date) AS last_return_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i.i_item_id, '^AAAA.*[A-Z]$')
      AND d.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_manufact_id
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        i.i_item_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amt,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_sold_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        MIN(d_sold.d_date) AS first_sale_date,
        MAX(d_sold.d_date) AS last_sale_date
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)plastic')
      AND d_sold.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
union_items AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id,
        total_return_amt AS metric_amount,
        total_return_qty AS metric_qty,
        first_return_date AS start_date,
        last_return_date AS end_date,
        distinct_tickets AS distinct_cnt,
        'RETURN' AS source
    FROM item_returns
    UNION
    SELECT 
        i_item_id,
        total_sales_amt AS metric_amount,
        total_sold_qty AS metric_qty,
        first_sale_date AS start_date,
        last_sale_date AS end_date,
        distinct_orders AS distinct_cnt,
        'SALES' AS source
    FROM web_sales_agg
)
SELECT 
    ui.i_item_id,
    ui.source,
    ui.metric_amount,
    ui.metric_qty,
    ui.distinct_cnt,
    CASE 
        WHEN ui.metric_amount > 10000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN ui.metric_amount BETWEEN 1000 AND 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS amount_category,
    SUBSTRING(ui.i_item_id, 1, 4) AS item_prefix,
    CONCAT(ui.source, '-', ui.i_item_id) AS source_item_key,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM customer c
        WHERE c.c_email_address LIKE '%@example.com'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM web_sales ws2
              WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                AND ws2.ws_item_sk = (
                    SELECT i2.i_item_sk
                    FROM item i2
                    WHERE i2.i_item_id = ui.i_item_id
                )
          )
    ) AS customers_with_example_email,
    ws_latest.ws_net_profit AS latest_net_profit
FROM union_items ui
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ws.ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = (
            SELECT i3.i_item_sk
            FROM item i3
            WHERE i3.i_item_id = ui.i_item_id
        )
      AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = (
            SELECT MAX(d2.d_date_sk)
            FROM date_dim d2
            WHERE d2.d_year = 2001
        )
    ORDER BY ws.ws_net_profit DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS ws_latest
ORDER BY ui.metric_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        cp.cp_department,
        d.d_year,
        ca.ca_address_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        t.word
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(split(w.w_warehouse_name, ' ')) AS t(word)
)
SELECT
    w_state,
    cp_department,
    d_year,
    word,
    SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS order_count,
    AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand
FROM base_data
WHERE
    d_year = 2002
    AND w_state = 'NY'
    AND inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    AND cp_department = 'Electronics'
GROUP BY
    w_state,
    cp_department,
    d_year,
    word
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss_addr_sk,
        ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss_hdemo_sk,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS store_txn_count,
        AVG(ss_quantity) AS store_avg_quantity
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_coupon_amt > 500.0
    GROUP BY ss_addr_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_hdemo_sk
)
SELECT
    ca.ca_state,
    wp.wp_type,
    SUM(ssa.store_total_net_profit) AS total_store_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_net_profit,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS return_order_count,
    AVG(cd.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate,
    MIN(ws.ws_net_profit) AS min_web_profit,
    MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS max_catalog_profit,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        JOIN customer_address ca2
            ON cs2.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca2.ca_address_sk
        WHERE ca2.ca_state = ca.ca_state
    ) AS avg_catalog_profit_by_state
FROM store_sales_agg ssa
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ssa.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ssa.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON ssa.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   AND cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   AND cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
   AND wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
WHERE
    cs.cs_net_profit > 5000.0
    AND ws.ws_net_profit > 2000.0
    AND wr.wr_fee > 20.0
    AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate BETWEEN 4000 AND 8000
    AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
    AND wp.wp_type IN ('Home', 'Search')
GROUP BY
    ca.ca_state,
    wp.wp_type
ORDER BY
    total_store_net_profit DESC,
    wp.wp_type ASC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_series(date_sk) AS (
    SELECT MIN(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1 FROM date_series
    WHERE date_sk + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales)
),
item_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss_item_sk,
        SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_txn_cnt,
        AVG(ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
    ws.ws_quantity,
    ws.ws_sales_price,
    iss.total_sales,
    iss.total_quantity,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    (SELECT SUM(p2.p_cost) FROM promotion p2 WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk) AS promo_total_cost,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_name ORDER BY iss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    COALESCE(rt.return_cnt, 0) AS return_count,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    ws_site.web_name
FROM date_series ds
JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.date_sk
    AND ss.ss_quantity > 1
JOIN item_sales_agg iss
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = iss.ss_item_sk
JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_site ws_site
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT wr.wr_order_number, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_order_number
) rt
    ON rt.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
WHERE
    p.p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '1999-01-01'
    AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'A'
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
    ws.ws_quantity,
    ws.ws_sales_price,
    iss.total_sales,
    iss.total_quantity,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    ws_site.web_name,
    rt.return_cnt
ORDER BY
    iss.total_sales DESC,
    sales_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH
    -- Catalog sales aggregated per customer and date
    cs_agg AS (
        SELECT
            cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
            cs.cs_sold_date_sk     AS sold_date_sk,
            d.d_date               AS sale_date,
            SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)   AS cat_net_paid,
            SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cat_net_profit,
            cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
            sm.sm_type,
            w.w_warehouse_name,
            hd.hd_income_band_sk,
            ib.ib_lower_bound,
            ib.ib_upper_bound
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
        GROUP BY
            cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
            cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
            d.d_date,
            cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
            sm.sm_type,
            w.w_warehouse_name,
            hd.hd_income_band_sk,
            ib.ib_lower_bound,
            ib.ib_upper_bound
    ),
    -- Left‑outer join of returns onto catalog sales (may be null)
    cs_returns AS (
        SELECT
            ca.customer_sk,
            ca.sold_date_sk,
            ca.sale_date,
            ca.cat_net_paid,
            ca.cat_net_profit,
            COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0) AS total_return_amount,
            COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0)     AS total_return_loss
        FROM cs_agg ca
        LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
            ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = ca.customer_sk
           AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ca.sold_date_sk
        GROUP BY
            ca.customer_sk,
            ca.sold_date_sk,
            ca.sale_date,
            ca.cat_net_paid,
            ca.cat_net_profit
    ),
    -- Web sales aggregated per customer and date
    ws_agg AS (
        SELECT
            ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
            d.d_date               AS sale_date,
            SUM(ws.ws_net_paid)   AS web_net_paid,
            SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
            sm.sm_type             AS ship_mode_type,
            w.w_warehouse_name    AS warehouse_name
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        GROUP BY
            ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
            d.d_date,
            sm.sm_type,
            w.w_warehouse_name
    ),
    -- Customers that bought both via catalog and web (INTERSECT)
    cust_in_both_channels AS (
        SELECT customer_sk FROM cs_agg
        INTERSECT
        SELECT customer_sk FROM ws_agg
    ),
    -- Full outer join of catalog and web aggregates
    full_sales AS (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(cr.customer_sk, ws.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
            COALESCE(cr.sale_date, ws.sale_date)     AS sale_date,
            cr.cat_net_paid,
            cr.cat_net_profit,
            ws.web_net_paid,
            ws.web_net_profit
        FROM cs_returns cr
        FULL OUTER JOIN ws_agg ws
            ON cr.customer_sk = ws.customer_sk
           AND cr.sale_date = ws.sale_date
    ),
    -- Attach store information (LEFT OUTER JOIN) on the sale date
    sale_with_store AS (
        SELECT
            fs.*, 
            s.s_store_name,
            s.s_city,
            s.s_state
        FROM full_sales fs
        LEFT JOIN date_dim d ON fs.sale_date = d.d_date
        LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    )
SELECT
    sws.customer_sk,
    c.c_customer_id,
    sws.sale_date,
    sws.cat_net_paid,
    sws.web_net_paid,
    (COALESCE(sws.cat_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(sws.web_net_paid

WITH sampled_web_page AS (
    SELECT
        wp_web_page_sk,
        wp_customer_sk,
        wp_type,
        wp_url,
        wp_char_count,
        wp_image_count
    FROM web_page
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (123)
),
category_pages AS (
    SELECT wp_web_page_sk
    FROM sampled_web_page
    WHERE wp_type = 'Category'
),
home_pages AS (
    SELECT wp_web_page_sk
    FROM sampled_web_page
    WHERE wp_type = 'Home'
),
category_not_home AS (
    SELECT wp_web_page_sk
    FROM category_pages
    EXCEPT
    SELECT wp_web_page_sk
    FROM home_pages
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_email_address,
        CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS full_name,
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_type,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_char_count,
        wp.wp_image_count,
        regexp_extract(wp.wp_url, 'https?://([^/]+)', 1) AS domain,
        CASE WHEN regexp_like(wp.wp_url, '\\.com$') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_com,
        SUBSTRING(wp.wp_url, 1, 20) AS url_prefix
    FROM customer c
    JOIN sampled_web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_email_address LIKE '%@example.com'
      AND regexp_like(wp.wp_url, '^http://www\\.foo\\.com')
      AND wp.wp_web_page_sk IN (SELECT wp_web_page_sk FROM category_not_home)
)
SELECT
    jd.c_birth_country,
    jd.wp_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT jd.wp_web_page_sk) AS distinct_page_count,
    SUM(jd.wp_char_count) AS total_char_count,
    AVG(jd.wp_image_count) AS avg_image_count,
    SUM(jd.is_com) AS com_page_count,
    MAX(jd.full_name) FILTER (WHERE jd.is_com = 1) AS any_com_full_name,
    (SELECT MAX(c2.c_last_review_date)
     FROM customer c2
     WHERE c2.c_customer_sk = jd.c_customer_sk) AS max_review_date,
    MIN(jd.url_prefix) AS sample_url_prefix
FROM joined_data jd
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (jd.c_birth_country, jd.wp_type),
    (jd.c_birth_country),
    (jd.wp_type),
    ()
)
ORDER BY
    jd.c_birth_country NULLS LAST,
    jd.wp_type NULLS LAST,
    distinct_page_count DESC

WITH
    store_sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            ss_customer_sk,
            ss_sold_date_sk,
            SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
            SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
            COUNT(*) AS num_sales
        FROM store_sales
        GROUP BY ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk
    ),
    store_sales_raw AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM store_sales
    )
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    d_sales.d_year AS sale_year,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    ss_agg.total_net_paid,
    ss_agg.total_net_profit,
    cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    CASE WHEN ss_agg.total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_category,
    COALESCE(wp.wp_max_ad_count, 0) AS max_ad_count,
    ws.web_name,
    (
        SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_quantity)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) AS max_catalog_quantity
FROM store_sales_agg ss_agg
JOIN customer c
    ON ss_agg.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sales
    ON ss_agg.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN date_dim d_return
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
JOIN store_sales_raw sr_raw
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = sr_raw.ss_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = sr_raw.ss_item_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   AND wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site ws
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sales.d_year = 2001
  AND wp.wp_max_ad_count > 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
          AND cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    )
GROUP BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    d_sales.d_year,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    ss_agg.total_net_paid,
    ss_agg.total_net_profit,
    cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    CASE WHEN ss_agg.total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END,
    COALESCE(wp.wp_max_ad_count, 0),
    ws.web_name
ORDER BY ss_agg.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH hh_income AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count
    FROM household_demographics hd
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE ib.ib_upper_bound <= 50000
)
SELECT
    ds.d_date AS sale_date,
    st.t_hour AS sale_hour,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hi.hd_buy_potential,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ss.ss_ticket_number,
    ss.ss_quantity,
    ss.ss_sales_price,
    ss.ss_net_paid,
    COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0) AS return_amount,
    (ss.ss_net_paid - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS net_revenue,
    CASE WHEN (ss.ss_net_paid - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.d_date ORDER BY (ss.ss_net_paid - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) DESC) AS revenue_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.d_date ORDER BY ss.ss_ticket_number) AS row_num_by_ticket,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.d_date ORDER BY ss.ss_ticket_number ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_last_3,
    ch.channel AS promo_channel
FROM
    (SELECT * FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (15)) ss
JOIN date_dim ds
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim st
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = st.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN hh_income hi
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hi.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
LEFT JOIN date_dim dr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim tr
    ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = tr.t_time_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.*
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
) p
LEFT JOIN date_dim dps
    ON p.p_start_date_sk = dps.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim dpe
    ON p.p_end_date_sk = dpe.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site w
    ON w.web_open_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim dwc
    ON w.web_close_date_sk = dwc.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(split(p.p_channel_details, ',')) AS ch(channel)
WHERE
    ds.d_year = 2001
    AND st.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
    AND hi.hd_income_band_sk IN (10, 13)
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND ss.ss_quantity > 2
    AND w.web_state = 'CA'
    AND p.p_channel_catalog = 'Y'
    AND ss.ss_store_sk IN (
        SELECT ss_store_sk FROM store_sales WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = 20010101
    )
ORDER BY
    ds.d_date,
    revenue_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) AS d_date_sk,
           1 AS seq
    FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_date_sk + 1,
           seq + 1
    FROM date_seq
    WHERE d_date_sk < (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim)
),
aggregated_returns AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        d_ret.d_date,
        returning_cd.cd_gender AS cd_gender,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer returning_c
        ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = returning_c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship
        ON returning_c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics returning_cd
        ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = returning_cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics returning_hd
        ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = returning_hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer refunded_c
        ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = refunded_c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sales
        ON refunded_c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics refunded_cd
        ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = refunded_cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics refunded_hd
        ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = refunded_hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        d_ret.d_year = 2020
        AND returning_cd.cd_gender = 'M'
        AND returning_hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
        AND d_ret.d_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_seq WHERE seq <= 365)
        AND s.s_store_id IN (
            SELECT s1.s_store_id
            FROM store s1
            JOIN date_dim d1 ON s1.s_closed_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
            WHERE d1.d_year = 2000
            INTERSECT
            SELECT s2.s_store_id
            FROM store s2
            JOIN date_dim d2 ON s2.s_closed_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            JOIN web_returns wr2 ON wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            WHERE wr2.wr_net_loss > 0
        )
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id,
             s.s_store_name,
             d_ret.d_date,
             returning_cd.cd_gender
)
SELECT
    ar.s_store_id,
    ar.s_store_name,
    ar.d_date,
    ar.cd_gender,
    ar.total_net_loss,
    ar.return_count,
    ar.total_return_quantity,
    SUM(ar.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ar.s_store_id ORDER BY ar.d_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_net_loss
FROM aggregated_returns ar
ORDER BY ar.total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE rec_items(i_item_sk, i_brand, i_category, i_manufact_id, i_wholesale_cost, lvl) AS (
    -- Anchor: smallest item for the selected manufacturer
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_brand,
           i.i_category,
           i.i_manufact_id,
           i.i_wholesale_cost,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM   item i
    WHERE  i.i_manufact_id = 117
      AND  i.i_item_sk = (
            SELECT MIN(i2.i_item_sk)
            FROM   item i2
            WHERE  i2.i_manufact_id = 117
          )
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step: next smallest item for the same manufacturer, up to 5 rows total
    SELECT i_next.i_item_sk,
           i_next.i_brand,
           i_next.i_category,
           i_next.i_manufact_id,
           i_next.i_wholesale_cost,
           r.lvl + 1
    FROM   rec_items r
    JOIN   item i_next
           ON i_next.i_item_sk = (
                SELECT MIN(i2.i_item_sk)
                FROM   item i2
                WHERE  i2.i_item_sk > r.i_item_sk
                  AND  i2.i_manufact_id = 117
              )
    WHERE  r.lvl < 5
),
store_ret AS (
    -- Full outer join between store returns and store to keep unmatched rows from both sides
    SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
           sr.sr_return_time_sk,
           sr.sr_item_sk,
           sr.sr_customer_sk,
           sr.sr_cdemo_sk,
           sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
           sr.sr_addr_sk,
           sr.sr_store_sk,
           sr.sr_reason_sk,
           sr.sr_ticket_number,
           sr.sr_return_quantity,
           sr.sr_return_amt,
           sr.sr_return_tax,
           sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
           sr.sr_fee,
           sr.sr_return_ship_cost,
           sr.sr_refunded_cash,
           sr.sr_reversed_charge,
           sr.sr_store_credit,
           sr.sr_net_loss,
           s.s_state
    FROM   store_returns sr
    FULL OUTER JOIN store s
           ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
)
SELECT
    ri.i_brand,
    ri.i_category,
    st.s_state,
    cp.cp_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number)               AS catalog_order_cnt,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price)                       AS total_catalog_sales,
    AVG(cs.cs_net_profit)                            AS avg_catalog_profit,
    MAX(cs.cs_list_price)                            AS max_catalog_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number)               AS web_order_cnt,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price)                       AS total_web_sales,
    AVG(ws.ws_net_profit)                            AS avg_web_profit,
    MIN(ws.ws_list_price)                            AS min_web_price,
    SUM(st.sr_return_amt)                           AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(st.sr_return_amt)                           AS avg_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT st.sr_ticket_number)             AS return_cnt
FROM   rec_items ri
JOIN   catalog_sales cs   ON cs.cs_item_sk = ri.i_item_sk
JOIN   catalog_page cp    ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
JOIN   warehouse w        ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
LEFT   JOIN web_sales ws   ON ws.ws_item_sk = ri.i_item_sk
                           AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN   store_ret st       ON st.sr_item_sk = ri.i_item_sk
WHERE  ri.i_manufact_id = 117
  AND  ri.i_wholesale_cost > 1.00
  AND  cs.cs_list_price > 100.00
  AND  st.s_state = 'CA'
  AND  ws.ws_wholesale_cost < 100.00
GROUP BY ri.i_brand,
         ri.i_category,
         st.s_state,
         cp.cp_type
ORDER BY total_catalog_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk,
           d.d_date,
           d.d_year,
           d.d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk,
           d_next.d_date,
           d_next.d_year,
           d_next.d_month_seq
    FROM date_seq ds
    JOIN date_dim d_next
      ON d_next.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE ds.d_date < DATE '1998-01-31'
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    ds.d_year,
    ds.d_month_seq,
    i.i_category,
    p.p_promo_name,
    pd.channel_detail,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
    (
        SELECT SUM(ss2.ss_net_paid)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
          AND ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    ) AS store_monthly_sales
FROM date_seq ds
JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca

WITH sales_union AS (

          ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit
   FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) ss
   WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 0

   UNION ALL

   SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
          ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
          ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,

   FROM web_sales ws

   UNION ALL

   SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
          wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
          wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
          wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk AS hdemo_sk,

          NULL AS promo_sk,
          NULL AS ship_mode_sk,

)

WITH RECURSIVE d AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year, d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2000-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_year, d2.d_month_seq
    FROM d
    JOIN date_dim d2
        ON d2.d_date = date_add('day', 1, d.d_date)
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2000-01-31'
)
SELECT
    d.d_date AS sale_date,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    c.c_customer_id,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ss.ss_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
    CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'Full Price' END AS promo_type,
    r_sr.r_reason_desc AS store_return_reason,
    r_wr.r_reason_desc AS web_return_reason,
    cr_l.total_cr_return_amount,
    cr_l.total_cr_return_cnt,
    cr_l.warehouse_name,
    ws.web_name AS website_name,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_7day_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_state ORDER BY ss.ss_net_profit DESC) AS profit_state_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY d.d_date) AS sales_seq
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
   AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
   AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_cr_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS total_cr_return_cnt,
        MAX(w.w_warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
      AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
      AND cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
      AND w.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 500000
      AND r_cr.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
) cr_l
WHERE
    d.d_year = 2000
    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    AND r_sr.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
    AND ws.web_country = 'United States'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    )
ORDER BY profit_state_rank, sale_date

WITH agg_base AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.cc_name,
        d.d_year,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_cs_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_ws_net_paid,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_cr_net_loss,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_sr_net_loss,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory,
        ARRAY_AGG(cs.cs_quantity) AS cs_quantity_array,
        ARRAY_AGG(ws.ws_quantity) AS ws_quantity_array
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer bc ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = bc.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address bc_addr ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = bc_addr.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics bc_cdemo ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = bc_cdemo.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics bc_hdemo ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = bc_hdemo.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer sc ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = sc.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address sc_addr ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = sc_addr.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics sc_cdemo ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = sc_cdemo.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics sc_hdemo ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = sc_hdemo.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = bc.c_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON (cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk OR sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk)
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON bc_hdemo.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = bc.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d.d_year = 2001
        AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND bc.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND ib.ib_upper_bound >= 40000
        AND cs.cs_sales_price > 100.00
        AND sr.sr_fee > 50.00
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM inventory i2 
            WHERE i2.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk 
              AND i2.inv_quantity_on_hand > 1000
        )
    GROUP BY 
        cc.cc_name,
        d.d_year,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        r.r_reason_desc
),
qty_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        t.cc_name,
        t.d_year,
        t.ib_income_band_sk,
        t.ib_upper_bound,
        t.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(q) AS total_quantity_sum
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            cc_name,
            d_year,
            ib_income_band_sk,
            ib_upper_bound,
            r_reason_desc,
            ARRAY_CONCAT(cs_quantity_array, ws_quantity_array) AS combined_qty_array
        FROM agg_base
    ) t
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.combined_qty_array) AS u(q)
    GROUP BY 
        t.cc_name,
        t.d_year,
        t.ib_income_band_sk,
        t.ib_upper_bound,
        t.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT 
    a.cc_name,
    a.d_year,
    a.ib_income_band_sk,
    a.ib_upper_bound,
    a.r_reason_desc,
    a.order_cnt,
    a.total_cs_net_paid,
    a.total_ws_net_paid,
    a.total_cr_net_loss,
    a.total_sr_net_loss,
    a.total_inventory,
    q.total_quantity_sum,
    (SELECT MAX(d_date) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS max_date_2001
FROM agg_base a
JOIN qty_agg q ON a.cc_name = q.cc_name
    AND a.d_year = q.d_year
    AND a.ib_income_band_sk = q.ib_income_band_sk
    AND a.ib_upper_bound = q.ib_upper_bound
    AND a.r_reason_desc = q.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY a.total_cs_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

    COUNT(DISTINCT r.r_reason_id) AS distinct_return_reasons,
    MIN(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS min_income_lower,
    MAX(ib.ib_upper_bound) AS max_income_upper
FROM filtered_store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d_sales ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim ts ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim tw ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = tw.t_time_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    AND wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse wh ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN date_dim d_store_closed ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_store_closed.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_promo_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_promo_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
WHERE
    d_sales.d_year = 2000
    AND ts.t_hour = 10
    AND ca.ca_gmt_offset = -6.00
    AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_sales ws2
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND d2.d_year = 2000
          AND ws2.ws_quantity > 5
    )
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (

WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_year) AS yr FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT yr + 1 FROM years WHERE yr < (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim)
),
inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT inv.inv_date_sk,
           inv.inv_warehouse_sk,
           SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM inventory TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS inv
    JOIN date_dim d_inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY inv.inv_date_sk, inv.inv_warehouse_sk
),
unioned AS (
    SELECT
        cust_ref.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        p_start.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
        d_ret.d_date_sk AS date_sk,
        d_ret.d_year AS d_year,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS sum_return_amount,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS sum_return_qty,
        'Loss' AS category_type,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS category_label
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d_ret ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer cust_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = cust_ref.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promotion p_start ON p_start.p_start_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p_end ON p_end.p_end_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cust_ship ON cust_ref.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_cust_ship.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cust_ref.c_customer_id, p_start.p_promo_id, d_ret.d_date_sk, d_ret.d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        cust_ret.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        p_end.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
        d_ret.d_date_sk AS date_sk,
        d_ret.d_year AS d_year,
        CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS sum_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS sum_return_qty,
        'Orders' AS category_type,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) > 5 THEN 'Many' ELSE 'Few' END AS category_label
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d_ret ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer cust_ret ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = cust_ret.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promotion p_end ON p_end.p_end_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cust_sales ON cust_ret.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_cust_sales.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cust_ret.c_customer_id, p_end.p_promo_id, d_ret.d_date_sk, d_ret.d_year
)
SELECT
    d_all.d_year,
    u.customer_id,
    u.promo_id,

    SUM(COALESCE(u.sum_return_qty, 0)) AS total_return_qty,
    SUM(COALESCE(i.total_qty_on_hand, 0)) AS total_inventory_qty,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) FROM promotion p) AS total_distinct_promos
FROM inventory_agg i
RIGHT OUTER JOIN date_dim d_all
    ON i.inv_date_sk = d_all.d_date_sk
JOIN unioned u
    ON u.date_sk = d_all.d_date_sk
WHERE d_all.d_current_year = 'Y'

GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (d_all.d_year, u.customer_id, u.promo_id, u.category_type, u.category_label),

    (d_all.d_year, u.customer_id),

)

WITH base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        c.c_customer_id,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_total,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS store_returns_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS catalog_returns_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_ext_sales_price, 0)) AS web_sales_total,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS num_transactions
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site we
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1999
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound >= 100000
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND w.w_country = 'USA'
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, c.c_customer_id),
        (d.d_year, d.d_month_seq),
        (d.d_year)
    )
)
SELECT
    b.d_year,
    b.d_month_seq,
    b.c_customer_id,
    b.sales_total,
    b.store_returns_loss,
    b.catalog_returns_loss,
    b.web_sales_total,
    b.num_transactions,
    (SELECT AVG(b2.sales_total)
     FROM base_agg b2
     WHERE b2.d_year = b.d_year) AS avg_year_sales,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM base_agg b3
     WHERE b3.d_year = b.d_year
       AND b3.d_month_seq = b.d_month_seq
       AND b3.sales_total > b.sales_total) AS higher_sales_customers_in_month
FROM base_agg b
WHERE b.sales_total > (
        SELECT AVG(b4.sales_total)
        FROM base_agg b4
        WHERE b4.d_year = b.d_year
      )
  AND b.c_customer_id IN (
        SELECT c_id
        FROM (
            SELECT c.c_customer_id AS c_id
            FROM store_returns sr
            JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity > 0

            INTERSECT

            SELECT c.c_customer_id AS c_id
            FROM web_sales ws
            JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 0
        )
    )
ORDER BY b.d_year, b.d_month_seq, b.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100

WITH high_cost_promotions AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_cost,
        CASE WHEN p.p_cost > 5000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS cost_category
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_cost > 0
)
SELECT
    sales_channel,
    promo_id,
    cost_category,
    hour,
    minute,
    total_profit,
    transaction_count,
    related_customer_count,
    CASE
        WHEN total_profit > 50000 THEN 'HIGH_PROFIT'
        WHEN total_profit > 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM_PROFIT'
        ELSE 'LOW_PROFIT'
    END AS profit_level
FROM (
    SELECT
        'Store' AS sales_channel,
        p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
        hp.cost_category,
        td.t_hour AS hour,
        td.t_minute AS minute,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk)
            FROM catalog_sales cs
            WHERE cs.cs_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
        ) AS related_customer_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN high_cost_promotions hp ON p.p_promo_sk = hp.p_promo_sk
    WHERE s.s_geography_class = 'Unknown'
      AND hp.cost_category = 'HIGH'
      AND ss.ss_net_profit > (
            SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_profit)
            FROM store_sales ss2
            WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
          )
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, hp.cost_category, td.t_hour, td.t_minute
    UNION
    SELECT
        'Web' AS sales_channel,
        p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
        hp.cost_category,
        td.t_hour AS hour,
        td.t_minute AS minute,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk)
            FROM web_sales ws2
            WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
        ) AS related_customer_count
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN high_cost_promotions hp ON p.p_promo_sk = hp.p_promo_sk
    WHERE w.web_country = 'United States'
      AND hp.cost_category = 'HIGH'
      AND ws.ws_net_profit > (
            SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_profit)
            FROM web_sales ws2
            WHERE ws2.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
          )
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, hp.cost_category, td.t_hour, td.t_minute
) AS combined
ORDER BY total_profit DESC, profit_level, sales_channel
LIMIT 100

    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
    MIN(i.i_current_price) AS min_price,
    MAX(i.i_current_price) AS max_price
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim t
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN reason r
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
INNER JOIN web_page wp
    ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
INNER JOIN web_site ws
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#43'
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
  AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
  AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
  AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
GROUP BY d.d_year, s.s_state, i.i_brand
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc,
        wp.wp_type AS wp_type,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        MIN(wr.wr_return_ship_cost) AS min_ship_cost,
        MAX(wr.wr_return_ship_cost) AS max_ship_cost
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_ship_cost > 1000
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity >= 2
      AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%price%'
      AND wp.wp_image_count >= 5
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
    GROUP BY i.i_category, r.r_reason_desc, wp.wp_type
),
base_alt AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc,
        wp.wp_type AS wp_type,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        MIN(wr.wr_return_ship_cost) AS min_ship_cost,
        MAX(wr.wr_return_ship_cost) AS max_ship_cost
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_ship_cost BETWEEN 500 AND 1500
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity = 1
      AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Lost my job'
      AND wp.wp_image_count = 4
      AND i.i_category = 'Clothing'
    GROUP BY i.i_category, r.r_reason_desc, wp.wp_type
)
SELECT
    u.i_category,
    u.r_reason_desc,
    u.wp_type,
    u.total_return_amt,
    u.avg_return_qty,
    u.distinct_orders,
    u.min_ship_cost,
    u.max_ship_cost,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY u.i_category ORDER BY u.total_return_amt DESC) AS category_return_rank,
    SUM(u.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY u.i_category) AS cumulative_return_amt
FROM (
    SELECT i_category, r_reason_desc, wp_type, total_return_amt, avg_return_qty, distinct_orders, min_ship_cost, max_ship_cost
    FROM base
    UNION
    SELECT i_category, r_reason_desc, wp_type, total_return_amt, avg_return_qty, distinct_orders, min_ship_cost, max_ship_cost
    FROM base_alt
) u
ORDER BY u.total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH promo_union AS (
    SELECT
        p_promo_sk,
        p_promo_name,
        p_channel_email,
        p_channel_event,
        p_channel_demo
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        p_promo_sk,
        p_promo_name,
        p_channel_email,
        p_channel_event,
        p_channel_demo
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_event = 'N'
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    pu.p_promo_name,
    ca.ca_state,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_order_cnt,
    MIN(cr.cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount,
    MAX(cr.cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cr2.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    ) AS total_return_amount_for_item
FROM catalog_returns cr
FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
LEFT JOIN promo_union pu
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = pu.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca
    ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE
    pu.p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND pu.p_channel_demo = 'N'
    AND cr.cr_ship_mode_sk IN (5, 1, 9)
    AND ca.ca_gmt_offset = -8.00
    AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr_ex
        WHERE cr_ex.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
          AND cr_ex.cr_return_amount > 100
    )
GROUP BY ROLLUP (cd.cd_gender, pu.p_promo_name, ca.ca_state)
LIMIT 100

WITH
  small_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_month_seq IN (2415111, 2415417)
    LIMIT 5
  ),
  multipliers AS (
    SELECT value AS multiplier
    FROM UNNEST(ARRAY[1, 2, 3]) AS t(value)
  )
SELECT
  d.d_year,
  ws.web_name,
  SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
  SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
  COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
  AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_on_hand,
  MIN(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS min_return_quantity,
  MAX(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS max_web_return_quantity,
  SUM(qty * m.multiplier) AS weighted_qty_sum
FROM small_dates d
CROSS JOIN multipliers m
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c_cr_refunded ON c_cr_refunded.c_customer_sk = cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_cr_refunded ON ca_cr_refunded.ca_address_sk = cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk
WHERE
  cr.cr_ship_mode_sk IN (1, 5, 14)
  AND cr.cr_refunded_cash > 1000
  AND wr.wr_return_ship_cost > 300
  AND ws.web_state = 'CA'
  AND ca_cr_refunded.ca_country = 'United States'
  AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 50
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_returns cr2
    WHERE cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_cr_refunded.c_customer_sk
      AND cr2.cr_refunded_cash > 2000
  )
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[cr.cr_return_quantity, wr.wr_return_quantity]) AS t(qty)
GROUP BY ROLLUP(d.d_year, ws.web_name)
ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, ws.web_name
LIMIT 100

WITH
    intersect_customers AS (
        SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN date_dim d_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
        WHERE d_ret.d_year = 2000
        INTERSECT
        SELECT wp.wp_customer_sk
        FROM web_page wp
        JOIN date_dim d_wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp.d_date_sk
        WHERE d_wp.d_year = 2000
    ),
    customer_email_parts AS (
        SELECT
            c.c_customer_sk,
            c.c_email_address,
            REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.c_email_address, '@([^\\.]+)\\.', 1) AS domain_prefix,
            REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.c_email_address, '\\.([a-zA-Z]+)$', 1) AS top_level_domain,
            part
        FROM customer c
        CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(c.c_email_address, '@')) AS t(part)
        WHERE part LIKE '%.%'
    ),
    category_year_returns AS (
        SELECT
            d.d_year,
            i.i_category,
            ce.top_level_domain,
            SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
            SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
            COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_item_sk) AS distinct_items_returned,
            CASE
                WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High'
                ELSE 'Low'
            END AS net_loss_flag
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN intersect_customers ic ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ic.sr_customer_sk
        LEFT JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        LEFT JOIN customer_email_parts ce ON c.c_customer_sk = ce.c_customer_sk
        WHERE i.i_item_desc LIKE '%Deluxe%'
          AND REGEXP_LIKE(c.c_email_address, '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@example\\.(com|org)$')
        GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
            (d.d_year, i.i_category, ce.top_level_domain),
            (d.d_year, i.i_category),
            (d.d_year),
            ()
        )
    ),
    ranked_returns AS (
        SELECT
            d_year,
            i_category,
            top_level_domain,
            total_return_amt,
            total_net_loss,
            net_loss_flag,
            RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS category_year_rank
        FROM category_year_returns
    )
SELECT
    rr.d_year,
    rr.i_category,
    COALESCE(rr.top_level_domain, 'UNKNOWN') AS email_tld,
    rr.total_return_amt,
    rr.total_net_loss,
    rr.net_loss_flag,
    rr.category_year_rank,
    concat('Category ', rr.i_category, ' - TLD ', COALESCE(rr.top_level_domain, 'unknown')) AS category_tld_label,
    substr(COALESCE(rr.top_level_domain, ''), 1, 3) AS tld_prefix,
    (
        SELECT AVG(sr_inner.sr_return_amt)
        FROM store_returns sr_inner
        JOIN date_dim d_inner ON sr_inner.sr_returned_date_sk = d_inner.d_date_sk
        WHERE d_inner.d_year = rr.d_year
    ) AS avg_return_amt_year,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_page wp
            JOIN date_dim d_wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp.d_date_sk
            WHERE wp.wp_customer_sk = (
                SELECT c2.c_customer_sk
                FROM customer c2
                WHERE c2.c_email_address LIKE concat('%@', rr.top_level_domain)
                LIMIT 1
            )
            AND d_wp.d_year = rr.d_year
        ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No'
    END AS has_web_page_visit
FROM ranked_returns rr
WHERE rr.d_year >= 1999
ORDER BY rr.total_return_amt DESC
OFFSET 10 ROWS FETCH NEXT 20 ROWS ONLY

WITH
union_sales_returns AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
           SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
           SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_sales_amount,
           SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    GROUP BY cr_item_sk
),
inv1 AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk, inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
),
inv2 AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk, inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand < 100
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    cd.cd_gender,
    ca.ca_city,
    td.t_hour,
    sm.sm_type,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    cc.cc_name,
    cp.cp_description,
    us.total_sales_amount,
    us.total_quantity,
    (SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_return_amt) FROM store_returns sr2 WHERE sr2.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS total_return_amount,
    inv1.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_qty_gt0,
    inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_qty_lt100
FROM union_sales_returns us
JOIN item i
    ON us.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN inv1
    ON i.i_item_sk = inv1.inv_item_sk
LEFT JOIN inv2
    ON i.i_item_sk = inv2.inv_item_sk
JOIN store_sales ss
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN time_dim td
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
FULL OUTER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
   AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON i.i_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
   AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN reason r
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 20
  AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    cd.cd_gender,
    ca.ca_city,
    td.t_hour,
    sm.sm_type,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    cc.cc_name,
    cp.cp_description,
    us.total_sales_amount,
    us.total_quantity,
    inv1.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand
ORDER BY us.total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    s.s_store_name,
    promo.p_promo_name,
    cc.cc_market_manager,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_indicator,
    (SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_profit)
       FROM tpcds.web_sales ws2
      WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk) AS avg_profit_for_promo
FROM tpcds.web_sales ws
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_sold
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_sold
  ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_ship
  ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_bill
  ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_ship
  ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.promotion promo
  ON ws.ws_promo_sk = promo.p_promo_sk
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_promo_start
  ON promo.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_promo_end
  ON promo.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.warehouse w
  ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_ret
  ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_ret.t_time_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_ret
  ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.reason r
  ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN tpcds.store s
  ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN tpcds.call_center cc
  ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
WHERE ws.ws_net_paid > (
    SELECT AVG(ws3.ws_net_paid)
      FROM tpcds.web_sales ws3
     WHERE ws3.ws_sold_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM tpcds.store_returns sr2
     WHERE sr2.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
       AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
       AND sr2.sr_return_quantity > 0
)
GROUP BY
    d_sold.d_year,
    s.s_store_name,
    promo.p_promo_name,
    cc.cc_market_manager
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d_next
        ON d_next.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dr.d_date)
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '2022-12-31'
),
catalog_ret_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_product_name,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS catalog_return_qty,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_amount)   AS catalog_return_amt
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_range dr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE i.i_category_id = 3
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name
),
web_ret_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_product_name,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS web_return_qty,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt)      AS web_return_amt
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_range dr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE i.i_category_id = 3
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name
),
full_ret AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(ca.i_item_sk, wa.i_item_sk) AS i_item_sk,
           COALESCE(ca.i_product_name, wa.i_product_name) AS i_product_name,
           ca.catalog_return_qty,
           ca.catalog_return_amt,
           wa.web_return_qty,
           wa.web_return_amt
    FROM catalog_ret_agg ca
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_ret_agg wa
        ON ca.i_item_sk = wa.i_item_sk
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_product_name,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_range dr
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE i.i_category_id = 3
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    fr.i_item_sk,
    fr.i_product_name,
    (COALESCE(fr.catalog_return_amt, 0) + COALESCE(fr.web_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amt,
    (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim) AS max_year
FROM full_ret fr
WHERE (COALESCE(fr.catalog_return_amt, 0) + COALESCE(fr.web_return_amt, 0)) > 0

UNION ALL

SELECT
    sa.i_item_sk,
    sa.i_product_name,
    0.0 AS total_return_amt,
    (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim) AS max_year
FROM sales_agg sa
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM catalog_ret_agg ca WHERE ca.i_item_sk = sa.i_item_sk
    )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_ret_agg wa WHERE wa.i_item_sk = sa.i_item_sk
    )

ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE rank_limits AS (
    SELECT 1 AS rank_val
    UNION ALL
    SELECT rank_val + 1 FROM rank_limits WHERE rank_val < 10
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) + SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk

WITH RECURSIVE date_range (date_sk) AS (

),
common_items AS (

    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk

    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_returning ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk

    JOIN customer_address ca_store_returns ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_store_returns.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_store_returns ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_store_returns.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p_store ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_store.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_store_sales ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_store_sales.ca_address_sk

WITH cs_base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_net_paid > 1000
      AND cs.cs_quantity >= 2
),
ss_base AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_addr_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_net_paid > 500
      AND ss.ss_quantity >= 2
),
union_customers AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk FROM cs_base cs
    UNION
    SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk FROM ss_base ss
),
intersect_customers AS (
    SELECT cust_sk FROM union_customers
    INTERSECT
    SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk FROM store_returns sr
),
main AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        cs.cs_net_paid AS catalog_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS store_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit + ss.ss_net_profit AS total_net_profit,
        CASE WHEN (cs.cs_net_profit + ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY (cs.cs_net_profit + ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank_in_store,
        (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid) FROM catalog_sales cs2 WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_catalog_net_paid_for_item,
        inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand,
        p_best.p_promo_id,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity > 0 THEN 'Returned' ELSE 'Not Returned' END AS return_status
    FROM cs_base cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ) AS inv_agg
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p2.p_promo_id
        FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        ORDER BY p2.p_cost ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS p_best
    JOIN ss_base ss ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT cust_sk FROM intersect_customers)
)
SELECT *
FROM main
LIMIT 100

WITH items_sold AS (

    UNION
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk FROM store_sales ss
    UNION
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk FROM web_sales ws
),
items_returned AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS i_item_sk FROM web_returns wr
),
items_no_return AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM items_sold
    EXCEPT
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM items_returned
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_manager_id,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS catalog_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_orders
    FROM items_no_return nr
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = nr.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
                      AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
                      AND sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = ws.ws_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND i.i_brand_id IN (1, 2, 3)
      AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451545 AND 2451555
      AND ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship > 1000
      AND i.i_manager_id = 63
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand_id, i.i_manager_id,
             p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name,
             sm.sm_ship_mode_id
    HAVING (SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) + SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) + SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price)) > 5000
),
keywords AS (
    SELECT
        a.*, 
        t.keyword,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.i_item_sk ORDER BY a.total_net_profit DESC) AS keyword_rank
    FROM agg_sales a
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(a.p_promo_name, ' ')) AS t(keyword)
    WHERE length(t.keyword) > 2
),
final_rank AS (
    SELECT
        k.i_item_sk,
        k.i_product_name,
        k.i_brand_id,
        k.i_manager_id,
        k.p_promo_id,
        k.p_promo_name,
        k.sm_ship_mode_id,
        k.catalog_sales,
        k.store_sales,
        k.web_sales,
        k.catalog_net_profit,
        k.store_net_profit,
        k.web_net_profit,
        k.total_net_profit,
        k.catalog_orders,
        k.store_orders,
        k.web_orders,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k.i_brand_id ORDER BY k.total_net_profit DESC) AS brand_profit_rank,
        k.keyword,
        k.keyword_rank,
        (SELECT AVG(cs_sub.cs_net_profit)
         FROM catalog_sales cs_sub
         WHERE cs_sub.cs_item_sk = k.i_item_sk) AS avg_catalog_net_profit_item
    FROM keywords k
    WHERE k.keyword_rank <= 3
      AND EXISTS (

                WHERE ws_inner.ws_item_sk = k.i_item_sk
                LIMIT 1
          )
            AND wp.wp_type = 'Home'
      )
)
