        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
      AND p.p_channel_demo = 'N'
    GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_store_sk
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.d_date,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ca.ca_state,
    sa.total_net_paid,
    sa.total_profit,
    sa.sales_cnt,
    sr.sr_return_amt,
    cr_agg.total_cr_return_amount,
    wr_summary.web_ret_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_date ORDER BY sa.total_net_paid DESC) AS store_sales_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN sr.sr_return_amt > 100 THEN 'High'
        WHEN sr.sr_return_amt > 0 THEN 'Low'
        ELSE 'None'
    END AS return_severity
FROM store_sales_agg sa
JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = sa.sold_date_sk
   AND ss.ss_store_sk = sa.store_sk
JOIN date_dim d
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
   AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
JOIN promotion p
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_ret_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
) AS wr_summary
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_order_number,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_cr_return_amount
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    GROUP BY cr.cr_order_number
) AS cr_agg
    ON cr_agg.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
WHERE cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
  AND w.w_state = 'CA'
  AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
ORDER BY d.d_date ASC, sa.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE numbers AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n + 1 FROM numbers WHERE n < 10
),
catalog_agg AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_item_sk,
    i.i_product_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_quantity > (SELECT MAX(n) FROM numbers)
  GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name
  HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0
),
web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_item_sk,
    i.i_product_name,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_quantity > (SELECT MAX(n) FROM numbers)
  GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name
  HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0
),
sales_union AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, sales_cnt, 'Catalog' AS channel
  FROM catalog_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, sales_cnt, 'Web' AS channel
  FROM web_agg
),
returns_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sr.sr_item_sk AS i_item_sk
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN store_sales ss ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
  WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM sales_union su
  WHERE su.total_net_paid > (
    SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_net_paid)
    FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = 2450815
  )
  EXCEPT
  SELECT i_item_sk FROM returns_items
)
SELECT
  su.i_item_sk,
  su.i_product_name,
  su.channel,
  su.total_net_paid,
  su.total_net_profit,
  su.sales_cnt,
  CASE WHEN su.total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.channel ORDER BY su.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM sales_union su
JOIN filtered_items fi ON su.i_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
ORDER BY su.total_net_profit DESC, profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH return_aggregates AS (
    SELECT r.r_reason_desc,
           COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.c_customer_id,
    email_part AS email_domain,
    'purchase' AS activity_type,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_category,
    ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS amount,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS total_reason_returns
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(c.c_email_address, '@')) AS t(email_part)
WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics'
  AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
  AND email_part LIKE '%.%'

UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.c_customer_id,
    email_part AS email_domain,
    'return' AS activity_type,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_category,
    wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax AS amount,
    (SELECT ra.total_returns
     FROM return_aggregates ra
     WHERE ra.r_reason_desc = r.r_reason_desc) AS total_reason_returns
FROM web_returns wr
JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(c.c_email_address, '@')) AS t(email_part)
WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics'
  AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
  AND email_part LIKE '%.%'
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sampled_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_email_address,
        c.c_current_cdemo_sk,
        c.c_current_addr_sk
    FROM customer c
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    t.t_hour,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS return_cnt,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_name) AS store_total_return_amt,
    AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_name) AS store_avg_return_amt,
    MIN(CONCAT('Store: ', s.s_store_name)) AS store_label,
    MIN(REGEXP_EXTRACT(sc.c_email_address, '^([^@]+)@', 1)) AS email_prefix,
    (
        SELECT MAX(sr2.sr_return_amt)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        JOIN store s2 ON sr2.sr_store_sk = s2.s_store_sk
        WHERE s2.s_store_name = s.s_store_name
    ) AS max_return_amt_for_store,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_name ORDER BY t.t_hour) AS hour_rank
FROM sampled_customers sc
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = sc.c_customer_sk
JOIN store s
    ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN time_dim t
    ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON sc.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE
    regexp_like(sc.c_last_name, '^A.*')
    AND sc.c_email_address LIKE '%@example.com'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_page wp
        WHERE wp.wp_customer_sk = sc.c_customer_sk
          AND wp.wp_url LIKE 'http://%example.com%'
    )
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS
    ((s.s_store_name, t.t_hour), (s.s_store_name), ())
HAVING
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 0
ORDER BY
    s.s_store_name,
    t.t_hour

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        td.t_hour,
        st.s_store_id,
        st.s_store_name,
        st.s_state AS store_state,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_current_price,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        ca.ca_state,
        pr.p_promo_name,
        pr.p_discount_active,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        CASE WHEN pr.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS promo_active_flag,
        ARRAY[ss.ss_quantity, sr.sr_return_quantity, cr.cr_return_quantity] AS qty_array
    FROM time_dim td
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store st
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion pr
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = pr.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
           AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND i.i_current_price > 20.0
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
),
quantity_expanded AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_store_name,
        store_state,
        t_hour,
        i_category,
        ss_net_profit,
        sr_return_amt,
        cr_return_amount,
        promo_active_flag,
        qty
    FROM joined_data
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(qty_array) AS t (qty)
),
store_daily_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_store_name,
        store_state,
        t_hour,
        i_category,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(promo_active_flag) AS promo_active_count,
        SUM(qty) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM quantity_expanded
    GROUP BY s_store_id, s_store_name, store_state, t_hour, i_category
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    s_store_name,
    store_state,
    t_hour,
    i_category,
    total_net_profit,
    total_return_amount,
    total_catalog_return_amount,
    promo_active_count,
    total_quantity,
    transaction_count,
    (total_net_profit - total_return_amount - total_catalog_return_amount) AS net_contribution,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'High Profit'
        WHEN total_net_profit BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium Profit'
        ELSE 'Low Profit'
    END AS profit_category
FROM store_daily_agg
WHERE total_net_profit > 0
HAVING total_quantity > 5
ORDER BY net_contribution DESC
LIMIT 100

plan_feedback.mechanism: dose-corrected validity gate: forced first lever (A) + threshold-gated deeper levels (C) + Vendi-aligned 3-gram reward
plan_feedback.depth_policy: forced >= 1 hint(s); beyond that continue only while Thompson(validity@k+1) > tau=0.25, ramping to ceiling=0.9
